strings.string: 在=landmark.nearest=附近一座僻远的书库里，=subject.name=与一群失了舌头的腌鱼人会面，共同写就了为人钟爱的食谱 =object.refname=。

string.ID: The pet finished downloading!
You should view the tooltip before equipping the axe.

strings.string: 装备战斧前，最好先看看它的浮窗说明。

string.ID: The battle axe has better penetration and deals more damage than your dagger.

strings.string: 战斧的穿透比匕首更好，伤害也更高。

string.ID: A battle axe. Get it.
It's a chem cell. It can be used later to power other artifacts you find.

strings.string: 这是一枚化学电池。以后可以用来为你找到的其它器物供能。

string.ID: The bear is dead! Looks like it dropped something, too.

strings.string: 熊死了！看来它还掉了点东西。

string.ID: This is an artifact beyond simple understanding. Try examining it.

strings.string: 这件器物无法凭常识理解。试着检视它。

string.ID: The whole game world is a series of contiguous maps. Our passage continues off screen. Let's follow it. Walk north.

strings.string: 整个游戏世界由一片片相连的地图构成。这条通道在屏幕之外仍在延伸。我们跟上去，向北走。

string.ID: You're ready to continue the journey on your own, but don't hesitate to play the tutorial again if you need a refresher.

strings.string: 你已经可以独自继续旅程了；若需要回顾，随时可以重玩教程。

string.ID: It's quite dangerous to fight this bear in melee combat! Try backing away and using Freezing Ray.

strings.string: 和这头熊近身肉搏相当危险！试着后退，用冰冻射线。

string.ID: It's a bear.
The bear is wounded, but it's tough. This'll be a harder fight.

strings.string: 熊受伤了，但它很结实。这一仗会更难打。

string.ID: The snapjaw is hostile! Let's get ready for a fight.

strings.string: 咬颚兽（Snapjaw）怀有敌意！准备战斗。

string.ID: The snapjaw is hostile! Let's get ready for a fight.

strings.string: 咬颚兽（Snapjaw）怀有敌意！准备战斗。

string.ID: You can attack a hostile creature by moving into its square. This is called {{W|bump attacking}}.

strings.string: 朝敌对生物所在的那格移动即可攻击它。这叫做{{W|撞击攻击}}。

string.ID: It's leather armor. This time, get it instead of equipping it.

strings.string: 这是皮甲。这次把它捡起来，而不是直接装备。

string.ID: This is your equipment and inventory screen. Equipped items on the left, and inventory on the right.

strings.string: 这是你的装备与物品栏界面。左边是已装备的物品，右边是物品栏。

string.ID: There's something else over here.
This water is valuable too. Take it all.
You can name your character or choose Next for a random name.

strings.string: 你可以给角色取名，或选「下一步」随机取名。

string.ID: We're on the surface now. We can walk the whole world this way, or we can access the worldmap to fast travel.

strings.string: 我们现在在地表了。可以就这样一路走过整个世界，也可以打开世界地图快速旅行。

string.ID: A torch. When it's nighttime or when you're underground, you need a torch equipped to see. Select it.

strings.string: 一支火把。到了夜里或身处地下时，得装备火把才看得见。选中它。

string.ID: We're not quite ready to leave yet.

strings.string: 我们还不太适合现在离开。

string.ID: You have no activated abilities.

strings.string: 你没有可主动使用的能力。

string.ID: You freed the Spindle for another's ascent and crossed into Brightsheol.

strings.string: 你释放了纺锤（the Spindle），让另一人得以飞升，随后渡入明暗界（Brightsheol）。

string.ID: You destroyed Resheph to save the burgeoning world but marooned yourself at the North Sheva.

strings.string: 你为拯救初生的世界而毁掉了雷谢夫（Resheph），却把自己困在了北谢瓦。

string.ID: You entered into a covenant with Resheph to help prepare Qud for the Coven's return.

strings.string: 你与雷谢夫（Resheph）立下盟约，协助为女巫会的归来预备卡德（Qud）。

string.ID: You destroyed Resheph and returned to Qud to help garden the burgeoning world.

strings.string: 你毁掉了雷谢夫（Resheph），回到卡德（Qud），为初生的世界耕耘。

string.ID: You rebuked Resheph and returned to Qud to help garden the burgeoning world.

strings.string: 你斥退了雷谢夫（Resheph），回到卡德（Qud），为初生的世界耕耘。

string.ID: You acceded to Resheph's plan to purge the world of higher life in preparation for the Coven's return.

strings.string: 你依从了雷谢夫（Resheph）的计划，为迎接女巫会的归而清除世间的高等生命。

string.ID: You destroyed Resheph and launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars with Barathrum.

strings.string: 你毁掉了雷谢夫（Resheph），与巴拉瑟鲁姆（Barathrum）一同投身尘封的宇宙，往来于群星之间。

string.ID: You destroyed Resheph and launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars.

strings.string: 你毁掉了雷谢夫（Resheph），投身尘封的宇宙，往来于群星之间。

string.ID: You launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars with Barathrum.

strings.string: 你与巴拉瑟鲁姆（Barathrum）一同投身尘封的宇宙，往来于群星之间。

string.ID: You launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars.

strings.string: 你投身尘封的宇宙，往来于群星之间。

strings.string: 你似乎找不到够到=target.the.name=的办法。

string.ID: You feel an uncomfortable pressure across the length of your body.

strings.string: 你感到一阵不适的压力贯穿全身。

string.ID: Your limbs suddenly feel perversely round and bumpy before they shrink back into your body.

strings.string: 你的四肢忽然变得圆鼓鼓、疙疙瘩瘩，随后缩回体内。

string.ID: An abrading force cuts the surfaces of your torso until you feel polished and perfectly smooth.

strings.string: 一股磨蚀之力刮过你的躯干表面，直到你觉得光洁平滑、毫无瑕疵。

string.ID: A quartet of prisms shatter out of you and grow. Each quinfurcates at the tip into five finger prisms.

strings.string: 四道棱晶从你身上迸裂而出并生长。每一道都在末端分成五根棱晶手指。

string.ID:
The bear is dead! Looks like it dropped something, too.
But first, let's use this opportunity to heal.

strings.string:
熊死了！看来它还掉了点东西。
不过先趁这个机会治伤吧。

string.ID:
You regain hitpoints naturally as turns pass. You can pass a few turns by waiting, or if there are no hostile creatures around, you can {{W|rest until healed}}.
Press =commandKey:CmdWaitUntilHealed=

strings.string:
随着回合流逝，生命值会自然恢复。你可以用「等待」度过几个回合；若周围没有敌对生物，还能{{W|休息到痊愈}}。
按 =commandKey:CmdWaitUntilHealed=

string.ID:
You picked up the odd trinket automatically because it is an artifact.

strings.string:
因为那是一件器物，你已经自动把它拾了起来。
按 =commandKey:CmdCharacter= 查看它。

因为那是一件器物，你已经自动把它拾了起来。

You can see a list of points of interest by pressing =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest=.

按 =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest= 可以查看兴趣点列表。
随着你探索更多地地图，这份列表会越来越长。

点击此按钮或按 =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest= 可以查看兴趣点列表。

string.ID:
You'll be able to explore the world freely after the tutorial.
For now, let's visit Joppa.

strings.string:
教程结束后，你就能自由探索这个世界了。
眼下，我们先去约帕（Joppa）吧。

string.ID:
You can look around here just like on a local map.
Use =commandKey:LookDirection=

在这里你也能像在局部地图上一样环视四周。

strings.string:
在这里你也能像在局部地图上一样环视四周。

string.ID:
There's a village to the north called Joppa. Let's go there.
Hold =commandKey:IndicateDirection= towards the north and press =commandKey:Take A Step=.

strings.string:
北边有一座叫约帕（Joppa）的村庄。我们去那儿。
朝北按住 =commandKey:IndicateDirection=，再按 =commandKey:Take A Step=。

string.ID:
There's a village to the north called Joppa. Let's go there.
Press =commandKey:CmdMoveN= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=.

strings.string:
北边有一座叫约帕（Joppa）的村庄。我们去那儿。
按 =commandKey:CmdMoveN= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=。

string.ID:
You can wait a turn for the bear to approach. That way, it won't be in range to attack you when it takes its turn.
Tap =commandKey:Take A Step= without choosing a direction with the stick to pass a turn.

strings.string:
你可以等一回合，让熊自己靠近。这样它行动时就够不到你，无法攻击。
不推摇杆方向、直接点 =commandKey:Take A Step= 即可空过一回合。

string.ID:
You can wait a turn for the bear to approach. That way, it won't be in range to attack you when it takes its turn.
Press =commandKey:CmdWait:allbinds= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction= on your character to pass a turn.

strings.string:
你可以等一回合，让熊自己靠近。这样它行动时就够不到你，无法攻击。
按 =commandKey:CmdWait:allbinds=，或在你自己身上用 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=，即可空过一回合。

string.ID:
You missed, then the bear attacked and missed.
Attack again.

strings.string:
你没打中，接着熊扑过来也没打中。
再攻一次。

string.ID:
This time you hit, but you failed to penetrate the bear's armor.
Then, the bear hit you and DID penetrate your armor. You took 4 damage.

strings.string:
这次你打中了，但没能穿透熊的护甲。
随后熊击中了你，{{R|而且穿透了你的护甲}}。你受到 4 点伤害。

string.ID:
You can pick up things that are in the same space as you.
Press =commandKey:CmdUse=

strings.string:
你可以拾取与你在同一格的东西。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest dialog
string.ID: They are disciples of Barathrum. Mostly they are Urshiib, like their mentor. Mutant albino cave bears. With quills to boot! A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the heart of Qud. He has spent centuries fiddling with the tokens of antiquity in his underground workshops.

strings.string: 他们是巴拉瑟鲁姆（Barathrum）的门徒。大多和他们的导师一样是乌尔希布（Urshiib）——变异的白化洞熊，还长着棘刺！一千年前，巴拉瑟鲁姆与他的亲族越过霍姆斯三角洲，进入卡德（Qud）腹地。此后数百年，他都在地下的工坊里摆弄上古的遗物。

strings.string: 我在地上发现一条脱落的舌头，已感染腐烂：是近期疾病的迹象。

string.ID: I found the discarded husks of the curative yuckwheat plant, a sign of recent illness.

strings.string: 我发现被丢弃的药用辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）外壳，是近期疾病的迹象。

string.ID: I found a few scraps from some kind of leatherworking project, a sign of recent craft.

strings.string: 我发现某件皮革活计剩下的碎料，是近期手工的迹象。

string.ID: This leather bracer has seen some use. Why is it out here?

strings.string: 这只皮护腕用过一阵。它怎么会在这儿？

string.ID: I found a small leatherworking hammer on the paths, a sign of recent craft.

strings.string: 我在路上发现一把小皮匠锤，是近期手工的迹象。

string.ID: I heard the sounds of fighting the other night! I stayed in the next day, so afeared was I.

strings.string: 前天夜里我听到了打斗声！第二天我吓得一整天没出门。

string.ID: I thought I heard splashing from a fight in the marsh grids, but I couldn't find anyone.

strings.string: 我好像听到沼泽格区里有打斗的水声，但过去没找到任何人。

string.ID: I saw a kendren merchant the other day! They were being very sneaky, so I think they were meeting someone in secret! Isn't that interesting?

strings.string: 前几天我看见一个外客（kendren）商人！他们鬼鬼祟祟的，我看是在偷偷见什么人！有意思吧？

string.ID: The faundren heard the voice of a hindren and a kendren discussing goods late at night, indicating recent trade.

strings.string: 方德伦们听到一个欣德伦和一个外客深夜谈论货物，说明近期有交易。

string.ID: I heard a hindren talking about buying and selling to a kendren late at night! I thought that all kendren had to report to Grand-Doe?

strings.string: 我听到一个欣德伦深夜谈着向外客买卖东西！我以为所有外客都得向大母鹿报备？

string.ID: The villagers are on edge due to rumors of sore throats in the village, indicating recent illness.

strings.string: 村里因有人喉咙痛的传言而人心不安，说明近期有疾病。

string.ID: I heard that someone in the village might have a sore throat, so I am staying at least ten handspan away from everyone today.

strings.string: 我听说村里可能有人喉咙痛，所以今天我跟谁都至少隔十拃远。

string.ID: The faundren are complaining about the smell of yuckwheat tea, indicating recent illness.

strings.string: 方德伦在抱怨辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）茶的气味，说明近期有疾病。

string.ID: I smelled yuckwheat tea the other day! That smell is so terrible! Is someone sick?

strings.string: 前几天我闻到了辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）茶的味道！那味儿太糟糕了！是有人病了吗？

string.ID: The scouts report that someone has taken leather from the village stores, indicating recent craft.

strings.string: 斥候报告有人从村中库房取走了皮革，说明近期有手工活。

string.ID: I went to do some repairs to my boots, but someone's been in our stores of boar leather! We have far less than we should.

strings.string: 我去修靴子，结果发现有人动过我们存的野猪皮！剩的比该有的少多了。

string.ID: The scouts heard someone doing work with tools late at night, indicating recent craft.

strings.string: 斥候听到有人深夜用工具干活，说明近期有手工活。

string.ID: I heard someone doing some kind of toolwork during a night watch shift. I didn't interrupt, but it seemed peculiar.

strings.string: 值夜班时我听到有人在摆弄工具。我没去打断，但总觉得蹊跷。

string.ID: I found an empty injector near the Hindriarch's bedroll. Why doesn't anyone know she was sick?

strings.string: 我在女族长（Hindriarch）的铺盖旁发现一支空注射器。为什么没人知道她病了？

string.ID: I found a bloody arrow on the paths of Bey Lah. Its fletching resembles the ones in Hindriarch Keh's quiver.

strings.string: 我在贝拉（Bey Lah）的路上发现一支带血的箭。它的尾羽和女族长凯（Keh）箭袋里的很像。

string.ID: You know, Grand-Doe spent some late nights working on something she wouldn't talk about. I wonder what that was.

strings.string: 你知道，大母鹿有阵子连着熬夜做一样她不肯说的事。我挺好奇那是什么。

string.ID: The faundren claim that Eskhind left the village sporting a poorly-made leather bracer, possibly to conceal Kindrish.

strings.string: 方德伦说，埃斯欣德（Eskhind）离村时戴着一只做工粗糙的皮护腕，也许是为了藏起金德里什（Kindrish）。

string.ID: The faundren tell me that Eskhind's sister had a period of complete silence; she may have been ill.

strings.string: 方德伦告诉我，埃斯欣德的妹妹有段时间完全不说话；她可能病了。

string.ID: You know auntie Eskhind's little sister, Liihart? She's always been quiet, but she didn't talk at all for, uh, two whole weeks before they left!

strings.string: 你认识埃斯欣德姑姑的小妹妹莉莉哈特（Liihart）吧？她一向安静，可他们走之前，呃，她整整两个星期一句话都没说！

string.ID: I found the village stores of Bey Lah untouched; Eskhind must have traded something for her basics.

strings.string: 我发现贝拉的村中库房没被动过；埃斯欣德一定是拿什么换来了她的基本物资。

string.ID: The faundren tell me that Kesehind went quiet for a few weeks, only to become louder than ever again.

strings.string: 方德伦告诉我，凯塞欣德（Kesehind）安静了几周，之后又比谁都聒噪。

string.ID: I found a worn-out bracer abandoned near Kesehind's bedroll.

strings.string: 我在凯塞欣德的铺盖旁发现一只被丢弃的破旧护腕。

string.ID: That's strange. This bracer is heavily worn, but surprisingly clean.

strings.string: 奇怪。这只护腕磨损得很厉害，却干净得出奇。

string.ID: The Bey Lah scouts have had trouble with violent kendren. What if one slipped by?

strings.string: 贝拉的斥候一直受凶暴外客的困扰。要是有哪一个溜进来了呢？

string.ID: The kendren are becoming more brazen in their hostility. I've had to misdirect and fight them off several times this month alone.

strings.string: 外客的敌意越来越放肆。就这个月，我已经不得不引开并击退他们好几回了。

string.ID: The scouts have seen kendren treasure hunters about. That type will take anything not nailed down.

strings.string: 斥候见过外客的寻宝人在附近转悠。那类人凡是没盯住的都会拿走。

string.ID: I came across some kendren who claimed to be treasure hunters. They said that they would pay good water for unique artifacts or treasures.

strings.string: 我碰到几个自称寻宝人的外客。他们说愿意出好水来换独特的器物或珍宝。

string.ID: I've heard that there is an outbreak of glotrot in the kendren villages outside of Bey Lah. Now I want to leave here even less!

strings.string: 我听说贝拉外面的外客村落爆发了舌腐（Glotrot）症。现在我就更不想离开这儿了！

string.ID: I found a set of foreign leatherworking tools on the village paths. A kendren crafter has been here.

strings.string: 我在村道上发现一套外来的皮匠工具。有外客工匠来过这儿。

string.ID: This set of leatherworking tools is shockingly well-made.

strings.string: 这套皮匠工具做工好得惊人。

string.Context: Children of the Tomb Accomplishment - Text
string.ID: You restored functionality to one of the four strange entities in the Tomb.

strings.string: 你让陵墓中四个奇异实体之一恢复了功能。

string.Context: Village apothecary conversation intro low tier
string.ID: I've the cure for what ails you.~You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.~Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.~"Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: 你哪儿不舒服，我有药。~你看上去气色不好。饮食里得多点辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）和蜂蜜。~觉得不舒服就用辟瘟麦做饭。病发现得够早，就能杀掉。~「止痛，也乱神。」嚼巫木树皮时小心点。

string.ID: You discover the abandoned village of =villageName=.
You discover the village of =villageName=.
I know a lot about the town!

strings.string: 这镇上的事我知道得多！

string.ID: I know a lot about the town!

strings.string: 这镇上的事我知道得多！

string.ID: You're in a pocket dimension with no worldmap.

strings.string: 你身处一个没有世界地图的袖珍维度。

string.ID: You feel some ambient astral friction here.

strings.string: 你在此感到周遭有些星界摩擦。

string.ID: The ceiling collapses and rocks come pouring in!

strings.string: 天花板塌了，石块倾泻而下！

string.ID: The whole compound rumbles around you.

strings.string: 整座院落在你四周隆隆作响。

string.ID: The walls creak, loose objects skid about, and dust is stirred up in iridescent clouds.

strings.string: 墙壁吱嘎作响，松动的东西四处滑撞，尘土被搅成一片片虹彩的云。

string.Context: ZoneManager zone build error retry message
string.ID: This zone isn't building properly. Do you want to force it to stop and build immediately?

strings.string: 这个区域没有正常构建。要强制它停止并立即构建吗？

string.ID: There was an issue building this zone. Automatically report it to us?

strings.string: 构建这个区域时出了问题。要自动向我们报告吗？

string.ID: Huh, you somehow destroyed the battle axe. Let's move on.

strings.string: 咦，你竟然把战斧毁掉了。我们继续吧。

string.ID:
Let's take another look at weapon stats. Next to the {{c|→}} is 5. That means you'll usually penetrate the armor of a creature with AV equal to 5.
You can penetrate armor multiple times, though, and each time you penetrate, you deal the weapon's damage.
Let's equip it.

strings.string:
我们再看看武器属性。{{c|→}}旁边是 5。这意味着你通常能穿透护甲值（AV）为 5 的生物的护甲。
不过护甲可以被多次穿透，每穿透一次就结算一次武器伤害。
我们把它装备上吧。

string.ID: Looks like there was some sort of battle to the north. Let's grab the gear that was left behind.

strings.string: 北边似乎发生过一场战斗。我们去把留下的装备捡起来。

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdCharacter=

strings.string:
我们看看装备界面。
按 =commandKey:CmdCharacter=

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdEquipment=

strings.string:
我们看看装备界面。
按 =commandKey:CmdEquipment=

string.ID: Let's move on. Keep exploring.

Oh! it looks like Warden Yrame killed Mehmet. Why, you ask?
Well, named creatures who you can perform the water ritual with, like Mehmet, generate with dynamic faction relationships. In your game, Mehmet must have been hated by the Fellowship of Wardens for some reason.

strings.string:
哦！看起来看守亚拉梅（Warden Yrame）杀了梅赫梅特（Mehmet）。你问为什么？
嗯，像梅赫梅特这样能与之举行水之仪式的具名生物，其派系关系是动态生成的。在你这局里，梅赫梅特多半因为某种原因被看守同盟所憎恨。

string.ID:
You have a few options now. You can roll with it and continue in this world where Mehmet's been revenge-slain. The early game will be a bit harder, but the main quest is not impacted.
You can start over and play the tutorial again, for the "normal" ending, which you were about to reach.
Or, since you were near the end anyway, you can start a new game and begin your journey proper!

strings.string:
你现在有几个选择。你可以顺势接受，在这个梅赫梅特已被复仇杀害的世界里继续。前期会稍难些，但主线不受影响。
你也可以重开并再玩一次教程，走你原本即将抵达的「正常」结局。
或者，既然你本来就快到尾声了，不妨直接开新档，正式开始你的旅程！

string.ID: Let's take a look at the bear before we continue.

strings.string: 继续之前，我们先看看这头熊。

string.ID:
Oh! Another creature. Let's look at it more closely.
When you come across something new, it's always a good idea to inspect it.

strings.string:
哦！又一只生物。我们仔细看看它。
遇到新东西时，检视一下总是好主意。

string.ID:
Let's try using an ability. Look at your ability bar. Let's start sprinting.

我们试试使用能力。看你的能力栏。先来冲刺吧。
用 =commandKey:Next Ability= 和 =commandKey:Previous Ability= 选中它，再按 =commandKey:Use Ability=。

string.ID: Let's try using an ability. Look at your ability bar. Let's start sprinting. You can click the button or hit the hotkey =commandKey:CmdAbility1=.

strings.string: 我们试试使用能力。看你的能力栏。先来冲刺吧。你可以点那个按钮，或按快捷键 =commandKey:CmdAbility1=。

string.ID: Huh, you somehow destroyed the leather armor. Let's move on.

strings.string: 咦，你竟然把皮甲毁掉了。我们继续吧。

strings.string: 我们往洞穴深处继续探索。

我们往洞穴深处继续探索。

string.ID:
Oh, you died. That's okay. It's a very common occurance in the world of Qud.

The good news is: you get to make a whole new character! Now with a little more knowledge than you had before.

string.ID: Keep moving forward.
Hold on, we want to show you the tooltip compare feature.

strings.string: 等一下，我们想给你看看浮窗对比功能。

string.ID: Equip the battle axe.
Press =commandKey:GamepadAlt= + =commandKey:Take A Step= to view the tooltip.

strings.string: 按 =commandKey:GamepadAlt= + =commandKey:Take A Step= 查看浮窗。

string.ID: Mouse over the battle axe and hover or press {{W|Alt}} to view the tooltip.

strings.string: 把鼠标移到战斧上悬停，或按 {{W|Alt}} 查看浮窗。

string.ID: Equip the battle axe since it's better than your dagger.

strings.string: 战斧比你的匕首好，装备它。

string.ID:
Select the Inventory && Equipment tab.
You can use =commandKey:Page Left= and =commandKey:Page Right= to navigate between tabs.

strings.string:
选择「物品 && 装备」页签。
你可以用 =commandKey:Page Left= 和 =commandKey:Page Right= 在页签间切换。

string.ID: What's that???

Select the Inventory && Equipment tab.
You can use =commandKey:Page Left= and =commandKey:Page Right= to navigate between tabs.

strings.string:
选择「物品 && 装备」页签。
你可以用 =commandKey:Page Left= 和 =commandKey:Page Right= 在页签间切换。

string.ID: Choose Mehmet.

And so Warden Yrame took her revenge. In Qud, sometimes even our best efforts at providing a safe starter village are foiled by the simulation!
What a charmed run! It's quite rare for this to happen, but now you get to see this hidden section of the tutorial. Good job.

strings.string:
看守亚拉梅（Warden Yrame）就这样报了仇。在卡德（Qud），有时我们为新手村营造的种种安全保障，也会被模拟机制搅乱！
真是场奇特的旅程！这种情况相当罕见，而现在你有幸看到了教程里这段隐藏内容。干得好。

string.ID:
Whatever you choose, good luck, and feel free to return here for a refresher.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
无论你选什么，祝你好运；需要温习时随时回到这里。
活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Quetzal! That's all for the tutorial, friend.
We just scratched the very tip of the surface. Quests, secrets, leveling up, physics, reputation, limbs... we leave that for you to discover.

strings.string:
绿咬鹃！教程就到这里了，朋友。
我们才刚蹭到最表面的一层。任务、秘密、升级、物理、声望、肢体……那些留给你自己去发现。

string.ID: Live and drink.
Joppa is a village. Everything you learned in the cave applies here too. Villages are like caves with very high roofs.

strings.string: 约帕（Joppa）是一座村庄。你在洞穴里学到的一切在这里同样适用。村庄就像屋顶极高的洞穴。

string.ID:
Ascend.
Press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.

strings.string:
上行。
你可以点这个按钮，或按 =commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

string.ID: Finally, a staircase. Walk over to it.
Keep exploring.

Descend.
Press =commandKey:CmdMoveD=.

Descend.
You can click this button or press =commandKey:CmdMoveD=.

strings.string:
下行。
你可以点这个按钮，或按 =commandKey:CmdMoveD=。

string.ID: Wait for the bear to take a step towards you.
Make sure the bear is in the path of your freezing ray.

strings.string: 确保熊在你的冰冻射线路径上。

string.ID: What's that??? Some sort of creature. Take a closer look at it.

strings.string: 那是什么？？？某种生物。仔细看看它。

string.ID: Keep moving down the passage...
Inspect the bear.
Use =commandKey:LookDirection= to look at the bear.
Press =commandKey:CmdLook= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract= the bear.

strings.string: 按 =commandKey:CmdLook=，或用 =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract= 点击那头熊。

string.ID:
Look view lets you look around and investigate your surroundings.
Move the cursor to the bear.

strings.string:
「观察」视图让你环视四周、探查环境。
把光标移到熊身上。

string.ID: Bump attack the bear.
Sprinting doubles your movespeed but ends if you make an attack. Let's sprint back down the corridor to put some distance between us and the bear.

strings.string: 冲刺会让移动速度翻倍，但一旦发动攻击就会中断。我们冲刺退回走廊，拉开与熊的距离。

string.ID:
Every character has Sprint, but most of your abilities are determined by traits like your mutations. You have Freezing Ray, so you can shoot frost out of your hands.
Select it with =commandKey:Next Ability= and =commandKey:Previous Ability= then press =commandKey:Use Ability=.

strings.string:
每个角色都有「冲刺」，但你大部分能力取决于变异之类的特质。你有「冰冻射线」，能从手中射出寒霜。
用 =commandKey:Next Ability= 和 =commandKey:Previous Ability= 选中它，再按 =commandKey:Use Ability=。

string.ID:
Every character has Sprint, but most of your abilities are determined by traits like your mutations. You have Freezing Ray, so you can shoot frost out of your hands. Select it.
Press =commandKey:CmdAbility2=

strings.string:
每个角色都有「冲刺」，但你大部分能力取决于变异之类的特质。你有「冰冻射线」，能从手中射出寒霜。选中它。
按 =commandKey:CmdAbility2=

string.ID: What's that??? Some sort of creature. Take a closer look at it.

strings.string: 那是什么？？？某种生物。仔细看看它。

string.ID: Before you move on, you should loot the corpse of the snapjaw.

strings.string: 继续之前，你应该搜刮咬颚兽（Snapjaw）的尸体。

string.ID: Take a look at the snapjaw before we continue.

strings.string: 继续之前，我们先看看这只咬颚兽（Snapjaw）。

string.ID: Looking at a creature shows its description and some other important details. Every object in the world can be looked at.

strings.string: 观察一个生物会显示它的描述和一些重要细节。世界上的每件物品都能被观察。

string.ID: Inspect the snapjaw.
Use =commandKey:LookDirection= to look at the snapjaw.

strings.string: 用 =commandKey:LookDirection= 观察那只咬颚兽（Snapjaw）。

string.ID: Press =commandKey:CmdLook= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract= the snapjaw.

strings.string: 按 =commandKey:CmdLook=，或用 =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract= 点击那只咬颚兽（Snapjaw）。

string.ID:
Look view lets you look around and investigate your surroundings.
Move the cursor to the snapjaw.

strings.string:
「观察」视图让你环视四周、探查环境。
把光标移到咬颚兽（Snapjaw）身上。

string.ID:
All actions are turn-based, meaning you take a turn, then other creatures take a turn. For the most part, creatures won't act until you do.
If you ever get panicked, just slow down and consider your next move. There's no rush.

strings.string:
所有行动都是回合制的：你走一回合，然后其它生物走一回合。多数情况下，你不行动，生物也不会行动。
要是慌了，就慢下来想想下一步。不用急。

string.ID: Take a step toward the snapjaw.

Whew! You killed the snapjaw and earned some experience. It looks like they dropped a piece of equipment, too.
Press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction.

strings.string:
呼！你干掉了咬颚兽（Snapjaw），还赚了些经验。看来它还掉了一件装备。
按 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom=，然后选一个方向。

string.ID:
Whew! You killed the snapjaw and earned some experience. It looks like they dropped a piece of equipment, too.
Press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction or press =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract=.

strings.string:
呼！你干掉了咬颚兽（Snapjaw），还赚了些经验。看来它还掉了一件装备。
按 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= 选一个方向，或按 =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract=。

string.ID: Let's equip it.

Select the Inventory && Equipment tab.
You can use =commandKey:Page Left= and =commandKey:Page Right= to navigate between tabs.

strings.string:
选择「物品 && 装备」页签。
你可以用 =commandKey:Page Left= 和 =commandKey:Page Right= 在页签间切换。

string.ID:
Sometimes squares have multiple items in them.
To see everything in a space, press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction.

strings.string:
有时一格里有好几件物品。
要看清某格里的一切，按 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom=，然后选一个方向。

string.ID:
Sometimes squares have multiple items in them.
To see everything in a space, press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction or press =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteractAll=.

strings.string:
有时一格里有好几件物品。
要看清某格里的一切，按 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= 选一个方向，或按 =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteractAll=。

string.ID:
Whoever this was, they had some books. All books can be read in game.
Books with {{Y|white}} titles are generated and usually contain nonsense, but the nonsense can occasionally be useful.
Books with {{W|gold}} titles are more valuable: they are handwritten by in-world beings and contain interesting takes on the world.

strings.string:
不管这人是谁，他有些书。所有书都能在游戏里读。
标题为{{Y|白色}}的书是随机生成的，内容通常胡说八道，但偶尔也有用处。
标题为{{W|金色}}的书更珍贵：它们由世界中的存在亲手写就，包含对世界的有趣见解。

string.ID: Get the books.

Welcome to the Caves of Qud tutorial. We'll just be scratching the surface here, learning enough of the basics to help you get your footing.
In Caves of Qud, you play as a mutated human or true kin.
For the tutorial, we're picking mutated human.

strings.string:
欢迎来到《卡德洞窟》（Caves of Qud）教程。我们只蹭蹭表面，学点基础，帮你站稳脚跟。
在《卡德洞窟》里，你扮演变异人或真正子嗣（True Kin）。
教程里我们选变异人。

string.ID:
Character creation is a deep and sometimes long process. We included some preset builds to help you get started. After the tutorial, you can try another build, or make a character from scratch. (The recommended way! Once you get your footing.)
For now, pick the marsh taur.

strings.string:
角色创建是个深奥、有时还挺长的过程。我们准备了一些预设构建帮你上手。教程结束后，你可以试试别的构建，或从零捏一个角色。（站稳脚跟之后，这是推荐做法！）
眼下，选沼泽牛头人（marsh taur）。

string.ID: On the 30th of Kisu Ux, you scuttle down a dark shaft at the edge of a sunken trade path and arrive at a caravanserai. It's powdered in salt and dust from across the ribbon of time.

strings.string: 基苏·乌克斯（Kisu Ux）月 30 日，你沿一条沉没商路边缘的黑暗竖井爬下，来到一处商旅客栈。它覆满盐与来自时间之带各处的尘土。

string.ID: Tastes good.
But first, you just became hungry. You need to eat.

strings.string: 不过先等等，你刚饿了。得吃点东西。

string.ID: Use the campfire.
Make camp.

Not much of a talker. But that's not true for everyone. As long as a creature isn't hostile, you can try to chat with them.
Let's see what the beetle has for trade.

strings.string:
它不太爱说话。不过并非人人都这样。只要生物没有敌意，你就可以试着跟它聊聊。
看看甲虫有什么可交易的。

string.ID: Complete the trade.
Before you move on, you should equip yourself from the nearby chest.

strings.string: 继续之前，你该从附近的箱子里给自己弄点装备。

string.ID: Equip the dagger too.
TUTORIAL GUIDE
[=commandKey:Accept=] Continue

Note: Playing a saved game in a language other than that game's original language will result in partial and incomplete translations.
Changing language requires restart.

strings.string:
注意：以非该存档原始语言来游玩存档，会导致翻译不完整、有缺漏。
切换语言需要重启。

string.ID:
Next time, if you want a more forgiving mode of play, try Roleplay, which lets you checkpoint at settlements.
Or try Wander mode, where most creatures are neutral to you and you gain experience via discovery instead of killing.
Or keep playing Classic if the challenge appeals to you and you'd like to explore a breadth of character types.

strings.string:
下次若想玩得宽容些，可以试试「角色扮演」模式，它允许你在聚落设置检查点。
或者试试「漫游」模式，那里大多数生物对你中立，你靠探索而非杀戮来获取经验。
如果你喜欢挑战、想遍尝各类角色，也可以继续玩「经典」模式。

string.ID:
Whatever you choose next, feel free to return to the tutorial if you need a refresher.
Live and drink, friend!

strings.string:
无论你接下来选什么，需要温习时随时回到教程。
活下去，喝足水，朋友！

string.ID: In %=year=%, Rebekah died of glotrot, and on her deathbed Resheph forgave her and absolved her of sin. He allowed her to be buried in the village of Ezra, outside the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters and beneath the shadow of the Spindle.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，蕾贝卡死于舌腐（Glotrot）症。弥留之际，雷谢夫原谅了她，赦免了她的罪。他准许她葬在埃兹拉村，就在食者（the Eaters）之墓的大门之外、纺锤（the Spindle）的阴影之下。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph appointed Rebekah administrator of =region=. She tendered alms for the sick in his name.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，雷谢夫任命蕾贝卡为=region=的执事。她以他的名义为病者施舍。

string.ID: Acting against a prohibition on the practice of worshipping the stars, Resheph led an army to the gates of Omonporch. There he defeated his brothers in battle and liberated its citizens, and they crowned him the sultan of Qud.

strings.string: 为反抗禁止拜星的禁令，雷谢夫率军来到奥蒙波奇城下。他在那里于阵前击败了自己的兄弟，解放了城中百姓；众人遂加冕他为卡德（Qud）的苏丹。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Rebekah betrayed Resheph by stealing the Mark of Death from the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters. In punishment, Resheph excommunicated her from the sultanate.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，蕾贝卡背叛了雷谢夫，从食者（the Eaters）之墓的大门上盗走了死亡之印。作为惩罚，雷谢夫将她逐出苏丹国。

string.ID: One starry evening, a babe was found swaddled with its mouth full of circuits by a group of baetyls in Red Rock. They took him into their fold and fostered him, and he became known as Resheph, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls.

strings.string: 一个繁星之夜，红岩的一群贝提尔发现一个襁褓中的婴儿，满嘴都是电路。它们收留并抚养了他，他从此名为雷谢夫——贝提尔的盘羊羔。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph cleansed the marshlands of the plagues of the Gyre and taught Abram to sow watervine along its fertile tracks.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，雷谢夫涤净了沼地中环流（Gyre）的瘟疫，并教亚伯兰沿着肥沃的轨迹播种水藤。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph closed the gates to the Tomb of the Eaters, abdicated the throne, and dissolved the sultanate in order to lift the curse of the Gyre.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，为解除环流（Gyre）的诅咒，雷谢夫封闭了食者（the Eaters）之墓的大门，退下王位，解散了苏丹国。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph, the Above, Ghost-in-Cerulean, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls, died of natural causes. He was 216 years old.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，雷谢夫——在上者、蔚蓝之鬼、贝提尔的盘羊羔——寿终正寝，享年 216 岁。

string.ID: After conferring with mysterious strangers, Resheph convinced them to help him found a harborage for the purpose of receiving visitors from across the clustered cosmos. They named it Starfarer's Quay.

strings.string: 雷谢夫与一群神秘的异乡人商议之后，说服他们帮他建一处港湾，用以接待来自群聚宇宙各处的访客。他们将其命名为星旅者码头。

string.ID: In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the first triad of plagues afflicted the land. The water was poisoned with salt, girshlings ravaged the fruit and wheat, and tongues rotted away in the mouths of kith and kin. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，环流（Gyre）扩张，第一组三重瘟疫降临大地。水被盐毒化，吉尔什灵毁坏了果实与麦子，亲族口中的舌头烂掉。雷谢夫行走在铬拱之下，医治病人。

string.ID: In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the second triad of plagues afflicted the land. The legs of kith and kin annealed to iron, darkness bloomed from the earth, and the svardym blackened the sky. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，环流（Gyre）扩张，第二组三重瘟疫降临大地。亲族的双腿与铁熔合，黑暗从地里绽出，斯瓦迪姆遮蔽了天空。雷谢夫行走在铬拱之下，医治病人。

string.ID: At Starfarer's Quay, Resheph consulted with mysterious strangers and learned the secret of the Gyre. By cause of the misdeeds of the elder saads and sultans, star beings had levied a curse on Qud. Resheph vowed to make right from this wrong and redeem our doomed world.

strings.string: 在星旅者码头，雷谢夫与一群神秘的异乡人商议，得知了环流（Gyre）的秘密。由于先代萨德（Saad）与苏丹的恶行，星辰之民向卡德（Qud）降下了诅咒。雷谢夫立誓要矫正这一冤屈，救赎我们这注定毁灭的世界。

string.ID: While traveling near Bethesda Susa, Resheph lost control of his chariot and drove it off a cliff. Luckily, a local physician named Rebekah came to his rescue. Moved by her kindness, Resheph enrolled at a nearby hospice as her apprentice.

strings.string: 在贝塞斯达苏萨附近出行时，雷谢夫的战车失控冲下悬崖。幸而当地一位名叫蕾贝卡的医师赶来相救。雷谢夫感其善意，进了附近一家济养院做她的学徒。

string.ID: In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the final plague afflicted the land. The Girsh Nephilim rose from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slouched toward Qud to eat its young. Resheph rose to meet them in battle and cast them back.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，环流（Gyre）扩张，最后的瘟疫降临大地。吉尔什拿非利从月阶的摇篮中升起，拖着身子朝卡德（Qud）而来，要吞食它的子嗣。雷谢夫挺身迎战，将它们击退。

string.ID: While traveling alone through the Rust Wells, Resheph came across a trove of gleaming stars in a bottle. From that day forth, he always kept some stardust on his person.

strings.string: 雷谢夫独自穿行锈井时，遇到一瓶闪闪发亮的星星。从那天起，他身上总带着一些星尘。

string.ID: At twilight in the shadow of the Spindle, the people of Omonporch saw an image on the horizon that looked like a ghost bathed in cerulean. It was Resheph, and after he came and left Omonporch, the people built a monument to him, and thenceforth called him Ghost-in-Cerulean.

strings.string: 暮色中，在纺锤（the Spindle）的影子里，奥蒙波奇的百姓望见地平线上有一个影像，宛如浸在蔚蓝中的幽灵。那正是雷谢夫；他来而复去之后，百姓为他立碑，从此称他为「蔚蓝之鬼」。

string.ID: Someone left a sealed merchant's waterskin on the paths, a sign of recent trade.

strings.string: 有人在路上落下一只封着蜡的商人水囊，说明近期有交易。

string.ID: Someone dropped a copper nugget on the paths, a sign of recent trade.

strings.string: 有人在路上掉了一块铜块，说明近期有交易。

string.ID: Someone discarded a worn but still functional leather bracer on the paths, a sign of recent craft.

strings.string: 有人在路上丢了一只破旧但仍能用的皮护腕，说明近期有手工活。

string.ID: Whoever stole Kindrish didn't steal from the village stores. These chests are simply packed with dried lah, vinewafers, and waterskins.

strings.string: 偷走金德里什（Kindrish）的人并没有从村里的库房下手。这些箱子只塞满了干拉花瓣、藤片和水囊。

string.ID: Eskhind is favoring a leg.

strings.string: 埃斯欣德一条腿不太敢使劲。

string.ID: Just before auntie Eskhind left the village, I saw her wearing a new bracer. It looked terrible!

strings.string: 埃斯欣德姑姑离村前不久，我看见她戴着一只新护腕。那可太难看了！

string.ID: Apparently, the Hindriarch isolated herself to work on a mystery project, possibly to hide Kindrish.

strings.string: 据说女族长把自己关了起来，在做一个神秘的东西，也许是为了藏起金德里什（Kindrish）。

string.ID: Rumor has it that the village is flush with water, perhaps because Keh made a big trade.

strings.string: 传闻村里水多得用不完，也许是因为凯做了一笔大交易。

string.ID: By the Eaters, how prosperous we've been. I've never seen the village so flush with fresh water.

strings.string: 食者（the Eaters）在上，我们可真富足。我从没见过村里有这么多清水。

string.ID: Theft by kendren is very common during an outbreak of disease like the one the villagers describe.

strings.string: 像村民描述的这种疫病暴发期间，外客行窃非常常见。

string.ID: Rumor has it that Kesehind has always worn hand-me-down armor, but he was recently seen with a brand new set.

strings.string: 传闻凯塞欣德一直穿别人传下来的护甲，但最近有人看见他换了一整套全新的。

string.ID: For weeks and weeks, Kesehind was so quiet, but now he's talking more than ever! He's so loud!

strings.string: 一连好几周，凯塞欣德都特别安静，可现在他比谁都话多！吵得要命！

string.ID: Did you see Kesehind's armor? He always used to wear hand-me-downs from the scouts, but what he's wearing now looks brand new!

strings.string: 你看见凯塞欣德的护甲了吗？他一向穿侦察兵传下来的旧货，可他现在这身看着是全新的！

string.ID: One villager was frightened by sounds of fighting at night, indicating recent violence.

strings.string: 一名村民被夜里的打斗声吓到，说明近期有暴力事件。

string.ID: One of Bey Lah's scouts heard a fight in the watervine paddies, indicating recent violence.

strings.string: 贝拉的一名侦察兵在水藤田里听到一场打斗，说明近期有暴力事件。

string.ID: Faundren saw a merchant from outside the village sneaking around, indicating recent trade.

strings.string: 方德伦看到一个村外来商在附近鬼鬼祟祟，说明近期有交易。

string.ID: Is that a patch of hindren fur? There's blood on it...

strings.string: 那是一片欣德伦的毛皮吗？上面有血……

string.ID: How odd, this watervine is stained red with blood.

strings.string: 真奇怪，这株水藤被血染红了。

string.ID: Someone has left a small hammer on the path.

strings.string: 有人在路上落下一把小锤子。

string.ID: How odd, the broken haft of a weapon, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 真奇怪，一截断掉的武器柄，说明近期有暴力事件。

string.ID: Hmm, this waterskin is still sealed with wax.
How odd, there's a copper nugget just lying on the ground.

strings.string: 真奇怪，地上就那么躺着一块铜块。

string.ID: How odd, some discarded chaff from a yuckwheat plant.

strings.string: 真奇怪，一些被丢弃的恶麦壳。

string.ID: How odd, someone dropped some scraps of cut leather here.

strings.string: 真奇怪，有人在这里掉了一些裁下的皮料碎屑。

string.ID: Eskhind is showing signs of a leg injury. Perhaps she was in a fight.

strings.string: 埃斯欣德显出一条腿受伤的迹象。也许她打过一场。

string.ID: Eskhind appears to be favoring a leg, though she has concealed any injury.

strings.string: 埃斯欣德似乎一条腿不太敢使劲，不过她把伤藏起来了。

string.ID: Hmm. This injector has been used.
Why, this arrow is covered with blood!
Kesehind tried to clean blood off his armor, but missed a spot.

strings.string: 凯塞欣德试图擦掉护甲上的血，但漏了一处。

string.ID: Carmine streaks on Kesehind's armor suggest that he tried and failed to wipe away spilled blood.

strings.string: 凯塞欣德护甲上的暗红条纹说明他曾想擦去溅上的血，却没擦干净。

string.ID: Kesehind's armor has bloodstains that he failed to remove.

strings.string: 凯塞欣德的护甲上有他没擦掉的血迹。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest dialog
DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest restart dialog
string.ID:
Are you seeking more work, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Recently we came into possession of a data disk bearing a peculiar stamp and encoded with a strange signal. The signal means nothing to us, but there's a sect of tinkers called the Barathrumites who might be interested in it. They are friends to our village and often trade for the scrap we tow out of the earth. Would you carry the disk to their enclave at Grit Gate, along the western rim of the jungle? In exchange for the delivery, you might seek an apprenticeship with them.
If you are interested, take the disk now, and travel safely.

strings.string:
=player.formalAddressTerm=，你还在找活干吗？我们最近得到一张数据盘，上面盖着奇特的印记，编码着一段古怪的信号。这信号对我们毫无意义，但有一支自称巴拉斯鲁米特的修补匠教派也许对它感兴趣。他们是我们村的朋友，常来收购我们从地里拖出来的废料。你愿意把这张盘送到他们在丛林西缘砂石之门的驻地吗？作为送件的回报，你或许能求个学徒身份。
若你有意，现在就拿走这张盘，路上小心。

string.ID: =spice:instancesOf.speakTo.!random|capitalize= =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers=.
Qud was once called Salum.
In the mystic air of Jeweled Dusk, a circle of farmers clasped hands and sheathed a vinereaper in the moistened soil. From then on, the villagers of Joppa were known as the people of the vine.

strings.string: 在珠光暮色的神秘气息中，一圈农夫手挽着手，把一把割藤刀插进湿润的泥土。从那以后，约帕（Joppa）的村民便被称为藤之民。

string.ID: In 979, Nuntu, the legendary albino ape, grew tired of bludgeoning things to death and journeyed to a root-strangled place on the River Svy. There he came upon Kyakukya and its inhabitants. The villagers of Kyakukya asked Nuntu to employ his magisterial skills and lead the village.

strings.string: 979 年，传奇的白化猿努图厌倦了用钝器把东西打死，于是踏上了前往斯维河畔一处被根系缠绕之地的旅程。他在那里遇到了卡库基亚及其居民。卡库基亚的村民请努图施展他的统御之才，来领导这座村庄。

string.ID: Under the Beetle Moon, folks settled here to gather goods of passage for Ape Saad Oboroqoru, and so Kyakukya was founded.

strings.string: 在甲虫月之下，人们在此定居，为猿神萨德（Saad）奥博罗库鲁收集过路货物，卡库基亚由此建立。

string.ID: Centuries after the height of the Gyre, the svardym Goek, Mak, and Geeub met the galgal Many Eyes while languishing inside of a reef sponge. Together they founded the Yd Freehold to live out the rest of their lives.

strings.string: 环流（Gyre）鼎盛的数百年后，斯瓦迪姆人戈克、马克和格乌布在礁海绵中苟延残喘时，遇到了加尔加人「众目」。他们一同创立了伊德自由领，以度余生。

string.ID: In 901, the villagers of the Yd Freehold and its founders abolished all forms of hierarchy from their settlement. The two pillars of civic life in the Freehold thus became anarchy and authenticity.

strings.string: 901 年，伊德自由领的村民与其创立者废除了聚居地中一切形式的等级制。自由领公民生活的两大支柱于是成了无政府状态与率真。

string.ID: < =commandKeyShort:Page Left= =prevPage= | =nextPage= =commandKeyShort:Page Right= >
Are you Vivira? Zothom sent me.

strings.string: 你是薇薇拉吗？佐托姆让我来的。

string.ID: You are friendlier than most turrets.
What is this place?
Farewell, Lightspitter.

{{emote|*crackle, crackle*}}-othom? My sympathies.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= of course welcome here, wayfarer. Speak to Agyra an =ifplayerplural:ye need:thou needest= aught, as ey delighteth in hospitality.

strings.string:
{{emote|*噼啪，噼啪*}}-托姆？我深表同情。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=当然受欢迎，旅人。若=ifplayerplural:你们:你=有所需，就去同阿吉拉说，伊好客成性。

string.ID: Why are you offering me sympathies?

strings.string: 你为何要对我表示同情？

string.ID: What is "here"?
You're much nicer than most turrets I meet.

strings.string: 你比我见过的多数炮塔都好得多。

string.ID: I see. Farewell.
You're rather civil for a turret.

strings.string: 作为炮塔，你算相当有礼了。

string.ID: What is this place?
Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

strings.string: 活下去，永不生锈，薇薇拉。

string.ID:
So I am told. I have never had the pleasure nor displeasure to meet another turret. I know only my friends here, who uplifted me by chance and cared for me by choice.
Wer't not for my shape, I wouldst be little different from other mopango.

strings.string:
别人是这么说的。我从未有幸——也从未不幸——遇见过另一座炮塔。我只认得此处的朋友：他们偶然将我扶起，又出于选择照料我。
若不是我这副形貌，我与别的莫潘戈本无多少分别。

string.ID: What is "here"?
What are mopango?
I see. Farewell.

=ifplayerplural:Ye know:Thou knowest= surely that this is the Tomb of the Eaters, but behind me lieth nestled a settlement occupied by the watchers of the tomb, a small coterie of mopango.
An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= know more of the settlement, =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must ask the watcher named Agyra residing within. Ey loveth the sharing of knowledge.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=定然知晓，此处是食者（the Eaters）之墓；但在我身后，静静坐落着一处由守墓者占据的聚落——一小群莫潘戈。
若=ifplayerplural:你们:你=想多了解那处聚落，就得去问居于其中的那位名叫阿吉拉的看守。伊爱与人分享知识。

string.ID: You're much nicer than most turrets I meet.

strings.string: 你比我见过的多数炮塔都好得多。

string.ID: What are mopango?
I see. Farewell.

Mopango are witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. We seek peace and harmony through understanding the Kasaphescence and Her many children. We nonetheless eschew conformity, and each of us seeketh a personal credo by which we livest our lives.
But I am a poor teacher. Speak to Agyra, and =ifplayerplural:ye shall:thou shalt= gain better understanding.

strings.string:
莫潘戈是往昔的见证者，也是未来的牧人。我们通过理解卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）与其众多子嗣，寻求和平与和谐。但我们仍拒斥千篇一律；我们每个人都在寻觅一条属于自己的信条，并依之而活。
可我算不上好老师。去同阿吉拉说吧，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=会有更好的理解。

string.ID: Do you have a personal credo?
I thank you. Farewell.

I do.
"Form needeth not follow function."
What does that mean?
What is this place?
You're very thoughtful, as turrets go.

strings.string: 就炮塔而言，你很有思想。

string.ID: Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

strings.string: 活下去，永不生锈，薇薇拉。

string.ID:
{{emote|*BEEP*}}
Credos hath no inherent meaning that one may so simply define. So =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest=: asking the meaning of a credo is considered impolite among mopango.
I apologize.
That's ridiculous.
Very well.
All is forgiven, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

strings.string: 一切都已原谅，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我并不生=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的气。

string.ID: You're rather civil for a turret.

strings.string: 作为炮塔，你算相当有礼了。

string.ID: What is this place?
Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

strings.string: 活下去，永不生锈，薇薇拉。

string.ID: =player.OffspringTerm=, who are you?
Stay safe, =name=. Please.
Live and drink, Hortensa.

=name=, you are back! I feared we would lose you in the Tomb, but you look better than well. Perhaps I should have had greater faith, or at least less worry.
Have you visited Barathrum's workshop, by the by? Klanq and Q Girl await you there.

strings.string:
=name=，你回来了！我原怕我们会把你丢在那座墓里，可你气色好得不能再好。或许我本该更有信心，至少少操些心。
对了，你去过巴拉瑟鲁姆的工坊了吗？克兰克和 Q女郎在那儿等你。

string.ID: I have.
Not yet.
Hie there now. Being tardy with Klanq carries risk, not so much from its offense as from its idle curiosity.

strings.string: 哎，这就去吧。让克兰克久等是有风险的——风险倒不在它生气，而在它闲得发慌的好奇心。

string.ID: Very well. Live and drink.

I am further relieved to know of another perspective looking upon this work. Klanq's presence here is vital, but it discomfits me: I cannot help but consider the introduction of chaos to an already chaotic endeavor to be a... conflagratory strategy.

strings.string: 知道还有另一双眼睛在审视这项工作，我更安心了。克兰克在此不可或缺，可它让我不安：我总忍不住觉得，往一桩本就混乱的事业里再引进混乱，是一种……纵火的策略。

string.ID: I will exercise my best judgement. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会尽力做出最好的判断。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I drink in the sight of you, cub. Thank you for keeping safe.

strings.string: 看着你，我就心满意足，孩子。谢谢你平安无事。

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必须经由食者（the Eaters）之墓进入明暗界（Brightsheol）。

string.ID: Drink deeply of life, Hortensa. Let's talk.

strings.string: 尽情畅饮生命吧，霍滕萨。我们聊聊。

string.ID: You too. Live and drink.

... I do not like this.
I know you will go. Please take care where you dig; mopango wanderers say the hot blood of Eater artifice yet runs in the guts of that place.

strings.string:
……我不喜欢这事。
我知道你一定会去。挖的时候千万当心；莫潘戈的游荡者说，那地方的脏腑里，食者（the Eaters）机巧的热血仍在奔流。

string.ID: I thank you.
Drink deeply of life, =player.offspringTerm=. Are you finding your way?

strings.string: 尽情畅饮生命吧，=player.offspringTerm=。你找到路了吗？

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你知道贝塞斯达·苏萨的事吗？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 关于奥蒙波奇和那位自封的伯爵，你知道些什么？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Hortensa?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰鸣了吗，霍滕萨？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你见过帕克斯·克兰克吗？

string.ID: Your hair is so gray! How long have you lived in Grit Gate?

strings.string: 你的头发好灰啊！你在砂砾门住了多久？

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 能跟我讲讲其他巴拉瑟鲁姆派成员吗？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?

There are pools of convalessence there. You see, when cryogenic mist condenses, it forms a cool, luminous liquid that's restorative if you're able to bathe in it.
Oh! And in one of the ruined wards, the Alchemist keeps their shop. Who's the Alchemist, you ask? A sort of enigmatic figure -- amateur liquid-tinker, poet, merchant. Their methods aren't scientific, but they are useful if you're seeking a specific kind of liquid. Just be careful around them, =name=.

strings.string:
那里有疗愈精粹的池子。你看，低温雾气凝结时，会形成一种清凉发光的液体，若能浸浴其中，便有复原之效。
哦！还有，在其中一间废弃的病房里，炼金术士开着铺子。你问炼金术士是谁？算是个谜一般的人物——业余液体修补匠、诗人、商人。他们的法子不科学，可你若在找某种特定的液体，倒是管用。在他们身边小心些，=name=。

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 关于奥蒙波奇和那位自封的伯爵，你知道些什么？

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰鸣了吗，霍滕萨？

strings.string: 你的头发好灰啊！你在砂砾门住了多久？

strings.string: 能跟我讲讲其他巴拉瑟鲁姆派成员吗？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?
Nothing other than a pet theory of mine that the Spindle is a liquid in laminar flow.

strings.string: 没什么，只是我的一点私见：纺锤（the Spindle）是一股处于层流之中的液体。

strings.string: 你知道贝塞斯达·苏萨的事吗？

strings.string: 你的头发好灰啊！你在砂砾门住了多久？

strings.string: 能跟我讲讲其他巴拉瑟鲁姆派成员吗？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?
Yes! I was even provided with a brief premonition of it, as my workbench liquids are sensitive to small vibrations around the enclave.

strings.string: 感觉到了！我甚至还得到了一瞬的预感——我工作台上的液体对聚落周围的细微震动很敏感。

{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}
Years. Decades on decades. Centuries, perhaps. Most of these wet-earred cubs were merely sketches in their mothers' dreambooks when I arrived to study under Barathrum. We knew so little then, know so little now.

strings.string:
{{emote|*霍滕萨轻笑。*}}
好些年。几十个十年。也许有几百年了。我来到这里师从巴拉瑟鲁姆时，这些乳臭未干的小崽子大多还只是他们母亲梦书里的草图。那时我们懂得那么少，如今也懂得那么少。

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 能跟我讲讲其他巴拉瑟鲁姆派成员吗？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?

{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}
You are sharp, =name=. In a way that's what I am. But liquids are more willful than scrap. I can't solder them together; they would run away, hide in the shale cracks, slowly come apart and disappear. I moreso think of myself as a wisewoman in dialogue with them -- I manage their moods and phases. My notebooks are full of their quirks and caprices. It's a wonder, isn't it, how at just the right temperature and pressure the continuity of matter is smashed apart? How the gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm?

strings.string:
{{emote|*霍滕萨轻笑。*}}
你眼很尖，=name=。某种意义上，我确实是。可液体比废铁更任性。我没法把它们焊在一起；它们会跑掉，躲进页岩的裂缝里，慢慢散开、消失。我更像是个与它们对话的智者——我调理它们的脾气与相态。我的笔记本里记满了它们的怪癖与反复无常。你说奇不奇：恰在某个温度与压力下，物质的连续性就被砸得粉碎？气态的蝴蝶如何从致密的蠕虫里振翅飞出？

string.ID: How long have you lived in Grit Gate?

strings.string: 能跟我讲讲其他巴拉瑟鲁姆派成员吗？

Shem -1.

Larger than life. Paternal. Concerned. The lenses of his eyes are focused on the far points of the world.

strings.string: 比生命更宏大。如父一般。心怀忧念。他双眼的晶状体，始终聚焦在世界的远方。

string.ID: Q Girl.
Shem -1.
I'd like to ask about something else.
Brassy. If you bent him he might snap. The way I treat liquids on my burner, Otho treats the units of the enclave.

strings.string: 黄铜脾气。你若硬掰他，他会断。我怎样对待炉上的液体，奥索就怎样对待聚落的编制单位。

string.ID: Q Girl.
Shem -1.
I'd like to ask about something else.
Sharp as a tack, and living a life of deep meaning. Inventive and orderly. I can't say I understand his music, but I do love how expressive he is with it.

strings.string: 锋利如钉，过着意蕴深厚的生活。富于创造，又井然有序。我不敢说我懂他的音乐，但我真心喜欢他借音乐表达出的样子。

string.ID: Q Girl.
Shem -1.
I'd like to ask about something else.

Oh, I have such a precious vantage point on my sweet neighbor! When he achieves a moment of perfection in his craft -- a flawlessly spiraled barrel, a mound of powder measured to the grain -- he beams like the high salt sun. What a lovely smile.

strings.string: 哦，我这可爱的邻居给了我一个多珍贵的视角！每当他的手艺臻于完美的一刻——一条螺旋无可挑剔的枪管，一堆精确到颗粒的火药——他就笑得像高盐之地的烈日。多好看的笑容。

string.ID: Q Girl.
Shem -1.
I'd like to ask about something else.
She explodes like gas and dust in a quiet corner of the galaxy. Radiant. Revolutionary. She's a good listener and companion for supper, which you mightn't expect.

strings.string: 她像星系某个安静角落里的气体与尘埃那样迸发。光芒四射。革故鼎新。她还是个很好的倾听者、很好的晚餐同伴——这你大概想不到。

string.ID: Shem -1.
I'd like to ask about something else.

After supper I like to retreat to the library, take a storybook off the shelves, flop down on the chairbear, and lose myself in another world. Many of these worlds feature palaces, markets, gardens, ships. Many of those places have bells. When they do, I always think of Mafeo. More than anyone else, Mafeo could be a character in the bright world of a story, where this dusty place is itself confined to a mere storybook.

strings.string: 晚饭后我喜欢躲进图书室，从架上抽一本故事书，一屁股瘫进熊椅里，让自己迷失在另一个世界。那些世界里常有宫殿、集市、花园、舟船。而那些地方常有大钟。每逢此时，我总会想起马费奥。比谁都更像，马费奥该是那个明亮故事世界里的角色——而在那里，这尘土飞扬的地方本身，也不过被囿于一本故事书中。

string.ID: Q Girl.
Shem -1.
I'd like to ask about something else.
Our sleepy sage. So sweet. She calms me. I sit in her room and we muse on the nature of things.

strings.string: 我们那位睡意朦胧的贤者。多甜的人。她让我安宁。我坐在她房里，一起冥想万物的本性。

string.ID: Q Girl.
Shem -1.
I'd like to ask about something else.

I've instructed Neek since they were a lil' cub. What a strange one! Bouncey. Full of smiles. But brilliant in their own way. My favorite book in all the world is Neek's "Spiderwebs on Hoversleds". Who would have ever thought?

strings.string: 尼克还是个小崽子的时候，就是我教的。多古怪的一个！蹦蹦跳跳。满脸笑意。但自有其聪慧之处。全世界我最爱的一本书，就是尼克的《悬浮橇上的蛛网》。谁能想得到呢？

string.ID: Q Girl.
Shem -1.
I'd like to ask about something else.
Fiery. Blustery. Like the stews he cooks. If you're going to chat with him, make sure you have your schedule cleared and a ewer of honeyed wine.

strings.string: 火气大。爱吹牛。就像他炖的菜。你要跟他聊，先确保日程空出来，再备一壶蜜酒。

string.ID: Q Girl.
Shem -1.
I'd like to ask about something else.
Precious Shem. They've such a wider view of the world than we do. What a momentous obligation we've created for ourselves, and how I wouldn't undo it!

strings.string: 珍贵的谢姆。他们对世界的视野比我们宽阔得多。我们为自己造出了多重大的责任啊——而我多么不愿将它撤销！

string.ID: Q Girl.
I'd like to ask about something else.
I've shared my honey with that prickly troglodyte for more years than I can count. I can't help but like him, and while he won't admit it, he feels the same about me.

strings.string: 我与那个浑身带刺的穴居人分享蜂蜜，年数多到数不清。我忍不住喜欢他；而他虽不肯承认，对我也是一样。

string.ID: Q Girl.
Shem -1.

She's a sphinx! So enigmatic that one. It's not entirely clear if she was there, waiting, when Q Girl succeeded at retreading the mainframe's guts, or if she sparked into being that very moment. Or was it some synthesis of the two?

strings.string: 谢谢，这就够了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I have another question, if you please.

strings.string: 我还有一个问题，如果方便的话。

string.ID: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢，这就够了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?
My condolences.
Live and drink, warden.
Warden, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 看守，我找到金德里什（Kindrish）了。

string.ID: Fine. Live and drink.
You're welcome. Live and drink.
Ah! Kendren! =name=! I'm so happy! Live and drink.

strings.string: 啊！外客！=name=！我太高兴了！活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.
=name=, it is good to see you. Rest and sup before you move on.

strings.string: =name=，见到你真好。上路之前先歇歇、吃点东西。

string.ID: I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信这首诗是写给你的。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.
I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信这首诗是写给你的。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.
My condolences. Live and drink.
Does this poem belong to you?
Does this poem belong to you?
It is real. Take the poem.
I must be mistaken. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我一定弄错了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.
Follow the road =EskhindRoadDirection= to find the hollow tree where Esk and I used to play.

strings.string: 顺着路=EskhindRoadDirection=，就能找到埃斯克和我从前玩耍的那棵空心树。

string.ID: {{emote|*The warden is lost in rumination.*}} It can't be. It simply can't be.

strings.string: {{emote|*看守者陷入沉思。*}} 不可能。这简直不可能。

string.ID: Ah! Yes. My apologies, kendren. Live and drink. I am Neelahind, Warden of Bey Lah. How... may I help you?

strings.string: 啊！是的。抱歉，外客。活下去，喝足水。我是尼拉欣德，贝拉的看守。有什么……我能帮上忙的？

string.ID:
We were... yes. We were close.
I can scarcely believe that she would be capable of doing such a thing. Stealing our greatest treasure? Eskhind wouldn't possibly... but if Grand-Doe says it, it must be so.

strings.string:
我们……是的。我们曾很亲近。
我几乎无法相信她会做出这种事。偷走我们最珍贵的宝物？埃斯欣德不可能……可既然大母鹿这么说，那就一定是这样。

string.ID: Wh—no! No! What? No, that's not possible! Ayvah, what an absurd idea!

strings.string: 什——不！不！什么？不，那不可能！哎呀，多荒唐的念头！

string.ID:
Grand-Doe speaks only truth! Grand-Doe only ever speaks truth!
It's not possible. She didn't lie.

strings.string:
大母鹿只说真话！大母鹿从来只说真话！
这不可能。她没有撒谎。

string.ID:
No. It's not true, and I won't hear any more of your poisonous ideas, kendren. Consider the topic closed.
Do you actually have a question?

strings.string:
不。这不是真的，我也不想再听你这些有毒的念头，外客。这个话题到此为止。
你到底还有没有别的问题？

string.ID:
Oh. Esk and I, we had a place... there's a path to the =EskhindRoadDirection= that leads to the remains of a lightning-struck tree, made hollow by the fire from above. It was the furthest from the village either of us had ever been, until I attended my first warden's moot.
She and I would spend time there, back then. Perhaps she is there now, but I don't dare check.

strings.string:
哦。埃斯克和我，我们有过一个地方……往=EskhindRoadDirection=有条小路，通向一棵被雷劈过的树的残骸，被天火掏空了。在我第一次参加看守议事会之前，那是我们俩去过的最远的地方。
那时我们常在那里消磨时光。也许她现在就在那儿，可我不敢去看。

string.ID:
No... no, I can't... and the artifact is lost?
It was all for nothing... for nothing...

strings.string:
不……不，我不能……那件器物也丢了？
全都白费了……白费了……

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.No. The Hindriarch lied to you..Text
string.ID:
No, it can't be... how. This place. This accursed village!
This whole village be damned!

strings.string:
不，不可能……怎么会。这个地方。这个被诅咒的村庄！
这整座村子都见鬼去吧！

string.ID:
Oh! Kendren, thank you, thank you! You've done so much for us. Here is a reward for your hard work.
Um, that said, there's still the matter of finding out who stole our treasure. It'd mean a great deal if you could still help with the resolution of the case.

strings.string:
哦！外客，谢谢你，谢谢你！你为我们做了这么多。这是你辛苦应得的报酬。
呃，话虽如此，还是得查清是谁偷了我们的宝物。若你仍能帮忙了结此案，那意义重大。

string.ID:
Wh-what's going on? Esk is here, a-and Grand-Doe seems very upset.
Would you please speak to her, kendren?

strings.string:
怎——怎么了？埃斯克在这儿，而——而且大母鹿似乎非常难过。
你能去跟她说说吗，外客？

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.You're the Warden. You tell me..Text
string.ID:
I... I don't know. Grand-doe usually resolves Bey Lah's disputes. I am present to defuse violence, or keep the peace through the threat of it.
What do you think?

strings.string:
我……我不知道。贝拉的纠纷通常由大母鹿裁断。我在场是为了消解暴力，或以暴力的威胁维持和平。
你觉得呢？

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.We will investigate and find the truth..Text
string.ID:
Oh. Well, yes, that's... that's a good idea. You'll help, right? My axe-arm and conviction are strong, but deduction has never been my greatest strength.
I can answer questions about the people in town, if that would be helpful.

strings.string:
哦。嗯，是的，那是……那是个好主意。你会帮忙的，对吧？我的斧臂与信念都很强，可推演从来不是我的长处。
如果能帮上忙，我可以回答关于镇上居民的问题。

string.ID:
Ah, =name=, live and drink!
Has your investigation reached a conclusion? Our fate is in your hands.

strings.string:
啊，=name=，活下去，喝足水！
你的调查有结论了吗？我们的命运在你手上。

string.ID:
Oh, =name=! I'm so happy!
I can scarcely believe she loves me, much less that... that we could be together. But it's true. Wherever we go from now on, we go together.

strings.string:
哦，=name=！我太高兴了！
我几乎不敢相信她爱我，更不敢想……我们能在一起。但这是真的。从今往后无论去往何处……

string.ID: I'm afraid that well is poisoned due to your false accusation: =thief.name|strip= isn't the culprit.

strings.string: 恐怕这口井已经被你的错误指控下了毒：=thief.name|strip=并非真凶。

string.ID: Hmm. But the only fur there was from a hindren's pelt, and kendren warriors fight to the death. With no corpse and no other fur, it seems unlikely that a hindren fought an outsider.

strings.string: 嗯。可那里唯一的毛皮来自欣德伦的皮，而外客战士向来战至身死。既无尸体，又无别的毛皮，看来不太可能是欣德伦与外客搏斗过。

string.ID: I'm afraid that makes no sense. Why would an outsider invite a trader to our village, when they could simply meet one outside of Bey Lah?

strings.string: 恐怕这说不通。外客为何要邀一名商贩来我们村，他们大可在贝拉之外与商贩碰面？

string.ID: But weren't the rumors of sore throats in the village? That wouldn't have anything to do with kendren.

strings.string: 可村里不是有喉咙痛痒的传言吗？那跟外客毫无关系。

string.ID: Why wouldn't an outsider bring their own leather? It would better disguise Kindrish. It seems a lot of work to find and raid our leather stores.

strings.string: 外客为何不自带皮革？那样更能掩藏金德里什（Kindrish）。特意找到并洗劫我们的皮革库，未免太费周章。

string.ID: Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! It would make no sense for a kendren to have one, then throw it away in the village.

strings.string: 护腕是贝拉的手艺！外客有一副，还把它扔在村里，完全说不通。

string.ID: Kesehind wields Ari, a battleaxe handed down through generations. It cannot break, and if it broke a weapon there would be scorch marks on it. This evidence does not hold up.

strings.string: 凯塞欣德使的是阿里——一柄世代相传的战斧。它不会断；若真砸断了兵器，上面会留下灼痕。这项证据站不住脚。

string.ID: There are few voices as low as Kesehind's in our village. Witnesses report a higher-pitched voice, don't they? They would know if Kesehind were speaking.

strings.string: 我们村里很少有像凯塞欣德那样低沉的嗓音。目击者说的是更高些的声音，对吧？若说话的是凯塞欣德，他们会认出来。

string.ID: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.

strings.string: 哦，不，那不可能是凯塞欣德。他宁可死于热病，也不肯咽下一根荞麦秆。

string.ID: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.

strings.string: 哦，不，那不可能是凯塞欣德。他宁可死于热病，也不肯咽下一根荞麦秆。

string.ID: That would be nigh unto impossible for Kesehind. He cannot perform fine tasks by torchlight; his night vision is too poor.

strings.string: 对凯塞欣德来说这几乎不可能。他在火把光下做不了精细活；夜视太差。

string.ID: No, that can't be it. Eskhind hates everything about watervine and keeps a wide berth from it. If her blood was spilled, it would have happened nearer to the path.

strings.string: 不，不可能。埃斯欣德厌恶水藤的一切，避得远远的。若她流了血，也该在小路附近才对。

string.ID: No, no. Eskhind makes the most of what few possessions she keeps, and if she traded a treasure for so much water, she'd never have lost track of any.

strings.string: 不，不。埃斯欣德对自己仅有的几件物件都物尽其用；若她拿宝物换了这么多水，绝不会把哪一袋弄丢。

string.ID: Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afraid of saltbacks. She would never get close enough to trade with a dromad merchent.

strings.string: 哦，不，埃斯欣德怕盐背兽怕得要命。她绝不会靠近到能与驼人商人交易。

string.ID: I doubt it. If Eskhind were sick, the last place she would stumble to evacuate her guts would be a watervine field.

strings.string: 我看未必。埃斯欣德若病了，最不可能跑去清肠子的地方就是水藤田。

string.ID: I'm afraid that Eskhind has no idea how to use proper leatherworking tools, much less pay for a set so fine. This surely isn't hers.

strings.string: 恐怕埃斯欣德根本不会用正经的制皮工具，更别说买得起这么好的一套。这肯定不是她的。

string.ID: I know the rumor you mean, but villagers heard the clash of weapons. Keh is too old for a prolonged fight like that, so I do not believe it was her.

strings.string: 我知道你说的那个传言，可村民听见的是兵器相击之声。凯年纪太大了，撑不住那样持久的打斗，所以我不信是她。

string.ID: Grand-Doe cannot swim, and panics even near the shallow pools of our paddies. I cannot imagine she would make splashing noises without adding screaming noises to them.

strings.string: 大母鹿不会游泳，连靠近我们水田的浅池都会惊慌。我想不出她弄出溅水声却不外加尖叫声的样子。

string.ID: Copper causes Grand-Doe to break out in great welts. She would not have traded for it, and if she saw a trader drop it, surely she would have told them to pick it up. She hates mess.

strings.string: 铜会让大母鹿浑身起大片疹块。她不会拿东西去换铜；若见商贩掉了铜块，她肯定会叫对方捡起来。她讨厌邋遢。

string.ID: I cannot bring myself to believe that Grand-Doe would allow anyone to stumble upon her own severed tongue. She would surely burn it as soon as she saw it.

strings.string: 我无法相信大母鹿会任人撞见她自己的断舌。她一看见就必定会烧掉。

string.ID: No, Grand-Doe is absolutely meticulous about work clutter. She wouldn't leave scraps lying about.

strings.string: 不，大母鹿对工作台上的杂乱一丝不苟。她不会把碎料随手乱放。

string.ID: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我发现一丛被血染红的水藤，是近期有过暴力的迹象。

string.ID: Signs of =circumstance.influence=, seemingly hidden from the village. But that can't be your only evidence, can it? There's no culprit!

strings.string:
我知道了。这确实表明存在某种动机层面的=circumstance.influence=，而且有人试图掩饰。
但这还不足以指认任何人，对吧？

string.ID: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我发现一丛被血染红的水藤，是近期有过暴力的迹象。

string.ID:
Oh. Yes, this does indicate that some kind of =motive.influence= transpired, and =thief.name|strip= was trying to hide it.
So what you're saying is....

strings.string:
哦。是的，这确实表明发生了某种=motive.influence=，而=thief.name|strip=正试图掩饰。
那么你的意思是……

string.ID: That's right. By concealing =all.influence=, it was =thief.name|strip= who stole Kindrish!

strings.string: 正是。通过隐瞒=all.influence=，偷走金德里什（Kindrish）的正是=thief.name|strip=！

string.ID:
The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.
And I... I will go with her. May my property be payment for the harm she has done to our people, and I will gladly pay it for the privilege of walking by her side.
I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.

strings.string:
证据确凿。埃斯欣德违背圣法与族人之意，从贝拉偷走了名为金德里什（Kindrish）的器物。她将被褫夺荣誉、褫夺水权、从我们的口述史中除名。她的名字再不会在此被提起，她也再不会回来……违者处死。
而我……我会随她同去。愿我的财产抵偿她对我族人造成的伤害；为能伴她同行，我心甘情愿付出。
我毫不怀疑，贝拉在我离去后会如我任看守之前那样繁荣。活下去，喝足水，我的族人。愿女族长凯长久引领你们。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.
She could never hope to repay the harm caused by her actions, but we will grant her this last mercy: Bey Lah will forget her debt alongside her name.
Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!

strings.string:
证据确凿。埃斯欣德违背圣法与族人之意，从贝拉偷走了名为金德里什（Kindrish）的器物。她将被褫夺荣誉、褫夺水权、从我们的口述史中除名。她的名字再不会在此被提起，她也再不会回来……违者处死。
她永远无法偿还自己行为造成的伤害，但我们赐她最后一份慈悲：贝拉将连同她的名字一并忘掉这笔债。
女族长凯的治理公正。愿她长寿！

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.
Eskhind is free to go, and I'm... I'm going with her. I cannot serve under Hindriarch Keh while my beloved returns to exile.
I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.

strings.string:
证据确凿：埃斯欣德没有偷金德里什（Kindrish）。事实上，我相信窃案并非任何欣德伦所为，而是那些早在调查者抵达之前就渗入我们边界的某位外客。他们中任何人都可能下手。
埃斯欣德可以自由离去，而我……我要随她同去。我心爱之人重回流放之途，我无法再在女族长凯麾下效力。
我毫不怀疑，贝拉在我离去后会如我任看守之前那样繁荣。活下去，喝足水，我的族人。愿女族长凯长久引领你们。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but rather one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.
Eskhind helped us cleave to the path of justice. She is free to go, and her name will not be forgotten, but she must remain in exile.
Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!

strings.string:
证据确凿：埃斯欣德没有偷金德里什（Kindrish）。事实上，我相信窃案并非任何欣德伦所为，而是那些早在调查者抵达之前就渗入我们边界的某位外客。他们中任何人都可能下手。
埃斯欣德帮我们守住了正义之路。她可以自由离去，她的名字不会被遗忘，但她必须继续流放。
女族长凯的治理公正。愿她长寿！

The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.
Eskhind is free to go, and I'm... I'm going with her. I cannot serve under Hindriarch Keh while my beloved returns to exile.
I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.

strings.string:
证据确凿：埃斯欣德没有偷金德里什（Kindrish）。事实上，我相信窃案并非任何欣德伦所为，而是那些早在调查者抵达之前就渗入我们边界的某位外客。他们中任何人都可能下手。
埃斯欣德可以自由离去，而我……我要随她同去。我心爱之人重回流放之途，我无法再在女族长凯麾下效力。
我毫不怀疑，贝拉在我离去后会如我任看守之前那样繁荣。活下去，喝足水，我的族人。愿女族长凯长久引领你们。

string.ID:

Eskhind helped us cleave to the path of justice. She is free to go, and her name will not be forgotten, but she must remain in exile.
Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!

strings.string:

埃斯欣德帮我们守住了正义之路。她可以自由离去，她的名字不会被遗忘，但她必须继续流放。
愿命运怜悯我们所有人。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. The crime was committed by none other than Grand-Doe's protector, Kesehind. He will be stripped of the ancestral axe he carries, stripped of his property, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will his name be spoken here again, and he will never return... on pain of death.
Moreover... Keh's attempt to pin blame on Eskhind without due process opened my eyes to her abuses of power. She need not leave Bey Lah, but she is Keh-hind once more-- stripped of her title and standing.
As for the hindriarchy, Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

strings.string:
证据确凿：埃斯欣德没有偷金德里什（Kindrish）。犯下此案的，正是大母鹿的护卫——凯塞欣德。他将被褫夺所持的祖传战斧、褫夺财产、从我们的口述史中除名。他的名字再不会在此被提起，他也再不会回来……违者处死。
此外……凯未经正当程序就想把罪名扣在埃斯欣德头上，让我看清了她对权力的滥用。她不必离开贝拉，但她又变回了「凯-欣德」——名号与地位皆被褫夺。
至于女族长之位，在我们作为一个族群想清下一步之前，埃斯欣德将暂代领袖之职。愿女族长埃斯克引领我们走向更光明的未来！

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Bey Lah's own Hindriarch has betrayed her people. She took our ancestral treasure as her own, pinning the crime on an exile she knew could not defend herself. For this treason, she is hereby stripped of title, stripped of property, stripped of home.
With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

strings.string:
证据确凿：贝拉自己的女族长背叛了她的人民。她将祖传宝物据为己有，把罪名扣在一个她明知无法自辩的流放者身上。以此叛族之罪，她即刻被褫夺名号、褫夺财产、褫夺家园。
随着凯-欣德被流放，女族长之位空悬，再无长老足以接任。在我们作为一个族群想清下一步之前，埃斯欣德将暂代领袖之职。
愿女族长埃斯克引领我们走向更光明的未来！

string.ID:
For me? Are you sure?
But... this is a poem. In Esk's handwriting. Are you s-sure this is for me?

strings.string:
这是什么？一首诗？
……我认得这个笔迹。你是从哪儿得来的？

string.ID:
Oh.
Ayvah, she-- Eskhind wrote this about... me? How my head swims at these lavish words. If she wrote this and meant it for me, she must... love me.
But it can't be. Can it?

Kendren, you must understand. I spent so many years trying in vain to fall out of love with Eskhind. I thought it the only way to endure our adolescence, watching her poor attempts at courtship with other hindren.
I thought it the only way to endure her departure, as well. But she is returned, and she loves me. Ayvah. I am terrified to speak to her of this, but I must.
Thank you.

strings.string:
我……我不知道你在说什么。
{{emote|*她别过脸去。*}}
那是很久以前的事了，外客。久到我已经忘了该怎么称呼它。可你把它读给我听了，所以我也不能装作没有听见。
是的。我爱她。而她永远不会知道。

string.ID:
No. You are the one investigating, so my bias need not enter play. If you determine that Eskhind is guilty, I will heed your word and carry out a just sentence.
After that, I'm not sure.

strings.string:
当然，外客。
不过我得先说清楚：我是贝拉的看守，这桩案子牵涉到我少年时代的朋友。我或许不是最公正的证人。你若需要，尽管问——我会照实答。

string.ID:
Keh is very wise and very careful, which makes up for her lack of strength or... tact. She always knows what's right, and she runs a very tight shift.
She hates clutter from work like nothing else and cleans up any mess she makes--unless it's a spill, then she makes Kesehind do it. It's because Grand-Doe has a terrible fear of standing pools of water, refusing to touch them. Copper and bronze afflict her with allergy-sores and she can't touch them. She's too old to spar with me, but her bow-arm still aims true.
That's all I can think of.

strings.string:
凯-欣德是我们的大母鹿，也是我母亲的姊妹。
她一生都在为贝拉做艰难的决断，而艰难的决定会磨硬一个人。她待我如亲生。可自埃斯克被流放以来，她再没有唤过我的名字。
我并不恨她。我只是……不再认得她了。

string.ID:
Oh. She's, well, she's a good person with strong convictions, or has always seemed so. I suppose that isn't helpful.
Esk has a good eye for detail. She hates watervine so much that she avoids the paddies and won't eat matz without lah broth to make it taste better. Umm, she's afraid of saltbacks. She's good at foraging and terrible at crafting.
I've missed her so much.

strings.string:
埃斯克……埃斯欣德。
我们自幼一同长大。她教我爬树，我教她握斧。她向来比我更敢想、更敢做，也更不肯低头。
后来她因为一件她没做过的事被流放了。我没能为她说话。这是我这辈子最大的遗憾。

string.ID:
Kesehind is completely loyal to Grand-Doe. We used to be friends, but his disposition has become so sour since he was appointed her protector, and he's quite cold to me now. He can't see well in darkness. He's the holder of Ari, an unbreakable heirloom fire axe, and he's very skilled with it.
He's terribly finicky about food. He'll only eat bland food and meat, and... oh! Once, when he had a bad cough as a faundren, a caretaker tried to feed him yuckwheat, and he kicked her so hard it dislocated her jaw. Poor Elder Eselhind.

strings.string:
凯塞欣德是大母鹿的护卫，也是村里最强的一双手。
他替她做那些不便亲自出手的事。他对此毫无愧色，并且认为这就是护卫的本分。
我不喜欢他，但我承认：他从不说谎。他若真做了，早就认了。

string.ID: Oh, not very much. The only kendren who were allowed in the village before you are traders, and it's always a very big fuss when one comes by. It's been a while since that happened, though, so any kendren who have visited must have come in secret.

strings.string:
你们这些外客……
说实话，我分不太清你们。你们来得急、去得快，像水藤田里的风。可埃斯克当年也是这么看你们的——她说你们身上有「不认命」的味道。
我想她说得对。

string.ID:
Live and drink, kendren.
Please forgive me; I am grateful that you opened my eyes, but the sight of you is yet a bitter leaf. Let me grieve my people in peace.

strings.string:
活下去，喝足水，外客。
请原谅我；我很感激你让我看清了，但见到你仍像一片苦叶。让我安静地为我的族人哀悼吧。

string.ID:
You've found our treasure? Thank you, kendren!
Please take this reward, we set it aside for just this purpose. I apologize if it's too little. Thank you so much, again.

strings.string:
你把金德里什（Kindrish）带回来了，还替我洗清了埃斯克的名声。
我欠你一份还不清的人情，外客。这份人情我记下了。

string.ID: There's a fear deep in my breast, kendren. What's to become of Bey Lah?

strings.string: 我心底深处有一份恐惧，外客。贝拉会变成什么样？

string.ID:
Kendren, thank you for clearing Esk's name!
You're so decisive. I wish I had that strength.

strings.string:
外客，谢谢你为埃斯克洗清了名声！
你真果断。我希望自己也有那份气力。

string.ID:
Oh! Is this what... Esk!
I could have gone years unknowing that my love for her was returned. But this is her script, and these words describe me.
Ayvah, I have to speak to her! Thank you so much, kendren.

strings.string:
哦！这就是……埃斯克！
我本可能许多年都不知道，我对她的爱是有回应的。可这是她的笔迹，而这些话写的就是我。
哎呀，我得去跟她说话！太谢谢你了，外客。

string.ID:
Thank you again for opening my eyes, kendren.
I have trouble smiling for my grief, my loss. Nonetheless, Eskhind and I have a brighter future because of you, and we are together. The road is hazardous, but we will walk it in time.

strings.string:
再次谢谢你让我看清，外客。
因为悲伤、因为失去，我笑不出来。尽管如此，因为有你，埃斯欣德和我有了更明亮的前程，我们在一起了。这条路凶险，但我们会一步步走下去。

string.ID:
Kendren.
Forgive me for seeming ungrateful. I am more affected by Esk's return and departure than I knew. Please give me space.

strings.string:
外客。
请原谅我显得不知感恩。埃斯克的归来与离去对我的影响，比我以为的更深。请给我一点余地。

string.ID:
What is this?
Poetry. In the exile's handwriting. Extolling love for... me, or someone very like me.
Is... is this a cruel joke? This cannot be real.

strings.string:
这是什么？
诗。是那个流放者的笔迹。颂扬着对……我，或某个极像我的人的爱。
这……这是个残忍的玩笑吗？这不可能是真的。

string.ID:
She loved me.
She loved me and I ... I exiled her. Oh, my heart.
Kendren I, I am grateful that you have opened my eyes to the truth, but how dearly I wish you had intervened earlier. This poem serves only as a harsh reminder that I must give up everything for my duty.
Please. Please leave me be. My heart... Esk, my heart...

strings.string:
你为什么要现在告诉我？
埃斯克被流放已经过去这么多年了。你本可以什么也不说，让我继续以为她是个贼。
可你说了。为什么？

string.ID: Who are you? What? Please, do not disturb me.

strings.string: 你是谁？什么？拜托，别来打扰我。

string.ID:
The Templar are assaulting the enclave? Oh dear, dear...
May our guns' lasers shine with the light of the Kasaphescence.

strings.string:
圣殿骑士在攻打聚落？哎呀，哎呀……
愿我们枪炮的激光闪耀着卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）之光。

string.ID: I must go.

Why, =name=, Brightsheol treated you well. There is a new gravity about you; your proverbial boots ring louder in the Annals with each step.
I imagine you're off to Teach's study? They're already at work down there.

strings.string:
哎呀，=name=，明暗界（Brightsheol）待你不薄。你身上多了一种新的分量；你那双所谓的靴子，每落一步在《年鉴》里都响得更沉。
我猜你要去蒂奇的书房？他们已经在下面动工了。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's presence?

strings.string: 你怎么看克兰克的到来？

string.ID: Light shine through you, Jacobo. Let's talk.

strings.string: 愿光照透你，雅各博。我们聊聊。

string.ID:
I admit a burning curiosity to see the joined imagination of our Q Girl and Pax Klanq, and no doubt yours as well. Watching such a creation burgeon from empty space to fullness of being would be a joyful entry in the chronicles of my life, but...
Too many fingers tangle in the honeypot, as my cubhood mentor would tell me.

strings.string:
我承认，我极想看看我们的Q女郎与帕克斯·克兰克联手能生出什么想象——无疑还有你的。眼看这样一件造物从虚空里滋长、直至圆满成形，会是我生平纪事里欢乐的一笔，可是……
正如我幼时的师父会说的：伸进蜜罐的手指太多了。

string.ID: So they do. Live and drink, Jacobo.

strings.string: 确实如此。活下去，喝足水，雅各博。

string.ID:
Never before had the Templar broken so far through our defenses. We live a new reality now, one harder to weather.
Is there anything you need, =name=?

strings.string:
圣殿骑士从未如此深入我们的防线。如今我们活在一个新的现实里，一个更难捱的现实。
=name=，你需要什么吗？

string.ID: Light shine through you, Jacobo. Let's talk.

strings.string: 愿光照透你，雅各博。我们聊聊。

string.ID: No. Live and drink.

My quills prickle with unease to hear you say such things.
Be certain to visit the village of Ezra. The Daughter of Exile who lives there is as good a tinker as any I know, and she always has surplus she's willing to sell.

strings.string:
听你说这些，我的棘刺都不安地竖了起来。
务必去一趟埃兹拉村。住在那儿的「流放者之女」是我认识的最好的修补匠之一，她总有富余的货愿意出手。

string.ID: I thank you. Live and drink.
Light shine through you, friend.
Did you feel that rumbling, Jacobo?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰鸣了吗，雅各博？

string.ID: Jacobo, do you have advice for entering Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 雅各博，进贝塞斯达·苏萨你有什么建议吗？

string.ID: Is that... music... coming from your loudspeaker? It sounds like a bell echoing in the void backward through time.

strings.string: 那是……音乐……从你的喇叭里出来的？ 听着像一口钟在虚空中逆着时间回响。

string.ID: That chrome orb earring you're wearing. What's the meaning of it?

strings.string: 你戴的那只铬球耳饰。它有什么含义？

string.ID: You have so many data disks.
What can you tell me about Grit Gate?

strings.string: 关于砂砾门，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: The Temple of the Rock is cut off from the wider world, and I hear the Mechanimist colonists no longer recognize High Priest Eschelstadt. That said, if you are favored by the Mechanimists, if you are welcome in their holy places, then I've no doubt that Phinae Hoshaiah will grant you peaceful entry.

strings.string: 岩石神殿与外界隔绝，我听说机械教派的殖民者已不再承认大祭司埃舍尔施塔特。话虽如此，若你受机械教派眷顾、被允许进入他们的圣地，那我毫不怀疑菲奈·何沙雅会让你平安入内。

string.ID: Is that... music... coming from your loudspeaker? It sounds like a bell echoing in the void backward through time.

strings.string: 那是……音乐……从你的喇叭里出来的？ 听着像一口钟在虚空中逆着时间回响。

strings.string: 你戴的那只铬球耳饰。它有什么含义？

What can you tell me about Grit Gate?

strings.string: 关于砂砾门，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: Yea! So you like it? Sheba Hag and I composed it on a wavelathe. We made a series of songs about the birth and life of the Kasaphescence. Together we call them "Spun on the Cosmic Loom".

strings.string: 是吧！你喜欢？那是示巴·哈格和我在波车上作的曲。我们写了一组关于卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）诞生与生平的歌，合称《宇宙织机上的纺绩》。

strings.string: 雅各博，进贝塞斯达·苏萨你有什么建议吗？

string.ID: Sheba Hag?
What's the Kasaphescence?
So you're a Mechanimist?

strings.string: 所以你是机械教派的人？

string.ID: Have you made other songs?

What can you tell me about Grit Gate?

string.ID: Oh, Sheba Hagadias. She's the librarian at the cathedral of the Six Day Stilt. My water-sister and cohort in chrome.

strings.string: 哦，示巴·哈加迪亚斯。她是六日高跷大教堂的图书馆长。我的水姊妹，我在铬之道的同袍。

What can you tell me about Grit Gate?

strings.string: 关于砂砾门，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID:
Beauty manifest, whose chromium shoals are Awe itself. In my belief system, She's the being from whom all metal was birthed, out in the ever-void. There are pieces of Her in every chrome belfry and every machine. Even bits of Her in our own blood.
For me, Her essence extends beyond mere metal. Anything that's ordered, She infuses: a poem, a mathematical proof, a clean workspace... so definitely not Q Girl's.

strings.string:
美之显现，其铬色浅滩即是「敬畏」本身。在我的信仰里，她是在永恒虚空中诞下一切金属的存在。每一座铬色钟楼、每一台机器里都有她的一部分。连我们的血里也有她的碎屑。
对我而言，她的本质不止于金属。凡有序之物，她皆灌注其中：一首诗、一道数学证明、一张干净的工作台……所以绝不是Q女郎那张。

string.ID: Of a sort, yes. I'm part of a branch who deify the Kasaphescence only. We believe the argent fathers to be earthly beings: important to the faith's early history but not divine.

strings.string: 算是吧。我属于只奉卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）为神的那一支。我们认为银之父是尘世的存在：对信仰的早期历史很重要，但并非神明。

string.ID: Many. Many. This is my third collaboration with Sheba. Our first two collections were called "Immaculate Chrome" and "Outside In".

strings.string: 很多。很多。这是我与示巴的第三次合作。前两部合集叫《无瑕之铬》和《由外而内》。

string.ID: Oh, it's the silver rondure. It's a mark of devotion to the Kasaphescence.

strings.string: 哦，那是银环。是对卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）虔敬的标志。

string.ID:
Don't I know it. I've had to invent eight separate systems of organization to manage them all. At the moment I'm trying out a new one, Harmonices Spiralis. Spiral towers with heights increasing according to the harmonic series of numbers. It's... fine.
The problem is I'm always inscribing more disks. New contraptions. Reverse-engineered artifacts. It's a good problem to have, I suppose.
Take a look. See if any interest you.

strings.string:
我怎么会不知道。为了管好它们，我已经发明了八套不同的整理法。眼下我在试一套新的——「和谐螺线」。螺旋塔，高度按调和级数递增。还算……行吧。
问题是我总在刻新的盘。新玩意儿。逆向工程出来的器物。我想，这算是个好问题。
看看吧。看有没有你感兴趣的。
