string.ID:
We're a vibrant community here. A circle of monks mapping the outer lattices and raising viaducts where we need to.
We remain secluded to protect ourselves. Otho and Barathrum insist on it. They are wise, and I defer to them. My collaboration with Sheba Hag does cause them worry, but they tolerate it, bless their hearts.

strings.string:
我们这儿是个生气勃勃的社群。一圈修士在测绘外围晶格，需要时就架起高架渠。
我们保持隐世是为了自保。奥索和巴拉瑟鲁姆坚持如此。他们睿智，我听从他们。我与示巴·哈格的合作确实让他们担心，但他们容忍了——愿上天保佑他们的心。

string.ID: Saad, welcom. Saad, from thyn heres shaken the wet and olde lif. Saad, in-to a smal vessel pouren hit. Saad, to thyn sash attachen the vessel. Saad, crossen nou thrugh the heigh gate and in-to Brightsheol.

strings.string: 萨德（Saad），来矣。 萨德，自汝发间抖落那湿冷的旧命。 萨德，将其倾入一只小瓶。 萨德，将瓶系于汝之腰带上。 萨德，今可穿过高门，入于明暗界（Brightsheol）。

string.ID: Where is Brightsheol in relation to Qud... to Salum?

strings.string: 明暗界（Brightsheol）与卡德（Qud）……与萨鲁姆，是何方位？

string.ID: Am I dead?
What is this place?
Why do you call me Saad?
I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我从厚世界来，负一使命：解除纺锤（the Spindle）的磁场。你能为我办到吗？

string.ID: Saad, the bodi dien, but the mind romen.

string.ID:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}
The shomrim connen. Why oghte we?

strings.string:
{{emote|*裹着雨水肖默形体的衣物，久久静止不动。*}}
守冥人（Shomer）已至。吾等何须如此？

string.ID: Because... I am a Saad, after all.
Shomer, you impudent whelp! Saad Resheph stands before you. Do as I say.

strings.string: 肖默，你这无礼的小畜生！身为萨德（Saad）的雷谢夫就站在你面前。照我说的做。

string.ID: Something changed atop the Spindle. If Brightsheol is indeed connected to the city there, then this change may suggest it's in peril...

strings.string: 纺锤（the Spindle）之上有了变化。若明暗界（Brightsheol）确与那座城相连，那么这变化或意味着它正陷危难……

string.ID: Wait. I have more questions to ask.

{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}
The shomrim remainen unbilefful.

strings.string:
{{emote|*裹着雨水肖默形体的衣物，久久静止不动。*}}
守冥人（Shomer）仍不肯信。

string.ID: {{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form remain still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*裹着雨水肖默形体的衣物静止不动。*}}

string.ID: One year ago, someone began broadcasting a signal from atop the Spindle. I have a recording of it here...

strings.string: 一年前，有人开始从纺锤（the Spindle）之上播送一道信号。我这里有一份录音……

string.ID: {{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form remain still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*裹着雨水肖默形体的衣物静止不动。*}}

string.ID: I ask you: disable the magnetic field so that the Spindle can be ascended and the signal investigated.

strings.string: 我请求你：解除磁场，使纺锤（the Spindle）得以攀登，信号得以查究。

string.ID:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}
Saad, the Seraph sprecen. Saad, thu asken, and the shomrim assenten. Saad, wiltou return to Salum or crossen in-to Brightsheol?

strings.string:
{{emote|*裹着雨水肖默形体的衣物，久久静止不动。*}}
萨德（Saad），炽天使已言。 萨德，汝既相求，守冥人（Shomer）允之。 萨德，汝欲归萨鲁姆，抑或渡入明暗界（Brightsheol）？

string.ID: If it can be done, return me to Qud. I wish to ascend the Spindle myself.

strings.string: 若此事可行，送我回卡德（Qud）。我要亲自登上纺锤（the Spindle）。

string.ID: ... I've shaken the wet life from my hair. Now I shall cross into Brightsheol.

strings.string: ……我已从发间抖落那湿冷之命。如今我将渡入明暗界（Brightsheol）。

string.ID: I need time to consider.
Saad, nou-then return.
I am ready.
I need time to reconsider.
Saad, nou-then crossen in-to Brightsheol.
I am ready.
I need time to reconsider.

=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
If Nacham is as wise as Doyoba believes, we stand to learn much very soon. Perhaps our coterie will spread the knowledge we gain, and we become a step closer to the Kasaphescence.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异的生灵被幽闭了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:你们:你=给了其中一个声音。
若纳哈姆真如多约巴所信的那般睿智，我们很快就能学到许多。或许我们的同修团会把所得的知识传播开去，让我们离卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）更近一步。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=随时愿意来此造访、居留，都受欢迎。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
I cannot help but hold some fear toward Dagasha. However, an it means us no harm I am open to allying with it. No doubt the future of this coterie hath changed, mayhap for the better.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异的生灵被幽闭了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:你们:你=给了其中一个声音。
我对达加莎难免心存畏惧。不过，若它对我们并无恶意，我愿意与之结盟。同修团的未来无疑已经改变——或许是变得更好。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=随时愿意来此造访、居留，都受欢迎。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
That said, I am uncertain what changes to expect. Dost the ancient Va'am yet have the capacity to defend, or protect? Can we gift it with a better means for transportation? I'll speak to Dadogom of this, and time shall reveal all.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异的生灵被幽闭了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:你们:你=给了其中一个声音。
话虽如此，我仍不确定该期待何种变化。古老的瓦阿姆还有自保、护人的余力吗？我们能赠它一种更好的移动之法吗？此事我会与达多戈姆商议，时间自会揭晓一切。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=随时愿意来此造访、居留，都受欢迎。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
I find myself amused at Kah's 'rest', for it appeareth as active as ever--far more so than I, ever. But running free and running unwillingly are certainly not the same. Perhaps, in time, it can learn a deeper rest from us.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异的生灵被幽闭了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:你们:你=给了其中一个声音。
卡赫所谓「安歇」令我失笑——它看上去一如既往地活跃，远比我活跃得多。但自由奔跑与身不由己地奔跑，终究不同。或许假以时日，它能从我们身上学会更深一层的安歇。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=随时愿意来此造访、居留，都受欢迎。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome here.
An =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= any questions, I would fain answer them.

strings.string:
你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。此处=ifplayerplural:欢迎你们:欢迎你=。
若=ifplayerplural:你们:你=有何疑问，我乐意作答。

string.ID: What can you tell me of k-Goninon?

strings.string: 关于 k-戈尼农，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: I have recovered a repulsive device.

strings.string: 我寻回了一件令人厌恶的装置。

string.ID: Greetings. I am =name=. Who are you?
Are you in charge here?
This settlement is... cozy.
What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 关于那座墓，你知道些什么？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.
Live and drink, plated one.
=ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= press these slynth into the fissures of historic stone where we reside, that they may observe what we do?

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:你们可愿:你可愿=把这些斯林斯压印进我们栖居的古老石缝，好让它们观察我们作为？

string.ID: I would.

If these slynth wish to become mopango and =ifplayerplural:ye speak:thou speakest= for them, then we shall accept them. Let them gaze into the schematics that wrote history beside us if they so choose.

strings.string: 若这些斯林斯愿成为莫潘戈，而=ifplayerplural:你们:你=为他们作保，我们便接纳他们。若他们愿意，就让他们凝视那些曾在我们身旁书写历史的图样吧。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Agyra.

Please understand that we mean no slight to =ifplayerplural:you:thee= in saying so, but what =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= of us is too heavy a weight for =ifplayerplural:your names:thy name= to bear.
Perhaps this will change, come deed and time.

strings.string:
请明白，我们这样说绝非轻慢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=；只是=ifplayerplural:你们所求:你所求=之物，对=ifplayerplural:你们的名号:你的名号=而言太过沉重。
或许待到事成、时移，一切会有转机。

string.ID:
How =ifplayerplural:fare ye:farest thou=, then, and what word of the slynth?
We shine with curiosity to hear it.

strings.string:
那么=ifplayerplural:你们:你=近来可好？斯林斯那边有何消息？
我们满心好奇，等着听呢。

string.ID:
The Kasaphescence shine upon =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=.
Although the welcome of these slynth be not entirely without incident, I am yet hopeful that their curiosity and dedication to tasks will serve them well among us.

strings.string:
愿卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）照临=ifplayerplural:你们:你=，=name=。
尽管这些斯林斯的到来并非全无波折，我仍希望他们的好奇心与做事之勤能在我们中间有所用处。

string.ID: My thanks, Agyra.

These lilypad folk fascinate by their similarities and differences to us alike--we have much to explore, as individuals and together.
The experiences and beings =ifplayerplural:ye herald:thou heraldest= overwhelm this humble pilgrim, =name=. May =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= bathe ever in Her light.

strings.string:
这些睡莲之民令人着迷——他们与我们既相似又相异，无论作为个体还是作为整体，都有许多可探究之处。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=带来的种种见闻与存在，令我这卑微的朝圣者应接不暇，=name=。愿=ifplayerplural:你们:你=永浴她的光。

string.ID: My thanks again, Agyra.

Oh, so =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast=, and what a sight. Please forgive my distance, but I am loath to touch it.
It appeareth of similar make to the children, and I believe its jaw seeketh them. Lebah claimeth that the device grants freedom, and I wonder what that freedom will look like. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= speak to the watchers of the children for further insight.

strings.string:
哦，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=当真寻到了，真是奇观。请原谅我站得远，我实在不愿碰它。
它看上去与那些孩子同出一源，我想它的颚正寻着他们。勒巴赫声称那装置能赐予自由，我倒想知道那自由是什么模样。或许=ifplayerplural:你们:你=该去问问那些孩子的看守，以求更深的理解。

string.ID: Understood. Live and drink, Agyra.

strings.string: 明白。活下去，喝足水，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Seek-ye:Seekest-thou= the repulsive device, then?
k-Goninon, ancient and venerated gelatinous cupola, doth patrol the catacombs. Arrived centuries ere we discovered this place, k-Goninon hath hardened and eateth not through the floor, and yet it eateth prodigiously. Safe from the conservators, as k-Goninon long ago consumed the Mark of Death itself.
Please be careful. k-Goninon hath devoured watchers and wouldst devour =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well.

strings.string:
那么=ifplayerplural:你们在寻:你在寻=那件令人厌恶的装置？
k-戈尼农——古老而受尊崇的凝胶穹顶——在墓窟中巡行。它在我们发现此地之前数百年就已到来，早已硬化，不再穿透地面进食，食量却依旧惊人。它不受防腐者管束，因为 k-戈尼农很久以前就把「死亡之印」本身吞了下去。
请务必小心。k-戈尼农吞噬过看守，也会吞掉=ifplayerplural:你们:你=。

string.ID: I will be careful. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会小心。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I am Agyra, a watcher of the tomb.

strings.string: 我是阿吉拉，此墓的看守。

string.ID: May I call you man, woman, or something else?

strings.string: 我该称你为男人、女人，还是别的什么？

string.ID: Are you in charge here?
It's a cozy home you have here.

strings.string: 你们这儿是个温馨的家。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 关于那座墓，你知道些什么？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.
Live and drink, Agyra.

I hope it is not overly crowded for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. We mopango are most comfortable in close quarters, but I acknowledge that not all creatures adore the close embrace of the depths as we do.
Regardless, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= welcome to stay and sup, and ask of me any questions =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= have.

strings.string:
希望这里对=ifplayerplural:你们:你=不算太拥挤。我们莫潘戈在逼仄处最自在，但我也承认，并非所有生灵都像我们一样钟爱深处的紧拥。
无论如何，=ifplayerplural:欢迎你们:欢迎你=留下用餐，有任何疑问都尽管问我。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?
Are you in charge here?
This settlement is... cozy.
What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 关于那座墓，你知道些什么？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.
Thank you. Live and drink.

No one leadeth us. We mopango hold little regard for hierarchy, and our shared decisions are made through discussion, quiet consideration, and consensus.
Shouldst be otherwise?

strings.string:
无人统辖我们。莫潘戈不甚看重层级；我们的共同决定经由讨论、静思与共识而成。
难道该是别的样子？

string.ID: I suppose not.
It's a cozy home you have here.

strings.string: 你们这儿是个温馨的家。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 关于那座墓，你知道些什么？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.
Live and drink, Agyra.
{{emote|*Agyra smiles at you, glowing softly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿吉拉对你微笑，柔柔地发着光。*}}

string.ID: It's a cozy home you have here.

strings.string: 你们这儿是个温馨的家。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 关于那座墓，你知道些什么？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.
I should take my leave. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我该告辞了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
We are mopango: witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. The Sacred Light of the Kasaphescence shineth within us, and we commune with relics of antiquity to maintain our humility and grow our wisdom.
We believe that one day, with enough knowledge, anyone who seeketh the Light shalt find it within emself. In the meantime, we work to become better and brighter as each one of us findeth a personal credo by which to live.

strings.string:
我们是莫潘戈：往昔的见证者，未来的牧人。卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）的圣光在我们体内照耀；我们与上古遗物相通，以守谦卑、长智慧。
我们相信，终有一日，凭足够的知识，凡求光者都能在伊自身之内寻得那光。在此期间，我们各自寻觅一条属于自己的信条，并依之而活，以求变得更好、更亮。

string.ID: Why do you speak so strangely?

strings.string: 你们说话为何如此古怪？

string.ID: Why do some of you have wheels?

strings.string: 你们中为何有的长着轮子？

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 关于那座墓，你知道些什么？

string.ID:
Aye. Ey, em, eir, eirs, emself. Thusly do we call ourselves and one another.
Sex is personal and mattereth not to a bare acquaintence. Gender is a societal relic in which we see no current utility.

strings.string:
正是。伊、伊、伊的、伊的、伊自身。我们如此称呼自己，也如此互称。
生理性别是私事，对泛泛之交毫无意义。社会性别则是一件社会遗物，我们看不出它如今有何用处。

string.ID: I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我还有别的问题。

string.ID: Oh. Live and drink.

The Tomb of the Eaters consisteth of twelve strata, or ten, once =ifplayerplural:ye account:thou accounteth= for transitional levels: the Folk Catacombs (in which =ifplayerplural:ye currently stand:thou currently standeth=), the Crematory and Columbarium, the Two Crypts, and the Six Tombs of Qud's Sultans above.
An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest= fortune here, gird =ifplayerplural:thyselves:thyself= for disappointment. The tomb playeth host to objects wondrous and profane alike, but little of what surface-dwellers considereth treasure.

strings.string:
食者（the Eaters）之墓共十二层——若=ifplayerplural:你们把:你把=过渡层也计入，则是十层：民墓窟（=ifplayerplural:你们此刻正站在其中:你此刻正站在其中=）、焚化堂与骨灰龛、双 crypt、以及上方卡德（Qud）六位苏丹的陵寝。
若=ifplayerplural:你们:你=是来此寻宝的，那就做好失望的准备吧。此墓所藏既有奇珍，也有秽物，但地表居民眼中的宝物寥寥无几。

string.ID: 'Wondrous and profane?' Now I'm curious.
I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我还有别的问题。

string.ID:
Aye. One's own credo shouldst inspire reflection and thought, with no clear-cut meaning but meaning nonetheless. Some of our coterie yet seeketh theirs, but an experienced watcher no doubt hath one. Any mopango who hath a credo wilt share it with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, an =ifplayerplural:ye request:thou requesteth= it.
My credo is: "Malice alone staineth the sanctity of questioning."

strings.string:
正是。一个人的信条应当引人反思与思索；它没有确切的含义，却又确有其含义。我们同修团中有些人仍在寻觅自己的信条，但经验丰富的看守必定已有一条。任何持有信条的莫潘戈，只要=ifplayerplural:你们:你=开口相求，都会与=ifplayerplural:你们:你=分享。
我的信条是：「唯有恶意，会玷污叩问的神圣。」

string.ID: What does that mean?
I have further questions.
I will ponder this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会好好想想。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I cannot simply explain my credo to =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. A credo informeth and confoundeth at once, and must be reflected upon by the listener.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= inexperienced in our ways, so please bear my words in the kind spirit they are meant: to ask a mopango to explain eir credo is to commit one of our few taboo acts. Be advised.

strings.string:
我无法简单地把自己的信条解释给=ifplayerplural:你们:你=听。信条既给人启发，又令人困惑，必须由听者自行反思。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你们=对我们的习俗尚不熟悉，所以请以善意领会我的话：要求一个莫潘戈解释伊的信条，是触犯我们少数禁忌之一。特此告知。

string.ID: Hmm. I have further questions.
Thank you. Live and drink.
Hmm. I have further questions.
Are you in charge here?
What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 关于那座墓，你知道些什么？

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
You demonstrate tremendous promise to have returned from Golgotha with such inexperience. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile. Take this bracelet, as well.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉瑟鲁姆的管家。为我们的初遇方式致歉，但我们必须采取防范。卡德（Qud）是个极不留情的地方。
你如此缺乏经验，却能从各各他生还，足见前途无量。收下这把火器作为奖赏——上面有我们最好的枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的印记。这只手镯也一并收下。
等你准备好讨论那道信号时，再来。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
I am pleased to see that you've returned with the waydroid, though you still know little of the dangers you bear. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉瑟鲁姆的管家。为我们的初遇方式致歉，但我们必须采取防范。卡德（Qud）是个极不留情的地方。
很高兴看到你带着道机回来了，尽管你对自身所负的危险仍所知甚少。收下这把火器作为奖赏——上面有我们最好的枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的印记。
等你准备好讨论那道信号时，再来。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
You are worthy to study with us. Take these.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉瑟鲁姆的管家。为我们的初遇方式致歉，但我们必须采取防范。卡德（Qud）是个极不留情的地方。
你有资格与我们一同研习。收下这些。
等你准备好讨论那道信号时，再来。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

It takes more than a willing spirit to be trusted here, wayfarer.
Prove your worth and bring us a waydroid, and we will have more to speak of.

strings.string:
要在此地获得信任，光有一颗热切的心是不够的，旅人。
证明你的价值，给我们带一台道机来，那时我们才有更多可谈。

string.ID: Are you ready to discuss the signal?

strings.string: 你准备好讨论那道信号了吗？

string.ID:
The signal is a repeat transmission being broadcast from an unknown source. =V0tinkeraddendum= One of our tinkers, {{m|Q Girl}}, discovered it while rigging a long wave detector. Unfortunately, it's encrypted, and we do not have the means here to decrypt it. You may be of some help in this matter, however.
We've long known the location of a fully functioning {{W|baetyl}} within the bowels of the great hall {{C|Bethesda Susa}}. The Mechanimists have consecrated the site around it and built a temple there. Q Girl claims to have developed a means to decrypt the signal, but she needs the computing power of the baetyl. If you can infiltrate the Mechanimist compound, you may be able to engage the baetyl and decode the signal.

strings.string:
那道信号是一段从不明来源播出的重复传输。=V0tinkeraddendum=我们的修补匠之一，{{m|Q女郎}}，在架设长波探测器时发现了它。遗憾的是，它经过加密，我们此地没有解密的手段。不过，你或许能在这件事上帮上忙。
我们早就知道，在大厅{{C|贝塞斯达·苏萨}}的腹地有一台运转完好的{{W|贝提尔}}。机械教派将四周奉为圣地，并在那里建起一座神殿。Q女郎声称已研制出解密之法，但需要那台贝提尔的算力。你若能潜入机械教派的营地，或许就能接触贝提尔并解出信号。

string.ID: What is a baetyl?

They are antique stones located in certain places deep within the caverns of Qud. We believe they are some sort of hyper-advanced machines built by the Eaters. Often one claims to possess a sentience of its own. However, most of them have gone haywire in the eons since their creation; it is rare indeed to discover one whose circuitry is wholly uncorroded.
The Mechanimists worship this one as an idol, and they will protect it at all costs. You will need to find a way through their host to the baetyl itself.
Do you believe you can accomplish this task?

strings.string:
它们是坐落在卡德（Qud）洞穴深处某些地方的古石。我们相信那是食者（the Eaters）建造的某种超级机器，往往自称拥有独立的意识。然而，自被造出以来的万古之中，它们大多已经失常；要找到一台电路全无锈蚀的，实在罕见。
机械教派把这一台当作偶像崇拜，会不惜一切代价守护它。你需要设法穿过他们的大军，抵达贝提尔本身。
你认为自己能完成这项任务吗？

string.ID: Yes, I do.
I must think on this task.

Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.
There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.
The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service.

strings.string:
很好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。去工坊找{{m|Q女郎}}。她会把给贝提尔的指令编码到数据盘的副本上。
还有一件事。那台贝提尔位于食者（the Eaters）古老低温舱的下方。岁月侵蚀了封存其低温雾气的机构，如今那冻雾自由地涌出舱室，冷却着整座洞穴。你最好弄些保暖衣物来保护=player.reflexive=。
机械教派的战利品归你所有。记住，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=，巴拉瑟鲁姆会善待你的效力。

string.ID: I will return with the data, Steward.

strings.string: 我会带着数据回来，管家。

string.ID: Luck be with you in the lair of Bethsaida, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

strings.string: 愿好运伴你进入贝塞达的巢穴，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: I will return with the data, Steward.

strings.string: 我会带着数据回来，管家。

string.ID: You return. Have you succeeded in decoding the signal?

strings.string: 你回来了。信号解出来了吗？

string.ID: Well done, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Present the disk.
[Give Otho the disk]
I must bring the decoded signal to Barathrum immediately. Return in a few hours. By then I'll have discussed our next course of action with Barathrum and will have further instructions for you.

strings.string: 我必须立刻把解出的信号交给巴拉瑟鲁姆。几小时后再来。届时我已与巴拉瑟鲁姆商议过下一步行动，会有新的指示给你。

string.ID: As you say, steward.
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=, I have no further instructions for you yet. Return soon.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=，我还没有新的指示给你。稍后再来。

string.ID: As you say, steward.
=name=, I've brought the decoded signal to Barathrum, and he's finished musing on it. We have fresh instructions for you, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Are you ready to hear them?

strings.string: =name=，我已把解出的信号交给巴拉瑟鲁姆，他也已思虑完毕。我们有新的指示给你，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。你准备好听了吗？

string.ID:
Barathrum needs you for an undertaking of great importance. You must journey to {{C|Omonporch}} far to the north. There the Spindle stretches from earth to sky. Unfortunately, a troublesome merchant from the Consortium of Phyta has relocated there and declared xerself Earl of Omonporch. We need you to broker a deal so that we may lease control of the Spindle. Failing that, you'll need to dispose of the self-appointed Earl.
Be careful on your approach to Omonporch, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. So far east into the reaches of Qud, the Putus Templar lie in wait.

strings.string:
巴拉瑟鲁姆有一件极重要的事需要你去做。你必须远赴北方的{{C|奥蒙波奇}}。纺锤（the Spindle）自那里拔地通天。遗憾的是，植物联盟一名难缠的商人迁去了那里，自称奥蒙波奇伯爵。我们需要你去谈成一笔交易，好让我们租下纺锤的控制权。若谈不成，你就得除掉这位自封的伯爵。
接近奥蒙波奇时务必小心，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。在卡德（Qud）东境的纵深，普图斯圣殿骑士正埋伏等候。

string.ID: Who are the Putus Templar?
What is the purpose of this?
I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我会为巴拉瑟鲁姆拿下纺锤（the Spindle）。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

The Putus Templar, or the Sons and Daughters, as they call themselves, are an order of knights who claim descendancy from the Eaters, the ancient folk who wrought the chrome halls of Qud. Beware them, for while they despise all mutants, they harbor a special malice for Barathrum.
Take care that you do not find =player.reflexive= inside one of their slave pens.

strings.string:
普图斯圣殿骑士——他们自称「子女会」——是一个骑士团，声称是食者（the Eaters）的后裔，也就是铸造了卡德（Qud）铬色厅堂的古老民族。提防他们：他们憎恶一切变异者，而对巴拉瑟鲁姆怀有格外的恶意。
当心别让=player.reflexive=落进他们的奴隶栏里。

string.ID: What is the purpose of this?
I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我会为巴拉瑟鲁姆拿下纺锤（the Spindle）。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

That will be revealed to you in due time.
Do not forget your place, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

strings.string:
时候到了自会告知你。
别忘了你的身份，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: Who are the Putus Templar?
I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我会为巴拉瑟鲁姆拿下纺锤（the Spindle）。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. The Putus Templar must have followed you back from Omonporch.
Let us use the precious little time we have before they arrive to prepare our defenses.

strings.string:
正如我所担心的，=name=。砂砾门正遭受攻击。普图斯圣殿骑士一定是尾随你从奥蒙波奇回来的。
趁他们抵达前这点宝贵的时间，我们赶紧布置防务。

string.ID: What can I do?
Go to the mainframe room and scan the shale surrounding Grit Gate for anomalies. Now, =name=!

strings.string: 去主机房，扫描砂砾门周边的页岩，找出异常。现在就去，=name=！

string.ID: I'll go now.

With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.
Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.

strings.string:
用我给你的铬制钥匙卡，你现在可以使用我们的电网。聚落各处都布有链式激光炮位与力场投射器。借埃列什基伽勒的侦察来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过与埃列什基伽勒对接来广播超频指令，或启动罗达尼斯·Y。
但要留意电流消耗。若超额取用，可能导致电压跌落。
快行动，=name=！就在我们说话的当口，圣殿骑士已经逼近。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我会尽全力守住砂砾门。

string.ID: That rumbling... what was it? An explosion? Hmm...

strings.string: 那阵轰鸣……是什么？爆炸？嗯……

string.ID: What are you thinking, Otho?

Grave thoughts, =name=. Listen to me now. Take this key card, go to Ereshkigal's room, and-- oh, that's the mainframe. It's what she prefers to be called.
Go to her room, access Ereshkigal, and scan the shale surrounding the enclave for anomalies. I've asked her to ready her sensors.
Update me with what you learn. You may use the intercom in the northeast corner of Ereshkigal's room to deliver your update.
Go, quickly! I'd soon be disabused of my fears.

strings.string:
沉重的念头，=name=。听我说。拿上这张钥匙卡，去埃列什基伽勒的房间，然后——哦，那就是主机。她更愿意被这么称呼。
去她的房间，接入埃列什基伽勒，扫描聚落周边的页岩，找出异常。我已让她备好传感器。
查到什么就来告诉我。你可以用埃列什基伽勒房间东北角的对讲机汇报。
快去！我但愿自己的恐惧很快被证明是多虑。

string.ID: I'll go now.

You can still activate our defenses, =name=. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

strings.string:
你仍可启用我们的防御，=name=。聚落各处都布有链式激光炮位与力场投射器。借埃列什基伽勒的侦察来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过与埃列什基伽勒对接来广播超频指令，或启动罗达尼斯·Y。
但要留意电流消耗。若超额取用，可能导致电压跌落。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我会尽全力守住砂砾门。

string.ID: Have you secured the Spindle yet?
Yes, the Spindle is ours.

strings.string: 是的，纺锤（the Spindle）归我们了。

string.ID: No, not yet.
Leave me alone for a moment, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I have duties to attend.

strings.string: 让我静一静，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我有职务要处理。

string.ID: I will return later, Otho.
That is sterling news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I'll go inform Barathrum straightaway.

strings.string: 这消息再好不过，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我这就去禀报巴拉瑟鲁姆。

string.ID:
Furthermore, I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.
The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.
You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.

strings.string:
此外，我与巴拉瑟鲁姆谈过了。他称赞了你处置奥蒙波奇伯爵的手腕，并感谢你在守卫砂砾门时展现的勇气。
今日之袭提醒了我们：太久以来，我们都把信心寄托于公会的隐世，以及普图斯圣殿骑士的牵绊。另一场袭击的威胁迫在眉睫，促使巴拉瑟鲁姆加快他的计划——连同你在会中的地位。
你被擢升为门徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉瑟鲁姆希望立刻与你一谈。

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他要与我谈话？巴拉瑟鲁姆本人？

string.ID:
I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.
The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.
You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.

strings.string:
我与巴拉瑟鲁姆谈过了。他称赞了你处置奥蒙波奇伯爵的手腕，并感谢你在守卫砂砾门时展现的勇气。
今日之袭提醒了我们：太久以来，我们都把信心寄托于公会的隐世，以及普图斯圣殿骑士的牵绊。另一场袭击的威胁迫在眉睫，促使巴拉瑟鲁姆加快他的计划——连同你在会中的地位。
你被擢升为门徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉瑟鲁姆希望立刻与你一谈。

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他要与我谈话？巴拉瑟鲁姆本人？

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他要与我谈话？巴拉瑟鲁姆本人？

string.ID: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Take this key and follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.

strings.string: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。拿上这把钥匙，沿楼梯下去到他的书房。他在等你。

string.ID: Thank you, Otho.
Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.

strings.string: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。沿楼梯下去到他的书房。他在等你。

string.ID: Thank you, Otho.
I am busy, wayfarer. Please talk to Mafeo in the trade square if you need something.

strings.string: 我很忙，旅人。若你需要什么，去贸易广场找马费奥。

string.ID: Don't be coy, =name=. Emboldened by your incursions into our village, you wish to fill it with your indigent foundlings on the weight of your reputation alone. Am I correct?

strings.string: 别装糊涂，=name=。你仗着几次闯进我们村子，就想仅凭自己的名声把那些穷酸弃儿塞满这里。我说得对吗？

string.ID: I... suppose so, yes.
Then I overestimated your intellect further than I realized. Get out.

strings.string: 那我高估你智力的程度，比我以为的还要多。滚出去。

string.ID: The slynth? What of them?

Live and drink, kendren. I am Hindriarch Keh; welcome to Bey Lah.
It's nearly unprecedented for one such as you to pass by our scouts unaccosted, but these are unprecedented circumstances. I have a task for you. Are you interested?

strings.string:
活下去，喝足水，外客。我是女族长凯；欢迎来到贝拉。
像你这样的人能不被我们的斥候拦下就走过去，几乎前所未有；不过眼下正是前所未有的时局。我有件事要交给你。有兴趣吗？

string.ID: Yes. Go on.

Good.
We hindren are a close-knit and staid people, and our safety depends on our solidarity. In order to preserve our safety and culture, we ask that any of our number who leave us never come back. Recently, one such exile took the treasure of our village, a bracelet named Kindrish, with her when she left. None of our number can leave to get it back, or it will be a violation of the values that I have guarded, and the Hindriarchs before me, for countless generations.
Will you help us recover our treasure? We have a small cache of valuables we can offer as a reward.

strings.string:
很好。
我们欣德伦是一个抱团而守旧的族群，安危系于团结。为保全我们的安全与文化，凡离族者，我们要求其永不回头。不久前，这样一个流放者离去时带走了村里的宝物——一只名为金德里什（Kindrish）的手镯。我们族中无人能外出取回，否则便是违背我、以及我之前无数代女族长所守护的准则。
你愿意帮我们找回宝物吗？我们有一小批值钱物件，可以作报酬。

string.ID: All right. I'll find your treasure.
No thank you. I don't care for this job.

strings.string: 不了，谢谢。这活我不感兴趣。

string.ID:
Excellent. I will do my best to reward you to your satisfaction.
Though her name is sand in my mouth now, the exile who stole Kindrish is called Eskhind. She left a few weeks ago, and took her sister and brother with her. I don't know where she's gone, but Warden Neelahind might, as they were close friends as children.
Find the exile called Eskhind and retrieve Kindrish from her, even... even if the cost is the life of her and her siblings. Kindrish has been handed down over countless generations, and it belongs to my people, not any individual. Go, kendren. Speak to Warden Neelahind, and find out where Eskhind is hidden.

strings.string:
很好。我会尽力给你满意的报酬。
尽管她的名字如今在我口中如沙，那个偷走金德里什（Kindrish）的流放者名叫埃斯欣德。她几周前离开，还带走了她的妹妹和弟弟。我不知道她去了哪里，但看守尼拉欣德或许知道——她们小时候很亲近。
找到那个叫埃斯欣德的流放者，从她手中取回金德里什——哪怕……哪怕代价是她和她手足的性命。金德里什传承了无数代，它属于我的族人，不属于任何个人。去吧，外客。去找看守尼拉欣德，问出埃斯欣德藏在何处。

string.ID: As you say.
Then I will thank you to leave as quickly as possible. I don't want the faundren to become used to our borders being permeable.

strings.string: 那就请你尽快离开。我不想让法恩德伦们习惯我们的边界可以随意穿越。

string.ID: As you say. Live and drink.

You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed. Take this as thanks.
That said, the exile must answer for her crimes. There is further reward for you if you see this case through to the end.

strings.string:
你找到我们的宝物了？我承认，外客，我相当佩服。收下这个，算是谢礼。
话虽如此，那流放者必须为她的罪行负责。若你把此案办到底，还有更多报酬。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed.
Take this as thanks, and... well. I suppose you've earned your stay for a while. Just try not to give the faundren any ideas.

strings.string:
你找到我们的宝物了？我承认，外客，我相当佩服。
收下这个，算是谢礼，还有……嗯。我想你算是挣得了在此逗留一阵的资格。只是别给法恩德伦们灌什么念头。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.
You're back. Have you found the exile and retrieved our treasure?

strings.string: 你回来了。找到那流放者、取回我们的宝物了吗？

string.ID: I have found Kindrish, but not Eskhind.

strings.string: 我找到了金德里什（Kindrish），但没找到埃斯欣德。

string.ID: Eskhind is dead, but Kindrish was not on her body.

strings.string: 埃斯欣德死了，但金德里什（Kindrish）不在她身上。

string.ID: I have not.
Perhaps you should get back to it rather than hanging around my village. Warden Neelahind may be able to help you.

strings.string: 那你或许该回去办正事，而不是在我村里晃荡。看守尼拉欣德也许能帮你。

string.ID: As you say. Live and drink.
Ayvah. She must have sold it. Tell no one about this. Please understand that I cannot reward you, as you did not complete the task I asked of you.

strings.string: 哎呀。她一定是把它卖了。此事不许对任何人提起。请理解，我无法给你报酬，因为你没有完成我交代的任务。

string.ID: Understandable. Live and drink.

strings.string: 可以理解。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Unacceptable. Prepare to die.
Why is an exile standing in my village? Are you trying to play me for a fool?

strings.string: 为什么一个流放者站在我的村子里？你是想把我当傻子耍吗？

string.ID: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish, but Eskhind did not have it.

strings.string: 女族长，我找到了金德里什（Kindrish），但不在埃斯欣德手上。

string.ID: Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.

strings.string: 埃斯欣德声称自己是被冤枉的。

string.ID:
The pariah claims to be wrongfully accused, and you believe her?
She is obviously lying. Are all kendren so gullible?

strings.string:
那个贱民说自己被冤枉，你就信了？
她显然在撒谎。难道外客都这么好骗？

string.ID: There is no proof that she is lying.

strings.string: 没有证据证明她在撒谎。

string.ID:
Fine! Go to the Warden, then, and have her solve this mystery.
But know this: until a thief is found and Kindrish is recovered, I cannot reward you. You get nothing. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
好！那就去找看守，让她来解这个谜。
但你记住：在找到窃贼、追回金德里什（Kindrish）之前，我无法给你报酬。你什么也得不到。活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: ...live and drink.
Why are you speaking to me? You have work to do.

strings.string: 你跟我说话做什么？你有活要干。

string.ID: I have questions for you.
Fine. What are they?
Why was Eskhind exiled?

strings.string: 埃斯欣德为什么被流放？

string.ID: Who is your bodyguard?
Is Neelahind a good warden?

strings.string: 尼拉欣德是个好看守吗？

string.ID: Why did you tell me Eskhind had a brother?

strings.string: 你为什么告诉我埃斯欣德有个弟弟？

string.ID: That's all. Live and drink.

She exiled herself by leaving Bey Lah. Our codes demand that no hindren who leaves us ever return.
She knew this, and still she chose to leave.

strings.string:
她离开贝拉，就是自我流放。我们的法典规定：凡离族之欣德伦，永不回头。
她明知如此，仍然选择离开。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Kesehind is a good boy. He lost his parents long ago, but has been like a son to me.
Now his axe-arm is strong where mine is not, and so he lends it.

strings.string:
凯塞欣德是个好孩子。他早年失去双亲，待我如子。
如今他的斧臂强健，而我的已不济，他便将这臂膀借给我。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Warden Neelahind attends to her duties admirably. She is not terribly assertive, but she need not be.
I'm surprised she's going along with this outsider-led investigation, but she always had a soft spot for the exile.

strings.string:
看守尼拉欣德尽责可嘉。她不太强势，不过她也不必强势。
她竟由着一个外客主导这场调查，我很意外；不过她对那流放者一向心软。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
If you ask the exile, I'm sure she'll spin some kind of accusation that I believe gender to be an immutable prison, that I impose it on others.
She's lying. Our people have a long history of two-gender hindren called {{w|hartind}}, respected and consecrated. There is a proper path to gender variance in our society, of which the male exile could have availed himself years ago.
He never did, so I do not recognize him.

strings.string:
你若去问那流放者，她一定会编出些指控，说我视性别为不可动摇的牢笼、说我把它强加于人。
她在撒谎。我们族群自古就有双性别的欣德伦，称为{{w|哈廷德（hartind）}}，受人敬重，并受祝圣。在我们的社会里，性别变异有一条正当的途径，那位男性流放者多年前本可循此而行。
他从未如此，所以我不承认他。

string.ID: I... see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我……明白了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Poem? I detest poetry. Why would one go about learning to write only to use purposefully unclear language, choosing rhyme scheme over clarity?
Of course it's not mine. Take it back.

strings.string:
诗？我讨厌诗。一个人何必学了写字，却偏要用故意含糊的语言、宁取韵脚而舍明白？
这当然不是我的。拿回去。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Gone...
All gone...

I have a terrible feeling that I've brought ill fortune to my village.
Perhaps it was a mistake to have hired you.

strings.string:
我有种极坏的预感：是我把厄运带给了村子。
或许雇用你本就是个错误。

string.ID: If you say so. Live and drink.

strings.string: 随你怎么说。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
They conspired against me. It is the only explanation.
You! Leave me alone.

strings.string:
他们合谋对付我。这是唯一的解释。
你！离我远点。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你会有办法的。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I should have kept them apart.
I should have kept all of you apart.

strings.string:
我本该把他们分开。
我本该把你们所有人都分开。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你会有办法的。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Ah, you again. I'd been doing so well at forgetting your countenance.
Leave me be.

strings.string:
啊，又是你。我本已快把你的脸忘干净了。
别来烦我。

string.ID: You have a great deal of nerve to speak to me after what you've done.

strings.string: 你做了那些事之后，还有脸来跟我说话。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你会有办法的。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你会有办法的。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Kendren! A moment of your time, please. You are =name=, yes? You seek to solve a mystery here in the village, yes?

strings.string: 外客！请借一步说话。你就是=name=，对吧？你是来查村里那桩疑案的，对吧？

string.ID: I am, and yes.
How did you know all that?
Who are you?
I don't have time for this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我没空听这个。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Poem? Oh! This is a Shakespriggan sonnet, but I didn't write it--the rhymes are a bit facile, and love poems don't interest me.
I've been teaching Eskhind about sonnets, so she must have written this. But that means... oh, poor thing.

strings.string:
诗？哦！这是一首莎士普里格体的十四行诗，但不是我写的——韵脚有点浅，而且情诗不合我的胃口。
我一直在教埃斯欣德十四行诗，所以这一定是她写的。可那就意味着……哦，可怜的姑娘。

string.ID:
I hoped you would ask! I closely study the works of the great bard, Willow Shakesprig. In particular, I am most fond of the stories of the Great Plant Detective, Hemlock Cones. Through these stories, I have learned to hone my perceptions and deductive skill to a fine point. It is my dearest hope that one day I shall be known not as Angohind, village bookworm... but Angohind, Master Detective.
My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?

strings.string:
我就盼着你问这句！我仔细研读伟大诗人柳·莎士普里格的著作。其中我最爱的是「大植物侦探」铁杉·科恩斯的故事。借这些故事，我把观察力与推演之术磨到了极细。我最大的心愿，是有一天人们不再叫我「安戈欣德，村里的书虫」……而是「安戈欣德，侦探大师」。
我祖母不许我插手村里那些怪事，可她没说不许我把侦查的门道教给你！你意下如何？

string.ID: I am listening.
I should... go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我该……走了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Yes, yes of course.
I am Angohind: grandson of esteemed Elder Eselhind, young scholar of Shakesprig, and best dressed hindren in Bey Lah. I am also, as luck would have it, an aspirant investigator with an ear... for mystery.
My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?

strings.string:
对，对，当然。
我是安戈欣德：受人敬重的长者埃塞尔欣德之孙、莎士普里格的年少学者、贝拉衣品最好的欣德伦。运气好的话，我还是一名见习调查员，有一双……听得出疑案的耳朵。

string.ID: I am listening.
No thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不了，谢谢。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Oh, truly? You won't regret this, kendren, I promise! So, let's get to it!
Every mystery hinges on the detection and interpretation of evidence. As Hemlock Cones said:
Ere any prosecution can commence, Accusers must obtain some evidence. The solving lies in seeing and locating Supporting clues as well as implicating.

strings.string:
哦，当真？你不会后悔的，外客，我保证！那我们就开始吧！
每一桩疑案，都系于证据的发现与解读。正如铁杉·科恩斯所言：
欲兴讼，先取证。 破案之要，在于看得见、找得着： 既要有旁证，也要有牵连。

string.ID: How do I find evidence?
What makes something evidence?
What is implicating evidence?
What is supporting evidence?
What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?

strings.string: 如果证据指向多个嫌疑人呢？

string.ID:
Professor Cones taught me everything about finding evidence!
Though evidence you found upon the ground may yet be sound, If it will be sufficient is a toss-up. Examine all your suspects and their homes and all around, And find a witness who may dish the gossip.
You can find evidence by looking at things on the ground, but you can also look at your suspects to see if there's anything off about them. You can also ask around to see if anyone has seen or heard anything strange, and different witnesses may have different things to report.

strings.string:
科恩斯教授把找证据的门道全教给了我！
地上捡来的证物未必不真， 够不够用却全凭天意。 翻遍嫌犯、其家与其四周， 再找个肯嚼舌根的证人。
你可以查看地上的东西来找证据，也可以端详嫌疑人，看他们身上有无异样。还可以四处打听，看有没有人见过、听过什么怪事——不同的证人，报上来的东西也可能不同。

string.ID: What about supporting evidence?
What makes something evidence?
What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?

strings.string: 如果我找到了指向多个嫌疑人的牵连性证据呢？

string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮忙，安戈欣德。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Evidence is any sign of something gone amiss. The Great Plant Detective gave some good examples in Act II of the tragedy of Gimlet:
So! Sweep the full estate for signs of {{W|trade}}, their shady night-time dealings to expose Now look for signs of {{W|craft}}, see what was made For to conceal a treasure hidden close. But darker still, if {{W|illness}} signs we find A desperate contagion may yet lurk And darkest yet, more {{W|violence}} may reply To those who stumble 'pon their grisly work.

strings.string:
证据就是一切不对劲的迹象。大植物侦探在《吉姆莱特》悲剧第二幕里举过几个好例子：
来！搜遍全宅，寻{{W|买卖}}之痕， 把他们夜里的勾当揭穿； 再找{{W|手艺}}的踪迹，看造过何物， 为的是藏起近处的宝物。 更暗的是，若见{{W|病症}}之兆， 说不定有急疫潜伏未消； 最暗的是，若逢{{W|暴行}}相应， 那是撞破了他们的血案。

string.ID: How do I find evidence?
What makes something evidence?
What is implicating evidence?
What is supporting evidence?
What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?

strings.string: 如果证据指向多个嫌疑人呢？

string.ID:
Implicating evidence is what it sounds like: evidence that implicates someone's involvement in a crime. For example, if someone observed strange behavior in a person, or if you found something weird in a person's room, or even if you observe them behaving strangely =player.reflexive=! That's implicating evidence.
Most of the time, a piece of implicating evidence isn't proof of a crime in and of itself, but when presented alongside supporting evidence, implicating evidence is the seed of truth from which grows the long frond of justice.

strings.string:
牵连性证据，顾名思义：就是把某人牵进案子的证据。比如有人看见某人举止古怪，或你在某人房里发现怪东西，甚至你亲眼看到某人行为反常=player.reflexive=！那都是牵连性证据。
多数时候，单单一桩牵连性证据并不能证明罪行；但它与旁证并列呈上时，便是真相的种子——正义的长叶由此而生。

string.ID: What about supporting evidence?
How do I find evidence?
What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?

strings.string: 如果我找到了指向多个嫌疑人的牵连性证据呢？

string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮忙，安戈欣德。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Supporting evidence can be any sign that something is amiss that you can't directly tie to an individual. One common example is a bloodstain, which indicates that violence was committed but doesn't tell you by whom.
At its heart, supporting evidence is most powerful when paired with implicating evidence. Once you have both, you'll be in a good position to accuse a suspect of wrongdoing.

strings.string:
旁证可以是任何「有事不对劲」的迹象，只要你无法直接把它系到某个人身上。常见的一例是血迹：它说明发生过暴力，却不会告诉你施暴者是谁。
归根结底，旁证与牵连性证据配对时最有力量。两者到手，你就足以指控某个嫌疑人行凶了。

string.ID: What about implicating evidence?
How do I find evidence?
What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?

strings.string: 如果我找到了指向多个嫌疑人的牵连性证据呢？

string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮忙，安戈欣德。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
As Professor Cones said:
We know the reach of law, however long, Is not the finest judge of right and wrong. Choose not what evidence thou wilt present Ere its consequence is evident.
In short, you must use your judgment and intuition, kendren.

strings.string:
正如科恩斯教授所言：
法网虽长，我们知道， 它判不明是非曲直。 呈上何证，且莫急定， 先看后果才知轻重。
简言之，你得靠自己的判断与直觉，外客。

string.ID: What if I accuse the wrong person?

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Multiple culprits?.Evidence is not created equalChoice.Text
string.ID: You're saying that what evidence I choose to show will affect the outcome of the case?

strings.string: 你是说，我选择出示哪些证据，会影响案子的结果？

string.ID: Then what's to keep me from simply choosing the outcome I want?

strings.string: 那什么能阻止我干脆挑一个我想要的结果？

string.ID:
That's always a risk, kendren.
Neelahind knows everyone in the village very well. If you present supporting evidence that contradicts something the Warden knows to be true about the suspect, well, she probably won't believe you. In fact, she might not let you accuse that person again, so be careful.
If you make too many bad accusations, you might lose credibility with her entirely.

strings.string:
这风险一直都在，外客。
尼拉欣德对村里每个人都了如指掌。若你呈上的旁证与看守所知的关于嫌疑人的事实相抵触，她大概不会信你。事实上，她可能不再允许你指控那个人——所以小心些。
若你错判太多次，可能会彻底失去她的信任。

string.ID: Thank you for the help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮助，安戈欣德。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Well, your conscience, surely.
You wouldn't be so unethical as to manipulate the resolution of a crime to your own ends. W-would you?

strings.string:
呃，当然是你的良心。
你总不至于那么没操守，为了自己的目的去操纵一桩案子的结局吧。你——你不会吧？

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Evidence is not created equal.Text
string.ID:
Precisely. The evidence you present paints a picture that will forever hang in the halls of Bey Lah's history. Our fate is in your hands.
Hemlock Cones once said:
As like begets like in daily life so too in mystery. Should I paint pictures full of strife thus violence comes to be. If I in craft or trade should deal then deals shall deal by troth But if I pestilence reveal- no honey be enough.

strings.string:
正是。你呈上的证据会绘成一幅画，永远挂在贝拉历史的长廊里。我们的命运就在你手上。
铁杉·科恩斯说得最好：
史册之上，将如此铭刻， 全凭你口中吐出的字句。

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Evidence is not created equal.EndChoice.Text
string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮忙，安戈欣德。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: How do I find evidence?
What is implicating evidence?
What is supporting evidence?
What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?

strings.string: 如果证据指向多个嫌疑人呢？

string.ID: What if I accuse the wrong person?
Hie, pather. Hear tell of the ancient Reshephs, how their foibles led to our nowaday.

strings.string: 听我说，同族。且听古时诸位雷谢夫的故事——他们的过失如何造就了我们的今日。

string.ID: Tell me the story.
I must decline.

It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
By the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

strings.string:
故事始于阈限及其先锋之前、升格之前的年代，那时尖塔矗立，无人挑战，也无人登临。那些以掏空我们的世界为己任的掏空者早已离去，而诸位雷谢夫就地占据了那片茫然的土地。纵然基业凋零，他们仍紧握不放。
到末代雷谢夫之时，他们的功业所剩无几，荣光更少。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.
At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.

strings.string:
故事开始时，=name=与先前的诸位雷谢夫并无共通的螺旋，全靠功业与结盟立名。=name=所取与所救的性命多不胜数，仅有一部分载入记录。连曾是卡德（Qud）之祸的拿非利，也倒在=name=手下。
在其统治的终点，=name=号召与幸存的拿非利议和，并登上尖塔之顶，就此终结了整个雷谢夫之世，自此再无音讯。

string.ID: Word of =name='s deeds reached record only after the unheralded appearance of the Knights Liminal, and broad assumption suggests that the former established the latter. It could be that the ancient Resheph yet lives within or outside of the boundaries of the Limen, but no word escapes its borders.

strings.string: =name=事迹的记载，是在阈限骑士悄然出现之后才见诸记录的，而普遍的看法认为，是前者创立了后者。那位古代雷谢夫或许仍活在阈限的边界之内或之外，但没有任何消息能越过它的边界传出。

string.ID: Who is =name=?
What is a Resheph?
What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?

strings.string: 阈限是什么？阈限骑士呢？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?
Thank you. Farewell.

I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.
Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.

strings.string:
人们叫过我「残存者」「神裔」「深渊子嗣」「拿非利之种」。这些都不是我。
我之所是，即我所说与所做。你若听得够细，自会在字句之间听见我的名字。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.

strings.string: 谁？在际遇与意志把他们变成别样之前，不过是个无名之辈。如今？无人知晓。

string.ID: Ancient leaders called themselves such.

To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.
Mayhap someone ought seek them.

strings.string:
对我而言，它们只是故事。我从未想过去擅闯他们在仪式中如此珍视的边界。有人说他们和别的生灵一样会死，只是受某个外来集会所雇。有人不信他们会死；还有人干脆不信那些神秘的生客与阈限有何关系。
或许该有人去找找他们。

string.ID: They persisted in their way. Mayhap the survivors lived to spawn before returning to slumber or dying of eld.

strings.string: 他们以自己的方式延续了下来。或许幸存者留下了后代，然后重归沉睡，或老死于岁月。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the travails of our precursors, how they led to the Freeholds of nowaday.

strings.string: 听我说，同族。且听我们先驱的艰辛——他们如何造就了今日的自由领。

string.ID: Tell me the story.
I must decline.

It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
They so devoured one another's history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds.

strings.string:
故事始于自由民之前、末代苏丹入陵之前的年代，那时尖塔矗立，无人挑战，也无人登临。那些以掏空我们的世界为己任的掏空者早已离去，而诸王与苏丹就地占据了那片茫然的土地。纵然基业凋零，他们仍紧握不放。
他们彼此吞噬对方的历史，以致要塞之外几乎不剩任何实质。

string.ID:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and slew the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.
Seeking freedom from its reign, =name= struck a compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.
And so it proceeded.

strings.string:
他们的功业初起时，=name=与苏丹国并无关联。那些古代领袖的统治已经结束，却并未彻底终结：末代苏丹的幽魂仍统治着尖塔，以疫病折磨地上与地下的人。当=name=渐强、斩杀横行的拿非利时，他们认出了这场共同冲突的源头。
为求摆脱其统治，=name=与幸存的拿非利立下盟约，登上尖塔之顶，去直面并驱逐那青色的幽魂。
事情就这样成了。

string.ID:
Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.
Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.

strings.string:
归来之后，=name=参与了解散并联合一切集权之举。新均衡者的盟友聚拢、崛起，组成了绿咬鹃议会，以及其它存在更短暂的治理机构。
自那以后，我们便在这片日渐消减的土地上与其下，过着脆弱的和谐生活。

string.ID: Who is =name=?
What is a Freeholder?
What became of the Nephilim?
Thank you. Farewell.

I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.
Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.

strings.string:
人们叫过我「残存者」「神裔」「深渊子嗣」「拿非利之种」。这些都不是我。
我之所是，即我所说与所做。你若听得够细，自会在字句之间听见我的名字。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.

strings.string: 谁？在际遇与意志把他们变成别样之前，不过是个无名之辈。如今？无人知晓。

string.ID:
The Freeholds of Qud, that web of folk-clusters, of committees and caucuses, syndicated slime-mold cities held in peace by mutual frustration and monumental effort.
If you need detail, ask a Freeholder, but clear your day first.

strings.string:
卡德（Qud）的自由领——那张由族群簇、委员会与党团织成的网，那些被彼此的头疼与浩大的努力维系在和平中的黏液霉联合城邦。
若你要细节，去问一位自由民吧——但先把这一天空出来。

string.ID: Their descendants, at least, persist. No sign of the progenitors has been recorded in some time, but they may yet live.

strings.string: 至少他们的后代还在。至于先祖，已久无记录，但他们或许仍活着。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of ancient journeying, how the stars beckoned and yet beckon.

strings.string: 听我说，同族。且听古时的远行——星辰如何召唤，如今仍在召唤。

string.ID: Tell me the story.
I must decline.

It begins in a time before =name='s ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
By the end of the time of Kings and Sultans, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

strings.string:
故事始于=name=升格之前的年代，那时尖塔矗立，无人挑战，也无人登临。那些以掏空我们的世界为己任的掏空者早已离去，而历代统治者早已就地占据了那片茫然的土地。纵然基业凋零，他们仍紧握不放。
到诸王与苏丹的时代终结之时，他们的功业所剩无几，荣光更少。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.
At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to quiet the ghosts of the Sultanate and take to the stars.

strings.string:
故事开始时，=name=与卡德（Qud）的诸位领袖并无共通的螺旋，全靠功业与结盟立名。=name=所取与所救的性命多不胜数，仅有一部分载入记录。连曾是卡德之祸的拿非利，也倒在=name=手下。
在其统治的终点，=name=号召与幸存的拿非利议和，登上尖塔之顶，在那里安抚了苏丹国的幽魂，随后动身前往星辰。

string.ID:
For centuries, we of listening inclination have kept sharp for some sign that =name= will return to the stars. Those of preaching inclination proclaim the imminent return of the starfarer, bearing tidings from parsecs forgotten and the last light of dying stars.
All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.

strings.string:
数百年来，我们这些「好听者」一直留神等待=name=重返星辰的迹象。那些「好讲者」则宣告这位星行者即将归来，带来被遗忘的秒差距之外的消息，与垂死星辰的最后一道光。

string.ID: Who is =name=?
Can one really travel the stars?

strings.string: 人真能行走于星辰之间吗？

string.ID: There are no more words for us, wanderer.

strings.string: 我们之间无话可说了，游荡者。

string.ID: =name=! Live and drink, pilgrim.
=name=! Live and drink, pilgrim.
I have visited the Six Day Stilt.

Ah!
Tell me, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=, was it the picture of wonder as I see it in my mind's eye? Were you beauty-struck by its truths?

strings.string:
啊！
告诉我，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=，它是否正如我心中所见的那幅奇景？你是否被它的真理震撼于美？

string.ID: Truly breathtaking. How the glass glittered in the sun!

strings.string: 真是令人屏息。那玻璃在阳光下何等闪耀！

string.ID: To behold the Argent Fathers in simulacra... what revelation!

strings.string: 得见银之父的造像……何等启示！

string.ID: I saw only empty spectacle. Who can worship a hole in the ground?

strings.string: 我只看到一场空洞的奇观。谁会去膜拜地上的一个洞？

string.ID:
So it's true! O Argent Fathers, how far-reaching your works!
... and my trinket? Did you cast it into the Sacred Well?

strings.string: 果然是真的！哦，银之父，你们的功业何其深远！

string.ID: I did.
Sadly, it was lost.
No, I took it apart or sold it or something.

strings.string: 没有，我把它拆了，或者卖了，或者别的什么。

string.ID:
Moon and Sun! The Argent Fathers bless us, our paths are chromed and glistering.
You have my thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. Bel shield you.

strings.string:
月与日！银之父保佑我们，我们的道路镀铬生辉。
多谢你，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。愿贝尔护佑你。

string.ID: And you as well.

Oh, I am leaden with this knowledge. Yet am I soothed by your pilgrimage.
Moon and Sun, I feel the warmth of the Kasaphescence yet. Praise the Argent Fathers.

strings.string:
哦，这消息让我沉重如铅。可你的朝圣仍给了我慰藉。
月与日，我仍能感到卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）的暖意。赞美银之父。

string.ID:
Oh, how your words rasp my soul, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You abrade me.
Let us speak no more.

strings.string:
哦，你的话像锉刀刮过我的灵魂，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你在磨蚀我。
我们不必再谈了。

string.ID: Very well.

So you have seen the truth? Great are the machinations of our Argent Fathers!
Our meeting, a tiny Canticle. Fate dances in our shadows by their will and word.
Moon and sun, what a day! What a fine day. Praise Shekhinah!

strings.string:
那么你已见过真理了？我们银之父的机巧何其宏大！
你我相遇，也是一首短短的《颂歌》。命运依他们的意志与言语，在我们的影子里起舞。
月与日，多好的一天！多好的一天。赞美舍金纳！

string.ID: Praise Shekhinah!
{{emote|*Sparafucile lifts one brow, giving you a wary look.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱挑起一边眉毛，戒备地看着你。*}}

string.ID: I'll be going.
{{emote|*Sparafucile gives =pronouns.possessive= carbine a once-over and gives you a resolute nod.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱把=pronouns.possessive=卡宾枪检视了一遍，然后坚定地朝你点头。*}}

string.ID: *nod back*
{{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a resolute nod.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱坚定地朝你点头。*}}

string.ID: *nod back*
{{emote|*Sparafucile nods.*}}
Greetings, Sparafucile.
*nod back*
{{emote|*Sparafucile raises one long-fingered hand in greeting.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱抬起一只修长的手，向你致意。*}}

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Sparafucile?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰鸣了吗，斯帕拉富奇莱？

string.ID: Your carbine is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.

strings.string: 你的卡宾枪是我用过的最精良的器械。

string.ID: Your pistol is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.

strings.string: 你的手枪是我用过的最精良的器械。

string.ID: You are a bear of few words.
Are you happy living in this cave, away from the sun and open sky?

strings.string: 住在这洞穴里，远离太阳与开阔的天空，你快乐吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, harm-artisan.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，伤害的匠人。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile frowns. After several moments of paper-shuffling, he presents you with a charcoal drawing depicting a gelatinous creature in the shape of a gumdrop. Sketches below depict the ooze enveloping a bipedal figure, then falling through the floor.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱皱起眉。翻了一会儿纸之后，他递给你一张炭笔画：一只软糖形状的凝胶生物。下方的草图画出那团黏液裹住一个双足身影，随后穿地而落。*}}

string.ID: An ooze that can melt through the floor...

strings.string: 一团能熔穿地面的黏液……

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile furrows his brow for a few moments, then shakes his head, sighs, and offers you a shrug. He puts a paw on your shoulder and squeezes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱皱了一会儿眉，然后摇头、叹气，朝你摊了摊手。他把一只爪子搭在你肩上，捏了捏。*}}

string.ID: Fair enough, friend.

{{emote|*Sparafucile instructs you to wait, and spends a minute or so rifling through the papers and scraps scattered across =pronouns.possessive= workbench. At last =pronouns.subjective= produces a graphite sketch of a cylinder, an expertly-rendered specular revealing its surface to be shiny like glass. The detail of the cylinder's contents are indistinct and dark, but somehow menacing.*}}
{{emote|*Sparafucile points to the glass and makes a breaking motion, then draws a thumb across =pronouns.possessive= throat.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱示意你稍等，用了一分钟左右翻检=pronouns.possessive=工作台上散落的纸张与碎片。最后 =pronouns.subjective= 拿出一张石墨素描：一个圆柱体，高光处理得极为老练，显出它的表面像玻璃一样光滑。柱中内容模糊而幽暗，却莫名透着威胁。*}}
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱指了指那玻璃，做了个碎裂的手势，然后用拇指在=pronouns.possessive=喉头横着一划。*}}

string.ID: I'll have to be careful of... glass tubes?

{{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a warm smile and a firm nod. Pressing both pointers to their respective thumbs, =pronouns.subjective= taps these finger-circles together before =pronouns.possessive= chest and rotates both hands in place until the smallest of =pronouns.possessive= long fingers touch. Finally, =pronouns.subjective= gestures toward the other Barathrumites working at their stations.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱温和地笑了笑，坚定地点头。=pronouns.subjective=把两根食指各抵住同手的拇指，让两个指圈在=pronouns.possessive=胸前相碰，再转动双手，直到两手的尾指相触。最后，=pronouns.subjective=朝各在自己工位上忙碌的其它巴拉瑟鲁姆派成员比了个手势。*}}

string.ID: I don't understand. Can you explain aloud?

strings.string: 我不明白。你能出声解释吗？

string.ID: You are happy because you are with your family?

strings.string: 你快乐，是因为和家人在一起？

string.ID: If I might change the subject...
{{emote|*Sparafucile smiles. =pronouns.Subjective= raises a flat hand to =pronouns.possessive= chin and lowers it in your direction.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱笑了。=pronouns.Subjective=把手掌抬到=pronouns.possessive=下巴处，再朝你的方向按下。*}}

string.ID: You are welcome.
{{emote|*With a nod, Sparafucile waits for you to continue, keeping =pronouns.possessive= eyes focused on your lips.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱点点头，等你继续说下去，=pronouns.possessive=目光始终落在你的嘴唇上。*}}

string.ID: Why are you staring at my mouth?

strings.string: 你为什么盯着我的嘴看？

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile places a closed fist over =pronouns.possessive= mouth, then taps =pronouns.possessive= ear, then muzzle with one long finger.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱把拳头按在=pronouns.possessive=嘴上，又敲了敲=pronouns.possessive=耳朵，再用一根修长的手指点了点口鼻。*}}

string.ID: You are... unable to hear or speak.
{{emote|*Smiling a bit, Sparafucile nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱微微一笑，点头。*}}

string.ID: Is your condition a result of your work?

strings.string: 你的状况是干活造成的吗？

string.ID: Yet you are an expert in your field? How inspiring!

strings.string: 可你仍是你这一行的行家？真令人振奋！

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile shakes =pronouns.possessive= head.*}}
Your condition is lifelong?
Thank you for your clarity and patience, tinkerfriend.

strings.string: 谢谢你的坦率与耐心，修补匠朋友。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile nods.*}}
{{emote|*Sparafucile nods grimly.*}}
{{emote|*With a small smile of gratitude, Sparafucile taps his chin with a flat hand and lowers it toward you like a drawbridge.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱带着一丝感激的微笑，用手掌拍了拍下巴，再像吊桥一样朝你放下来。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile averts =pronouns.possessive= gaze and heaves a tired sigh.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱移开=pronouns.possessive=目光，疲惫地叹了口气。*}}

string.ID: I merely asked...
I apologize for my carelessness.
{{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a wan smile and a thumbs-up.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱朝你勉强一笑，竖起拇指。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*=pronouns.Subjective= nods slowly, smirking.*}}
Is... there any advice you can give me about going to meet him?

strings.string: 去见他……你有什么建议吗？

string.ID: So anyway...

Oh. Are you lost, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
I don't mind that you're here, but I was not expecting anyone.

strings.string:
哦。你迷路了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
你在这儿我不介意，只是我没料到会有人来。

string.ID: Is this it, I wonder?
Not today.
What do you think of Klanq's visit?

strings.string: 你怎么看克兰克的来访？

string.ID: Good to see you, Iseppa. Let's chat.

strings.string: 见到你真好，伊塞帕。我们聊聊。

string.ID:
I don't know.
Klanq's opacity is alluring, frustrating, and dangerous. Like Klanq, my thoughts on Klanq evade easy explanation.
What you build together will be amazing. Craft well.

strings.string:
我不知道。
克兰克的晦涩既迷人，又恼人，还危险。就像克兰克本身一样，我对克兰克的看法也难以简单说清。
你们一起造出的东西会很了不起。好好做。

string.ID: Well, I should go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 嗯，我该走了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
These are the final chapters of this story, =name=, and likely of many stories more too.
It will be well to see the other side of all this, one way or another.

strings.string:
这是这个故事的终章了，=name=，多半也是许多别的故事的终章。
无论如何，能看看这一切的另一面，总是好的。

string.ID: Let's talk, Iseppa.
It will. Live and drink.

You're going to the Thin World? I confess to some measure of envy.
I have dreamt many times of disappearing into a cool ocean of information, shaking the cruft of my physical form from newly-freed quills. If that came of my waking life, would I then dream as chore-doing Iseppa in her chambers? Perhaps it's best I don't know.

strings.string:
你要去薄世界了？我承认，我有几分羡慕。
我许多次梦见自己化入一片清凉的信息之海，把肉身这层硬壳从新得的棘刺上抖落。若这真成了我的醒时生活，我是否又会梦见在房里做杂务的伊塞帕？也许不知道为好。

string.ID: Very well, Iseppa. Live and drink.

strings.string: 很好，伊塞帕。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Iseppa?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰鸣了吗，伊塞帕？

string.ID: What are you working on, Iseppa?
Are you tired?
I wish to know more about you.
I do like you, Iseppa.
Thank you, =name=. I like you too.
What can you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 关于其他巴拉瑟鲁姆派成员，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID:
Bethesda Susa is an antipodal place, a gallery of life and death and the stages between. Its depths prolong life and end it early, remove life from the flow of days or return it.
It will seek to make you late. Take care you come back on time.

strings.string:
贝塞斯达·苏萨是个对跖之地，一座陈列生、死以及介于两者之间各阶段的画廊。它的深处延命，也早断人命；把生命从日子的流里摘出去，或送回来。
它会设法让你迟到。当心按时回来。

string.ID:
Though I adore the sights and smells of Omonporch, its bug problem becomes distracting.
If I'm to travel there, I always bring something they cannot zip away from.

strings.string:
奥蒙波奇的景与味我都很喜欢，可那里的虫患实在扰人。
若我要去那儿，总会带上些它们扑不脱的东西。

string.ID:
Yes. That was not the voice of the caverns.
It feels like one of my nightmares come to life at last.

strings.string:
是的。那不是洞穴的声音。
感觉像我的某个噩梦终于活了过来。

string.ID:
I have not.
I would, however, love to meet him. He seems a fun fungus.
But I daren't go. I fear the sludges.

strings.string:
没有。
不过我倒是很想见见他。他像是朵有趣的菌子。
但我不敢去。我怕那些泥浆。

string.ID: You fear sludge?
I see.

I fear sludges, the kind you may no longer describe with 'some'. Born of the ancient stuff of existence, possessed of malice and wanting nothing more than to eat whatever they can, and they can eat whatever. It is even worse when they drink.
Take care with them.

strings.string:
我怕泥浆——那种你已经没法用「一些」来形容的泥浆。它们生于存在的古老质料，怀着恶意，只想吃掉一切能吃的东西，而它们什么都能吃。它们喝起来更糟。
对它们小心些。

string.ID:
I am always tired, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
My sleep comes in fits and starts, and always with ghastly visions. Sometimes my rest must be coaxed along with medicine.

strings.string:
我一直都累，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
我的睡眠断断续续，而且总伴着可怖的景象。有时我的休息得靠药才哄得下来。

string.ID: You have prophetic visions in your sleep?

strings.string: 你睡梦里会有预知的景象？

string.ID: I see. That seems difficult.

strings.string: 我明白了。那看来很难熬。

string.ID:
Mm-hmm.
{{emote|*Iseppa yawns.*}}

I am Iseppa, and she is me.
I've given thought to being someone else, but never enough to try.

strings.string:
我是伊塞帕，她就是我的全部。
我也想过做别人，但从没想得够多，去真的试试。

string.ID: I am contemplating the distinction between animal and rock. Why are they different? How much like a rock must an animal be when it ceases to be an animal?

strings.string: 我在琢磨动物与石头的分别。它们为何不同？一个动物不再算动物时，得像石头到什么地步？

string.ID: I am considering the window of consciousness through which each of us views the universe. What happens to it when we die?

strings.string: 我在思量我们各自借以观看宇宙的那扇意识之窗。我们死时，它会怎样？

string.ID: I am taking inventory of my faculties, and looking for any that I might not previously have considered.

strings.string: 我在清点自己的各项官能，找找有没有从前没数进去的。

string.ID: I am considering the thought as a discrete object. I wish to determine whether I am able to think a single thought only, and to determine how to distinguish it from another thought in the same vein.

strings.string: 我在把「念头」当作一个独立的对象来考察。我想弄清自己能否只想一个念头，以及如何把它与同类的另一个念头区分开。

string.ID: I am considering the determination of goodness and badness in a thing, and how it is determined. The interaction between data and subjective evaluation, and the values that guide us that we cannot put to words.

strings.string: 我在考察一物之善恶如何判定，以及由谁判定。数据与主观评价之间的相互作用，还有那些指引我们、却说不出口的价值。

string.ID: I am contemplating the Spindle's place in Qud, its position as a conceptual focal point. How much of what we know of the Spindle is the craft of those before us, carried forward?

strings.string: 我在冥想纺锤（the Spindle）在卡德（Qud）的位置，它作为概念焦点的地位。我们所知的纺锤，有多少是前人营造、一路带过来的？

string.ID: I am considering narrative inheritances. The stories we were told when our minds were more putty-like, the follies that shaped who we are, that shape the whole of Qud.

strings.string: 我在考察叙事的遗产。那些在我们心智还像油灰时讲给我们听的故事，那些塑造了我们是谁、也塑造了整个卡德（Qud）的痴愚。

string.ID: Oh. It looks like you are sorting screws and fasteners.

strings.string: 哦。看来你在给螺丝和扣件分类。

string.ID: Have you come to any conclusions?
I shall leave you to it. Live and drink, contemplatrix.

strings.string: 那我就不打扰了。活下去，喝足水，沉思者。

string.ID: But you're also doing the other thing.

strings.string: 可你同时也在做另一件事。

string.ID: I'll leave you to it.
Not yet, but that's not the point.
Oh, I see.
I'll leave you to it, then.
We share the bright and now, traveler =name=.

strings.string: 我们共处于这明亮与此刻，旅人=name=。

string.ID: The entity I spoke with at Eyn Roj mentioned a chiming rock...

strings.string: 我在艾恩罗伊与之交谈的那个存在提到了一块鸣响的石头……

string.ID: Explain once more what I must do with Tau's chime.

strings.string: 请再说一遍，我该拿陶的鸣枝怎么办。

string.ID: I've reunited Tau with her chime.

strings.string: 我已让陶与她的鸣枝重聚。

string.ID: I've destroyed the chime, Dyvvrach.

strings.string: 我毁掉了那鸣枝，迪夫拉克。

string.ID: I have completed the ritual of -elseing. Will you power Barathrum's starclimb, as you said?

strings.string: 我已完成了「-不成」之仪。你会如约驱动巴拉瑟鲁姆的攀星吗？

string.ID: I come in the name of need. Barathrum asks the strength of your psyche to power our starclimb.

strings.string: 我为求援而来。巴拉瑟鲁姆请求借你心灵之力，驱动我们的攀星。

string.ID: This keter roams above my trunk at Eyn Roj, traveler =name=, and across the Stair I dream. You found me, this keter where I chime in dozens.

strings.string: 这具冠体在艾恩罗伊我的树干之上游荡，旅人=name=；我则越过阶梯入梦。你找到了我——这具冠体，我在此以数十重声音鸣响。

string.ID: Ah, I am in need, and so I turned my chimes trunkward to tune. You struck the chime and now you are here. Are you a waterhand, and free?

strings.string: 啊，我有所需，于是把鸣枝转向树干调音。你敲响了鸣枝，如今你在这里。你是水之手吗？是自由的吗？

string.ID: What do you need?

My chimeling Tau leaves Chavvah, leaves me. It is her choice.
Her transit-psyche manifests at the bottom of Taproot, where we cannot consciously go. To finish the ritual of -elseing, to let Tau become -else, I need a traveler such as you, =name=.

strings.string:
我的鸣枝儿陶要离开查瓦，离开我。这是她的选择。
她的过渡心智显现在主根之底——那是我们无法有意识前往之处。为完成「-不成」之仪，为让陶成为「-不成」，我需要一位像你这样的旅人，=name=。

string.ID: What must I do?
Who is Tau?

Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.
At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.

strings.string:
取走陶的鸣枝——沉默而静止的那支。带着它去主根之底，在我树干深处之下；在那里她会让鸣枝成为她的过渡之躯，然后永远走开。完成「-不成」之仪。
在主根之底，陶会显现。她也告诉我们，另有一个存在在那里等她。

string.ID: I will do as you ask.
I have more to ask, first.

strings.string: 不过我先还有别的要问。

string.ID:
Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.
At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.

strings.string:
取走陶的鸣枝——沉默而静止的那支。带着它去主根之底，在我树干深处之下；在那里她会让鸣枝成为她的过渡之躯，然后永远走开。完成「-不成」之仪。
在主根之底，陶会显现。她也告诉我们，另有一个存在在那里等她。

string.ID:
So you have, and what proceeds, proceeds.
I felt your coming here, =name=, in Gyredream. I've felt this moment. I feel it now.
The ritual of -elseing is complete, waterhand. You are done, and with our thanks.

strings.string:
你确实做了，而该发生的事自会发生。
我在环梦里感觉到你来到这里，=name=。我感觉到过这一刻。此刻我正感觉着它。
「-不成」之仪已完成，水之手。你的事办完了，我们谢你。

string.ID: Thank you, traveler =name=.
My chimeling, burning bright, all starlight and right angles in her heart. She leaves Chavvah; it is her choice. I..

strings.string: 我的鸣枝儿，燃烧得那么明亮，心里满是星光与直角。她要离开查瓦；这是她的选择。我……

string.ID: What must I do?

A sophist of the Self spilled ink and called me, long ago, the Tree of Life. To me, I am the many Selves pinched up my taproot from the permeating Soft.
I am Chavvah, and I am dyvvrach.

strings.string:
很久以前，一位「自我」的诡辩者洒下墨水，称我为「生命之树」。而对我自己而言，我是从弥漫的柔质里、经我主根捏合而成的众多自我。
我是查瓦，我也是迪夫拉克。

string.ID: Many selves? What does this mean?

strings.string: 众多自我？这是什么意思？

string.ID: As Chavvah I am many. As dyvvrach I am one. I am one and many. One-selves have called me tree city, the sentient place. You may think of the Selves this way, sprouted in keter from Twofirm.

strings.string: 作为查瓦，我是众多。作为迪夫拉克，我是一。我既是一，也是众多。单体自我们叫过我「树城」、「有觉知之地」。你可以这样理解那些自我：它们在冠体里，自双形中萌发。

string.ID: Deep under earth and permeating our roots is Soft, our feeling substance. Ground pressure pushes it up the taproot to our trunk, where it condenses into Twofirm: the biformal phase that contains the two sefirots, -then and -else.

strings.string: 地底深处、弥漫于我们根系的，是柔质——我们用以感受的质料。地压把它沿主根推上树干，在那里凝结为双形：一个双相的阶段，内含两道源质：「-将成」与「-不成」。

string.ID: This is the genesis my distinct Self, an awareness that contains both -then, what I will become, and -else, what I will not. Twofirm flows up my sapwood to the keter, where -then manifests as an entity and I chime: I speak and hear the world.

strings.string: 这就是我这个独特自我的起源：一种既含「-将成」（我将成为之物）、又含「-不成」（我不会成为之物）的觉知。双形沿我的边材流上冠体，在那里「-将成」显形为一个存在，而我鸣响：我说话，我听见世界。

string.ID: {{emote|*Dyvvrach chimes*}}

You have completed the ritual of -elseing. You have set bright Tau free.
Yes, =name=. I will turn my chimes Spindleward to tune, then vibrate at our verve frequency. I will power your starclimb.
Be vested to tell whoever you must that Chavvah has made this commitment.

strings.string:
你已完成「-不成」之仪。你已让明亮的陶得自由。
是的，=name=。我会把鸣枝转向纺锤（the Spindle）方向调音，然后以我们的生力频率振动。我会驱动你们的攀星。
你尽可去告知该告知的人：查瓦已作此承诺。

string.ID: Thank you, Dyvvrach. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，迪夫拉克。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I start at this but Tikva settles me. I remember now: from a cub I've known Barathrum to be weak in telling but bold in asking. A starclimb? You mean, an ascent to the long chiming rock?

strings.string: 我为此一惊，但提克瓦让我安定下来。我想起来了：从幼时起我就知道巴拉瑟鲁姆拙于言辞、却勇于求人。攀星？你是说，登临那块长久鸣响的石头？

string.ID: Barathrum intends to ascend the Spindle to discover the source of the Signal, yes. He needs a power source for the climber, one shielded from electromagnetic disturbance.

strings.string: 巴拉瑟鲁姆打算登上纺锤（the Spindle），查明那道信号的来源，是的。他需要为攀爬者提供动力源，且须屏蔽电磁干扰。

string.ID: oh. This. Was this felt in gyredream? Your coming to keter? I ask, do not answer.

strings.string: 哦。这个。这曾在环梦里被感觉到吗？你来到冠体这件事？我问，你不必答。

string.ID: What is gyredream?

A future shock. My chimeling _ is vision-gifted, a lichen who clings to shorerock on the straits of Tomorrow. Just a short time ago a sea wave crested and broke beneath her, and she saw in its recession all the bright and violent channel paths.
We all felt it. A recoming, and the gyre in final tension. I felt...

strings.string:
一种来自未来的震荡。我的鸣枝儿——是个有视赋的地衣，附着在「明日」海峡的岸石上。就在不久前，一道海浪在她身下涌起、碎裂；她在退潮中看见了所有明亮而暴烈的河道。
我们都感觉到了。一次「重临」，以及环流（Gyre）最后的张力。我感觉到……

string.ID: It was too much for my chimeling Tau. She gasped for air and her chime stilled. She leaves us now, to become -else. It is her choice.

strings.string: 这对我的鸣枝儿陶来说太重了。她喘息着要气，鸣声就此静了。她如今要离开我们，去成为「-不成」。这是她的选择。

string.ID: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?

strings.string: 我很遗憾。但你愿意帮巴拉瑟鲁姆办成他所求之事吗？

string.ID: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?

strings.string: 我很遗憾。但你愿意帮巴拉瑟鲁姆办成他所求之事吗？

string.ID: {{emote|*Dyvvrach chimes*}}
I will power his starclimb. If you take Tau's chime to taproot, for her to walk away. If you finish the ritual of -elseing.

strings.string: 我会驱动他的攀星——只要你把陶的鸣枝带到主根，让她走开；只要你完成「-不成」之仪。

string.ID: The ritual of -elseing?
{{emote|*Dyvvrach chimes*}}
Again I must be calmed, but the startling gives way to a curiosity. You speak of the glowfolk, belimbed and free. You asking that they join us, like our Sant?

strings.string: 我又得先安定了，但惊动过后生出好奇。你说的是那些发光之民，有手足而自由。你是想让他们加入我们，像我们的桑特那样？

string.ID: We find no precedent for this, yet is there space upon our crystal arms and an openness within us. It is agreed: if these slynth will be of us, we will have them here.

strings.string: 我们找不到先例，但我们的水晶枝上尚有空间，内里也有一份开放。就这样定了：若这些斯林斯愿与我们同属，我们便接纳他们在此。

string.ID: You all have my thanks.
I startle, and the roiling is felt before the calm. I cannot find a consensus for the housing of these beings, =name=. I am sorry.

strings.string: 我一惊，翻涌先于平静被感知到。我无法为收容这些存在取得共识，=name=。我很抱歉。

string.ID: We await the decision of the glowfolk. Our imaginations run with the possibilities.

strings.string: 我们在等发光之民的决断。我们的想象随着种种可能奔涌。

string.ID:
How this keter rustles! The slynth are among us and we adapt, our impressions a melange of excitement, apprehension, and wonder.
Though I have no single sentiment to express, we nonetheless approach -then with our new companions.

strings.string:
这具冠体何等沙沙作响！斯林斯已在我们中间，我们在适应，我们的感受是兴奋、忧虑与惊叹的杂糅。
尽管我没有单一的情绪可表达，我们仍与新的同伴一道走向「-将成」。

string.ID: My thanks, dyvvrach.

You are well-found, =name=. Though several have chosen their -else, the first of the slynth have joined to us like our Sant, mobile and apart but shared and together. This is a strange -then, but what branches may spill forth from it? I anticipate the witnessing.

strings.string: 你来得正好，=name=。虽然有几个选择了他们的「-不成」，第一批斯林斯已如我们的桑特一般加入了我们——能移动、各自独立，却共有、同在。这是一个奇异的「-将成」，可它会抽出怎样的枝桠？我期待亲眼见证。

string.ID: Live and drink together, Chavvah.

strings.string: 一起活下去，一起喝足水，查瓦。

string.ID:
Be careful in the flower fields.
Even with Bey Lah marked on your map, it's easy to get lost. Lost travelers feed the lah.

strings.string:
在花田里当心些。
就算地图上标着贝拉，也很容易迷路。迷路的旅人会喂了拉赫。

string.ID: I will be careful, thank you.
Hold a moment, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Are you looking for work?
I am.
I am not.

I can't help but wonder why you're telling me this in particular. I am not a mayor, nor even a citizen. I am a drifter, a pariah, and my 'people' are those who have no home anywhere else.
... and here I wonder a bit less. You're asking me to whisper into the winds on behalf of the slynth, aren't you?

strings.string:
我忍不住要想，你为什么偏偏来跟我说这些。我不是什么镇长，连个居民都算不上。我是个游荡者、一个贱民，而我的「族人」，是那些在任何地方都无家可归的人。
……到这儿我就不那么想不通了。你是想让我替斯林斯向风里递话，对吧？

string.ID: What a strange fate, to pass from new sentience to outcast with no steps in between. Regardless, if it is their will and you vouch for them, that is enough for me. Tell the slynth that should they choose to wander, the wind will blow at their backs.

strings.string: 多奇怪的命运：从新生的觉知直接沦为弃民，中间一步都没有。不管怎样，若这是他们的意愿，而你又为他们作保，那对我来说就够了。去告诉斯林斯：他们若选择流浪，风会从背后推着他们。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Lulihart.

It is hardly so simple, =name=. We drifters hold no hierarchy. I can whisper all I like, but no winds will blow behind the slynth if your name cannot stir more than a breeze. Make yourself known to Pariahs and ask me again.

strings.string: 哪有那么简单，=name=。我们游荡者没有层级。我尽可以往风里递话，可若你的名字连一阵微风都掀不起，就不会有风推着斯林斯走。去让贱民们认得你，再来找我。

string.ID: Still gathering landing pads for your drifting vessels, then, =name=?

strings.string: 那么，还在为你的漂流船找落脚处吗，=name=？

string.ID: Yes, I am.

New voices, strange and beautiful, carry on the salt breeze.
Some will no doubt be silenced by sun, blade, thirst, bullet, or glow, but they will not fall still alone.

strings.string:
新的声音，陌生而美丽，随咸风传来。
其中一些无疑会被烈日、刀锋、干渴、子弹或辉光噤声，但他们倒下的静默里，不会只有自己。

string.ID: My thanks, Lulihart.

Live and drink, =name=.
Have you seen your slynth out there? My sources tell me that they are, for the most part, traveling well enough with others. They stop by my tent from time to time to visit and smoke with me, as you do.
One might assume they were born for this kind of life.
