strings.string:
活下去，喝足水，=name=。
你在外头见过你那些斯林斯吗？我的消息说，他们大体上跟别人相处得还不错。他们时不时会到我帐篷来坐坐，和我一道抽上一口——就像你一样。
旁人大概会以为他们生来就过这种日子。

string.ID: My thanks again, Lulihart.

I see. In that case, rest and speak a bit with me, won't you? My worries can wait another day.
That said, if you change your mind, you'll come find me, won't you?

strings.string:
我明白了。既然如此，那就歇歇，陪我说会儿话，好吗？我的烦心事可以再等一天。
不过，你若改了主意，会来找我的，对吧？

string.ID: Perhaps. Live and drink.

Lovely. Take a seat. Chew the bark with me, and I will tell you what I know.
I've heard tell that my ancestral hometown, Bey Lah, is in some kind of trouble. They've opened their borders for the first time I know of and are specifically seeking to hire kendren -- that's their word for outsiders like you. Would you be willing to go see what they need?

strings.string:
好极了。坐下吧。陪我嚼嚼树皮，我把我所知道的告诉你。
我听说我的祖乡贝拉出了某种麻烦。据我所知，他们头一回开放了边界，还专门要雇外客——那是他们对你这种外来者的称呼。你愿意去看看他们需要什么吗？

string.ID: How do you know this?
Why do you care?
Why don't you go there yourself?
Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我照你说的去贝拉。

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

My name is Lulihart. The blood of the hindren runs through my veins, but two of my three parents were kendren, so that blood is... dilute, and salt-brined from being born out here.
Dilute, salty blood. Heh.

strings.string:
我叫露莉哈特。欣德伦的血在我血管里流，可我的三位双亲里有两位是外客，所以那血……很淡，而且因为生在这外头，还浸着盐。
又淡又咸的血。嘿。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我照你说的去贝拉。

string.ID: How do you know about Bey Lah's trouble?

strings.string: 你怎么知道贝拉出了麻烦？

string.ID: Why do you care about Bey Lah?
Why don't you go there yourself?
Pass. This task is not to my liking.

My water goes to scouts to keep a distant eye on Bey Lah. To make sure that it is still there, still safe.
I have never been within a parasang of my people's land, but I know exactly where the once-hidden village stands. I will share this knowledge with you if you agree to consider whatever their request may be.

strings.string:
我的水钱花在斥候身上，让他们远远盯着贝拉，确认它还在那儿、还平安。
我从未踏进我族人土地一帕拉桑（parasang）之内，可那座曾经隐秘的村庄在哪儿，我一清二楚。你若答应去听听他们的请求，我就把这位置告诉你。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我照你说的去贝拉。

string.ID: Wait, who are you?
Why do you care?
Why don't you go there yourself?
Pass. This task is not to my liking.
Even blood as thin as mine ties me to the cervidian meadow. The hindren may not say so, but they are my family.

strings.string: 就算是我这样淡的血，也把我系在鹿原上。欣德伦嘴上或许不认，但他们是我的家人。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我照你说的去贝拉。

string.ID: And who are you?
Why don't you go there yourself?
Pass. This task is not to my liking.

I am not welcome in Bey Lah.
My blood is not pure, and I was not born in the meadow. These things make my name as salt in the mouths of true hindren.
They are misguided, but they are my misguided family. They stagnate as Qud changes around them. I worry.

strings.string:
我在贝拉不受欢迎。
我的血不纯，我也不生在鹿原。这些让我的名字在真正的欣德伦口中如同盐粒。
他们走错了路，但他们是我的家人，走错了路的家人。卡德（Qud）在他们周围变着，他们却停滞不动。我担心。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我照你说的去贝拉。

string.ID: How do you know this?
Why do you care?
Pass. This task is not to my liking.

Bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I feel better knowing that at least one kendren will reach back to aid my kin. They are on the cusp of a new fate, and I wish to see it while I yet live.
Let me advise you of Bey Lah's location, and here is a little chew-boon for your trouble.

strings.string:
愿上天保佑你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。知道至少有一位外客愿意回头帮我的族人，我心里好受些。他们正站在新命运的门口，我希望趁我还活着看看那是什么。
我把贝拉的位置告诉你；这点嚼头，算是给你的辛苦费。

string.ID: Thank you, Lulihart. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，露莉哈特。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I hear that Bey Lah's status is once again quo. I hoped for a measure more of change, but thousands of years of tradition do not give so easily.
Thank you for helping my foolish people.

strings.string:
我听说贝拉又恢复了原状。我本指望能多改变几分，可数千年的传统不会那么轻易松手。
谢谢你帮我那些愚钝的族人。

string.ID: Once in the fullness of time there met the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer. The Fool offered a tale of the Reshephs, and the wanderer sat to hear.

strings.string: 时轮圆满之际，曾有一遇： 环流（Gyre）之愚者，与一位游荡者。 愚者讲起雷谢夫们的旧事， 游荡者便坐下听。

string.ID: Tell me the tale.

Ere the limen, ere ascension, when the spire rose lonely strong, the Reshephs ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.
Qud held no mysterious borders, grasped no guiding hands -- at least, none the denizens could grasp. So they knew.

strings.string:
阈限之前，升格之前， 尖塔孤高耸立之时， 雷谢夫们统治着空陷之地， 彼此吞噬， 随他们所愿。
卡德（Qud）那时没有神秘的边界， 也握不住任何指引之手—— 至少，住民们握不住。 他们便如此以为。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood apart and above
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and quieted the Reshephate.

strings.string:
无人向=name=致敬， =name=也不致敬于谁， 只凭言语与刀锋， 凭行事与不屑， 立于其外，立于其上。
为推退环流（Gyre）， 为倾洒拿非利之血， 他们登上尖塔， 让雷谢夫之世归于沉寂。

string.ID:
Only silence on the ground met we benighted things until the Knights Liminal drew their lines upon the salt.
Unknowing, unseeing, waiting only to know who will spin us around next.

strings.string:
地面上唯有沉默， 迎着我们这些蒙昧之物， 直到阈限骑士 在盐土上划下他们的界线。
不知，不见， 只等着知道 下一个把我们转起来的是谁。

string.ID:
Who, I? Only a fool, tra la, only a remnant scrap.
Only left-behind, only madness, only an echoing gyre.

strings.string:
谁，我？ 不过一个愚人，啦啦， 不过一片残渣。
不过是被留下的， 不过是疯癫， 不过是一道回响的环流（Gyre）。

string.ID:
No one of fate, no one of blood, no one of importance, until, suddenly, someone of all of these things.
=name= is a dream from which we cannot awaken.

strings.string:
无关命运， 无关血脉， 无关紧要， 直到忽然之间，这三者集于一身。
=name=是一场我们醒不来的梦。

string.ID: The Resheph, power-haver, ruler of souls, holder of land, authority made singular.

strings.string: 雷谢夫，掌权者， 众魂之主治者， 土地之持有者， 权柄被收束为一。

string.ID: O to step over a line one is not meant to cross to parts unknown and desired! O to be halted by chants and weapons and crushing shibboleth. O coven! O not coven? I only want to see!

strings.string: 啊，跨过一条 本不该越过的线， 去往未知而渴望之处！ 啊，被喝止—— 被咒唱、兵器 与碾人的暗语喝止。 啊，结社！啊，还是不成社？ 我只是想看看！

string.ID: Once in the fullness of time there met the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer. The Fool offered stories of journeyers past and the wanderer sat to hear.

strings.string: 时轮圆满之际，曾有一遇： 环流（Gyre）之愚者，与一位游荡者。 愚者讲起昔日远行者的故事， 游荡者便坐下听。

string.ID: Tell me the tale.
Ere the Freeholds, ere ascension, when the spire rose lonely strong, Kings and Sultans ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.

strings.string: 自由领之前，升格之前， 尖塔孤高耸立之时， 诸王与苏丹统治着空陷之地， 彼此吞噬， 随他们所愿。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood against old rule.
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and quieted the remnants.

strings.string:
无人向=name=致敬， =name=也不致敬于谁， 只凭言语与刀锋， 凭行事与不屑， 挺身对抗旧日的统治。
为推退环流（Gyre）， 为倾洒拿非利之血， 他们登上尖塔， 让残存的幽魂归于沉寂。

string.ID:
Upon their return what power =name= wrested they called on allies to distribute and dissolve.
The Freeholders, new hollowers, the Quetzal Council, and other such fools.
Countless years of struggle centuries of change. We remember what we can and watch new and old die.

strings.string:
归来之后， =name=夺来的权柄， 他们召来盟友 去分派、去解散。
自由民们， 新的掏空者， 绿咬鹃议会， 以及诸如此类的愚人。
数不清的争斗之年， 几百年的变迁。 我们记得住多少就记多少， 看着新的与旧的死去。

string.ID:
Who, I? Only a fool, tra la, only a remnant scrap.
Only left-behind, only madness, only an echoing gyre.

strings.string:
谁，我？ 不过一个愚人，啦啦， 不过一片残渣。
不过是被留下的， 不过是疯癫， 不过是一道回响的环流（Gyre）。

string.ID:
No one of fate, no one of blood, no one of importance, until their return and the realization of their future.
=name= is a temple in memory upon which hopes are hung and rage is borne out.
Too great to be real, too foundational not to be, too contradictory to have ever existed.

strings.string:
无关命运， 无关血脉， 无关紧要， 直到他们归来， 直到他们的未来成为现实。
=name=是记忆中的一座神殿， 希望悬挂于其上， 怒火也在其上得以宣泄。
太过伟大，不像真的； 太过根本，不能不是真的； 太过自相矛盾，不可能真的存在过。

string.ID:
Freeholder: one who argues; bickerer.
Freeholder: a peer among peers among peers among peers tessellated thus until one must scream to be heard.

strings.string:
自由民： 好争辩者；爱口角者。
自由民： 同侪中的同侪， 同侪中的同侪中的同侪， 如此层层镶嵌， 直到必须尖叫才能被听见。

string.ID: Once in the fullness of time there met the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer. The Fool offered stories spanning ground to sky and the wanderer sat to hear.

strings.string: 时轮圆满之际，曾有一遇： 环流（Gyre）之愚者，与一位游荡者。 愚者讲起自地及天的故事， 游荡者便坐下听。

string.ID: Tell me the tale.
Ere the struggles of our day, when the spire rose lonely strong, Sultans ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.

strings.string: 在我们今日的争斗之前， 尖塔孤高耸立之时， 苏丹们统治着空陷之地

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood against old rule.
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and quieted the remnants.

strings.string:
无人向=name=致敬， =name=也不致敬于谁， 只凭言语与刀锋， 凭行事与不屑， 挺身对抗旧日的统治。
为推退环流（Gyre）， 为倾洒拿非利之血， 他们登上尖塔， 让残存的幽魂归于沉寂。

string.ID:
Who, I? Only a fool, tra la, only a remnant scrap.
Only left-behind, only madness, only an echoing gyre.

strings.string:
谁，我？ 不过一个愚人，啦啦， 不过一片残渣。
不过是被留下的， 不过是疯癫， 不过是一道回响的环流（Gyre）。

string.ID: I must decline.
Who are you?
Who is =name=?
What is a Resheph?
What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?

strings.string: 阈限是什么？阈限骑士呢？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.
I must decline.
Who are you?
Who is =name=?
What is a Freeholder?
Thank you. Farewell.
I must decline.

Though =name= was gone our memories remained and the plagues receded and many rejoiced.
To this day eyes turn to the stars looking for a sign that our starfarer has deigned to return.
Countless years of struggle centuries of change. We remember what we can and watch new and old die.

strings.string:
虽然=name=已去， 我们的记忆尚存， 疫病退去， 许多人欢庆。
直到今日， 目光仍转向星辰， 盼一个迹象：我们的星行者 是否肯回来了。
数不清的争斗之年， 几百年的变迁。 我们记得住多少就记多少， 看着新的与旧的死去。

string.ID: Who are you?
Who is =name=?
Is it really possible to travel the stars?

strings.string: 真的有可能行走于星辰之间吗？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

Starfarer, herald, disruptor, feared, revered, savior and abandoner.
=name= is a dream from which we will one day awaken.

strings.string:
星行者，先驱，搅局者， 被畏惧，被崇敬， 既是救主，也是弃人者。
=name=是一场我们终有一日会醒来的梦。

string.ID:
Who cares?
Can one? Maybe. Can I? Surely not. Can YOU? Well. Prove it.

strings.string:
谁在乎呢？
人能吗？也许。 我能吗？当然不能。 你——能吗？嗯。 那就证明给我看。

string.ID: Once, after it all burst apart, the Fool of the Gyre met a wise jelly. They sat in the slag of the world and the Fool told the story of nowaday.

strings.string: 曾有一次，在一切崩裂之后， 环流（Gyre）之愚者遇见了一团有智慧的胶质。 他们坐在世界的熔渣里， 愚者讲起了今日的故事。

string.ID: Bloop, blorp. (Proceed.)
Glub. (I must decline.)
Who are you?
Who is =name=?
Thank you. Farewell.
Who are you? Get out of my work space!

strings.string: 你是谁？滚出我的工作区！

string.ID: Sorry! I'm going!
Innovation's sworn enemies have come knocking, =name=. Let us answer them.

strings.string: 创新的死敌来敲门了，=name=。我们去会会他们。

string.ID: Take care.
=name=. Come in. Eat.
You seem more irritated than usual.
About your workshop...

Otho has forbidden me from requesting a sample of Klanq. I am to refrain from being puffed on, to cultivate my own!
Are we yet researchers? Is subject consent no longer adequate ethical rigor? Let Klanq puff on Dardi!

strings.string:
奥索禁止我向克兰克索取样本。他要我别去挨那口气，自己培养去！
我们还算是研究者吗？受试者同意不再算足够的伦理严谨了吗？让克兰克来喷达迪一口！

string.ID: Death to all subjugators who dare face us.

strings.string: 胆敢面对我们的奴役者，统统去死。

string.ID: About your workshop...
Oh? Oh! Do pick up the mopango recipe for bone babka while you're there, won't you? I must know how they make it so dense.

strings.string: 哦？哦！你到那儿的时候，务必把莫潘戈的骨巴布卡配方弄到手，好吗？我一定要知道他们是怎么做得那么紧实的。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Dardi addresses you without looking up from =pronouns.possessive= many workspaces, many of which billow smoke, steam, or some unknown miasma.*}}
Welcome to my laboratory, =name=. Rest and sustain =player.reflexive= before returning to your travels.

strings.string:
{{emote|*达迪头也不抬地跟你说话，=pronouns.possessive=面前摊着许多个工作台，大多冒着烟、蒸汽，或某种不明的瘴气。*}}
欢迎来到我的实验室，=name=。先歇歇，把=player.reflexive=养足，再上路。

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Dardi?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰鸣了吗，达迪？

string.ID: That smell from the oven is... indescribable.

strings.string: 烤箱里飘出来的那味道……难以形容。

string.ID: What are you working on?
Laboratory? You work in a kitchen.

strings.string: 实验室？你这是在厨房里干活。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，食物修补匠。

string.ID:
Yes! I have braved its wharf in the past, to gather precious convalessence for my experiments.
Are you going? Dress warmly and mind the trolls.

strings.string:
去过！我从前冒过那儿的码头，为我的实验采集珍贵的疗愈精粹。
你要去？穿暖和点，当心那些巨魔。

string.ID: Did you call this kitchen your laboratory?

strings.string: 你把这厨房叫作你的实验室？

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，食物修补匠。

string.ID:
Omonporch is a fine source of bananas, but I have little to say about self-appointed nobility.
Claimed authority has a heady aroma, but no broth beneath it. Let us simply appease Asphodel and leave xem to xyr fantasies.

strings.string:
奥蒙波奇是个不错的香蕉产地，至于自封的贵族，我没什么好说的。
自称的权威闻着挺冲，底下却没有汤。我们只管安抚好阿斯福德勒，让伊去做伊的梦。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，食物修补匠。

string.ID:
My air-puffed pastry experiment collapsed thanks to that disturbance.
Whoever is responsible will pay dearly.

strings.string:
我那充气酥皮的实验，被那阵动静毁了。
不管是谁干的，都要付出高昂代价。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，食物修补匠。

string.ID:
I have visited the rainbow wood but once, and there I sampled an array of strange foods, one of which allowed me an unusual lens through which to view the world. It was nothing like I had ever experienced, and I imagined such wondrous recipes. I wrote them all down as best I could, of course.
Sadly, once I returned to my ordinary frame of reference, my scribblings proved impossible to read. So it goes.

strings.string:
我去过彩虹林，只有一次。在那里我尝了一串奇怪的食物，其中一样给了我一副不寻常的透镜去看世界。那是我从未有过的体验，我因此想出了许多奇妙的菜谱。当然，我尽力把它们都记了下来。
遗憾的是，一回到寻常的参照系，我的涂鸦就读不出来了。世事如此。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，食物修补匠。

string.ID:
What you smell is Grit Gate's signature dish. The Porridge is a recipe passed down through generations of Barathrumites, and it is the food that inspired me to pursue my craft. Yes, outsiders quail at the intensity of the scent, for its flavor is as bold as its effects!
We use cuisine to channel lightning from our bodies! Other recipes may let us breathe fire, or learn the secrets of the Eaters. The Porridge is as precious a part of our legacy as the Barathrum Clock or the foaminator.

strings.string:
你闻到的是砂砾门的招牌菜。那锅粥是巴拉瑟鲁姆派代代相传的配方，也正是它激励我投身此道。没错，外人会被那气味的猛烈吓退，因为它的味道和它的效力一样霸道！
我们用烹饪从体内引出闪电！别的配方能让我们吐火，或习得食者（the Eaters）的秘密。那锅粥，与巴拉瑟鲁姆钟、泡沫机一样，是我们遗产中珍贵的一部分。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，食物修补匠。

string.ID:
Oh, it changes by the hour, sometimes the minute. Preserve this, observe that, add anything, taste everything.
But the starapple of my eye, the Spindle up which I cast my ambitious gaze... is edible vapor. Food that you eat, food that you breathe. Sadly, to date the most I have managed is an herbed saline suspension. Salty air, if you will.

strings.string:
哦，它每小时都在变，有时每分钟都在变。腌这个，观察那个，什么都往里加，什么都尝一尝。
但我眼中的星苹果、我雄心所仰望的那根纺锤（the Spindle）……是可食的蒸汽。既能吃、又能呼吸的食物。遗憾的是，至今我做到的极限，只是一份加了香草的盐水悬浊液。你要愿意，就叫它「咸空气」。

string.ID: Vapor... and salt?
Good luck with your experiments, then.
Well, I should be going.

Yes. The flavor, the breathability, all successful, but the barrier between flavor and food is in the calories, and they have yet eluded me. But it is only a matter of time. I am patient, and I am relentless.

strings.string: 对。味道、可呼吸性，全都成了；但「味道」与「食物」之间的那道关隘在于热量，而热量至今躲着我。不过这只是时间问题。我有耐心，也绝不罢手。

string.ID: Good luck, then.
I will leave you to it. Live and drink.

strings.string: 那我就不打扰了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I have no need for luck, but I appreciate your well-wishes nonetheless.
May your own endeavors drive you as mine drive me. Did you wish to speak of anything else?

strings.string:
我不需要运气，不过还是多谢你的好意。
愿你自己的事业驱使你，如同我的事业驱使我。你还想说点别的吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，食物修补匠。

string.ID: Kitchen? You think this a mere kitchen?

strings.string: 厨房？你以为这只是个厨房？

string.ID: It certainly looks like a kitchen.

strings.string: 它看起来确实就是个厨房。

string.ID: No, of course it's a laboratory, I wasn't thinking.

strings.string: 不，这当然是实验室，我没动脑子。

string.ID: Why don't I see myself out?

And I suppose the Stilt is a modest church, its great bazaar a junk sale?
Look about you. Every instrument you see is precision-calibrated, every tool handcrafted and built to last. In this room, sustenance and ingenuity come together to evolve cuisine itself, to shape not this culture alone but, over time, every culture. Is that kind of influence the product of a kitchen? Can a simple clay oven in the flower fields do what we do here? Has every kitchen an indelible influence over Qud?
{{emote|*He frowns.*}}
Should they? Should we not all?

strings.string:
那么照这说法，高跷是座朴素的小教堂，它的大集市是旧货摊了？
看看你四周。你见到的每一件仪器都经精密校准，每一件工具都手工打造、经久耐用。在这间屋子里，养分与巧思汇合，让烹饪本身进化；它塑造的不只是这一种文化，久而久之，是每一种文化。那种影响力，是一个厨房的产物吗？花田里一只普通的陶炉，做得出我们这里做的事吗？每个厨房都对卡德（Qud）有不可磨灭的影响吗？
{{emote|*他皱起眉。*}}
应该有吗？我们难道不该都有吗？

string.ID: I'm lost.
*mutter 'live and drink' while backing away*

strings.string: *一边后退一边嘟囔「活下去，喝足水」*

string.ID:
But perhaps you are right, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Think for a moment.
Every ingredient in the soup of collective knowledge is a valuable one, and who am I to elevate myself over more humble pioneers? But! All the more reason for us to regard cuisine (and by extension, culture itself) to be a scientific endeavor, an ongoing trial-and-error, a blending of what we know and what we don't know, calling upon reality itself to be our guide.
You are more insightful than I realized, =name=. Thank you for this discussion. Did you need aught else?

strings.string:
不过也许你是对的，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想一想。
集体知识这锅汤里，每一种材料都珍贵；我又凭什么把自己抬到更谦卑的先驱之上？可是！这恰恰更说明，我们该把烹饪（进而把文化本身）视为一项科学事业：一场持续的试错，一次已知与未知的调和，请现实本身来做我们的向导。
你比我以为的更有洞见，=name=。谢谢你这番讨论。你还需要别的吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，食物修补匠。

string.ID: {{emote|*The little watcher stares at you.*}}
Look, Lebah. I have recovered the repulsive device.

strings.string: 看，莱巴。我把那件令人厌恶的装置找回来了。

string.ID: Live and drink, quiet one.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，安静的小家伙。

string.ID: ... aye.
Agyra tells me you found some kind of repulsive device.

strings.string: 阿吉拉跟我说，你发现了某种令人厌恶的装置。

string.ID: Where is the repulsive device, again?

strings.string: 那件令人厌恶的装置，再说一遍在哪儿？

string.ID: I have freed one of the children.

strings.string: 我放出了那些孩子中的一个。

string.ID: I am =name=. What is your name?
What is your credo?
Live and drink, quiet one.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，安静的小家伙。

string.ID: That's all you have to say?
I barely survived and all you can say is 'ah' and 'yes'?

strings.string: 我差点没命回来，你就只会说「啊」和「是」？

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.
{{emote|*Lebah curls into an armored ball and stops responding to your questions.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*莱巴蜷成一个带甲的球，不再回应你的问题。*}}

string.ID: Lebah, do not ignore me.
What is your credo?
Live and drink, Lebah.
"An thou art swallowed by the Gyre, sing thee to the last."

strings.string: 「若你被环流（Gyre）吞没，便唱到最后一息。」

string.ID: What is your name?
The meaning is plain: An =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= swallowed by the Gyre, =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= sing to the last.

strings.string: 意思很明白：若=ifplayerplural:你们:你=被环流（Gyre）吞没，=ifplayerplural:你们就该:你就该=唱到最后一息。

string.ID: I don't understand.
Can you explain further?
That was not so much an explanation as it was a rephrasing.

strings.string: 那与其说是解释，不如说是换了句话重说一遍。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah stares at you wordlessly.*}}
I should go.

Ah,
aye.
a most repulsive device. The mind-echoes of that communion yet haunteth me.

strings.string:
啊，
唉。
一件极其令人厌恶的装置。那次相通留下的心念回声，至今仍缠着我。

string.ID: What was so bad about the device?
I will trouble you no further, then.

Not... the device. Repulsive as a key to a prison doth repulse. To know a key is to know of a prison.
Our watched children are bound, and lock swalloweth key. An =ifplayerplural:ye free:thou freest= one, three remaineth forever.
k-Goninon hath it now. An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest=.

strings.string:
不是……装置本身。令人厌恶的，是它像一把牢门钥匙那样令人厌恶。知道一把钥匙，就是知道一座牢。
我们看护的那些孩子被锁着，而锁吞掉了钥匙。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=放出一个，还剩三个永远锁着。
如今钥匙在 k-戈尼农手里。若=ifplayerplural:你们:你=要去找的话。

string.ID: Oh, do you mean this thing?
I will seek to retrieve it, then.
Who or what is k-Goninon?

strings.string: k-戈尼农是谁，或者是什么？

string.ID:
An elder ooze. My communion so disturbed me that I allowed them too close.
k-Goninon consumed the device, but I escaped.

strings.string:
一团古老的软泥。那次相通扰得我心神不宁，以致让它靠得太近。
k-戈尼农吞下了那装置，但我逃了出来。

string.ID: I will seek to retrieve it, then.
Tell me more about k-Goninon.

I concern myself little with oozes but to stay away.
Please, no more. I tire. Talk to Agyra.

strings.string:
我对软泥只关心一件事：离远点。
拜托，别问了。我累了。去问阿吉拉。

string.ID:
k-Goninon hath it.
Ask Agyra.

strings.string:
在 k-戈尼农那儿。
去问阿吉拉。

string.ID: Of course. k-Goninon.
{{emote|*Lebah nods to you, slowly curls into an armored ball, and speaks no further*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*莱巴朝你点点头，缓缓蜷成一个带甲的球，不再说话*}}

string.ID: Live and drink, little seer.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，小小的先知。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah yelps at the sight of the device, curling into an armored ball.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*莱巴一见那装置就尖叫一声，蜷成一个带甲的球。*}}

string.ID: Maybe I'll take this somewhere else.

strings.string: 也许我该把这东西拿到别处去。

string.ID: {{emote|*you receive no reply*}}
{{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...

strings.string: {{emote|*自言自语*}} ……超出质量阈值了，也许该装个带悬浮器的神经节遥投器……

string.ID: Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you.

strings.string: 哦，我没注意到你在那儿。那是因为我在无视你。

string.ID: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...

strings.string: {{emote|*自言自语*}} ……热桶的废热？还是离心提取到日渣（sunslag）的 p 密度……

string.ID: Where can I find a cave?
I'm not interested.
There are caves everywhere, you dolt! Scoop the surface of the marsh, or head on east to the rust wells, or wander into the Desert for all I care...

strings.string: 到处都是洞，你这蠢货！去沼泽表面刨一刨，或者往东去锈井，再不然就滚进沙漠里去，随你便……

string.ID: I will return with your knickknack.

strings.string: 我会带着你的小玩意儿回来的。

string.ID: I'm not interested.
You're standing in my light! What do you want?

strings.string: 你挡着我的光了！你想干什么？

string.ID: Here is your knickknack.
Nothing. I will return with your knickknack.

strings.string: 没什么。我会带着你的小玩意儿回来的。

string.ID: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!

strings.string: 啊，嗯，嗯。你原来还真有点用处？再去给我弄一个来！

string.ID: If I must.
Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!

strings.string: 啊，嗯，嗯。你原来还真有点用处？再去给我弄一个来！

string.ID: Here is your knickknack.
If I must.

{{emote|*Argyve whistles.*}}
Impressive, you! Maybe you're fit to poke around my workshop and swap scrap with me. I have been wanting another apprentice. So unfortunate about Skref, what with the disembowelment and all. Take a seat, there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿尔盖夫吹了声口哨。*}}
了不起啊，你！也许你够格在我工坊里翻翻找找，跟我换点废料。我一直想再收个学徒。斯克莱夫真是可惜，被开膛破肚什么的。坐那儿吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve raises both eyebrows.*}}
Now, to screw the nut on the bolt with an explanation! I'm on the cusp, you see. A grand discovery. The Weirdwire Conduit is near assembled, and once it is, we'll be able to chat with anyone... in instant time! from here to the Yd Freehold. But before I can finish, I need wire. As much as you can find... at least two hundred feet. You should be able to scavenge it from the rust wells.

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿尔盖夫两条眉毛都挑了起来。*}}
好，现在把解释这颗螺母拧到螺栓上！你看，我就站在临界点上。一项伟大的发现。怪线导管快要装好了；一旦装成，我们就能跟任何人交谈……瞬间即达！从这里到伊德自由领。但完工之前，我需要线。你能找到多少就要多少……至少两百英尺。你应该能从锈井里捡到。

string.ID: I'll fetch you your wire.
I'm not interested.
The wire! Give it to me!
Take the wire.
I don't have enough yet.

{{emote|*Argyve hoots*}}
Yes, yes! Beautiful wire! -oh, before I forget, I repaired an old recoiler for you. Use it whenever you wish to hop back to Joppa quickly. Now, give me a few moments to attach the wire...

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿尔盖夫怪叫一声*}}
好，好！漂亮的线！——哦，趁我还没忘，我给你修好了一台旧回弹器。想快点跳回约帕（Joppa）时就用它。现在，给我几分钟把线接上……

string.ID: I will return.
It's working! Genius! Genius! Noise in the static- I hear it! I hear!... what's this? What *is* that? Wait...

strings.string: 成功了！天才！天才！静电里有杂音——我听见了！我听见了！……这是什么？那*到底*是什么？等等……

string.ID: It's repeating itself...
{{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿尔盖夫自言自语了好几分钟。*}}

string.ID: Apprentice! Come, here! Something strange is occurring. The Conduit is picking up a signal, some sort of repeating transmission. I cannot decipher it, however. I lack cryptogull eggs and, well, never you mind! I have a great task for you, my apprentice. Do you accept it?

strings.string: 学徒！过来，到这儿来！出了怪事。导管接收到了一道信号，某种重复传输。可我解不开它。我缺隐鸥蛋，还有，呃，你别管了！我有一件大任务交给你，我的学徒。你接不接？

string.ID: Can I know what it is?

-yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.

strings.string: ——能。你必须去找老巴拉瑟鲁姆，当今在世最年长、最有智慧的修补匠。他和他的追随者「巴拉瑟鲁姆派」住在东北方砂砾门的拱顶之下，在卡德（Qud）那片被丛林勒死的废墟里。他会知道这信号意味着什么。

string.ID: Who are these Barathrumites?

strings.string: 这些巴拉瑟鲁姆派是什么人？

string.ID: I require no further information. I will go.

strings.string: 我不需要更多信息了。我去。

string.ID: Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can.

strings.string: 巴拉瑟鲁姆的门徒。大多是熊族，跟他们的导师一样——那种长着棘刺的白化熊，比起被烈日腌透的丛林地表，更喜欢烛光昏暗的洞穴。一千年前，巴拉瑟鲁姆与他的族人越过霍姆斯三角洲，进入卡德（Qud）正在生锈的心脏。他在自己的工坊里花了几个世纪，把时光造物上的铬壳一层层剥下。若他解不开这道信号，就没人能解开了。

string.ID: I accept the task, Argyve.

strings.string: 我接下这任务，阿尔盖夫。

string.ID: I must think on this.
Farewell, Argyve.

Splendid! Perfect! Let me record the signal to disk, which you'll need to guard with your life, I'm afraid.
I'll rig up a droid scrambler for you, too. You see, the Barathrumites have programmed a troupe of waydroids to guard the approach to Grit Gate. With the scrambler, you'll needn't worry about them. Wait there.

strings.string:
好极了！完美！让我把信号录到盘上——恐怕你得用命去护着它。
我还会给你拼一台道机干扰器。你看，巴拉瑟鲁姆派编了一队道机守卫砂砾门的通路。有了干扰器，你就不必担心它们了。在那儿等着。

string.ID: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿尔盖夫自言自语了好几分钟。*}}

string.ID: Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!

strings.string: 拿好。现在，走！滚吧！愿你活得够久，能替我办事。走开，走开！

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.
The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.

strings.string: 巴拉瑟鲁姆派说，入会之前我得先探一处叫各各他的洞。

string.ID: Argyve, I am no apprentice. The Barathrumites call me =factionaddress:Barathrumites= now.

strings.string: 阿尔盖夫，我不是学徒了。巴拉瑟鲁姆派现在称我为=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: Need anything, Argyve?
Farewell, Argyve.
My apprentice! What?
Who are the Barathrumites again?

Did they, now? Well you're not MY =factionaddress:Barathrumites=!
Grit Gate is not Joppa, you pridesome solder-nail, and in this house you are apprentice still.
Now, what did you want? Be quick!

strings.string:
是吗？可你不是*我的*=factionaddress:Barathrumites=！
砂砾门不是约帕（Joppa），你这自命不凡的焊钉；在这间屋子里，你仍然是学徒。
说吧，你想要什么？快点！

string.ID:
-what?
No, no, I'm far too engrossed to see to your curiosity. I'm sure the Barathrumites have something for you to do.

strings.string:
——什么？
不，不，我太投入了，没空搭理你的好奇心。巴拉瑟鲁姆派肯定有活儿给你干。

string.ID:
Live and drink, wayfarer.
Cause no strife here and we will have no quarrel.

strings.string:
活下去，喝足水，旅人。
只要你不在此生事，我们便无争执。

string.ID: You speak like a Warden.
What are you doing here?

I am no one of any importance.
But my name is Zothom, and some call me the Penitent.

strings.string:
我算不上什么人物。
但我名叫佐索姆，有人叫我「忏悔者」。

string.ID: You speak like a Warden.
What are you doing here?
I am no Warden. My only fellowship is with my own shame.

strings.string: 我不是看守。我唯一的同伴，是我自己的耻辱。

string.ID: Why are you ashamed?
My name is =name=. What is yours?
What are you doing here?
I watch over the Grave of Rebekah to atone for my deeds, and to find my credo.

strings.string: 我守着蕾贝卡之墓，以赎我昔日所为，也为自己寻一条信条。

string.ID: Who is Rebekah?
Your deeds?
Your credo?
Are you a Warden?

I was once a vile graverobber, the lowest of the low. Years ago I sought to plunder the Tomb of the Eaters, and set off to do so with a pair of confederates. I watched both of them die, slain by ancient artifice and entombed with the ancient dead.
I would have shared their fate, but for a coterie of mopango nesting in the catacombs. They kept me safe and fed me while I treated my wounds. It is in their honor that I seek a credo now.

strings.string:
我曾是个卑劣的盗墓贼，下贱中的下贱。多年前我想去劫掠食者（the Eaters）之墓，便与两个同伙一同出发。我眼看着他们两个死掉——被古老的机巧所杀，与古老的死者同葬。
我本该同他们一样，全靠墓窟里栖居的一群莫潘戈。他们护我周全、供我饭食，直到我养好伤。如今我寻访信条，正是为了向他们致敬。

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要进入食者（the Eaters）之墓。

string.ID: Live and drink, Penitent One.
Is your motivation just?

Only those who pay their respects to the Grave of Rebekah will know the way into the tomb.
If you make it inside, the mopango will offer you solace and knowledge, and can tell you more about the Tomb's contents.

strings.string:
唯有向蕾贝卡之墓致敬的人，才会知道入墓之路。
你若能进去，莫潘戈会给你慰藉与知识，也能告诉你更多关于墓中事物的来历。

string.ID: Who is Rebekah?
The mopango?
Can't you tell me anything else?

strings.string: 你不能再多告诉我一些吗？

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.
May you share my fate, then.
Tell me how to get in anyway.

strings.string: 不管怎样，告诉我怎么进去。

string.ID: We'll see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 走着瞧吧。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Tell me about the mopango, then.

Yes. It is a rite of passage for the mopango people: a statement that inspires contemplation, discussion, and thought. An ideal credo has no single explanation or interpretation and is meant to inspire contemplation in those who hear it. For this reason, it is considered rude among mopango to ask the meaning of a credo.
Someday I will find mine.

strings.string:
是。那是莫潘戈人的成年之礼：一句引人沉思、讨论与思索的话。理想的信条没有唯一的解释或诠释，本就是为了引发听者的沉思。正因如此，在莫潘戈中间追问一条信条的含义，被视为无礼。
总有一天我会找到属于我的那条。

string.ID: Who are the mopango?
I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要进入食者（the Eaters）之墓。

string.ID:
Mopango are plated, digging creatures whose armor scales glow a pale white. They are contemplative, sociable, and mostly peaceful. They commune with ancient objects, which is why a coterie of their kind lives in the Tomb of the Eaters.
They are patient even with rough-hewn wanderers such as we, but it's still not best to ask one to explain eir credo.

strings.string:
莫潘戈是披甲的掘地生灵，甲鳞泛着苍白的微光。他们好沉思、喜交际，大多平和。他们与古物相通，正因如此，才有一群同修团住在食者（the Eaters）之墓里。
就连我们这种粗野的游荡者，他们也耐心相待；但还是别去要求一个莫潘戈解释伊的信条为好。

string.ID: I'd like to meet these mopango.
I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要进入食者（the Eaters）之墓。

string.ID: Live and drink, Penitent One.

If you do find =player.reflexive= in the Tomb, the mopango settlement is nestled in the wall of the Northwest Catacombs. The entrance is guarded by a chain turret named Vivira, brightly-painted to distinguish em from eir brethren.
Resist your reflexive urge to fight or flee, as Vivira is friendly and open to parley. If you meet, tell em I sent you.

strings.string:
你若真在墓里找到了=player.reflexive=，莫潘戈的聚落就嵌在西北墓窟的墙壁中。入口由一座名叫薇薇拉的链式炮塔守卫——它漆得鲜亮，好与同类区分。
压住你想打或想跑的本能：薇薇拉友善，愿意交谈。若你见到伊，就说是我让你去的。

string.ID: Speak to a... turret? I suppose I will; live and drink.

strings.string: 跟一座……炮塔说话？我想我会的；活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Speak to a... turret? No thank you; live and drink.

strings.string: 跟一座……炮塔说话？不了，谢谢；活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Rebekah was a physician, and an advisor to Resheph until she lost his favor. When, after years of exile, she lost her voice and her life, she was buried here, an outsider unfit to be interred with the honored dead. So she rests here.
I believe her proximity will help me find my credo.

strings.string:
蕾贝卡曾是医师，也是雷谢夫的谋士，直到失宠。多年流放之后，她失去了声音，也失去了性命，便被葬在此处——一个不配与受尊崇的死者同葬的外人。于是她长眠于此。
我相信离她近些，能帮我找到自己的信条。

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要进入食者（the Eaters）之墓。

string.ID: Live and drink, Penitent One.

The engraving is done, Moloch! I do hope it's to your liking. Your deeds are incised here for all time.
You may now enter the sarcophagus, Moloch. Be at peace.

strings.string:
镌刻已完成，摩洛克！但愿合您心意。您的事迹已在此永世铭刻。
您现在可以入石棺了，摩洛克。请安息。

string.ID:
Now, uh... hop... hop into the sarcophagus.
Safe travels.

strings.string:
那么，呃……请……请入石棺吧。
一路平安。

string.ID: .....oh... oh? Peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.

strings.string: ……哦……哦？愿所有在盘羊羔之家里踱步者皆得安宁。

string.ID: Do you know the Mark of Death?
How do I get to Brightsheol?
Why is this tomb unfinished?

strings.string: 这座陵墓为何没有完工？

string.ID:
...oh..... I am Herododicus, lapidary, lithographer, sculptor, calciminer, and biographer to the Coiled Lamb. I will tarry here until the Godhead passes on, and then I will canonize his deeds in high relief.
I've tarried for quite some time, now.... What a prodigious reign! Bless that Coiled Lamb!

strings.string:
……哦……我是赫罗多迪库斯，宝石匠、石版师、雕刻师、白灰匠，以及盘羊羔的传记作者。我会在此滞留，直到神首逝去，然后以高浮雕将他的事迹封圣。
我已经滞留相当久了……多么漫长的统治啊！愿盘羊羔受福！

string.ID: The sultanate is dissolved. Resheph rules no longer.

strings.string: 苏丹国已经解体。雷谢夫不再统治了。

string.ID:
.....oh.... oh.... Poor friend. The ironshank must be upsetting your digestion. The darkness must be blooming in your brain, making you slow and doltish.
The sultanate dissolved? Tidings would have reached me.... someone would have said so....
Oh... poor, doltish friend. You cantered too long outside the House of the Coiled Lamb, and now you are a dolt.

strings.string:
……哦……哦……可怜的朋友。一定是铁胫（Ironshank）搅坏了你的肠胃。一定是黑暗在你脑中开花，让你变得迟钝愚笨了。
苏丹国解体？消息应该传到我这儿了啊……总有人会说一声的……
哦……可怜又愚笨的朋友。你在盘羊羔之家外面踱步太久了，如今你傻了。

string.ID: It is a test. Tell me the answer now.

strings.string: 是考验。现在把答案告诉我。

string.ID: I want to ask you something else.

{{emote|Herododicus whirrs fearfully.}}
The Mark is =MarkOfDeath=.

strings.string:
{{emote|*赫罗多迪库斯恐惧地嗡嗡作响。*}}
那印记是=MarkOfDeath=。

string.ID:
Oh! Brightsheol? The forever braid of life? The Garden Behind the High Gate? Why, you must rank among the crown echelon of machine and folk, and you must... well, you must...
Start to decompose. You must... You must be dead. Dead and entombed. The body remains, but the mind wanders...

strings.string:
哦！明暗界（Brightsheol）？那条永恒的生命之辫？高门之后的花园？哎呀，您必定位列机械与万民之巅，而您必须……嗯，您必须……
开始腐烂。您必须……您必须已经死了。死了，且已入陵。肉身留下，心智游荡……

string.ID: You must be dead? Is that truly the only way?

strings.string: 我必须死？那真的是唯一的办法？

string.ID: I bear the Mark. Entomb me.

strings.string: 我带有那印记。把我入殓吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|Herododicus pauses.}}
Ye... yes? Is this a test? I suppose you... could we... could we have been in Brightsheol all along? Is that the answer?

strings.string:
{{emote|*赫罗多迪库斯停顿。*}}
是……是吗？这是一场考验吗？我想您……难道我们……难道我们一直就在明暗界（Brightsheol）里？这就是答案吗？

string.ID: Wrong on both counts. Resheph stands before you. Entomb me.

strings.string: 两点都错了。雷谢夫就站在你面前。把我入殓吧。

string.ID: Resheph is gone, biographer. I am here, and I have need to travel to Brightsheol. Entomb me.

strings.string: 雷谢夫已经不在了，传记作者。我在这里，而我要前往明暗界（Brightsheol）。把我入殓吧。

string.ID: Of course not. Let's back up.

strings.string: 当然不是。我们退回去说。

string.ID:
That's not even how it works!
First, I image your head, read your self's narrative from the folds of your brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of your life's deeds...
Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm done... then you can entomb =player.reflexive=.

strings.string:
根本不是这么运作的！
首先，我要为您的头部成像，从您脑子的褶皱里读出您自我的叙事，再拿它跟薄世界对您生平事迹的环境记录交叉核对……
然后我……把它……风格化……，再镌刻到墙上。等我做完……您才能为=player.reflexive=入殓。

string.ID: Do that then.
Hold on. I have more to ask.
You are forgiven. Now entomb me.

strings.string: 宽恕你了。现在把我入殓。

string.ID: I've misled you, biographer. I have another question.

strings.string: 我误导了你，传记作者。我还有个问题。

string.ID:
Moloch! Allow me to explain the deification procedure, as it is clearly beneath your station to know!
First, I must image the great Moloch's head, read your self's narrative from the folds of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= Holiest Brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of His Eminence's life's deeds...
{{emote|*Herododicus whispers*}} I'm sure your version is the better one, Moloch...

strings.string:
摩洛克！请允许我解说封神流程——这显然不是您这身份该去了解的事！
首先，我要为伟大的摩洛克头部成像，从=ifplayerplural:你们:你=至圣之脑的褶皱里读出您自我的叙事，再拿它跟薄世界对尊者生平事迹的环境记录交叉核对……
{{emote|*赫罗多迪库斯低语*}} 我敢说您那个版本更好，摩洛克……

string.ID: Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm finished, the sarcophagus will open, and you can lay =player.reflexive= to rest!

strings.string: 然后我……把故事……风格化……，再镌刻到墙上。我一完工，石棺就会打开，您就可以让=player.reflexive=安息了！

string.ID: Do it then.
Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............

strings.string: 开始与薄世界年鉴交叉核对…………

string.ID:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled. Now to engrave it.
Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.

strings.string:
交叉核对完成。您的叙事已编纂完毕。现在开始镌刻。
安宁……愿所有在盘羊羔之家里踱步者皆得安宁。

string.ID: Peace, biographer.
Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............

strings.string: 开始与薄世界年鉴交叉核对…………

string.ID:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled, Moloch. Now to go engrave it.
Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled... in Your House, Moloch.

strings.string:
交叉核对完成。您的叙事已编纂完毕，摩洛克。现在去镌刻。
安宁……愿所有在盘羊羔之家里踱步者……在您的家里踱步者皆得安宁，摩洛克。

string.ID: Peace, biographer.

'Tis a saying among the stonemasons, "Never finish a job too early." By the decretum of Sagittar, old as it is, they have until the Coiled Lamb is... is decom-.. passed... decompassed.... dead, deadlike... to complete their work on the Tomb.
Bless the Coiled Lamb, peace to those who canter in his house, and let us pray the day never comes!

strings.string:
石匠之间有句老话：「活儿永远别完工得太早。」依据萨吉塔那道古老的法令，他们可以一直干到盘羊羔……腐……逝……腐逝……死掉，像死了一样……才需完成陵墓的工程。
愿盘羊羔受福，愿在他家里踱步者得安宁——让我们祈祷那一天永不到来！

string.ID: But Resheph is dead. The sultanate is dissolved.

strings.string: 可雷谢夫已经死了。苏丹国已经解体。

string.ID: -mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=.
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达微笑。*}}
进来——来坐，坐在那边的荫凉里，靠着个垫子。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Live and drink, =name=. Come, sit with me.

strings.string:
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达微笑。*}}
活下去，喝足水，=name=。来，陪我坐坐。

string.ID:
-mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=?
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Live and drink. Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there. And welcome to Joppa.
You may drink of our freshwater, too, and quench your thirst.

strings.string:
——唔。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=？
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达微笑。*}}
活下去，喝足水。进来——来坐，坐在那边的荫凉里，靠着个垫子。欢迎来到约帕（Joppa）。
你也可以喝我们的淡水，解解渴。

string.ID: I'm back from Red Rock with the corpse of a pale spiderling. Elder, would you examine it?

strings.string: 我从红岩回来了，带回一只苍白幼蛛的尸体。长者，您要看一看吗？

string.ID: What is this place, Joppa?
Do you sell wares here?
I'm looking for work.
I'm looking for work.
Can you tell me about the Gyre and the Girsh nephilim again?

strings.string: 能再跟我讲讲环流（Gyre）和基什拿非利吗？

string.ID: What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 关于六日高跷，您能讲些什么？

string.ID: Argyve wants me to meet the Barathrumites.

strings.string: 阿尔盖夫想让我去见巴拉瑟鲁姆派。

string.ID:
-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neath the shelf of the world. A million breaths of salt the wind heaves over the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi. And to the east, the rotting jungles of Qud.
Here in the crack between the two, watervine can grow, and we grow it. mmm, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
——这儿？绿洲小村。在世界那座台架之下。风从大盐漠莫格拉伊上，吹来百万次呼吸那么多的盐。往东，是卡德（Qud）腐烂的丛林。
就在这两者之间的裂缝里，水藤长得起来，而我们种它。唔，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Can you tell me about Qud?

-mm, there? Land slopes up and is toothed in chrome steeples, ageless things. Looming over the old-earth tunnels, pillowed in rotting jungle and fungus groves. And broken against the mounts of the north, they are, in the shadow of the Spindle...
There are people, friends, communities. And friends-to-noone, too. History is thick as the high salt sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and where the past is ground up like matz meal, a mix of life sets in.
-mm, adventurous ones set off for their own splinter of artifact. To both Fates, life and death...

strings.string:
——唔，那儿？地势向上倾斜，齿列般排着铬色的尖塔，永不老去的东西。它们俯瞰着旧世的隧道，垫在腐烂的丛林与菌林之中。而在北方群山的撞击下，它们断裂了——在纺锤（the Spindle）的影子里……
那里有人，有朋友，有社群。也有与谁都算不上朋友的人。历史厚得像高盐之地的烈日，=player.formalAddressTerm=；而往事被磨成无酵饼粉的地方，就会有生命掺和进来。
——唔，爱冒险的人便出发，去寻属于自己那一块碎片。生死两命，都赌上了……

string.ID: -here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers.

strings.string: ——这儿？买草药的话，去东门那边找我女儿。东南角坐着的塔姆有一堆零碎玩意儿，就摆在他那些抽屉柜上。

string.ID:
-mm, work? The farmers are plagued by cave vermin. You might speak to Mehmet o' there, by the southern watervine patch.
And Argyve, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.

strings.string:
——唔，找活？农夫们正被洞穴害虫困扰。你可以去南边水藤田那儿找穆罕默德说说。
还有阿尔盖夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那个修补匠。他总在找能拿线连起来的零碎，嘿。去西南边他那间铁皮棚子。

string.ID: -mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.

strings.string: ——唔，找活？去找阿尔盖夫吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那个修补匠。他总在找能拿线连起来的零碎，嘿。去西南边他那间铁皮棚子。

string.ID: -ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon.

strings.string: ——啊，唔，何等奇观。里面的雕像，是对眼睛的一次启示。那儿卖蜡烛的多得能把你的皮囊从浅滩一路掏空到甲虫之月（Beetle Moon）。

string.ID: -mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have.

strings.string: ——唔，巴拉瑟鲁姆派。那帮熊人，是股古怪的风。他们，唔，哈。他们不太待见外人。但愿阿尔盖夫卖给你的欢迎，不比你能得到的更好。

string.ID:
-this? Oh? Oh...
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses for several minutes.*}}
Warted leg? mm. Foul smell of sour gum? mmm. Moon and sun....
A girshling? This is a girshling.

strings.string:
——这个？哦？哦……
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达停顿了好几分钟。*}}
长疣的腿？唔。酸树脂似的臭味？唔……月与日啊……
吉尔什灵？这是吉尔什灵。

string.ID: What's a girshling?

Creature of plague, =player.formalAddressTerm=. mmm. This one...
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
This one covered in slick and muscled out the bilge hose of sleeping Agolgot, in the cave under the Cloaca...
-mm, but here? Girshling this far west? There must be hundreds for one to reach... mm, does the Gyre widen again??

strings.string:
瘟疫之物，=player.formalAddressTerm=。唔。这一只……
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达停顿。*}}
这一只浑身滑腻，是从沉睡的阿戈洛特的舱底软管里挤出来的，就在泄殖腔之下的洞穴里……
——唔，可它怎么到了这儿？吉尔什灵跑到这么西边？得有好几百只，才可能有一只跑到……唔，环流（Gyre）又在变宽了吗？？

string.ID: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.

strings.string: 我跟吉尔什灵旁边一个奇怪的身影说过话。

string.ID: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...

strings.string: 有个奇怪的身影在跟着那东西……

string.ID: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.

strings.string: 我注意到那东西的獠牙被拔掉了。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, plagues. Of our great grandsires many-times-over. Salt, darkness, svardym-frog... Girshling.

strings.string:
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达停顿。*}}
——唔，瘟疫。比我们高祖辈还要早许多倍的那些。盐、黑暗、斯瓦迪姆蛙……吉尔什灵。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Do not like to sour the air with a harsh word! But this tiding bites my liver like acid. mm, must ask Nima for an elixir of yuckwheat...

strings.string:
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达停顿。*}}
——唔，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我不爱用难听的话把空气弄酸！可这消息像酸一样咬我的肝。唔，得去找尼玛要一剂辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）药水……

string.ID: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.

strings.string: 我跟吉尔什灵旁边一个奇怪的身影说过话。

string.ID: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...

strings.string: 有个奇怪的身影在跟着那东西……

string.ID: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.

strings.string: 我注意到那东西的獠牙被拔掉了。

string.ID: I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.
-mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.

strings.string: ——唔，哦？穿着染色的长袍，手上比划个不停？还念叨着烟斗奶？那一定是个环流（Gyre）尸鬼。他们差不多把基什拿非利当神来拜。

string.ID: Girsh nephilim?

{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, nephilim. Seventh plague. Girsh titans born on the Moon Stair, and quickened to life to eat our young. Sultan Resheph drove them back a chiliad ago, away to slumber. mm, do they rouse?

strings.string:
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达停顿。*}}
——唔，拿非利。第七场瘟疫。生在月阶上的基什泰坦，被赋予生命，为的是吃我们的幼崽。苏丹雷谢夫在一千年前把它们赶了回去，赶去沉睡。唔，它们要醒了吗？

string.ID: -mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.

strings.string: ——唔，哦？那一定是个环流（Gyre）尸鬼。他们把那牙齿直接绑在自己牙床上，好在基什拿非利面前做个样子。

string.ID: Girsh nephilim?

-mm? No, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Your finding is rich in value to us. We are poor farmers, and sharpen our vinereapers is all we can do. But others? Perhaps more.
Take these prickly-boons as thanks. mm, I will not soon forget this, =name=. Leave me now to muse, kindly...

strings.string:
——唔？不，=player.formalAddressTerm=！你的发现对我们价值极大。我们只是穷农夫，能做的不过是把割藤刀磨快。可别人呢？或许能做更多。
收下这些棘礼，算是谢意。唔，我不会很快忘记这事，=name=。现在让我独自想想吧，好心人……

string.ID:
-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad old. Seven such: girshlings, darkness. mm, svardym-frog...
Ah, nephilim, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Girsh titans who eat the young of kith and kin. Sultan Resheph drove them under the earth, but do they stir??

strings.string:
——唔，怎么？瘟疫，一千年前的事。共七场：吉尔什灵、黑暗。唔，斯瓦迪姆蛙……
啊，还有拿非利，=player.formalAddressTerm=。吃亲族幼崽的基什泰坦。苏丹雷谢夫把它们赶到了地下，可它们动了吗？？

string.ID: -mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?

strings.string: ——唔，哦？你是想知道他们会不会来约帕（Joppa）？

string.ID: mm, I am for you, =name=. Any friend of yours is too a friend of Joppa, and if those friends desire shelter I wouldn't dare turn them away. I only hope these lilypad-folk have the patience for a farmer's life. -mm, not as exciting here as it was in the Palladium Reef.

strings.string: 唔，我支持你，=name=。你的朋友就是约帕（Joppa）的朋友，若那些朋友想要个落脚处，我不敢把他们赶走。只望这些睡莲之民有耐心过农夫的日子。——唔，这儿可不像钯礁那边那么热闹。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Elder.
-mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.

strings.string: ——唔，愿你慷慨的心得福，=name=。我无意轻慢这些斯林斯，只是你向约帕（Joppa）人求的这份情，太重了。

string.ID: Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.

strings.string: 你跟斯林斯谈过了吗，=name=？我很好奇他们会选哪里落脚。

string.ID:
-mm, your luminous friends are settling in quite well.
There is yet a pall of ennui among some, but such is the case for any party of brave migrants. Ah, they will find their ground or their path, all in time. Some farmers show some small discomfort but that will pass in time.

strings.string:
——唔，你那些发光的友人安顿得挺好。
有些人还罩着一层倦怠，可哪一队勇敢的迁徙者不是如此。啊，他们总会找到自己的地，或自己的路，都只是时间问题。有些农夫显得有些不自在，但那也会过去。

string.ID: My thanks, Elder.

-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how the slynth have become a part of Joppa!
Some cared not for the slow pace of our lives and struck out on their own, and with their thews and wits I have no doubt they will live to find purpose. mm, others are welcome to grow and flourish here in our marshes.

strings.string:
——唔，啊，=name=。来看看斯林斯怎样成了约帕（Joppa）的一部分！
有些人看不上我们这慢吞吞的日子，自己出去闯了；以他们的筋腱与头脑，我毫不怀疑他们会活出个名堂。唔，其余的，尽可在我们的沼泽里生长、繁茂。

string.ID: My thanks again, Elder.

Klanq puff on you...
..later. Now, Klanq pause puff for prickles favor.

strings.string:
克兰克朝你喷……
……稍后。现在，克兰克停喷，为棘刺办事。

string.ID: Is the Creature ready?
I am ready for the Creature to be moulded and catalyzed.

strings.string: 我准备好让那生物被塑形、被触媒了。

string.ID: Didn't you die?
Can you tell me about the components I must gather?

strings.string: 能讲讲我必须收集的构件吗？

string.ID: What should I know about the Creature?

strings.string: 关于那生物，我该知道什么？

string.ID: Do you live in Grit Gate now?
I would like to ask some questions about the large creature.

strings.string: 我想问几个关于那大型生物的问题。

string.ID: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.

strings.string: 克兰克散布！杀克兰克，杀不到要紧处。

string.ID: Materials ready? Circuits to solder. Klanq stir the soup?

strings.string: 材料齐了？电路要焊。克兰克搅汤？

string.ID: You haven't provided the mound with all the necessary materials.

strings.string: 你还没给泥堆备齐所有必需材料。

string.ID: You don't have enough primordial soup.
Klanq stir! Come back three days and Creature arrive. Now, take operating manual.

strings.string: 克兰克搅！三天后回来，生物就到。现在，拿操作手册。

string.ID: I'll return in three days.
No! Be back =mound.complete.days=.
Soup, body, catalyst, atzmus, armament, incantation, hamsa, power source, soup. Ask component!

strings.string: 汤、躯体、触媒、超验印记（atzmus）、武备、咒文、五手护符（hamsa）、动力源、汤。问构件！

string.ID: Tell me about the soup.
Tell me about the body.
Tell me about the catalyst.
Tell me about the atzmus.
Tell me about the armament.
Tell me about the incantation.
Tell me about the hamsa.
Tell me about the power source.
Where do I place components once they are gathered?

strings.string: 构件收集齐后，我放到哪里？

string.ID: I have something else to ask.
Primordial soup 20 drams. Act as Creature circulatory liquid. Catalyzed and boom! Animating substance. Electromagnets induce sinusoidal flow.

strings.string: 原初之汤 20 德拉姆（dram）。作生物循环液。被触媒，然后轰！赋活之物。电磁体引出正弦流。

string.ID: Body of creature friend to form Creature after. Must follow you and be experience. No worry, friend not consumed in creation.

strings.string: 用生物友伴的躯体来塑成生物。必须跟随你，必须有阅历。别担心，友伴不会被造物吞掉。

string.ID: Three dram of pure liquid to catalyze soup and circulate nutrient. Liquid choice alter sanguine mixture, change Creature.

strings.string: 三德拉姆（dram）纯净液体，用以触媒汤、循环养分。液体的选择会改变血液配比，改变生物。

string.ID: Atzmus transcendental imprint of being. Pattern trait after creature part, crossed with Body.

strings.string: 超验印记（atzmus），存在本身的超验烙印。依生物部位取特征样式，与躯体交叉。

string.ID: Zetachrome weapon. Attune Creature to the martial art and shape metachrome fist-types in the fashion after.

strings.string: 泽塔铬武器。使生物与那门武艺同调，并依其法塑出元铬拳型。

string.ID: Words spoken from your experience and inscribed to form being-bond. First sounds heard in Creature's early dreambrain.

strings.string: 出自你阅历的言语，铭刻而成存在之契。是生物早期梦脑里最先听见的声音。

string.ID: Chosen token to palm-solder and orient with object-meaning, 5 lbs. or less. Like others, choice alters Creature trait and behavior.

strings.string: 自选的凭物，掌焊并依物之义定向，重量 5 磅以下。与其它构件一样，选择会改变生物的特征与行为。

string.ID: Ascending Creature need mightful battery with rare electromagnet shielding. Purple prickles make neutron cell with 3 flux drams, or must find different source.

strings.string: 登升的生物需要强力电池，附罕见的电磁屏蔽。紫色的棘刺能用 3 通量德拉姆（dram）造中子电池，否则就得另找动力源。

string.ID: Interact with scrap-clay mound. Then chat Klanq to solder circuits and stir the soup.

strings.string: 与废料黏土泥堆互动。然后找克兰克聊，焊电路、搅汤。

string.ID: What ask! Klanq say.
I will bond with the Creature. How does this work?

strings.string: 我要与生物结契。这怎么运作？

string.ID: I am bonded with the Creature. How does this work?

strings.string: 我已与生物结契。这怎么运作？

string.ID: Barathrum and I will ascend the Spindle inside the Creature?

strings.string: 我和巴拉瑟鲁姆要坐在生物里登上纺锤（the Spindle）？

string.ID: Can the Creature wear equipment?
What if it's damaged or destroyed?
I have something else to ask.
Creature follow you like friend. Also, can enter Creature and take control. One friend fit inside with you.

strings.string: 生物像友伴一样跟随你。也能进入生物、接管控制。里面还能塞进一个友伴，与你同行。

string.ID: Creature is large creature, can only wear gigantic gear. Like kraken or saltback.

strings.string: 生物是大型生物，只能穿巨型装备。像海怪或盐背兽那样。

string.ID: Prickles install reshaping nook in Court of Sultans at Omonporch. There, respackle Creature with one dram of sunslag. Or recall creature if lost.

strings.string: 棘刺在奥蒙波奇的苏丹之庭装了重塑壁龛。在那里用一德拉姆（dram）日渣（sunslag）重新凝塑生物。丢失了也能召回。

string.ID: Yes! But before then, can walk around with creature. Talk, fight, sleep... the normal. Friend.

strings.string: 是！但在那之前，可以带生物四处走。说话、打架、睡觉……平常那些。友伴。

string.ID: Klanq live! Tragedy of jalopy invite Klanq to dimcandlespace. Klanq soften stone floor with plushes, dust shelves of boring jars with happy and spores. Prickles look at it.

strings.string: 克兰克住下！破车之悲剧邀克兰克来昏暗烛光处。克兰克用软垫软化石头地，用快乐与孢子给乏味罐子的架子撒灰。棘刺看看它。

string.ID: Ah, a stranger. Welcome to the hydropon. I am Thah.

strings.string: 啊，一位生客。欢迎来到水培城。我是塔赫。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, Thah. I am =name=.
What manner of being are you?
Is all well here?
Live and drink, Thah.
Well met, =name=. Please forgive the, ah, austerity of our cradle. You may sup with us at our meager camp and rest under the shade of this Palladium shell. Sorry, as well, about the crowding.

strings.string: 幸会，=name=。请原谅我们培育槽的，呃，简陋。你可以在我们这寒酸的营地吃点东西，在这片钯壳的荫下歇息。也抱歉，这里挤了些。

string.ID: You don't seem to like your accommodations.

strings.string: 你似乎不喜欢自己的住处。

string.ID: We are called slynth, a people grown one by one from a hydroponic cradle containing a cutting of water lily and empowered by sunslag. We are but a handful of generations old, and kept no written history until I was grown, ah, some number of decades ago.

strings.string: 我们叫斯林斯，是一个由水培培育槽一株一株培育出来的族群——槽里养着一截睡莲插枝，由日渣（sunslag）赋力。我们只有几代人的历史；直到我，呃，几十年前被培育出来，我们才开始有文字记载。

string.ID:
Well enough. We drink the sun's rays, eat what we scavenge, rest under the shell, and it is. Enough.
I read and tinker. Some hunt. Others tend the cradle. Each day is like the next. Every so often, someone leaves.
We, ah, rarely hear from them thereafter. I hope they are all well.

strings.string:
还算好。我们饮阳光，吃拾来的东西，在壳下歇息——也就，够了。
我读书、修补。有些人打猎。有些人照看培育槽。每天都和前一天一样。偶尔，有人会离开。
之后我们，呃，很少听到他们的消息。希望他们都好。

string.ID: You don't seem happy with the status quo.

strings.string: 你似乎对现状并不满意。

string.ID:
To be wholly honest, =name=, I grow frustrated.
We are a young species, grown one by one in yonder sun-touched cradle. Over years, we have increased, but not, ah, not. Not grown.
Look around you. You see it, yes? This hydropon is no settlement.

strings.string:
老实说，=name=，我越来越沮丧。
我们是个年轻的族群，在那边的日晒培育槽里一株一株长出来。这些年我们数量增加了，但不是，呃，不是。没有成长。
看看你四周。你看到了吧？这座水培城算不上一个聚落。

string.ID: How can I help?

This is an existential conundrum, =name=, I'm not sure that it could-- ah, wait, no. I am reconsidering.
No, you could help. If you wished. I think.
May I explain?

strings.string:
这是个存亡攸关的难题，=name=，我不确定它能否——啊，等等，不，我改主意了。
不，你确实能帮上忙。如果你愿意的话。我想。
我可以解释一下吗？

string.ID: Please do.
I have changed my mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我改主意了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I don't believe my people wish to stay here, but we have had so little, ah, meaningful contact with other sapient creatures. We have no allies. We have nowhere to go but here.

strings.string: 我不认为我的族人想留在这里，可我们与其他有智生灵的接触少得可怜，呃，少得谈不上什么意义。我们没有盟友。除了这里，无处可去。

string.ID: You travel far and wide, do you not? You have the air of a traveling hero! From the epics. As such, you have seen many settlements, likely ingratiated yourself to some.

strings.string: 你走南闯北，对吧？你身上有一股游历英雄的气派！像史诗里那样。既然如此，你见过许多聚落，多半还与其中一些结下了交情。

string.ID: Surely, if you were to intercede on our behalf, some might welcome us? If, ah, let us say three settlements were to offer us shelter, this would grant us both direction and agency. Would you consider being our ambassador? Not unpaid.

strings.string: 若你替我们出面说和，想必总会有人愿意接纳我们？如果，呃，比如说有三个聚落愿意给我们庇护，那我们便既有方向、也有了自主。你愿意做我们的大使吗？不会白干。

string.ID: I will help.
I decline. Live and drink.

strings.string: 恕我谢绝。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Thank you, =name=. I have, ah, I have been crafting a personal project. Of sorts. I promise it to you for this task, and of course the gratitude of a young species.
Return to me after settlements agree to grant us refuge, and I will discuss them with my kin.

strings.string:
谢谢你，=name=。我，呃，我一直在做一件私人的东西。算是吧。我把它许给你作酬劳，当然还有一支年轻族群的感激。
等有聚落答应给我们庇护之后，回来找我，我会与族人商议。

string.ID: Live and drink. I will return with news.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水。我会带着消息回来。

string.ID: Come, =name=. It is time.

Ah, =name=, Moon and Sun.
Any news of our future home?

strings.string:
啊，=name=，月与日。
关于我们未来的家，有消息吗？

string.ID: Yes, I have news about the slynths' sanctuary.

strings.string: 有，斯林斯庇护所有消息了。

string.ID: None yet. Live and drink, Thah.

strings.string: 还没有。活下去，喝足水，塔赫。

string.ID: Ah! Let us discuss?

Joppa! An historic site. I wasn't sure if, ah, it still existed. As a village.
The quiet of the saltmarshes may be strange to my people, but some have voiced a wish for more peace than the Reef can spare. Thank you for this choice, =name=.

strings.string:
约帕（Joppa）！一处历史遗址。我不确定它，呃，是否还存在。作为一座村庄。
盐沼的寂静对我的族人或许陌生，但有些人说过，想要比钯礁所能给的更多安宁。谢谢你争取到这个选择，=name=。

string.ID:
The worshippers of Shekhinah? Fascinating. I, ah, don't know what to think of that.
It may be what my kin need, now I consider it. The Canticles make little sense to me but they are, ah, compelling. More compelling than me, certainly. I will discuss this with the others.

strings.string:
舍金纳的信徒？真有意思。我，呃，不知道该怎么看。
细想之下，或许这正是我族人所需要的。那些《颂歌》我大多听不明白，但它们，呃，有感染力。肯定比我有感染力。我会和其他人商议。

string.ID:
Did you say Barathrumites? So that's how it's pronounced.
Grit Gate is, ah... that's where Q Girl resides, isn't it? She wrote my favorite book, {{W|Disquisition on the Malady of the Mimic}}. I imagine such a home would have a positive effect on my kin. I will speak to them.

strings.string:
你说的是巴拉瑟鲁姆派？原来是这么念的。
砂砾门是，呃……Q女郎就住在那儿，对吧？她写了我最爱的那本书，{{W|《拟态之疾论》}}。我想这样的家会对我的族人有好影响。我去跟他们说。

string.ID:
Kyakukya? I didn't realize it had so many syllables.
That's where the, ah, faithful to the ape-god gather, correct? And, uh... Crowsong, as well. I will present this possibility to my people and we will discuss it.

strings.string:
基亚库基亚？我没意识到它有这么多音节。
那是，呃，猿神的信徒聚集之地，对吧？还有，呃……鸦歌。我会把这个可能提给族人，我们商议一下。

string.ID:
Ezra is, ah, the village at the base of the Spindle, is it not?
The very cradle of history. Not that my kin have a strong taste for history, but perhaps living amongst fresco and bas-relief will change their, ah, collective outlook?

strings.string:
埃兹拉是，呃，纺锤（the Spindle）脚下那座村庄，对吧？
正是历史的摇篮。虽说我的族人并不特别偏爱历史，但也许住在壁画与浅浮雕之间，会改变他们，呃，整体的看法？

string.ID: Fascinating. I know nothing about these mopango, but any people whose love for learning and discovery defines them are, ah... good, in my opinion. I will discuss this with my kin, and see if they agree.

strings.string: 真有意思。我对这些莫潘戈一无所知，但任何一个以热爱学问与发现为立身之本的族群，在我看来都是，呃……好的。我会与族人商议，看他们是否同意。

string.ID:
There is a sadness in, ah... choosing pariahs. Some of my kin dreamed of belonging, and the very word is the antithesis of belonging.
But then, if wanderers look after one another, there is a belonging in that as well. Even alone, we would not be alone. I will offer this choice to the others and we will discuss it.

strings.string:
选择与贱民为伍，这里头有一种，呃……悲凉。我有些族人曾梦想有所归属，而「贱民」这个词本身就是归属的反面。
可话说回来，若游荡者彼此照拂，那也是一种归属。就算独自一人，我们也不会孤单。我会把这个选择提给其他人，我们商议。

string.ID:
The nearby settlement? The one, ah, founded by three svardym and a galgal? I've always been mortally afraid to go there, knowing even the barest facts.
But you say they will accept us? Perhaps I was wrong.

strings.string:
附近那处聚落？就是，呃，三个斯瓦迪姆和一个加尔加尔建的那处？哪怕只知道最粗浅的底细，我也一直怕得要死，从不敢去。
可你说他们会接纳我们？也许我错了。

string.ID:
Bey Lah is real? Stain me surprised to hear so... I, ah, believed the hindren exclusively diasporic.
There is an undeniable poetry in it, if the slynth should emigrate to a mythical and secretive village. I will discuss this with my kin.

strings.string:
贝拉是真的？听你这么说我真吃惊……我，呃，一直以为欣德伦全都离散在外了。
若斯林斯迁往一座神话般隐秘的村庄，这其中的诗意无可否认。我会与族人商议。

string.ID:
Chavvah? The, ah, the... the tree of life? Allows us joining?
That, that is simply, ah, extraordinary. I will apprise my kin of this, and we will, ah... we will ponder what it may mean for us.

strings.string:
查瓦？那，呃，那……生命之树？允许我们加入？
那，那简直，呃，非同寻常。我会告知族人，我们，呃……我们会思量这对我们意味着什么。

string.ID: I have made my inquiries. It is time for the slynth to choose a new home.

strings.string: 我该问的都问了。斯林斯该选新家了。

string.ID: The village of Joppa has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 约帕（Joppa）村已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: The Mechanimists of the Six Day Stilt agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 六日高跷的机械教派已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: The Barathrumites of Grit Gate agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 砂砾门的巴拉瑟鲁姆派已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: The village of Kyakukya has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 基亚库基亚村已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: The village of Ezra has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 埃兹拉村已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: The mopango of the Tomb agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 陵墓中的莫潘戈已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: If the slynth choose to wander Qud, the Pariahs have agreed to look after them.

strings.string: 若斯林斯选择在卡德（Qud）流浪，贱民们已同意照拂他们。

string.ID: The Yd Freehold agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 伊德自由领已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: The village of Bey Lah has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 贝拉村已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: The chimes of Chavvah have agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 查瓦的鸣枝已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: Let's talk about something else.

I read a history once that mentioned =village.name=, taking note of their reverence for =village.sacred= and equal loathing of =village.profane=.
Will my kin accept a life of =village.activity=? I will consult with them.

strings.string:
我读过一部史书，提到过=village.name=，书中记下他们敬奉=village.sacred=，也同样憎恶=village.profane=。
我的族人会接受=village.activity=的生活吗？我会去问他们。

string.ID: The village of =village.name= has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: =village.name=村已同意接纳斯林斯为族人。

string.ID: Wanderer, thank you! I will tell my kin of these places. We will convene and discuss, and we will, ah, choose. Please be patient in the meantime.

strings.string: 游荡者，谢谢你！我会把这些地方告诉族人。我们会开会商议，然后，呃，做出选择。这期间请耐心等候。

string.ID: As you say, Thah. I will return.

strings.string: 如你所说，塔赫。我会回来的。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, =name=.
It's curious to see you still here, after helping your kin emigrate.

strings.string: 帮族人迁走之后，还见你留在这儿，倒是有趣。

string.ID: Why have you asked me to return?
Moon and Sun, Thah.

I've been crafting a kind of a relic, a piece of art that serves a purpose and that you can carry on your, ah, your person. I finally finished building it while you were away, and the opportunities you offered us inspired the finishing touches. I'd like you to have it.

strings.string: 我一直在做一件类似遗物的东西——一件有用处的艺术品，可以随身，呃，携带。你外出期间我终于把它做完了，而你为我们带来的那些机会启发了最后的收尾。我想把它送给你。

string.ID: I will cherish it. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会珍惜它。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, Thah.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Joppa shall be the new home of the slynth. The notion of a lasting, peaceful life with, ah, purpose... this appeals to many of our number, and where better than Abram's very watervine marsh?
Our emigration party departs for the saltmarshes in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：约帕（Joppa）将成为斯林斯的新家。一种持久、安宁而有，呃，有目标的活法……这吸引了我族中许多人；还有哪里比亚伯兰亲自开辟的水藤沼泽更合适？
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往盐沼。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: most of our number will join the Mechanimist faith, and reside at the Stiltgrounds at the edge of the Mogh'ra'yi.
Our emigration party departs for the Six Day Stilt in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：我族多数人将皈依机械教派，定居在莫格拉伊边缘的高跷场。
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往六日高跷。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is among the disciples of Barathrum. My kin have agreed to dedicate themselves to the pursuits of learning and service.
Our emigration party departs for Grit Gate in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林斯的新家就在巴拉瑟鲁姆的门徒之中。我的族人已同意投身于学问与服务。
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往砂砾门。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Kyakukya shall be the new home of the slynth. There are many ways to grow when one is planted in the very heart of Qud.
Our emigration party departs for the river in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：基亚库基亚将成为斯林斯的新家。当一株植物被栽在卡德（Qud）的正中心，生长的法门有许多。
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往河边。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is among the villagers of Ezra, harvesting musa alongside the banana ranchers and singing their songs.
Our emigration party departs for Omonporch in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林斯的新家就在埃兹拉的村民之中，与香蕉牧人们一同收割芭蕉，同唱他们的歌。
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往奥蒙波奇。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become mopango, taking root in ancient rock and casting our gaze back toward the history that preceded us.
Our emigration party departs for the Tomb of the Eaters in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林斯将成为莫潘戈，扎根于古老的岩石，把目光投向先于我们的历史。
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往食者（the Eaters）之墓。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is no home at all, but the floating fellowship of Qud's Pariahs. We were blessed with roots that need not fix themselves to the soil and have opted to use them accordingly.
We will split into parties and leave to meet with other wayfarers come morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林斯的新家根本不是家，而是卡德（Qud）贱民那流动的伙伴之谊。我们生来有幸，根系无需钉死在土里，便决定照此行事。
我们将分成小队，明早动身去与别的旅人相会。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall join the Yd Freehold, remaining in the reef where our cradle lies but mingling among other sapient creatures to learn their ways and teach what we know.
Our emigration party departs for the Freehold in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林斯将加入伊德自由领，留在培育槽所在的礁区，与其他有智生灵往来，学他们的门道，也教我们所知。
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往自由领。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Bey Lah shall be the new home of the slynth. There is a familiarity to this tucked-away village, newly greeting the world; this is our gentle emergence from obscurity, and one not undertaken alone.
Our emigration party departs for the flower fields in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：贝拉将成为斯林斯的新家。这座僻处一隅、刚刚开始迎向世界的村庄，让我们感到熟悉；这是我们自幽暗中温和地现身，而且不是独自上路。
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往花田。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become a part of Chavvah, the living city. There are no words for the breadth of futures before us, and we would not know them if they were. Perhaps we will learn to chime.
Our emigration party departs for the moon stair in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林斯将成为查瓦——那座活着的城——的一部分。摆在我们面前的前程之广阔，无以言表；纵有言辞，我们也读不懂。也许我们会学着鸣响。
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往月阶。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become citizens of =village.name=. We shall learn the practice of =village.activity=, hold =village.sacred= dear and spurn =village.profane=.
Our emigration party departs for =village.name= in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论与斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林斯将成为=village.name=的居民。我们将学习=village.activity=，珍视=village.sacred=，摒弃=village.profane=。
我们的迁徙队明早出发前往=village.name=。

string.ID: May the Argent Fathers watch over you.
May you find knowledge.
May Oboroqoru be merciful.

strings.string: 愿奥博罗库鲁慈悲待你。

string.ID: May the Eaters protect you.
Mayest thou rest ever in the Light of the Kasaphescence.

strings.string: 愿你永歇于卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）之光中。

string.ID: May the winds favor you.
Chime joyfully.
May the Fates favor you.

Ah, one last little thing, =name=. About your reward... it's not quite finished, but now I know just what it needs.
Please return to the hydropon after my kin have safely reached their new home and I will give it to you. I will not leave the cradle.

strings.string:
啊，最后还有件小事，=name=。关于你的报酬……它还没完全做完，但现在我知道它缺什么了。
等我的族人平安抵达新家之后，请回水培城来，我会把它交给你。我不会离开培育槽。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy a life of farming. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。倒不是，呃，倒不是说我不会喜欢务农的日子。只是一想到守了它几十年之后要离开这培育槽……我做不到。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. I don't, ah, resent that my kin have found succor in the embrace of faith, but I don't know how to walk that path myself. Someone needs to watch over the hydropon, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下了。我并不，呃，并不怨我的族人从信仰的怀抱里得了慰藉，只是我自己不知道该怎么走那条路。再说，总得有人看着水培城。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. I'd love to see the vaunted halls and, ah, bathe in the light of brilliant minds, but when I think about the journey my roots lock up. I feel, ah, unready. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下了。我很想看看那些备受称许的厅堂，呃，在杰出头脑的光辉里沐浴一番；可一想到那趟路程，我的根就僵住了。我觉得，呃，还没准备好。再说，总得有人看着培育槽。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy sharing knowledge with the mayor of our new home. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。倒不是，呃，倒不是说我不会喜欢与我们新家的镇长交流学问。只是一想到守了它几十年之后要离开这培育槽……我做不到。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. As fascinated as I would be to examine the statuary and bas-reliefs, my favorite mode of, ah, interaction with history is through the written word. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下了。虽说考察雕像与浅浮雕会让我着迷，但我与历史，呃，打交道最喜欢的法子还是通过文字。再说，总得有人看着培育槽。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID: Your thirst is mine, my water is yours.

strings.string: 你的渴即我的渴，我的水即你的水。

string.ID: Swap spittle?
Let's get to it.
{{emote|licks lips}}
My thirst is mine, your water is yours.

strings.string: 我的渴归我，你的水归你。

string.ID: Thirst. Water. Drink.
Slurp time.
My water is thirst, your water is yours.

strings.string: 我的水即渴，你的水即你的。

string.ID: Live and drink, =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=player.siblingTerm=.
I have some gossip that may interest you.

strings.string: 我有些闲话，你或许感兴趣。

string.ID: I have a secret to share with you.

strings.string: 我有个秘密要与你分享。

string.ID: Share a secret with me, =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=.
Would you teach me to craft =recipe=?
Would you teach me your ways?

strings.string: 你愿意教我你的门道吗？

string.ID: I am a friend to fungi. Colonize me.

strings.string: 我是真菌之友。来定殖我吧。

string.ID: I promise not to bother you again, =hermit=.
Would you gift me your =object.nameSingle=?
Would you gift me your =object.nameSingle=?
Teach me to think like a child again.

strings.string: 教我再像孩子那样思考。

string.ID: Would you teach me your ways?

strings.string: 你愿意教我你的门道吗？

string.ID: Teach me a secret of the aggregate mind.

strings.string: 教我聚合心智的一个秘密。

string.ID:
=subject.T= =verb:grab= your hand and you close your eyes. You find =player.reflexive= in a darkling thicket. =subject.T= =verb:tug= you over roots of braided nether, until finally you stumble into a glade. Others are here. You take their hands as =subject.t= took yours.
After a moment or an eon, you awaken knowing =mutation.name=.

strings.string: =subject.T=住你的手，你闭上眼。你在幽暗的灌木丛中发现了=player.reflexive=。=subject.T=着你越过交织的幽冥之根，直到你跌跌撞撞闯进一片林间空地。这里还有别人。你握住他们的手，正如=subject.t=握住你的手。过了片刻，或过了万古，你醒来时已通晓=mutation.name=。

string.ID: Would you share the favorite dish of your people?

strings.string: 你愿意分享你族人最爱的一道菜吗？

string.ID: Teach me to cook one of your signature dishes.

strings.string: 教我烹一道你的拿手菜吧。

string.ID: I would ask you to join me, =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=.
Live and drink, =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=.
{{g|[end the water ritual]}}
Let's trade.
Do you have work that needs doing?
My services are available if you have work to offer.

strings.string: 你若有事要办，我随时效力。

string.ID: Is there work around here?
Speak to =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers=.
Talk to =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers=.
Find =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers=.
Thank you. I have more to ask.

strings.string: 谢谢你。我还有别的要问。

string.ID: What is your name, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?
What may I call you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?
What are you called, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?
I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What is your name?
I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What may I call you?
You may call me =subject.refname=.
My name is =subject.refname=.
I am called =subject.refname=.
They call me =subject.refname=.
Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
My thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
Pleased to meet you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

{{emote|*The chime rings a bone-shaking alarm.*}}
Is this a taunt? A challenge? What cruelty drives you to attempt communication after what you have done?

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟发出一阵震骨的警报。*}}
这是嘲弄？是挑战？你做了那种事之后，还有什么残忍驱使你来尝试交谈？

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?
Your mockery disgusts me. You disgust me. I will not be calmed, Tikva!

strings.string: 你的嘲弄令我作呕。你令我作呕。我不会被安抚，提克瓦！

string.ID:
{{emote|*The chime rings a knell.*}}
O gesticulating hand.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟敲出一记丧音。*}}
哦，比划不停的手。

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?

We are adrift now. I will seek signs of her, or whatever she becomes. What do you care?
Do not answer.

strings.string:
我们如今在漂流。我会去寻她的迹象，或她所变成之物。你又在乎什么？
不必回答。

string.ID:
{{emote|The chime rings loud and sharp.}}
Heavy the hand. Heavy the head.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟响得又亮又锐。*}}
手沉。头亦沉。

string.ID: Tau has completed her -elseing.

strings.string: 陶已完成了她的「-不成」之仪。

string.ID:
I wonder how it must feel to be =name=, so loath to see the pen of fate in another's grasp that you see fit to wrench it away. Does it bring exultation of control, or relief from a gnawing insecurity?
Do not answer. I will not be calmed. Ask if asking.

strings.string:
我很好奇做=name=是什么滋味——如此不愿看见命运的笔握在他人手里，以致你觉得该把它夺过来。这带来的是掌控的狂喜，还是啃噬般不安的纾解？
不必回答。我不会被安抚。要问便问。

string.ID: I do have questions, still.

You. I roil to see you. I welcome you. I churn.
Do you know this weight, I wonder? Can you?

strings.string:
你。见到你让我翻涌。我欢迎你。我搅动。
我很好奇，你懂这份重量吗？你能懂吗？

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

I am torn asunder! This outcome, this outcome, the shear splits me. Why Ptoh? How? Has this always been us? Which of us yet carry this -else to reify under pressure to our extancy?
Do not answer. There is no word-answer, and perhaps none at all. You have done us a service and I thank you for this -elseing.

strings.string:
我被撕作两半！这结局，这结局，那剪切力把我劈开。为什么是普托（Ptoh）？怎么会？我们一直都是这样吗？我们之中还有谁带着这「-不成」，要在压力下把它实现在我们存在之上？
不必回答。没有言辞上的答案，也许根本就没有答案。你为我们做了一件事，我谢你这「-不成」之仪。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

{{emote|*the chime rings a sharp, urgent gonging tone*}}
Entity! You are given persistent will and agency, twice-hewn architecture of body and strong fiber that pulls. You bolt upright and damp-haired into fullness, your grasp abrading the threads of existence. Your responsibility remains whether acknowledged or not. Have strength, the time is now.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟敲出一记尖锐急迫的锣音*}}
存在者！你被赋予了持存的意志与能动，两度切削的躯体架构，以及会牵引的强韧纤维。你湿着头发猛地坐起，直入圆满，你的抓握磨蚀着存在的丝线。无论承认与否，你的责任都在。要有力量，时候就是现在。

string.ID: Is something the matter?
Is all this about gyredream?

strings.string: 这一切都跟环梦有关吗？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我要把陶的鸣枝带到主根，好让她离开查瓦。

string.ID: I accept. Ask if asking.

{{emote|*the chime rings again, echoing louder in the walls of your mind*}}
Hear me! It is more important than ever to know that you are a driver, reforged and honed. You tool yourself to apply selective atrocity. It cannot be helped. You shape this, your path bloody and blooming. You start in sleep and shake the ground.
All must, but you most of all. The weight may have been negligent once, but it is terribly heavy now.
Do you accept responsibilty?

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟再次响起，在你心智的墙壁间回荡得更响*}}
听我说！比以往更重要的是：你要知道自己是个驱动者，被重铸、被磨利。你把自己当作工具，去施加有选择的暴行。这无可避免。你在塑造这一切，你的道路血迹斑斑又繁花盛开。你在睡眠中启动，撼动大地。
所有人都必须如此，而你尤其。这份重量或许曾经可以轻忽，如今却沉重得可怕。
你接受这份责任吗？

string.ID: I do not.

Yet, what you break is broken. -else is not -then regardless of will. This way split me again from Tikva, sundered early the love I knew, the denial. Our cowardice.
Ignore this digression. Ask, if asking.

strings.string:
然而，你打碎的东西就是碎了。无论意志如何，「-不成」都不是「-将成」。这条路又一次把我和提克瓦分开，早早劈开了我所知的那份爱——那否认。我们的怯懦。
别理会这段跑题。要问便问。

string.ID: You loved another chime?

You are encysted as Tikva, just as they! Milky white keratinous thoughts melt to a sick mass, wrapped in a protective membrane. I tremble. So it is.
Ask, if asking.

strings.string:
你和他们一样，像提克瓦那样被包成了囊！乳白色的角质念头融成一团病灶，裹在保护膜里。我颤抖。事情就是这样。
要问便问。

string.ID: That's disgusting.
What's that about Tikva?
Just as Tikva, you turn away from your self-disgust. Yet, it is you and within you. You contain that you cannot tolerate.

strings.string: 正如提克瓦，你背对自己的自我厌弃。可它就是你，就在你之内。你容纳着你无法容忍之物。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tzedech emits a powerful, body-thrumming chime*}}
Yes. You understand destroying. You know the weight. We are past time of querulous inquisition, of confessions on lined parchment. Was the whole of this in your weight? It no longer matters. Scale the firmament, smite or soothe what rouses there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*特泽德赫发出一记强劲、震体的鸣响*}}
好。你懂毁灭。你知道那份重量。我们已经过了抱怨式审问、在划线羊皮纸上忏悔的时节。这一切是否全在你的重量里？已经不重要了。去攀登苍穹，去打击或安抚在那里苏醒之物。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings clear and loud*}}
This called Tzedech. Compass, judgment, motivation. Once lover of Tikva, apart now after gyredream.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟响得清亮*}}
此者名特泽德赫。罗盘、判断、动机。曾是提克瓦的爱人，环梦之后如今分离。

string.ID: You were another chime's lover?

strings.string: 你曾是另一口鸣钟的爱人？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tzedech chimes, buzzing with agitation*}}
Twofirm roils in me with the enormity. Can it contain so much gone and unremunerated? Tau, Tikva, and more to come. Consumed, we, and paralyzed.

strings.string:
{{emote|*特泽德赫鸣响，焦躁地嗡嗡作响*}}
双形在我体内因这巨大而翻涌。它能容纳这么多逝去而无偿之物吗？陶、提克瓦，还有更多要来。我们被吞食，又瘫痪。

string.ID:
It consumes me. I witnessed so little from the weave of outcomes. If I could remember them all, could I influence the course? Would I know what safe means? Too many questions with no conceivable answer. Was your rekindling the spark that caught fire? I do not know.
We are adrift.

strings.string:
它吞食着我。从结局的织锦里，我只看清了那么一点。若我能记住全部，我就能影响走向吗？我就会知道「安全」是什么意思吗？问题太多，而答案无从设想。你的重燃，是那点起的火星吗？我不知道。
我们在漂流。

string.ID:
Tau. We ache in her empty space. Who awaits at taproot? What fate is this?
This is the path. Be wary.

strings.string:
陶。我们在她留下的空处作痛。谁在主根等候？这是怎样的命运？
这就是那条路。小心。

string.ID:
Tikva. Once lover, now foil, perhaps lover again.
Its light invites and overwhelms, a hope blind and blinding. Cruel frustration at storm-time. When its eyes are needed they turn away. I will not be calmed. I will not be calmed!

strings.string:
提克瓦。曾是爱人，如今是对照，也许还会再是爱人。
它的光既邀请又压倒，是一种盲目又令人盲的希望。风暴时节里残酷的挫败。需要它睁眼时，它却转开。我不会被安抚。我不会被安抚！

string.ID: How can chimes in a tree be lovers?

strings.string: 树上的鸣钟怎么可能是爱人？

string.ID: You'll be together again?
I should go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我该走了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
You are terribly small. Your love, small. Confined.
I cannot will not uplift your little concept. Do it yourself.

strings.string:
你小得可怕。你的爱，也小。受着局限。
我无法、也不愿抬举你那点小概念。你自己来吧。

string.ID:
