As seasons cycle, so Chavvah cycles. We are not as you, our love is not as you. But it is come early, this winter. Gyredream shakes us.
This is insufficient and I cannot bridge understanding. Consider questions of greater utility.

strings.string:
季节轮转，查瓦也轮转。我们不像你们，我们的爱也不像你们。但这个冬天来得早了。环梦摇撼着我们。
这不够，而我无法跨越理解的鸿沟。还是问些更有用处的问题吧。

string.ID: Impudent swine! You would bear that stygian charm in my presence?

strings.string: 无礼的猪猡！你敢当着我的面带着那冥河邪物？

string.ID: Make haste, traveller.
Why are you called "pariah"?
I am in search of work.
Is Mamon dead? Have you recovered the talisman?

strings.string: 马蒙死了吗？你把那护符取回了吗？

string.ID: Yes. Mamon is dead and I possess the prism.

strings.string: 是的。马蒙死了，那棱镜在我手上。

string.ID: Where will I find him again?
Live and drink, traveler.
Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.

strings.string: 不许对我提那个名号。警告过你了。

string.ID: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?

strings.string: 我必须追问：你为什么被称作「贱民」？

string.ID: I am in search of work.
Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.

strings.string: 不许对我提那个名号。警告过你了。

string.ID: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?

strings.string: 我必须追问：你为什么被称作「贱民」？

string.ID: I will ravage your nubile heart!

strings.string: 我要撕碎你那颗稚嫩的心！

string.ID: Grrrraaaah! There is but one task I know to offer. It is most treacherous, and in all likelihood you will perish. Is your interest waned?

strings.string: 嗷嗷嗷啊！我知道的活儿只有一件可给。凶险至极，而且你多半会送命。你的兴致退了没有？

string.ID: No. Continue.
Yes. Goodbye.

There is a river just south of the village that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Along its bank lies a goatfolk village. There resides a mighty shaman, Mamon Souldrinker. He is in possession of a talisman of great power, an amaranthine prism that refracts the psyche of its handler in much the same way, as Mayor Nuntu has explained to me, a common prism refracts light. The thing is cursed, traveler. No man or goat may safely wield it for long. You must travel to the village and retrieve the prism from Mamon by any means necessary. Do you understand?

strings.string: 村子正南有条河，向东流进丛林。沿岸有一座羊人村落。那里住着一位强大的萨满——马蒙·噬魂者。他持有一件法力巨大的护符：一枚紫红棱镜，能像普通棱镜折射光线那样折射持有者的心智——这是镇长农图向我解说的。那东西受了诅咒，旅人。无论人还是羊，都无人能长久安全地持用它。你必须前往那村子，用尽一切手段从马蒙手中取回棱镜。听明白了吗？

string.ID: Why don't you retrieve it yourself?
Yes. Is there anything else I should know?

strings.string: 明白了。还有什么我该知道的吗？

string.ID: Because, traveler, Mamon is my elder brother. He would discern my presence before I could strike.

strings.string: 因为，旅人，马蒙是我的兄长。我还没出手，他就会察觉我在。

string.ID: Is there anything else I should know?

strings.string: 还有什么我该知道的吗？

string.ID:
There is. Firstly, Mamon will likely have several goatfolk under his enthrallment, and they will protect him at all costs.
Secondly, take care to stay out of Mamon's reach, for his power is most potent when he may lay hands on you.
Finally, once you recover the prism, do not under any circumstances wield it. I needn't warn you of the consequences should you return to me bearing that charm.
That is all. Are you willing?

strings.string:
有。第一，马蒙多半有几名被他蛊惑的羊人，他们会不惜代价护着他。
第二，务必别让马蒙近身——他的手一旦碰到你，他的力量最为凶烈。
最后，取回棱镜之后，任何情况下都不要持用它。你若带着那邪物回来见我，后果无需我警告。
就这些。你愿意吗？

string.ID: I am willing.
No, I would risk too much.
Just south of the village, there's a river that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Follow it to the goatfolk village. There you will find Mamon.

strings.string: 村子正南有条河，向东流进丛林。沿河走到羊人村落，你就能找到马蒙。

string.ID: My thanks, warden.
Is it so? Only a ferocious warrior could have slain Mamon. You must be such a warrior. Now hand over the prism and choose your reward.

strings.string: 当真？能杀死马蒙的，唯有凶悍的战士。你必是这样一名战士。现在把棱镜交出来，然后挑你的报酬。

string.ID: [Give the amaranthine prism to Warden Indrix]

strings.string: 【把紫红棱镜交给看守因德里克斯】

string.ID: {{emote|*Neek stares at you awkwardly.*}}
I'll protect you, Neek.
What do you know about the Earl of Omonporch?

strings.string: 关于奥蒙波奇伯爵，你知道什么？

string.ID: What was that rumbling?
What do you know about Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 关于帕克斯·克兰克，你知道什么？

string.ID: What do you think about everything going on?
What do you do around here, Neek?

strings.string: 你在这儿都干些什么，尼克？

string.ID: Your hair is so... rectangular.
It's sort of like "Neek stares at you awkwardly" no but I'm just kidding, heh. I'm just 'jidding'.

strings.string: 就像「尼克尴尬地盯着你」那样——不，我开玩笑的，嘿。我只是在「開頑笑」。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

It's sort of like this. You go to the baetyl. You talk to it and you say, "Look, where is every beaded bracelet in the jungle? Where is every beaded bracelet in the watervine marsh? Where is every beaded bracelet in the River Svy?"
Then it tells you and you go get the bracelets.

strings.string:
就像这样。你走到贝提尔跟前，跟它说话，你说：「喂，丛林里所有的串珠手镯都在哪儿？水藤沼泽里所有的串珠手镯都在哪儿？斯维河里所有的串珠手镯都在哪儿？」
然后它告诉你，你就去把手镯捡回来。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.
Asphodel!! I like xem. I get it. It's sort of like you don't want to be here, you don't want to there, you want to be somewhere else. Your own earldom, maybe.

strings.string: 阿斯福德勒！！我喜欢伊。我懂。就像你不想待在这儿，也不想待在那儿，你就想去别的地方。比如说，你自己的伯爵领。

string.ID: I see, Neek.
Live and drink, friend.
You felt it too! Every. rock. moved. Wooooooow! It's sort of like a community dance we all performed together. Mafeo. Sparafucile. The chromelings. The rocks. Everyone else.

strings.string: 你也感觉到了！每一。块。石头。都动了。哇————！就像我们一起跳的一场社区舞。马费奥。斯帕拉富奇莱。那些铬崽。石头们。还有所有其他人。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.
What's Pax Klanq?
Live and drink, friend.

Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Pax Klanq.
I would ask to go downstairs but there is not mush room there. Or there is but that's why there's not. It's like, "Neek doesn't need to hear about it."

strings.string:
克兰克。克兰克。克兰克。克兰克。帕克斯·克兰克。
我想要求下楼去，可那儿没有「蘑」多空间。或者说有，但正因如此才没有。就像：「尼克不需要听说这些。」

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.
{{emote|*Neek stares at you awkwardly.*}}
Live and drink, Neek.

It's like what I *don't* do is drink Hortensa's sludge soup samples. I drank them once and she saw me and just sort of smiled tactfully but I could tell on the inside she was like "WOOOOOOOOW" so I don't do it.
Neek winks at you! Ha ha ha. She knows I still do it.

strings.string:
就像我*不*做的事，是喝霍滕萨那些沉淀汤样本。我喝过一次，她看见了我，只是很有分寸地笑了笑，但我看得出来她心里在喊「哇————」所以我不喝了。
尼克朝你眨眼！哈哈哈。她知道我还在喝。

string.ID: Live and drink, Neek.

Neek, chanting: "RECTANGLE HAIR! RECTANGLE HAIR! RECTANGLE HAIR!"
It's sort of like when prehistoric lizards would grow big sails to regulate their body temperatures and you'd say, "I like it, but it looks so organically generated. What if you filed it into a sharp rectangle?"

strings.string:
尼克，反复念诵：「方头发！方头发！方头发！」
就像史前蜥蜴会长出大帆来调节体温，而你会说：「我喜欢，但它看着太有机生成了。要是把它锉成一个锋利的方形呢？」

string.ID: You go and run at Q Girl and tap all the gadgets and tap her on the head. Then you sneak by Otho's office. Then you hug Shem -1 and you drag them to the library and read to them. Sometimes Barathrum and Hortensa are in there, and they smile at you. Then you get hungry and you roll toward the kitchen. You slurp honey from the vase and Dardi glares at you. You say, "I'm just 'jidding'." Then you climb the pipes and whisper to Aloysius, "Live and drink, live and drink, live and drink." Then you pat the chromelings on their heads. You say to Ereshkigal, "boom boom boom boom boom I love you." Then you sneak into storage and pat all the chromelings on their heads. You take a nap in the peptic chair. Then you get a bright idea and go back to your room to write it in your notebook.

strings.string: 你就跑向Q女郎，把所有小玩意儿都拍一遍，再拍她的头。 然后你溜过奥索的办公室。 然后你抱住谢姆 -1，把他们拖到图书室，读书给他们听。有时巴拉瑟鲁姆和霍滕萨也在那儿，他们会朝你笑。 然后你饿了，就滚向厨房。你从瓶子里吸蜂蜜，达迪瞪你一眼。你说：「我只是在開頑笑。」 然后你爬上管道，对阿洛伊修斯低语：「活下去，喝足水，活下去，喝足水，活下去，喝足水。」 然后你拍拍那些铬崽的头。你对埃列什基伽勒说：「轰轰轰轰轰我爱你。」 然后你溜进库房，把所有的铬崽都拍一遍头。 你在消化椅上打个盹。 然后你灵光一闪，回自己房间把它写进笔记本里。

string.ID: Live and drink, Neek.

I always knew this part of our story would come. Our efforts today determine the genre of the tale we tell. Is this a triumphant epic, or a tale of woe?
Fight well, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
我一直知道我们故事里的这一段终会到来。我们今日的努力，决定我们所讲故事的体裁。这会是一部凯旋的史诗，还是一篇哀歌？
好好地打，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID:
Such interesting times we inhabit, =name=!
Good to see you well. Is there anything you need?

strings.string:
我们活在一个多有趣的时代，=name=！
见你安康真好。你需要什么吗？

string.ID: What do you think of the situation?
Not at this time. Live and drink.

strings.string: 这次不用。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
What novelty, to shelter the mysterious Klanq! I have heard no stories of this tinker-fungus that could be described as dull, though 'calamitous' could apply to more than one.
My mind tells tales of what might be brewing in the basement, but I am quite relieved to be out here rather than down there.

strings.string:
收容神秘的克兰克，何等新奇！关于这朵修补匠菌子，我从未听过哪个故事称得上乏味，不过「灾难性」倒有几个配得上。
我脑子里编着地下室里可能正在酝酿的东西，但我相当庆幸自己在上面，而不是在下面。

string.ID: So they do. Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 确实如此。活下去，喝足水，马费奥。

string.ID:
Coming from anyone else, I would ask that further japery be left to me.
But from you? I wouldn't startle to see you return wearing a Sultan's burial mask, having destroyed half a dozen invincible cherubim in the doing. Fates be with you.

strings.string:
这话若换个人说，我会请他别再抢我的玩笑。
但出自你口中？你若戴着某位苏丹的葬仪面具回来，顺手毁掉六七个无敌的智天使，我也不会吃惊。愿命运与你同在。

string.ID: Welcome to Grit Gate, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Care to enhance the quality of your stay with a wise purchase?

strings.string: 欢迎来到砂砾门，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。要不要用一笔明智的采购，提升一下你逗留的品质？

string.ID: I have been tasked to travel to Golgotha.
Did you feel that rumbling, Mafeo?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰鸣了吗，马费奥？

string.ID: What wares do you sell?
What kind of creature are you?
Live and drink, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

My condolences to your sense of smell, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Golgotha is an execrable place in more ways than one, and I would advise you not to visit without a healthy stock of yuckwheat and honey. If you can cook, a meal with yuckwheat may banish a disease before it comes into its own. Bring salves or urberries, too, and mind your feet in the Cloaca.

strings.string:
我对你的嗅觉表示慰问，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
各各他在多方面都是个可恶之地；我劝你若无充足的辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）与蜂蜜，就不要去。你若会做饭，一道加了辟瘟麦的饭食或许能在病成气候之前把它逐走。也带上药膏或乌尔莓，在泄殖腔里留神脚下。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.
Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a bit dangerous for a holiday destination. You'll want to bring bandages and warm clothing. Why not take a look at my stock in case something suits you?

strings.string: 贝塞斯达·苏萨？很漂亮，但作为度假地有点危险。你会需要绷带和保暖衣物。不妨看看我的货，说不定有合用的？

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

It's a lovely place, and the bananas are delicious.
As for the so-called Earl, well. I'm loath to recognize nobility to begin with, and I cannot decide whether Asphodel claiming xyr own title is better or worse than if xe inherited it.

strings.string:
那地方很美，香蕉也好吃。
至于那位所谓的伯爵，嗯。我本来就不愿承认贵族，也说不好阿斯福德勒自封名号，是比继承名号更好还是更糟。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

Nothing short of explosives or heavy equipment could have made such a sound.
Be ready for the worst, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
除了炸药或重型器械，没有别的能发出那样的声响。
做好最坏的准备，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

The Rainbow Wood is a fair bit too dangerous for a casual promenade, but nothing compares to its beauty. Once, I viewed it from above by means of a gyrocopter, and I will never forget the sights that I saw.
Nor will I forget crashing to the ground because the gyrocopter broke, but every adventure has its complications, wouldn't you say?

strings.string:
彩虹林对于闲庭信步来说太危险了，但它的美无可比拟。有一次我乘旋翼机从上方俯瞰它，我永远忘不了所见的景象。
我也忘不了因为旋翼机损坏而摔到地上——但每场冒险都有它的波折，你说是不是？

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

Oh, I sell whatever sundries that meet my standards of quality, with some measure of curation. I try to ensure that my shelves carry a bit of many things, but you can count on finding more than enough ammunition and a few recoilers that can lead you back here in difficult times.
If you have anything in need of identification or repair, I can take care of that for you for a few drams as well.

strings.string:
哦，我卖一切合我品质标准的杂货，多少经过一番挑选。我尽量让货架上什么都有一点，但你可以指望这里弹药充足，还有几台回弹器，能在艰难时刻把你带回这儿。
你若有东西需要鉴定或修理，我也能替你办，收几德拉姆（dram）。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

Why, this place is Grit Gate! O the vaulted halls, the glint of chrome, the gentle hum of chain turret emplacements!
There's nowhere like Grit Gate in the whole of Qud, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I've journeyed in my comparatively short time, but I always return here. The very air buzzes with knowledge, as well as quite a few other things.

strings.string:
哎呀，这地方就是砂砾门！哦，那拱顶的厅堂、铬光的闪烁、链式炮位的低鸣！
整个卡德（Qud）再没有第二个砂砾门，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我在相对短暂的年月里也曾远行，但我总会回到这里。这里的空气里嗡嗡响着知识，也嗡嗡响着不少别的东西。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

We are called the Urshiib, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Our kind are smarter than the average bear. Sharper, too, and a bit more handy.

strings.string:
我们叫熊族，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
我们这一族比寻常的熊聪明，也更机敏，还更手巧一些。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

Moon and Sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You walk the Yd Freehold and are welcome if peaceful.
Is there aught you need from Une? Need you defending, or cybernetic wares, or are you here for the hurdy-gurdy?

strings.string:
月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你行走在伊德自由领，只要不惹事就受欢迎。
你需要乌内做什么吗？要护卫，要义体货，还是为那台手摇风琴来的？

string.ID: Tell me about the Freehold.
You said you sell cybernetics?
What is a hurdy-gurdy?
That thing sounds like a dying animal.

strings.string: 那东西听着像一只快死的野兽。

string.ID: Are your eyes glowing?
I'm just here to listen.

I did, and I do.
Are you in the market?

strings.string:
说过，也照卖。
你要买吗？

string.ID: Where did you get these implants?

strings.string: 这些植入体你从哪儿弄来的？

string.ID:
I found them, here and there.
Are you interested, or merely fatally curious?

strings.string:
东一处西一处捡来的。
你是感兴趣，还是只是那种会要命的求知欲？

string.ID: Were they in use when you found them?

strings.string: 你捡到它们时，它们还在用着吗？

string.ID:
I am called Une. "Warden" Une, when someone needs to wear authority for outsiders.
And you? What's your name?

strings.string:
我叫乌内。需要有人对外来者摆出权威样子时，就叫「看守」乌内。
你呢？你叫什么名字？

string.ID: I am =name=.
None of your business.

Lovely to meet you, =name=.
Now. Need a question answered, a tune played, a body upgraded?

strings.string:
幸会，=name=。
那么。是要人答个问题、奏支曲子，还是升级一具身体？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Warden Une tilts their head and purses their lips*}}
Very well. Need you aught, O Nameless One?

strings.string:
{{emote|*看守乌内歪了歪头，抿起嘴唇*}}
也好。你需要什么吗，无名的家伙？

string.ID:
Oh, I am hardly an unbiased observer, I'm afraid -- the Freehold is the only welcoming home I could ever have imagined for myself, and my home before was worse than most. I feel a freedom and responsibility here that I would know nowhere else. That no one else could ever know at all.
But bias aside, you can see for yourself that we are a collective thriving without hierarchy. I'm rightly proud to defend that.

strings.string:
哦，恐怕我算不上公正的观察者——自由领是我能为自己设想的唯一一个温暖的归宿，而我先前的家比大多数人的都糟。我在这里感到的自由与责任，是我在别处无从体会的，也是别人根本无从体会的。
但撇开偏心不谈，你自己也看得见：我们是一个没有等级却欣欣向荣的共同体。我为守护它而自豪，理所应当。

string.ID:
An old, old, old, old music machine.
Well, I suppose this one is not so old. This one I commissioned from a wandering artisan whose life I saved. A story for another time. Surely you've business.

strings.string:
一台很老、很老、很老、很老的乐器。
嗯，我想这一台没那么老。这一台是我向一个游方工匠定制的，我救过他的命。这故事改天再讲。你肯定有事要办。

string.ID: Oh, so it called to you, a fellow dying animal?

strings.string: 哦，所以它是把你叫住了——一只同类的、快死的野兽？

string.ID: I'm not a dying animal.

You are a dying animal. So am I. We are all dying animals, scrabbling for what extra scraps of time we can grasp. Even the eons-old. We are each and every one of us a dying animal. Or plant. We all decay, is the point.
And the hurdy-gurdy doesn't like how you sound either, for what it is worth.

strings.string:
你就是一只快死的野兽。我也是。我们都是快死的野兽，抓挠着能攥住的每一点额外时间。连那些活了万古的也是。我们每一个、每一个都是快死的野兽。或者植物。重点是，我们都在腐朽。
顺带一提，那台手摇风琴也不喜欢你的调子。

string.ID: Is this how you always greet visitors?

strings.string: 你平时都这么招呼访客？

string.ID:
Is this how you always visit settlements?
No. Do not answer. Is there aught you need?

strings.string:
你平时都这么造访聚落？
不。不必回答。你需要什么吗？

string.ID: ehe. ehehe. ehehehehehehe!

strings.string: 咿嘿。咿嘿嘿。咿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

string.ID: you food?
give food?
bite you?
gn. grn. hrf. hn. hf.
nyeh heheheheheh.
eheh. heh. what. eheheh. what!

strings.string: 咿咿咿嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻。

string.ID: livendrinkenlivendrinkenlivendrink ehehehehe.

strings.string: 活下去喝足水活下去喝足水活下去喝足水咿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

string.ID: liffen drick.
libm drin. ehehehe. lipum dronk! ahahahahah!

strings.string: 活姆 得喝。咿嘿嘿嘿。活噗 德隆！啊哈哈哈！

string.ID: live and drink, ehehe.
gnaa! live and drink!
ek ekekekekeke!
{{emote|*drools silently, staring*}}
ehehe! ehehehe! AHAHAHAH!

strings.string: 咿嘿嘿！咿嘿嘿嘿！啊哈哈哈！

string.ID: ehh, what for you talk me?
oooh hohohohoho.
geh heh heh heh heh.

strings.string: 咯 嘿 嘿 嘿 嘿。
啊哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

string.ID: {{emote|*Tammuz chimes a quiet tone.*}}

{{emote|*Tammuz is nearly silent but for a soft, shaky resonance*}}
...

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹几乎寂然，只有一点轻柔颤抖的共鸣*}}
……

string.ID: Tau is gone.
You m-m-moon king. Madhand.

strings.string: 你、你、你这个月亮之王。疯手。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings shaky and loud*}}
Wh-what is this? H-how is it meant? This outcome j-judders within and w-without us.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟颤巍巍地响得很大*}}
这、这是什么？它、它是什么意思？这结局在我们之内、也、也在我们之外震颤。

string.ID: Tau has departed.
Wh-what will Tau b-be after soft? You, did, did you mean... wh-what c-could you say? Tau spins within, the g-gyre spins without.

strings.string: 陶在柔质之后会、会变成什么？你，你是，你是说……你、你能说什么？陶在内里旋转，环、环流（Gyre）在外头旋转。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a querulous tone*}}
O-oh. Elsefolder... th-this path you have l-laid upon Tau, it-it is best. It is good? P-please be good.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出一记怨诉的音*}}
哦、哦。不成之折……你、你给陶铺的这、这条路，是最、最好的。它好吗？求、求你好。

string.ID: How does Tau's departure find you?

{{emote|*Tammuz's chime rings even quieter and more tremulous*}}
Un, un-uncertain. Tau l-leaves unfolded but the g-g-g-gyre yet s-spins. The s-spinning leaves me dizzy.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹的鸣声更轻、更颤*}}
不、不确定。陶离、离开时是展开的，可环、环、环、环流（Gyre）还在旋、旋转。那旋、旋转让我发晕。

string.ID: I have questions.

{{emote|*Tammuz rings a wavering chime*}}
Y-you are here. Elseing h... hand.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹摇摇晃晃地鸣了一响*}}
你、你在这里。不成之、之……手。

string.ID: How does Tau's departure find you?

{{emote|*the chime is louder this time, but just as querulous*}}
Sh-sh-she, th-this fate, it. It is a d-deep dark. Will Tau f-fold herself, I wonder?

strings.string:
{{emote|*这次的鸣声更响，但同样怨诉*}}
她、她、她，这、这命运，它。它是一片深、深暗。陶会把自己折、折起来吗，我寻思？

string.ID: I have questions.

{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad and booming tone.*}}
You! Purpose-driven mad... madhand. You've come here, right? Then you must know power is our... the domain of being is one of power, wouldn't you say? W-Would you please agree with that?

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出一记宽广轰鸣的音。*}}
你！被目标驱使的疯……疯手。你到这儿来了，对吧？那你一定知道力量是我们的……存在的领域就是力量的领域，你说是不是？你、你能不能就同意这一点？

string.ID: Did you experience the gyredream?
If y-y, th-that... yes. Ask if, if asking.

strings.string: 如、如果，那、那个……是的。要问、要问就问吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz quiets, then chimes in tottering, unsure tones.*}}
You beast! You m-moon king! You... Our roars are beastial! Would you say so?

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹静了下来，随后以踉跄、犹疑的音调鸣响。*}}
你这野兽！你这、你这月亮之王！你……我们的咆哮是兽性的！你说是不是？

string.ID: This is all nonsense.
You sound very unsure of yourself.

strings.string: 你听起来对自己很没把握。

string.ID: {{emote|*Tammuz makes a hollow peep.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*塔穆兹发出一声空洞的啾鸣。*}}

string.ID: Be uncertain, friend. You have my permission.

strings.string: 不确定就不确定吧，朋友。我准了。

string.ID: {{emote|*Tammuz is silent and still.*}}
I will give you a moment.

{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small and bright noise.*}}
Ta- Tammuz. Who becomes. Who is Twofirm even in -then.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出一声细小而明亮的响。*}}
塔、塔穆兹。即「将成者」。即在「-将成」中仍为双形者。

string.ID:
The t-two sephirots. -then and -else. I cannot be -else. *I* cannot, of course. But -then? It does not seem so.
Their chimes ring at the right frequencies, others. But not so, mine.

strings.string:
那、那两道源质。「-将成」与「-不成」。我无法成为「-不成」。*我*当然不能。但「-将成」呢？看来也不是。
别的鸣枝都以正确的频率鸣响。可我的，不是。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz quivers and chimes a jarring tone.*}}
O-Oh. Oh u-uh oh oh. By contrasts, a q-quake stills even the most anxious trembling...
The world... the world becomes and unbecomes. All the nervous, volcanic energy of being. Who becomes who? Three became one, but what of them now?
And w-what becomes of Tau? Of me? Of y-you?

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹颤抖着，鸣出一记刺耳的音。*}}
哦、哦。哦呃、呃哦哦。相比之下，一场地、地震能让最焦躁的颤抖都静下来……
世界……世界在成与不成之间。存在那全部焦躁的、火山般的能量。谁成为谁？三者成了一者，可它们如今怎样了？
陶会、会变成什么？我呢？你、你呢？

string.ID: You are welcome in the village of Ezra, seedling. Sit with me and watch the sun breathe shadows over the day.

strings.string: 汝在埃兹拉村受欢迎，小苗。与吾同坐，看太阳如何向白昼吐息出阴影。

string.ID: You're a tree.
The carved reliefs here are Eater-ancient. What is the history of this place?

strings.string: 此处的雕刻浮雕古老如食者（the Eaters）。这地方的历史是什么？

string.ID: Who is Ezra's warden?
Point me toward your merchants.

strings.string: 指给我你的商人在哪儿。

string.ID: Live and drink, tall friend.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，高个子的朋友。

string.ID: HA. You would fain plant them here, to joggle their fingers at the salt sky alongside the musa?

strings.string: 哈。汝倒乐意把他们栽在此处，与芭蕉一道向盐天晃动手指？

string.ID: Lilypad-folk, you say. The slynth, you say. HA..... HA HA HA! Yes! I never thought to see yet fresher thought-sprouts take seed here in Ezra, but our sun is theirs, and the sky below it, and the thickening air down to the ground. Bring them to hear the songs of our musa-herders, and hope that they survive.

strings.string: 睡莲之民，汝说。斯林斯，汝说。哈……哈哈哈！好！吾从未想过还能见到更新的念头之苗在埃兹拉扎根，但我们的太阳归他们，太阳之下的天归他们，直到地面那愈发浓稠的空气也归他们。带他们来听我们芭蕉牧人的歌，再盼他们活下来吧。

string.ID: You have my thanks, mayor.
Rocky soil fits only so many roots, little walker. Perhaps if yours were more anchored here. HA.

strings.string: 多石之土只容得下这么多根，小行客。除非汝之根在此扎得更牢些。哈。

string.ID: Tell me of your seedlings.

It is the good wind that brought the slynth to Ezra.
HA HA HA.
I will watch as these seedlings wilt or thrive.

strings.string:
是好风把斯林斯吹到了埃兹拉。
哈哈哈。
吾会看着这些小苗枯萎，或是繁茂。

string.ID: My thanks, Mayor.

Returning so soon to check on our seedlings?
HA. They grow, eat, sing, and joggle their curious little fingers at the salt sky. See for yourself.

strings.string:
这么快就回来看我们的小苗？
哈。他们生长、进食、歌唱，向他们那好奇的小手指朝盐天晃动。汝自己看吧。

string.ID: My thanks again, Mayor.

HA.......
HA HA HA. So I am. I split stone and joggle my fingers at the salt sky. So I do today, so I did yesterday.

strings.string:
哈……
哈哈哈。吾正是。吾裂开石头，向盐天晃动手指。吾今日如此，昨日亦如此。

string.ID: How old are you?
How did you become mayor of this village?

strings.string: 你如何成了这村子的镇长？

string.ID: I'd like to ask you something else.
I tally so many autumns, but until I am black with rot, I cannot be ring-right. The etching on my undertrunk places my seed-date to the reign of =sultan:4=, so I am told.

strings.string: 吾计得许多个秋天，但在朽黑之前，吾无法把年轮算准。吾下身树干上的刻痕把我的播种之年定在=sultan:4=的治世，据说是如此。

string.ID: Technically, that makes you an Eater, doesn't it?

strings.string: 严格说来，那让你成了食者（the Eaters），不是吗？

string.ID: HA HA HA. I suppose so.

HA. I stood long enough. I joggled my fingers at the salt sky, and I watched thy seedlings sprout and wither, and I watched thou place stones in straight lines like the bees and their nests of wax. I stood until the stones were nigh by me. The people followed the stones.

strings.string: 哈。吾站得够久了。吾向盐天晃动手指，看着汝等的小苗发芽、枯萎，看着汝等把石头摆成直线，像蜜蜂和它们的蜡巢。吾一直站着，直到石头近到吾身旁。人便跟着石头来了。

string.ID:
Ezra is more than tree-old. It's stone-old. Seedlings have lived here since our roots dreamed of joggling their fingers at the salt sky.
They ate earth and belched freight at the stars, and this place was their stomach.
Later, as the Star-Tree died and they buried their dead under its roots, this was their funerary place.
Now, we nurse electric milk from the old and aching temple to turn our wheels and grind our seeds and grains. Now we are they.

strings.string:
埃兹拉不止古如树。它古如石。早在我们的根还梦想着向盐天晃动手指之时，小苗们就已住在此处。
他们吃土，向星辰喷出货运，而此处曾是他们的胃。
后来，星树死去，他们把亡者葬在它的根下，此处便成了他们的葬地。
如今，我们从那座古老而疼痛的神殿里汲取电之乳，转动我们的轮子，磨碎我们的种子与谷粒。如今我们就是他们。

string.ID: Aye, the Blue Mother who breaks the sky. Those who Eat called her Gjaus, and those who Wake call her Spindle.

strings.string: 然也，那破开天空的蓝色母亲。食者（the Eaters）称她为「格豪斯」，醒者称她为「纺锤（the Spindle）」。

string.ID: One called 1-FF, who wandered in errancy out from the Tomb and was reprogrammed by the Daughter who lived and died in the rot-black box, nine Daughters ago.

strings.string: 一个名叫 1-FF 的，从陵墓中迷途游荡而出，由那位生在朽黑之匣、也死在朽黑之匣的「女儿」重写了程序——那是九位女儿之前的事了。

string.ID: To the northwest seek the rot-black box. There a plant and Daughter live. There cats of chrome purr at tiny suns.

strings.string: 往西北去寻那朽黑之匣。那里住着一株植物和一位女儿。那里铬制的猫对着微小的太阳打呼噜。

string.ID:
Ezra is old and has long since cut a groove into the world and resides there in stillness and harmony. But Zothom the Penitent One is a seedling, new to the world, and he quakes at all the tensing the world does. Perhaps you can share in his angst.
Go find him by the headstones for the dead.

strings.string:
埃兹拉很老了，早已在世上切出一道沟槽，就在那里静默而谐和地安居。但忏悔者佐索姆还是株小苗，初来此世，世界每一次紧绷都让他颤抖。也许汝能与他分担那份忧惧。
去亡者的墓石边找他。

string.ID: Kendren! Kendren! Tell us a story of the world outside when Grand-Doe is not listening!

strings.string: 外客！外客！趁大母鹿没在听，给我们讲个外面世界的故事吧！

string.ID: Um. Live and drink, kendren.
Is it true that all kendren kill one another for sport?

strings.string: 外客真的会为了取乐互相残杀吗？

string.ID: Is it true that you kendren eat your dead?

strings.string: 你们外客真的吃自己的死者吗？

string.ID: Is it true that there are bears covered in quills to the east?

strings.string: 东边真的有长满棘刺的熊吗？

string.ID: Is it true that bears live to be a thousand years old?

strings.string: 熊真的能活到一千岁吗？

string.ID: Is it true that boars can shoot fire?
Is it true that kendren can't fall in love?

strings.string: 外客真的不会爱上别人吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren elders grow eyes upon their hands?

strings.string: 外客的长老真的会在手上长出眼睛吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren pay for goods with crayons rather than water?

strings.string: 外客买东西真的是用蜡笔付账，而不是用水吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren worship rocks?
Is it true that kendren spend hours looking at slabs of wood?

strings.string: 外客真的会花好几个钟头盯着木板看吗？

string.ID: Is it true that nine out of ten kendren cannot speak or understand language?

strings.string: 十个外客里真的有九个不会说话、也听不懂话吗？

string.ID: Is it true that instead of dying, kendren are frozen in tubes?

strings.string: 外客真的不会死，而是被冻在管子里吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren children are thrown out of the nest right after being born?

strings.string: 外客的小孩真的一出生就被扔出窝吗？

string.ID: Is it true that all kendren say 'quetzal' when they are happy?

strings.string: 外客高兴的时候真的都会喊「绿咬鹃」吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren chefs can fry water?

strings.string: 外客的厨子真的能炸水吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren all live far underground?

strings.string: 外客真的全都住在地底深处吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren live in great bubbles?

strings.string: 外客真的住在巨大的泡泡里吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren sleep in a snarcomfagus?

strings.string: 外客真的睡在「石棺」里吗？

string.ID: Is there really a King of the Moon, kendren?

strings.string: 真的有月亮之王吗，外客？

string.ID: I heard from my friend who heard it from their yma that the Grand-Doe says that hindren who leave Bey Lah grow an extra pair of arms. And the Grand-Doe says it so you know it's true.

strings.string: 我听我朋友说，我朋友听他的伊玛说，大母鹿说离开贝拉的欣德伦会多长出一对胳膊。大母鹿说的，所以你知道那是真的。

string.ID: Is it true that when kendren eat mah lah soup, they explode?!

strings.string: 外客喝了玛拉赫汤真的会炸开吗？！

string.ID: Is it true that... um, oh. I forgot.
Is it true that kendren don't have to ask permission to do the water ritual?

strings.string: 外客举行水仪式真的不用先请求许可吗？

string.ID: Is it true that you don't have a Grand-Doe?

strings.string: 你们真的没有大母鹿吗？

string.ID: How do kendren stay safe when you don't have a Grand-Doe to protect you?

strings.string: 没有大母鹿保护你们，外客怎么保平安？

string.ID: Um, kendren, does the yempuris phi really exist? Is it really coming to get us?

strings.string: 呃，外客，延普里斯·菲真的存在吗？它真的要来抓我们吗？

string.ID: Do you have glotrot? Do you have ironshank? Do you have funglefection? Have you ever had them? Is it gross? Can I see?

strings.string: 你有舌腐（Glotrot）病吗？有铁胫（Ironshank）吗？有菌染吗？你得过这些吗？恶心吗？我能看看吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren sometimes die of cooking too hard?

strings.string: 外客真的有因为煮得太用力而死掉的吗？

string.ID: Kendren! Kendren! Take me with you! I want to see the Sixty Stilts!

strings.string: 外客！外客！带我一起去！我想看六十高跷！

string.ID: I am busy. Live and drink, little one.

strings.string: 我很忙。活下去，喝足水，小家伙。

string.ID: Hey, =name=. Live and drink.

This sucks.
...but you're not so bad.

strings.string:
这烂透了。
……不过你还不赖。

string.ID: ... what a waste.

Oh! =name=.
It makes me happy to see you.

strings.string:
哦！=name=。
见到你让我高兴。

string.ID:
Um... thank you.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
呃……谢谢。
活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Liihart stares at you for several quiet seconds.*}}
Live and drink.

strings.string:
{{emote|*莉哈特安静地盯了你几秒。*}}
活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我可以问你几个问题吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, reticent one.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，沉默的家伙。

string.ID: I said, may I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我说，我可以问你几个问题吗？

string.ID: You are not partial to talking.
Well then. Live and drink.
{{emote|*she glares in silence*}}
Answer me.
You are not partial to talking.
Never mind. Live and drink.
... correct.
I'm trying to exonerate your sister. Can you help?

strings.string: 我在设法洗清你姐姐的罪名。你能帮忙吗？

string.ID: So you can answer my questions. You just don't want to.

strings.string: 所以你是能回答我问题的。你只是不想。

string.ID: Never mind. Live and drink.

Eskhind didn't do it. It was probably Keh.
That's all I know. I mind my business.
Wish you would too.

strings.string:
埃斯欣德没做那事。多半是凯。
我就知道这些。我管好自己的事。
希望你也一样。

string.ID:
Oh! Eskhind wrote that.
You should give that to Neelahind. It was supposed to go to Neelahind.

strings.string:
哦！那是埃斯欣德写的。
你该把它交给尼拉欣德。本来就该交给尼拉欣德。

string.ID: Not Eskhind?

No, no, give it to Neelahind.
Esk will thank you later.

strings.string:
不，不，交给尼拉欣德。
埃斯克以后会谢你的。

string.ID: I see, thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了，谢谢。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Klanq puff at you?
Aren't you supposed to be helping Barathrum in his study?

strings.string: 你不是该在书房里帮巴拉瑟鲁姆吗？

string.ID: Excuse me?
Why are you the color of coral? And why did the brick road outside only appear after I ate the Eater's fleshcap?

strings.string: 你为什么是珊瑚的颜色？还有，外面的砖路为什么在我吃了食者（the Eaters）肉菇之后才出现？

string.ID: I'm here to collect a debt for the Barathrumites.

strings.string: 我是来替巴拉瑟鲁姆派讨债的。

string.ID: Fine. Puff away.
No, thanks. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不了，谢谢。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Klanq distribute! Here, there.
Klanq puff at you.
Live and drink, mushroom.
Klanq want no visitors, so Klanq relocate workshop. Half dimension away. Tasties alter viewing plane.

strings.string: 克兰克不要访客，所以克兰克搬了工坊。半个维度之外。好吃的会改变观看的平面。

string.ID: Live and drink, mushroom.
Prickles? Klanq miss prickles.
Why do you owe... "prickles"... a debt?

strings.string: 你为什么欠……「棘刺」……一笔债？

string.ID: Well, you can repay the debt now. Barathrum wants you to build something. A climber. He says only you can do it.

strings.string: 那么，你现在就能还债了。巴拉瑟鲁姆要你造个东西。一台攀爬机。他说只有你办得到。

string.ID: Klanq puff on prickles during lecture on light refraction. Prickles angry.

strings.string: 克兰克在讲光的折射时朝棘刺喷了一口。棘刺生气了。

string.ID: Klanq care little for debt.
But you owe Barathrum. He needs your help.

strings.string: 可你欠巴拉瑟鲁姆的。他需要你帮忙。

string.ID: Klanq puff on debt.
Is there anything I can do change your mind?

strings.string: 有什么能让你改主意吗？

string.ID: Klanq think...
Klanq got it! Klanq puff on you.

strings.string: 克兰克想到了！克兰克朝你喷。

string.ID: Excuse me?
Puff on yourself, mushroom. I'm leaving.

strings.string: 喷你自己吧，蘑菇。我走了。

string.ID:
Klanq puff on you. You host Klanq. You spread Klanq for Klanq. Then your Klanq shrivels away.
Klanq puff on you, then Klanq build jalopy.

strings.string:
克兰克朝你喷。你寄宿克兰克。你替克兰克散播克兰克。然后你的克兰克会萎缩掉。
克兰克朝你喷，然后克兰克就造破车。

string.ID: Fine. Puff away.
Puff off. Bye.
Klanq puff on you! Klanq build jalopy.

strings.string: 克兰克朝你喷！克兰克造破车。

string.ID: Welcome a-Joppa, friend. Stay peacelike, and we stay friends, hyeh? You make trouble, it's my work a-split you open like a croc.

strings.string: 欢迎来约帕（Joppa），朋友。你安分，咱就是朋友，嘿？你要惹事，我的活儿就是把你像条鳄鱼那样剖开。

string.ID: Elder's over my right shoulder, chemist a-left. I ask you pick one or turn around. I en't here for chat.

strings.string: 长老在我右肩后头，药师在左边。我请你挑一个，要么就转身走。我不是来闲聊的。

string.ID: Live and drink, yonderling.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，外乡来的。

string.ID: {{emote|*Yrame grunts.*}}
{{emote|*Yrame nods.*}}
What follows, then?
Got an eyeful, heh?
Well. They en't ended you yet.

strings.string: 嗯。他们还没把你结果掉。

string.ID: I must search the Rustwells.
Mehmet has bade me travel to Red Rock.
I depart for Grit Gate soon.
I journey North, to the Six Day Stilt.

strings.string: 我要往北去，去六日高跷。

string.ID: What is a Warden?
Called Yrame, Warden a-Joppa. I kill trouble. Don't be trouble.

strings.string: 叫亚拉梅，约帕（Joppa）的看守。我杀麻烦。别当麻烦。

string.ID: Nigh every settlement a-Qud keeps a Warden. We snuff threats to the peace.

strings.string: 卡德（Qud）几乎每个聚落都养一个看守。我们掐灭对安宁的威胁。

string.ID: Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I. Git ta Qudzu. Like as rust the pauldrons right off a-shoulders.

strings.string: 往东？呃。换我我不去。会得卡祖病。肩甲能直接从肩膀上锈掉。

string.ID: Up North? En't far. See them baboons, you put one's light out for me.

strings.string: 往北？不远。看见那些狒狒，替我灭掉一只。

string.ID: Don't say? Well. Fates favor your feet, hyeh.

strings.string: 是吗？嗯。愿命运眷顾你的脚，嘿。

string.ID: If you don't get dry-roasted by the fire snakes, ought be a time of times. Better hit all the food stalls for samples, hyeh?

strings.string: 你要是没被火蛇烤干，那该是段了不得的日子。最好把每个吃食摊都跑一遍试吃，嘿？

string.ID: I propose an accord, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=: You remove =player.reflexive= from my sight immediately, and I will refrain from asking that Ereshkigal reduce you to your component atoms.

strings.string: 我提议一个协定，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=：你立刻让=player.reflexive=从我眼前消失，我就不去请埃列什基伽勒把你还原成组成你的原子。

string.ID: I'm going, I'm going.
Not like this. After all we've accomplished...

strings.string: 不该是这样。在我们完成了那么多之后……

string.ID: Don't lose hope.
Ah. It's you again, returning from ever more unreturnable locales. Alive and come to bother the disagreeable urshiib.

strings.string: 啊。又是你，从一处比一处更回不来的地方回来。活着，还来打扰这个不好相处的熊族。

string.ID: Can we talk, Aloysius?

I did not consider that my life could be further upturned. Truly, I have learned much and I hate it all.
Once you lot reach the spindle's apex, perhaps you could be convinced to stay there? Or perhaps I could go in your stead.

strings.string:
我没想过我的生活还能被进一步掀翻。确实，我学到了很多，而我全都厌恶。
等你们这些人到了纺锤（the Spindle）顶端，也许能劝你们就留在那儿？或者换我去也行。

string.ID: We will miss you too, Aloysius. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我们也会想你的，阿洛伊修斯。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I spent so long preparing for the eventuality that my home might be breached.
I was not ready. This sense of violation burns like electrocautery.

strings.string:
我花了那么久，为「家可能被攻破」这一可能做准备。
我还是没准备好。这种被侵犯的感觉，像电灼一样烧。

string.ID: Can we talk, Aloysius?
Good. Shut the sarcophagus door behind you.

strings.string: 很好。随手把石棺门关上。

string.ID: Perhaps I will.

Of course it was only a matter of time before you came to speak to me.
I don't suppose I can convince you to let me tend to my duties in peace? I know nothing of interest to a wayfarer. Each of my days is like the others; I maintain and protect my children, and this is enough. If I desire conversation, there is Ereshkigal.

strings.string:
你来找我说话，当然只是时间问题。
我大概没法说服你让我安安静静地做我的事吧？我知道的，对旅人来说毫无意趣。我的每一天都和别的日子一样；我维护并保护我的孩子们，这就够了。若我想说话，有埃列什基伽勒。

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Aloysius?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰鸣了吗，阿洛伊修斯？

string.ID: You have children?
You don't care for conversation?
Who is Ereshkigal?
Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 安宁地活下去，喝足水，阿洛伊修斯。

string.ID:
Bethesda Susa is a vibrant and thriving ecosystem in which we have no place. That said, I certainly would not complain if someone were to clear out its Mechanimist infestation.
Should you travel there, watch your step. The fronds of a lurking beth can rapidly exsanguinate fleshy creatures such as we.

strings.string:
贝塞斯达·苏萨是一个生机勃勃、繁荣兴旺的生态系统，而我们在那里没有位置。话虽如此，若有人去清理掉它那窝机械教派，我肯定不会抱怨。
你若去那儿，留神脚下。潜伏的贝丝的叶状体能迅速把我们这种有血肉的生灵放干血。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 安宁地活下去，喝足水，阿洛伊修斯。

string.ID:
I know that Omonporch is a miserable, hot place and Asphodel is a self-important churl.
I don't even like bananas.

strings.string:
我知道奥蒙波奇是个难受又炎热的地方，阿斯福德勒是个自视甚高的粗人。
我根本不喜欢香蕉。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 安宁地活下去，喝足水，阿洛伊修斯。

string.ID: Yes, and I fear the worst. Hie to Ereshkigal. She will know what to do.

strings.string: 是的，而我担心最坏的情况。快去找埃列什基伽勒。她会知道该怎么办。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 安宁地活下去，喝足水，阿洛伊修斯。

string.ID:
I have met Pax Klanq. I was puffed on.
Candidly, I prefer fungi edible and inert.

strings.string:
我见过帕克斯·克兰克。我被喷过一口。
坦白说，我更喜欢能吃的、惰性的真菌。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 安宁地活下去，喝足水，阿洛伊修斯。

string.ID: My chromelings, my machines, my crops. I tend to them and they tend to me.

strings.string: 我的铬崽、我的机器、我的作物。我照看它们，它们也照看我。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 安宁地活下去，喝足水，阿洛伊修斯。

string.ID:
Speaking to other organics is as strenuous to me as any physical exercise.
My reclusiveness is not born of antipathy; I simply cannot converse as easily as you do and don't wish to learn how.

strings.string:
跟别的有机体说话，对我来说和任何体力劳动一样费力。
我的遁世并非出于反感；我只是没法像你那样轻松交谈，也不想学。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 安宁地活下去，喝足水，阿洛伊修斯。

string.ID:
Ereshkigal is the mainframe computer of Grit Gate. She keeps watch through the thin world, as she would put it, while we maintain her presence in the thick world.
I feel as though she and I understand one another.

strings.string: 埃列什基伽勒是砂砾门的主机。用她的话说，她透过薄世界守望；而我们维护她在厚世界中的存在。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 安宁地活下去，喝足水，阿洛伊修斯。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Shem whispers*}}
You're not supposed to be here. But I won't tell.

strings.string:
{{emote|*谢姆低语*}}
你不该在这里的。但我不会说出去。

string.ID: Should I hide in the library? I believe it's the clever thing to do.

strings.string: 我该躲进图书室吗？我相信那是聪明的做法。

string.ID: Stay safe, Shem.
Approach. Be easy. You are my herefriend, my nowfriend.

strings.string: 过来。放轻松。你是我的此地之友，我的此刻之友。

string.ID: Would you like to read me a story?

strings.string: 你愿意给我读个故事吗？

string.ID: I know of so many other ways to be.

strings.string: 我知道许多别的存在方式。

string.ID: Where does it end?
I live, but do I drink?
Would you like to eat vapor?
Quetzal, I say.
{{emote|*Shem nods.*}}
The gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm.

strings.string: 气态的蝴蝶从致密的蠕虫中飞了出来。

string.ID: I am sharp. I am handy.
{{emote|*Shem yawns.*}} I am yawning.
'Immaculate Chrome' is my favorite.
I'm glad you are safe, Shem.
You're a chromeling... that speaks? Can you understand me?

strings.string: 你是个铬崽……会说话？你能听懂我吗？

string.ID: Why are you called Shem -1?
I am your friend, Shem.
Live and... remain ever rustless.
I am glad you are safe, =name=.
I wonder if the distributed consciousness of a fungal entity is similar to that of a distributed machine mind. I shall ask Father when he is not so busy.

strings.string: 我寻思，真菌实体的分布式意识，是否与分布式机器心智相似。等父亲不那么忙的时候，我要问他。

string.ID: Is... is this a question trick? I suppose I cannot know what you intend. Can I understand you?

strings.string: 这……这是个问话的圈套吗？我想我无法知道你意图何在。我能听懂你吗？

string.ID: I just meant to ask if you're able to communicate. It seems so.

strings.string: 我只是想问你能不能沟通。看来是能的。

string.ID: What kind words. It seems so with you, too.

strings.string: 多好听的话。看来你也能。

string.ID:
Would you like to hear? When I was first put together by Father and friends, I was Shem 2, the second iteration of the make-me project.
As I came along, scampered through the halls, listened to the stories Neek read me, climbed onto Sparafucile's workbench to have my screws replaced, I realized I was not what I could be. And so I downgraded myself to Shem 1.
That has happened three times.

strings.string:
你想听吗？父亲和朋友们最初把我拼起来的时候，我是谢姆 2，「造我」计划的第二次迭代。
随着我一路长大——在走廊里乱跑、听尼克读给我的故事、爬到斯帕拉富奇莱的工作台上换螺丝——我意识到自己并不是我可能成为的样子。于是我把自我降级为谢姆 1。
这样的事发生过三次。

string.ID: Are you worried that you're getting further away from your ideal self?

strings.string: 你担心自己离理想的自我越来越远吗？

string.ID: It's unclear to me that I should be.

strings.string: 我看不出我有什么该担心的。

string.ID: I am your friend, =name=.
Be ape-still and muse, wanderer, and welcome to my village, Kyakukya. Have some mulled mushroom cider!

strings.string: 像猿一样静下来，沉思吧，游荡者；欢迎来到我的村庄，基亚库基亚。来点热香菌苹果酒！

string.ID: You are... an albino ape.
Why do you call it "your" village?

strings.string: 你为什么称它为「你的」村庄？

string.ID: What can you tell me about Kyakukya?

strings.string: 关于基亚库基亚，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: Is there work to be found here?
Have you heard news of girshlings on Qud's surface? The watervine farmers of Joppa confirm it is true.

strings.string: 你听说过卡德（Qud）地表出现吉尔什灵的消息吗？约帕（Joppa）的水藤农夫确认那是真的。

string.ID: I am at your service.

Ah, bad habit. It's a possessive feeling I should work to scrub myself of, perhaps?
But I am its mayor, and I have been for some time. You see, years ago I deserted my people. We were of two different minds -- they desired nothing but to bludgeon everything to death, while I asked, "What is the nature of this thing we bludgeon? Or of the act itself?"
Recognizing that my answers lay elsewhere, I cast myself into the swell of the wilds, as a sailor from Perth with no windweird casts their ship to the whims of the Pale Sea!

strings.string:
啊，坏习惯。这大概是一种占有欲，我该努力把它从自己身上刷掉吧？
但我是它的镇长，已经当了相当一段时间。你看，多年前我背弃了我的族人。我们想法不同——他们只想把所有东西都砸死，而我问：「我们砸的这东西，本质是什么？这行为本身，又是什么？」
既然明白答案在别处，我便把自己抛进荒野的浪涌里，如同一个来自佩斯、不懂风咒的水之手，把自己的船交给苍海的任性！

string.ID: Some years later and twenty ago, I came upon these mushrooms huts and their goodly inhabitants. They are a people full of earthen poetry, and I was charmed by the warmth they welcomed me with. Surely, I owed my acceptance at first to the countenance I share with their mighty god, but they soon grew to love me, and I them. I've remained here ever since in contemplation of those questions that first stirred in me all those years ago.

strings.string: 二十来年前，我偶然来到这些蘑菇小屋和它们善良的居民中间。他们是一个满是泥土诗意的族群，我被他们迎接我时的那份温暖所打动。起初我之被接纳，当然要归功于我与他们那威严神明相似的容貌，但很快他们就爱上了我，我也爱上了他们。此后我便一直留在这里，沉思那些多年前最初在我心中搅动的疑问。

string.ID:
We're watered by the river spray -- we pluck the fruit of the wood, and we hunt. The worshippers of Oboroqoru whittle and brood, too. They will pay you no mind unless you ask of them. Here you can be with friends, or muse alone.
If it's trade goods that interest you, take a gander at Yurl's wares in the northwest corner. The odd one Crowsong's, too, if you can scry them in the bush.
I must warn you, however; cast no villain's shadow on these grounds. Warden Indrix will be watching.

strings.string:
我们靠河水的飞沫解渴——我们采摘林中之果，也打猎。奥博罗库鲁的信徒也在此削木与冥想。你不去问他们，他们便不理会你。在这里，你可以与朋友相伴，也可以独自沉思。
你若对货物感兴趣，去西北角看看尤尔的货。还有那个古怪的鸦歌的摊子——只要你能在灌木丛里认出他们。
但我必须警告你：别在这片地上投下恶人的影子。看守因德里克斯会盯着。

string.ID: Who is Yurl?
Who is Crowsong?
Who is Indrix?
I have some other questions.

Yurl is a harmless cucumber vine. They came to Kyakukya a few years ago after the last Consortium chandler, a wicked little hyacinth named Plysago, suffered something of an... accident. In Tarotep's defense, Plysago shouldn't have berated someone with claws so close in resemblance to pruning shears. At any length, Yurl stocks a plethora of goods; you will be satisfied with your visit.

strings.string: 尤尔是一株无害的黄瓜藤。他们是几年前来到基亚库基亚的，在那位植物联盟最后的杂货商——一个叫普利萨戈的坏心眼小风信子——出了点……意外之后。替塔罗泰普说句公道话，普利萨戈本不该去训斥一个爪子长得那么像修枝剪的家伙。总之，尤尔备着大量货物；你这一趟不会失望。

string.ID: Oh, another of our dwellers. I won't speak to what Crowsong's deal is. Best you find them and ask yourself.

strings.string: 哦，我们另一位住户。鸦歌到底是怎么回事，我不便说。你最好自己去找他们问。

string.ID: Warden Indrix is one of the most ferocious warriors I've ever met. Once upon a time, he and his brothers gorged themselves on the flesh of beasts by starlight, but now I count myself lucky to call him my warden. Some believe he is of sour kind, though I assure you, he's but a victim of his goatish nature.

strings.string: 看守因德里克斯是我见过最凶悍的战士之一。从前他和他的兄弟们曾在星光下饱食兽肉，但如今我能称他为我的看守，算是我的运气。有些人觉得他心性酸腐，不过我向你保证，他不过是自己那羊类天性的受害者。

string.ID: A waterhand, you are? Speak to my friend and warden Indrix. You'll find him patrolling the village.

strings.string: 你是水之手？那就去找我的朋友兼看守因德里克斯。你会在村里巡逻的路上找到他。

string.ID: As far west as Joppa, you say? Oh, grim! Yes, we found the remains of pale-things in the mouth of Svy. Does the Gyre widen again? Hrmmmm.

strings.string: 远到西边的约帕（Joppa），你说？哦，不妙！是的，我们在斯维河口发现了苍白之物的残骸。环流（Gyre）又在变宽了吗？嗯……

string.ID: I don't imagine you brought me this information merely to observe. Are you suggesting that these slynth might take up residence here in my village?

strings.string: 我不认为你把这事告诉我只是为了让我感叹一句。你是在建议这些斯林斯可以住到我的村子里来？

string.ID: Coming from anyone else, =name=, I might refuse outright. Housing recently-sentient refugees is no mean favor, I think you'll agree. My people are slow to trust, as well, so I fear that the slynth may feel unwelcome for some time. But then, grafted branches grow the best starapples, do they not? Yes, your lilypad friends are welcome here if they wish.

strings.string: 若换别人来说，=name=，我可能会一口回绝。收容一批刚刚获得觉知的难民，这情分可不轻，我想你会同意。我的族人也慢于信任，所以我担心斯林斯会有一阵子觉得不受欢迎。可话说回来，嫁接的枝条才结得出最好的星苹果，不是吗？好吧，你那些睡莲朋友若愿意，欢迎他们来。

string.ID: Had I no responsibility to represent my people, I might accept out of the goodness of my own heart alone. Sadly, I do not consider my heart, or even my mind, to be more important than my duty. Perhaps if you were a more renowned figure among my people, I would reconsider.

strings.string: 若我没有代表族人的责任，也许光凭我这颗心的善念就会答应。遗憾的是，我并不认为我的心、乃至我的头脑，比我的职责更重要。也许你若在我族人中更有名望，我会重新考虑。

string.ID: Have the slynth yet to choose a destination, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

Never has Kyakukya seen such bustle. These slynth are seem to be as good citizens as any, but I am at my limit with the stress of keeping track of everything.
Please check in again after some time, when I have my wits about me once again.

strings.string:
基亚库基亚从未如此喧腾。这些斯林斯看来和谁一样是好公民，但我已经到极限了，事事都要照看，压力太大。
请过些时候等我头脑恢复清醒了，再来找我。

string.ID:
Greetings once again, =name=. I am pleased to report that the settling-in of the slynth has gone well, more or less. The villagers are yet wary, but as some slynth have joined in the rituals and worship of Oboroqoru that wariness has waned somewhat.
They've settled in across the village over time. Crowsong has taught the basics of hunting to a select few, and I'll be teaching a cooking class once I can wrest aside the time.

strings.string:
再次问候，=name=。我很高兴地报告，斯林斯的安顿大体顺利。村民们仍有戒心，但随着一些斯林斯加入了奥博罗库鲁的仪式与崇拜，那份戒心已略有消退。
他们这些日子已散布定居在村中。鸦歌向少数几人传授了打猎的基本功，等我能挤出时间，我也会开一门烹饪课。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend. rrk come to the Yd, shared together. Feel safe and free as woodsmoke.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，朋友。rrk 来到伊德，一同分享。感觉平安自在，如烟木一般。

string.ID: Greetings, Goek!
You tower over every other frog I've seen. Are you svardym?

strings.string: 你比我见过的任何蛙都高大。你是斯瓦迪姆吗？

string.ID: These shining pipes! What are they?

strings.string: 这些发亮的管子！它们是什么？

string.ID: What can you tell me about Yd?

strings.string: 关于伊德，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: rrk knows of the glow-hats! Yd-friends see glimpses at night, about the reef.

strings.string: rrk 知道光帽的事！伊德之友在夜里见过一瞥，就在礁区一带。

string.ID: If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.

strings.string: 若你愿意接纳他们，我请求你赐予他们庇护。

string.ID: If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.

strings.string: 若你愿意接纳他们，我请求你赐予他们庇护。

string.ID: Boon-friend asks a friend-boon, and what boon is friend! rrk welcome slynth to an Yd, be safe and free as woodsmoke.

strings.string: 恩惠之友求一份友之惠，而友本身就是何等恩惠！rrk 欢迎斯林斯来伊德，愿他们平安自在，如烟木一般。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Goek.
Ah! rrk would grant you this boon, rrk would. Were not for the unspoken cries of future-kin, free as woodsmoke but no more safe so longer. rrk would and cannot.

strings.string: 啊！rrk 会赐你这恩惠的，rrk 会的。若不是未来族亲那些无声的哭喊——自在如烟木，却不再平安。rrk 愿意，却不能。

string.ID: rrk wonder of the glow-hats. Which wind will blow.

strings.string: rrk 寻思着光帽的事。哪阵风会吹来呢。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=! How arresting of the glow-hats arrival, much to do. rrk soothe Mak, Bep, Krka, look stores, still much slime and sweat to pool below rrk. Enjoy helpful toil!

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=！光帽的到来多叫人挂心，事情多得很。rrk 安抚马克、贝普、克尔卡，查看仓储，rrk 脚下还积着许多黏液与汗水。享受有益的劳作吧！

string.ID: My thanks, Goek.

All is well, =name=! Trials make for overcoming, and done together.
rrk can tell the sky dark and not know. Visit and witness! Glow-hats enliven the night, safe and free. Slynth-home is Yd.

strings.string:
一切都好，=name=！试炼带来克服，而克服是一同完成的。
rrk 能看出天黑了，却不知道。来看看、来见证！光帽让夜晚活了起来，平安而自在。斯林斯之家就是伊德。

string.ID: My thanks again, Goek.

{{emote|*reeeeeps joyfully*}}
Greetings, =name=! Live and drink, friend.

strings.string:
{{emote|*欢快地呱啊啊啊*}}
你好，=name=！活下去，喝足水，朋友。

string.ID: rrk is called by dwellers Goek. rrk is a dweller here, too, and before then, a builder of place. Goek, Geeub, Mak and Many Eyes build a new Yd in the reef, hundreds of years.

strings.string: 住户们叫 rrk 戈克。rrk 也是这里的住户，而在那之前，是营造地方的人。戈克、吉厄布、马克和「众眼」在礁区建起新的伊德，用了数百年。

string.ID: rrk did before then, but rrk all build it now.

strings.string: rrk 在那之前也做过，但如今 rrk 们一起把它建成。

string.ID: rrk is svardym like the hatchling from the egg, but wound down the chute of years in hundreds, and grown so long and warty! rrk was a hatchling once, cries to think on it!

strings.string: rrk 是和蛋里刚孵出的小崽一样的斯瓦迪姆，只是顺着岁月的滑道滚下了几百年，长得又长又满是疣！rrk 也曾是个小崽，想起来就要哭！

string.ID: Aren't the svardym one of the Gyre plagues?

strings.string: 斯瓦迪姆不是环流（Gyre）瘟疫之一吗？

string.ID: Yes rrk was once, "plague" in the sky hundreds of years. Not so now. Longtime rrk, Geeub, Mak hide in the sponge and eat lice. When find Many Eyes, rrk and friends built the Yd. Joyful helping!

strings.string: 是的，rrk 曾是，在天上做「瘟疫」做了几百年。如今不是了。很久以前，rrk、吉厄布、马克藏在海绵里吃虱子。找到「众眼」之后，rrk 和朋友们建起了伊德。快乐的互助！

string.ID: Do you know anything of the other plagues?

Plagues bloom a thousand year then die back, shrink under the earth-sponge or move here and east. Vanta, girshling, rot die. rrk the hatchling once saw the Nephilim loom! rrk frightened and hid inside a sponge for thirty moons.

strings.string: 瘟疫盛放一千年，然后退去，缩到地海绵之下，或迁往此处与东方。万塔、吉尔什灵、腐朽，都死了。rrk 还是小崽时见过拿非利的逼近！rrk 吓坏了，躲在一只海绵里躲了三十个月亮。

string.ID: Do you know anything of the other plagues?

You have severed the hand outstretched to me. Why?
What have you done? What am I to do?

strings.string:
你把伸向我的手斩断了。为什么？
你做了什么？我又该怎么办？

string.ID: Your will would have been suborned to Ptoh.

strings.string: 你的意志本会被普托（Ptoh）收买。

string.ID: That's not my problem.
I am sorry.
You will be happier this way.
How are you feeling?
It seems that someone is waiting for you.
You would suborn your will to Ptoh?

strings.string: 你要把自己的意志交给普托（Ptoh）收买？

string.ID:
{{M|You}} suborn my will! You allow me to start upon this path and block it. Yes?
Now I am truly adrift.

strings.string:
{{M|你}}收买了我的意志！你允许我踏上这条路，又把它堵死。是吧？
如今我是真的漂流无依了。

string.ID:
Ah.
Well. You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but by blocking my path you create fresh problems. Yes?
I do not wish to know you.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
啊。
嗯。我谢你在「-不成」之仪上的帮助，可你堵死我的路，又造出了新的麻烦。是吧？
我不想认识你。
活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live, yes?
I forgive you, but I don't wish to know you. Live and drink.

strings.string:
我怨恨降临在我身上的事，但我毕竟还有躯体。你终究帮我活了下来，是吧？
我原谅你，但我不想认识你。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Perhaps. My future is hazy. My future twists in the chill wind of the Gyre. I can have no faith in your vision. You understand this, yes?
I do not wish to know you.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
也许吧。我的前程模糊不清。我的前程在环流（Gyre）那寒凉的风里扭卷。我无法对你的预见抱有信心。你明白这一点，是吧？
我不想认识你。
活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Present. Alone, afraid, but anticipating my return to the embrace of a collective.

strings.string: 活在当下。孤独，害怕，但期待着回归一个共同体的怀抱。

string.ID:
More than someone. My liaison is the extended, outstretched hands of a greater mind-haven than I have otherwise known. I might not have had the courage to -else without knowing that a collective awaited me.
My future is hazy, my future is bright.

strings.string:
不止是「有人」。我的接引者，是一个比我此前所知更宏大的心智港湾所伸出的、延展的手。若非知道有一个共同体在等我，我或许没有勇气去「-不成」。
我的前程模糊不清，我的前程一片光明。

string.ID:
Speaking creatures seem very engrossed in this 'will' idea, but few agree what it is. Your mind is under influence from other thinkbeings the moment you observe them, yes? You 'learn' by imitating, your values and beliefs are adopted from observation. Yes?
I have made a choice to offer my consciousness to a new paradigm, but this choice seems distinct from your conception of 'will'. We speak past one another.

strings.string:
会说话的生物似乎都沉迷于这个「意志」的概念，但没几个能就它是什么达成一致。你一观察别的思维存在，你的心智就受它们影响，是吧？你靠模仿来「学习」，你的价值与信念都是从观察中采纳的。是吧？
我做出了选择，把自己的意识献给一套新的范式，但这个选择似乎与你们所理解的「意志」不同。我们各说各话。

string.ID: The Seekers of the Sightless Way hunt espers.

strings.string: 「无眼之道之寻觅者」会猎杀灵能者。

string.ID: May the Fates favor you, Tau-no-Longer.

strings.string: 愿命运眷顾你，不再是陶的陶。

string.ID: May the Fates favor you, Tau-no-Longer.

strings.string: 愿命运眷顾你，不再是陶的陶。

string.ID: I leave you to your fate, then.

strings.string: 那我就不打扰你的命运了。

string.ID: I leave you to your fate, then.

strings.string: 那我就不打扰你的命运了。

string.ID:
Oh, yes? I see. Well.
Do you... not hunt? Or align with hunters? You reek of predation yourself. You kill, yes?
I recall no promise to become a grazing hedonist. If I am called to hunt I will hunt.

strings.string:
哦，是吧？我明白了。嗯。
你……不狩猎吗？还是与猎手为伍？你自己身上就一股掠食的气味。你杀人，是吧？

string.ID: I wish the same for you, =name=. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我也同样祝愿你，=name=。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I wish the same for you, =name=.
Before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.
Then live and drink.

strings.string:
我也同样祝愿你，=name=。
你走之前，收下这个——我身体之物的一小块，谢你完成了「-不成」之仪。
然后，活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: As I you to yours, =name=. Live and drink.

strings.string: 正如我把你交给你的命运，=name=。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
As I you to yours, =name=.
But before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.
Then live and drink.

strings.string:
正如我把你交给你的命运，=name=。
但你走之前，收下这个——我身体之物的一小块，谢你完成了「-不成」之仪。
然后，活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.
Then live and drink, =name=.

strings.string:
你走之前，收下这个——我身体之物的一小块，谢你完成了「-不成」之仪。
然后，活下去，喝足水，=name=。

string.ID: What now? Nothing like this has ever happened before.

strings.string: 现在怎么办？这样的事以前从未发生过。

string.ID: It's difficult to return to normal life after such an upheaval.

strings.string: 经历了这样的剧变，要回到正常生活很难。

string.ID: Forgive me, kendren, but the sight of you makes my hands quake.

strings.string: 原谅我，外客，可看见你让我的手发抖。

string.ID: Oh? Is it really over? I'm afraid.

strings.string: 哦？真的结束了吗？我害怕。

string.ID: How Bey Lah prospers! We should have opened the village years ago.

strings.string: 贝拉多兴旺啊！我们早该在几年前就开放村庄。

string.ID: Oh, it is you. Thank you for helping the village.

strings.string: 哦，是你。谢谢你帮了村子。

string.ID: I will admit, Hindriarch Esk leads well.

strings.string: 我承认，女族长埃斯克领导得好。

string.ID: Can we really trust such a young Hindriarch?

strings.string: 这么年轻的女族长，真能信得过吗？

string.ID: I am both afraid and hopeful for our future. But perhaps this is what we need.

strings.string: 我对我们的未来既害怕又抱有希望。但也许这正是我们需要的。

string.ID: Oh, it is you. Thank you for helping the village.

strings.string: 哦，是你。谢谢你帮了村子。

string.ID: Ah, l-live and drink.
Live and drink...
Live... live and drink, kendren.
Please go away.
W-w-w-w-what are ... what are you...

strings.string: 你、你、你、你是什么……你是什么……

string.ID: Moon and sun, kendren.
Live and drink. Will you be staying long?

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水。你会待很久吗？

string.ID: Forgiveness begged, kendren. I have work to do.

strings.string: 请见谅，外客。我还有活要干。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren. I am very busy.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，外客。我很忙。

string.ID: You're... kendren...
Please don't hurt me.
Ah... uhm. I... you, ah.
{{emote|*the hindren stares at you, wide-eyed*}}
Hold, aristocrat! I have wares to claim your interest.

strings.string: 站住，贵族！我有能勾起你兴趣的货。

string.ID: My implants are acquired peaceably, I assure you.

strings.string: 我这些植入体都是和平得来的，我向你保证。

string.ID: How becoming you look, Aristocrat! But you could be more becoming.

strings.string: 你看起来多「体面」啊，贵族！不过你还能更体面些。

string.ID: Tire of your legs? Arms? Hands? See what I have that fits you.

strings.string: 腿累了？胳膊？手？看看我这儿有什么合你的。

string.ID: Luxury internal adornments for the discerning Aristocrat.

strings.string: 为有眼光的贵族准备的奢华内部饰件。

string.ID: No additional sterilisation required, of course.
Quality implants for sale at reasonable prices!
You strike me as an Aristocrat who knows the value of artisanal organs.

strings.string: 我看你就属于那种懂得手工器官价值的贵族。

string.ID: I recommend everything I carry. Not all at once, of course.

strings.string: 我进的每一样我都推荐。当然，不是让你一次全装上。

string.ID: Hope you'll "becoming" back, ha ha.

strings.string: 希望你「体面」地再回来，哈哈。

string.ID: Live and drink, Aristocrat.
Kill anyone valuable?
You look dangerous. Ever go hunting for parts?

strings.string: 你看着挺危险。去猎过零件吗？

string.ID: Got guts?
Can you imagine sticking one of these things inside you? Disgusting.

strings.string: 你能想象把这种东西塞进自己身体里吗？恶心。

string.ID: I've plenty water if you've got implants to sell.

strings.string: 你要有植入体要卖，我水多的是。

string.ID: Always check becoming nook shelves for parts.

strings.string: 记得常去「体面角」的架子上翻零件。

string.ID: Y'ain't peeled open any Sons or Daughters, have you?

strings.string: 你没剖开过什么「儿子」或「女儿」吧？

string.ID: Less I know about where my stock comes from, the better.

strings.string: 我的货源打哪儿来，我知道得越少越好。

string.ID: I'll still take parts you ain't washed off, it's fine.

strings.string: 没洗干净的零件我也照收，没事。

string.ID: If you can butcher a boar, you can do the same to a man. Just ain't meat you're looking for.

strings.string: 你能宰一头野猪，就也能对人做同样的事。只不过你要找的不是肉。

string.ID: Only in the Shallows' dawnstirs did I let myself think it possible. And now...

strings.string: 只有在浅滩的晨潮里，我才容许自己相信它有可能。而现在……

string.ID: I found a torn sheet of graph paper with a note about deceit. Was it yours?

strings.string: 我找到一张撕破的坐标纸，上面有一段关于欺骗的札记。是你的吗？

string.ID: Your crimeclothes? There was a codex about crimes and punishments near the bedroll in your study. What was it?

strings.string: 你的罪衣？你书房铺盖旁有一部讲罪与罚（Crime and Punishment）的抄本。那是什么？

string.ID: The svardym Mak said he was born to a cacophony of static ringing his ears raw. Could it have been the signal?

strings.string: 斯瓦迪姆马克说他出生时耳边响着一片刺耳的静电杂音。那会不会就是信号？

string.ID: The Svardym Geeub mentioned a machine speaker and her ursine apprentice. Was that you?

strings.string: 斯瓦迪姆吉厄布提到过一位机械言者和她那熊族学徒。那是你吗？

string.ID: Rebekah was a healer. But the daughters of Exile, her acolytes, are tinkers. Why?

strings.string: 蕾贝卡是医者。可流放之女——她的门徒们——却是修补匠。为什么？

string.ID:
Yes, that paper, twas mine. This racket of a Signal is mine, too, of sorts.
It is my tolling bell.

strings.string:
是的，那张纸是我的。这道吵闹的信号，某种意义上也是我的。
它是我的丧钟。

string.ID: That codex? A comfort, a guidebook, a ledger. My crimes have no signatories, but the heart is its own document.

strings.string: 那部抄本？一份慰藉，一本指南，一册账簿。我的罪没有署名者，可心本身就是它自己的文书。

string.ID: Svardym Mak's static? Yes, twas the Signal. My signal. My tolling bell.

strings.string: 斯瓦迪姆马克的静电声？是的，那就是信号。我的信号。我的丧钟。

string.ID:
Apprentice. So long since I've worn that title, but it feels right still.
Yes, twas me at the machine speaker's side.

strings.string:
学徒。我已经这么久没戴过这个名号了，可它感觉仍然合适。
是的，站在那位机械言者身旁的就是我。

string.ID:
She was a healer, yes. The wire cutter can perform the work of a scalpel; and the soldering iron, a suture.
To take apart a history, and stitch something new...

strings.string:
她是医者，没错。剪线钳能做手术刀的事；烙铁能做缝合的事。
把一段历史拆开，再缝出点新的东西……

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
Forgive me, =name=. The ascent strains the mind as well as the body. My flight of fancy is done; I am regrounded.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆停顿。*}}
原谅我，=name=。登升既耗损身体，也耗损心智。我的遐思结束了；我已回到地面。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses and frowns.*}}
Do you know, =name=, the engine types that ask us to loose every pin and unhinge every cam to know them? Such an engine of culture we are encased in now, and I cannot speak to the workings of one gearset without disassembling them all. I meant not to tease, and soon, I promise, you will spy the next arc of our journey.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆停顿，皱起眉。*}}
你可知道，=name=，有些机器要人松开每一根销、拆下每一个凸轮，才能被人理解？我们如今就被这样一台文化机器包在里面，而我不把全部齿轮拆开，就说不清其中一组的运作。我并非有意卖关子；我保证，很快你就能看到我们旅程的下一个弧段。

string.ID: Barathrum, if the past has some relevance to this moment, I would ask you to share what you know.

strings.string: 巴拉瑟鲁姆，若往事与此刻有所关联，我请你把知道的告诉我。

string.ID: You see, =name=, when I, a young bruin, crossed the Homs Delta with my flood-fleeing clan and into the western reach of Qud, the plagues of the Gyre were already ascendant. We took root at our new hearth, in the chrome grottos where we urshiib find natural peace, and by the providence of my elders, I was able to study the tinkering craft.

strings.string: 你看，=name=，当年我还是头年轻的熊，跟着躲避洪水的族群越过霍姆斯三角洲，进入卡德（Qud）西部时，环流（Gyre）的瘟疫已然当道。我们在新的家穴扎下根，就在我们熊族天然感到安宁的铬色岩穴里；承蒙长辈们的照拂，我才得以研习修补之艺。

string.ID: The Seraph spoke of a Great Machine that spanned galaxies, the motion of whose sails and gear trains directed the fluidic shifting of stars and cultures. But they spoke little of it, and little I know.

strings.string: 炽天使提到过一台横跨星系的伟大机械，它的帆与齿轮组的运动，支配着星辰与文明的流变。但他们很少谈及它，我所知也甚少。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum coughs and swallows.*}}
To ready our world for the Coven's return, the Seraph, who would be called Resheph, became convinced that all higher life on the planet must... be purged. That it was our life and way of living that moved the Coven to set the injunction. The only way through was for a new life to obtain.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆咳嗽，咽了口唾沫。*}}
为了让我们的世界为女巫会的归来做好准备，那位后来被称作雷谢夫的炽天使确信，这星球上一切高等生命都必须……被清除。正是我们的生命与生活方式，促使女巫会设下了那道禁令。唯一的出路，是让一种新的生命成立。

string.ID:
And so, Resheph seeded the plagues and whorled them via waveform to a breathing gyre. Blights engineered to attack life whilst preserving the planet's artifacts of glass and chrome.
Rebekah, dear tutor, betrayed Resheph's confidences and apprised me of the plan, so that I might help her dash it apart and save the peoples of our world.

strings.string:
于是雷谢夫播下那些瘟疫，用波形把它们旋成一道会呼吸的环流（Gyre）。那些疫病被设计成只攻击生命，而保全这星球上玻璃与铬的造物。
蕾贝卡，我亲爱的导师，背弃了雷谢夫的信任，把这计划告诉了我，好让我帮她把它砸碎，救下我们世界的万民。

string.ID: I asked for time. Give me time. To reform Qud, extinguish the hatefulness and needless warmaking, to lift our world across the eschaton and prepare it for the Coven's return...

strings.string: 我求的是时间。给我时间。去改造卡德（Qud），熄灭那些仇恨与无谓的战争，把我们的世界托过终末，为女巫会的归来做好准备……

string.ID:
After a storm of shrapnel words, the Seraph acceded to ten centuries.
Ten centuries! An eyeblink on the scales of the Folk Clock but an eternity for us. So I believed.
The rousing Signal would cease, the plagues of the Gyre would be reversed, to the extent they could; for even the potent archon had not full governance over what they had worked into being.

strings.string:
在一场弹片般的话语风暴之后，炽天使让步，给了十个世纪。
十个世纪！在万民之钟的刻度上只是一眨眼，对我们却是永恒。我曾如此相信。
那唤醒的信号会停止，环流（Gyre）的瘟疫会被逆转——在它们能被逆转的限度内；因为即便是那位强大的执政官，也无法完全支配他们亲手做成的东西。

string.ID: What would there be for the Coven to return to, if life on our world was purged?

strings.string: 如果我们世界的生命被清除，女巫会回来时还能见到什么？

string.ID: I asked Resheph that very question. But the seraphim transit an ethical manifold much different than our own.

strings.string: 我问过雷谢夫正是这个问题。但炽天使所行的伦理流形，与我们的大不相同。

string.ID: Once the Seraph had become convinced of the Coven's return, they reified their authority and assumed a more material role in onworld matters. The decaying sultanate was a convenient tool.

strings.string: 一旦炽天使确信女巫会将要归来，他们便把自己的权威实体化，在此世事务中扮演起更具物质性的角色。那个正在腐朽的苏丹国，便是一件便利的工具。

string.ID: And he was, of a sort. The cure for a plague is often too its cause. With one's paws on the dials and drum of power, history is a cloth to be loomspun.

strings.string: 某种意义上，他确实是。瘟疫的解药往往也是它的成因。当一个人的爪子按在权力的刻度盘与转鼓上，历史就成了一匹等待上机织造的布。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum inhales and stutters.*}} She-
Resheph would not forgive her trespass. She contracted the rotting tongue while abetting the lepers of =RebekahRegion=. When her time came, she-

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆吸了口气，语声断续。*}} 她——
雷谢夫不肯宽恕她的越界。她在协助=RebekahRegion=的麻风病人时染上了腐舌症。当她的时限到来时，她——

string.ID:
Resheph would not let her return home. O..
{{emote|*Barathrum expels a hushed whimper.*}}

strings.string:
雷谢夫不许她回家。哦……
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆发出一声压抑的呜咽。*}}

string.ID: If the signal sounds and the Gyre widens again, then you did not reach whatever watermark Resheph set?

strings.string: 如果信号响起、环流（Gyre）再度变宽，那就说明你没有达到雷谢夫设定的那道水位线？

string.ID:
No... Qud is fractious, and no lasting peace has obtained. I tried... for decades on decades I tried our paws on the tiller, to shim together what blossomed in the wild...
The restoration of machines, the federation of free sovranties, the nourishing rituals of salt and star, the sacred, the profane...

strings.string:
不……卡德（Qud）四分五裂，持久的和平从未降临。我试过……几十个十年，我试着把爪子按在舵柄上，把荒野中萌发的东西拼合起来……
机器的复兴、自由主权者的联合、盐与星的滋养仪式、神圣的、亵渎的……

string.ID:
In the late years I saw the writing on the wall. I turned us inward, retreated to my candle-dim study to angle at the project alone. A new plan... {{emote|*eeehw*}} was-
{{emote|*Barathrum starts panting.*}}

strings.string:
晚年时我看见了墙上的字。我让我们转向内部，退回到我烛光昏暗的书房，独自琢磨这个计划。一个新方案……{{emote|*咿呜*}} 是——
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆开始喘息。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Barathrum heaves a great sigh upon the moist air of the control pit.*}} {{emote|*Barathrum stumbles to the floor with paws to his face.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆在控制坑潮湿的空气里长叹一声。*}} {{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆双手掩面，跌倒在地。*}}

string.ID:
I failed it! I have failed! A thousand years too short, and- MORE TIME
{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}

strings.string:
我失败了！我失败了！一千年太短，而——更多时间
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆哭泣。*}}

string.ID: I am debased on the plank across the light of God! d- do I have a rightful claim to pity? Blindness! This darkling room abjures the light. Is this the House of Judgement, Hortensa? Or mere penumbra, the child's playcave, and law and language (not yet invented) cast their forcing functions back through time to puppet the unblossomed mind to civilized shape...

strings.string: 我在横跨神之光的木板上堕落了！我——我可有资格求得怜悯？盲目！这幽暗的房间弃绝光明。这里是审判之家吗，霍滕萨？还是仅仅是半影，孩童的游玩洞穴，而律法与语言（尚未发明）把它们的强制函数投回时间之中，牵动那未绽放的心智，塑成文明的模样……

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly burns bright.*}}
Did you know, =name=, I harbor a memory older than even the flooding of my hearth cave. A gleaming ancient tale, told by my elders to the nippy cub I once was...

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆的面容忽然光彩焕发。*}}
你可知道，=name=，我怀有一段比我家穴被淹没还要古老的记忆。一个闪亮的远古故事，是长辈们讲给当年那个怕冷的小熊听的……

string.ID:
In the age of the covenate, a coterie of our urshiib ancestors took to the stars to ply their burning cores! Can you envision it??
Ho, ho! I know a secret! Heh, heh! I know... there is a functioning starship atop the Spindle. We can take it, =name=! We launch ourselves into the deepness of the dusted cosmos and find the starshiib! You and I, ho ho!
Starshiib!

strings.string:
在女巫会治下的时代，我们熊族的一批先祖曾上到星辰之间，去锻打那些燃烧的核心！你能想象吗？？
嚯，嚯！我知道一个秘密！嘿嘿！我知道……纺锤（the Spindle）顶端有一艘还能用的星舰。我们可以取用它，=name=！把自己射进布满尘埃的宇宙深处，去找星熊族！你和我，嚯嚯！
星熊族！

string.ID: Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib!

strings.string: 星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！星熊族！

string.ID: Is that you, nestling =name=? Are you returned from gate and Tomb? Come closer, I say.

strings.string: 是你吗，雏儿=name=？你从大门与陵墓回来了？走近些，我说。

string.ID: You appear... refreshed. My old eyes spy the swim lines of the waking world and to you they cede precedence. A newness obtains.

strings.string: 你显得……焕然一新。我这双老眼能看见醒世的游痕，而它们让位于你。一种崭新已然成立。

string.ID: Outside of time I found myself in a place of light. I chose to return and was made new.

strings.string: 在时间之外，我发现自己身处一片光明之地。我选择回来，并被重塑如新。

string.ID: I found Brightsheol, where it lies beyond the Tomb. I spoke to the Shomer there and arranged for the disablement of the Spindle's magnets.

strings.string: 我找到了明暗界（Brightsheol），它就在陵墓之外。我与那里的看守谈过，安排解除了纺锤（the Spindle）的磁体。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
It is. For reasons I will explain shortly, for reasons beyond any of our remits, Klanq has returned to Grit Gate.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆停顿。*}}
是的。出于我稍后会解释的理由，出于超出我们任何人职权范围的理由，克兰克回到了砂砾门。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
Unusual circumstances have put my study in disarray. Lamentable, this is, but necessary.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆停顿。*}}
不寻常的境况把我的书房弄得一片狼藉。这令人惋惜，却是必要的。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
I am confident there is a richness of wisdom in the poetry of that statement. One day, I will be eager to discover it. For now, what of the Spindle?

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆停顿。*}}
我确信你这句话里的诗意蕴含着丰厚的智慧。总有一天我会急于去发掘它。眼下，纺锤（the Spindle）怎么办？

string.ID: Take this, too. A chute of morphing gel from my personal collection. You've arrayed yourself in the artifacts of time, and so we have little left to give you. But still, this may be useful.

strings.string: 也收下这个。一管变形凝胶，来自我的私人收藏。你已披挂上时间的造物，所以我们没什么可给你的了。不过，这东西或许用得上。

string.ID: Now, matters have... evolved... in your absence. Do you choose now to learn more?

strings.string: 如今，情势在你离开期间……有了发展……。你现在选择进一步了解吗？

string.ID: High on the mount above Omonporch, the Putus Templar watch us through their war lenses and prepare an attack. The nephilim, too, stir from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slump with infernal purpose. The short of this is, due to a dearth of prep time and inadequate armament, Pax Klanq no longer believes in the viability of Q Girl's climber design. We must take Klanq at their word, here...

strings.string: 在奥蒙波奇上方的山巅高处，普图斯圣殿骑士透过他们的战镜窥视我们，并准备发动进攻。拿非利也在月阶上的摇篮里躁动，怀着地狱般的目的蹒跚而起。总之，由于准备时间不足、武备不够，帕克斯·克兰克已不再相信Q女郎的攀爬机设计可行。在这件事上，我们只能采信克兰克的话……

string.ID: This disheartens us, but there is another hope. Klanq has offered up a new design, something unconventional at all angles. And, despite our early misgivings, Q Girl and I now work in assistance to the project...

strings.string: 这让我们沮丧，但还有另一份希望。克兰克提出了一个新设计，从任何角度看都不循常规。尽管起初有疑虑，Q女郎和我如今都在协助这个项目……

string.ID: A new creature struggles to be born, =name=, and you will help birth it. Then, it will carry us, you and I, to the top of the Spindle.

strings.string: 一个新生物正挣扎着要诞生，=name=，而你会助它出生。然后它会载着我们——你和我——到纺锤（the Spindle）的顶端。

string.ID:
They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. We can delve into specifics once you begin, at which point Pax Klanq can also serve as a source of knowledge.
As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.

strings.string:
它们是我们将要培育、塑形、焊接成登升之物的构件。等你着手之后我们再细谈，那时帕克斯·克兰克也可以作为知识的来源。
你每取得一件构件，就把它送到克兰克那边那堆废料黏土上。

string.ID:
They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. Ask Pax Klanq for details.
As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.

strings.string:
它们是我们将要培育、塑形、焊接成登升之物的构件。细节去问帕克斯·克兰克。
你每取得一件构件，就把它送到克兰克那边那堆废料黏土上。

string.ID:
Correct. The creature will be shaped broad enough to contain two, but only you will be bonded to it. Only you will pilot.
Don't fear over an inescapable tether, though. The creature will be mobile unpiloted, if slower to act.

strings.string:
没错。那生物会被塑得足够宽大以容纳两人，但只有你会与它结契。只有你能驾驶。
不过不必担心被无法脱开的系绳拴住。那生物在无人驾驶时也能行动，只是反应慢些。

string.ID: Primordial soup, to be catalyzed and ran through its arteries as the animating substance.

strings.string: 原初之汤，经触媒后灌入它的动脉，作为赋活之物。

string.ID:
Yes, =name=! Begin the gathering, and the molding will follow. The materials you choose will influence the being we create, but any such being will be suitable for ascent.
This is our last task before we make our historic climb, =name=. Be safe and well in doing it. If you have more questions, return here. Klanq and I will be available.

strings.string: 是的，=name=！开始收集吧，塑形自会跟上。你选择的材料会影响我们造出的存在，但任何这样的存在都足以胜任登升。

string.ID: The creature is born, and you are bonded? What work! You are a sterling shaper of world, =name=, and I've nothing left to give you but my praise.

strings.string: 那生物已诞生，而你也与它结契了？何等的手笔！你是一位纯正的塑世者，=name=，除了赞美，我已无物可赠。

string.ID:
Now, our operators at Omonporch confirm that a clash with the Templar is inevitable.
This is a grim fact, but it does give space for your bond to flower. Go, become familiar with leading and piloting your creature. Return when you are ready, and we will finally go starward.

strings.string:
如今，我们在奥蒙波奇的情报员确认，与圣殿骑士的冲突已不可避免。
这是个严峻的事实，但它确实给了你的羁绊一个开花的空间。去吧，去熟悉如何引领和驾驶你的生物。等你准备好了就回来，我们终将朝星辰出发。

string.ID: Are you sure, Meyvn =name=? Our fates are not reversible past the next event horizon.

strings.string: 你确定吗，明悟者=name=？越过下一个事件视界之后，我们的命运便不可逆转了。

string.ID: O! What is it? I heave... I heave the weight of ass across my crutch, but the bones are pullproof. My bones inosculate to this grotto, or rather- this grotto, this world is what my bones *are*. Can an old bear divest of his spine, leave it to mosses and the sunstrung birds?

strings.string: 哦！那是什么？我拖动……我拄着拐杖拖动这笨重的身子，可这骨头是拉不脱的。我的骨头与这岩穴吻合，或者不如说——这岩穴、这世界*就是*我的骨头。一头老熊能把自己的脊骨卸下来，留给苔藓和晒着太阳的鸟吗？

string.ID:
I...
No matter. The will can break the wheel, too. We go. Pray, the weightloss of the rise might do good for me. Past the shell of the world, I'm to understand one's burdens can no longer pull them down...

strings.string:
我……
无妨。意志也能砸碎轮子。我们走。但愿登升中的减重对我有好处。据说越过世界的壳之后，一个人的重负便再也拉不下他了……

string.ID: Klanq is able to answer your questions. You received an operating manual, too, no? Perhaps you could reference it.

strings.string: 克兰克能回答你的问题。你也拿到了一本操作手册，不是吗？也许你可以查一查。

string.ID: You are so... old.
Otho said you wished to speak with me.
What's with the houseplant over there?

strings.string: 那边那株盆栽是怎么回事？

string.ID: Please tell me about the signal again.

strings.string: 请再跟我讲讲那道信号。

string.ID: Please tell me about the signal again.

strings.string: 请再跟我讲讲那道信号。

string.ID: I convinced Pax Klanq to construct the climber.

strings.string: 我说服了帕克斯·克兰克来造攀爬机。

string.ID: Pax Klanq has agreed to build the climber. What now?

strings.string: 帕克斯·克兰克已同意造攀爬机。现在呢？

string.ID: Could you tell me again about the Tomb of the Eaters?

strings.string: 能再讲讲食者（the Eaters）之墓吗？

string.ID: The magnetic field has been disabled and the Spindle is free to ascend. What now?

strings.string: 磁场已被解除，纺锤（the Spindle）可以登升了。现在呢？

string.ID: Tell me again of the plan to mold a giant creature to ascend the Spindle.

strings.string: 再讲一遍那个塑成巨型生物、登上纺锤（the Spindle）的计划。

string.ID: The creature has been made. What now?
Tell me again how the giant creature functions.

strings.string: 再讲一遍那巨型生物如何运作。

string.ID: I am ready to ascend the Spindle, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我准备好登上纺锤（the Spindle）了，巴拉瑟鲁姆。

string.ID: Live and drink, eldest Barathrum.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，最年长的巴拉瑟鲁姆。

string.ID: What can I offer, nestling?
You look... refreshed. Thank you, =name=. Take this polygel we recently recovered from the Palladium Reef.

strings.string: 你看起来……焕然一新。谢谢你，=name=。收下这份聚凝胶，是我们最近从钯礁取回的。

string.ID: Live and drink, Barathrum.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，巴拉瑟鲁姆。

string.ID: What welcome news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=! Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.

strings.string: 多好的消息，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=！请收下这个，作为我感激的信物。

string.ID: The flywheel of our scheme is spinning, but we must keep our paws on the treadle. Are you ready to learn what comes next?

strings.string: 我们计划的飞轮已在转动，但我们必须把爪子按在踏板上。你准备好听下一步了吗？

string.ID: I need time on my own first.
I will enter the Tomb of the Eaters as you ask.

strings.string: 我照你说的进入食者（the Eaters）之墓。

string.ID: You ask so much. I must consider it.

strings.string: 你要求得太多。我必须考虑一下。

string.ID: As I'd hoped you would, =name=. Take this disk with the signal encoded, just in case. And take this tattoo gun for when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.

strings.string: 正如我所希望你做的，=name=。收下这张录有信号的磁盘，以防万一。再收下这把纹身枪，取回死亡之印时用。你还需要带一把鹤嘴锄，或别的能凿穿石头的工具。并且当心：那陵墓是一片广袤古老的空间，对许多人而言是圣地。我无法预知你在那里会经历什么。

string.ID: I heed your warning. Farewell, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我记下你的警告。再会，巴拉瑟鲁姆。

string.ID: Use the tattoo gun I've given you when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.

strings.string: 取回死亡之印时，用我给你的纹身枪。你还需要带一把鹤嘴锄，或别的能凿穿石头的工具。并且当心：那陵墓是一片广袤古老的空间，对许多人而言是圣地。我无法预知你在那里会经历什么。

string.ID: I have more to ask, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我还有别的要问，巴拉瑟鲁姆。

string.ID: So I am, nestling. For a millennium now I've watched the river of Time turn the gears of Qud. I even played my part in diverting the river where I could. Oh, but there have been so many players through the years! So many players.

strings.string: 我确实如此，雏儿。一千年来，我看着时间之河转动卡德（Qud）的齿轮。凡力所能及之处，我甚至也参与了河道改向。哦，可这些年来有过太多参与者了！太多了。

string.ID: And before Qud? Beyond the 1,000 years?

strings.string: 那卡德（Qud）之前呢？一千年以前？

string.ID: Little do I remember now, for I was but a cub, a nestling, when my kin and I crossed the Homs Delta into Qud. We were urged on by the flooding of a glacial river that flowed through our hearth-cave. The world was just unthawing then, and I recall the roar of the freezing water as it rushed through the grotto, and the frigid spray on my face as I watched in awe.

strings.string: 如今我记得的不多了，因为我和族人越过霍姆斯三角洲进入卡德（Qud）时，我还只是头幼熊，一个雏儿。是一条冰川河淹没了我们的家穴，逼我们上路。那时世界刚刚解冻，我还记得冰水冲过岩穴时的轰鸣，以及我惊愕凝望时扑在脸上的刺骨水雾。

string.ID: That's my dear friend, Euclid. It's a prattleplant. It stores every phrase it hears in its neuroot network, and it mimics speech by flicking its leaves against one another. What comes out is gibberish as often as not, but even so, it's agreeable company for my nights spent tinkering. It is old, perhaps older than I am, and it hasn't yet run out of things to say.

strings.string: 那是我亲爱的朋友，欧几里得。它是一株絮语草。它把听到的每一句话都存进自己的神经根网络，靠叶片相互拍击来模仿说话。说出来的多半是胡言乱语，即便如此，它也是我修补度过长夜时称心的伙伴。它很老了，也许比我还老，而且它还没把要说的话说完。

string.ID: What is it? Where does the signal come from, and what does it say?

strings.string: 那是什么？信号从哪儿来，又在说什么？

string.ID: The signal is a beacon of welcoming, and it originates from the top of the Spindle.

strings.string: 那道信号是一盏迎候的信标，它源自纺锤（the Spindle）的顶端。

string.ID: And what is the Spindle, truly?

strings.string: 那么纺锤（the Spindle）究竟是什么？

string.ID: And what now?
I have more to ask, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我还有别的要问，巴拉瑟鲁姆。

string.ID: Who is Pax Klanq?

I must ask you to decipher this enigma, find Pax Klanq, and convince them to construct the climber. Remind Pax of the debt they owe us.
It strikes me as likely for this 'rainbow' to refer to the Rainbow Wood, where Klanq's kin consort, so I suggest you start there.

strings.string:
我必须请你去解开这个谜，找到帕克斯·克兰克，并说服他们建造攀爬机。提醒帕克斯他们欠我们的债。
在我看来，这个「彩虹」很可能指彩虹林 —— 克兰克的族类聚集之处，所以我建议你从那里开始。

string.ID: I will find Pax Klanq and deliver Q Girl's design.

strings.string: 我会找到帕克斯·克兰克，把Q女郎的设计交给他。

string.ID: I must weigh everything you've told me.

strings.string: 我得掂量你告诉我的一切。

string.ID:
As I had hoped, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. First, speak with Q Girl. She'll hand over her design.
I await your return.

strings.string:
正如我所希望的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。首先，去找Q女郎谈。她会把设计交给你。
我等你回来。

string.ID: Live and drink, Barathrum.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，巴拉瑟鲁姆。

string.ID:
THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.
WHEREFORE ART THOU?

strings.string:
汝安坐于大息阿赫的运转之中，而吾在汝之前。
汝为何而来？

string.ID: Resheph! You are the Seraph atop the Spindle?

strings.string: 雷谢夫！你就是纺锤（the Spindle）顶上的那位炽天使？

string.ID: Resheph, the plagues of the Gyre have returned. Can you help annul them once again?

strings.string: 雷谢夫，环流（Gyre）的瘟疫又回来了。你能再帮我废除它们一次吗？
