string.ID: I am here on account of your Gyre and its plagues. Hear me, I ask.

strings.string: 我为你那环流（Gyre）及其瘟疫而来。请你听我一言。

string.ID: I am here on account of your Gyre and its plagues. Hear me, I ask.

strings.string: 我为你那环流（Gyre）及其瘟疫而来。请你听我一言。

string.ID: Through great labors I ascended the Spindle, and now wish to know more of our world and worlds surrounding. Will you tell?

strings.string: 我历经艰辛登上纺锤（the Spindle），如今想更多了解我们的世界与周遭诸世界。你愿意讲吗？

string.ID: I cannot abide what you've done, and so come to smash order out of thee.

strings.string: 我无法忍受你所做之事，故而前来把你砸出秩序。

string.ID: {{emote|*Tremble in fear.*}}
COHERING... AS THE FRIGID SPRAY TO THE BLOCK OF ICE. 'TIS COLD!

strings.string: 正在凝聚……如刺骨水雾之于冰块。真冷！

string.ID:
PHANTASM'D O'RE THE THIN BOUNDARY?? 'TIS BEEN A TICK.
AND THOU, CHILD? THOU ART WHO OFF'D THE FLOW AHIND GJAUS.

strings.string:
竟幻越了那薄薄的边界？？不过一瞬而已。
而汝，孩子？汝便是那个关闭格豪斯背后之流的人。

string.ID: EGREGORE OR ONE-WISE?
AY, A WORLD-ARCHON IN SERAPH CASTE, STIRRED BY THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH.

strings.string: 然也，一位属炽天使品阶的世界执政官，为大息阿赫的运转所搅动。

string.ID: NAY, FOR I SET THEM A-WHORLING. THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN. THE NOOSPHERE MUST BE TILLED ERE THEY ARRIVE.

strings.string: 否，因是吾将它们旋起。星纪将尽，女巫会正在归来。在他们到来之前，智圈必须先被耕耘。

string.ID: But 1,000 years ago you cured them.

strings.string: 可一千年前你治愈了它们。

string.ID:
AY, BUT ONLY FOR A BRIEF INTERCESSION AT ANOTHER'S BEHEST.
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES ONCE MORE. THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
然也，但那只是应他人之请的短暂代祷。
地慧之聚再度增长。生命之树上的冠必须被修剪。

string.ID: You were responsible for the plagues then?

strings.string: 那么那些瘟疫是你造成的？

string.ID: AY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN.

strings.string: 然也，星纪将尽，女巫会正在归来。

string.ID: I am ready to speak on the final fate of Qud.

strings.string: 我准备好谈论卡德（Qud）的最终命运了。

string.ID: I am ready to speak on the final fate of Qud.

strings.string: 我准备好谈论卡德（Qud）的最终命运了。

string.ID: I am ready to speak on the final fate of Qud.

strings.string: 我准备好谈论卡德（Qud）的最终命运了。

string.ID: Resheph, I have annulled the nephilim, the greatest of the Gyre's plagues. Your plan is broken.

strings.string: 雷谢夫，我已废除了拿非利——环流（Gyre）诸瘟疫中最强大的一支。你的计划已被打破。

string.ID: Why purge all life? Aside from the immorality of it, nothing would remain.

strings.string: 为何清除一切生命？除却不义，那也不会剩下任何东西。

string.ID: Why do you believe the Coven now returns?

strings.string: 你为何相信女巫会如今归来？

string.ID: Barathrum mentioned a Great Machine?

strings.string: 巴拉瑟鲁姆提到过一台伟大机械？

string.ID: What moved the Coven to set the injunction on our world?

strings.string: 是什么促使女巫会对我们的世界设下那道禁令？

string.ID: Barathrum told of a splinter race of urshiib that took to the stars. Are they real?

strings.string: 巴拉瑟鲁姆说起过一支上了星辰的熊族分支。他们是真的吗？

string.ID: I implore you, Resheph, reverse the Gyre.

strings.string: 我恳求你，雷谢夫，逆转环流（Gyre）。

string.ID: THEN LET US DISCOURSE.
Enter into a new covenant with me, I implore you.

strings.string: 与我立一个新的誓约，我恳求你。

string.ID: I can't abide your amoral course. I return now to Qud to help nurture its communities, come what may of your plagues.

strings.string: 我无法忍受你这不辨善恶的做法。我如今要回卡德（Qud）去，帮助培育那里的社群，无论你的瘟疫会带来什么。

string.ID: I've mused on your words and have joined you at your vantage point. The plagues of the Gyre are the only way to prepare for the Coven's return.

strings.string: 我思量了你的话，并来到你的视点与你同在。环流（Gyre）的瘟疫是为女巫会归来做准备的唯一途径。

string.ID: I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.
I SHALL CONSENT TO THE DRAWING OF THIS NEW COVENANT. YET, A CHANGE MUST BE WROUGHT FROM WHAT HATH BEEN BEFORE.

strings.string: 吾将应允立此新约。然则，须自往昔之中锻出一番改变。

string.ID: I STROVE MINE UTMOST TO KEEP IN HIGH ESTEEM THE PERSPECTIVES OF MINE ATTENDANT AND HER STOUT-HEARTED CUB, BUT THEIR WILLS WERE TOO WEAK, AND I SUBSUMED THEM.

strings.string: 吾曾竭尽全力尊崇吾之侍从与她那只心志坚定的幼崽的见解，但他们的意志太弱，吾将他们吸纳了。

string.ID: THIS TIME, THOU SHALT REMAIN AT THE SHEVA WITH ME, AND LEND THY OWN HAND TO STEER THE COURSE OF THE WORLD FROM THIS LOFTY PERCH.

strings.string: 这一次，汝须与吾同留示巴，并自此高处以汝亲手，为世界之航向掌舵。

string.ID: THOU SHALT MAINTAIN DISCOURSE WITH THY CONTACTS UPON THE WORLD, AND FROM THIS PLACE SHALT THOU COUNSEL THEM.

strings.string: 汝须与汝在世上之诸般联系保持交谈，并自此地向他们进言。

string.ID: I assent to this. The covenant is drawn.
No, I wish to return to Qud.
I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.
I shall remain here, but I have one demand.

strings.string: 我会留在此地，但我有一个要求。

string.ID: SPEAK THY ASK.
Then I assent. The covenant is drawn.
I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.

AYE, LET IT BE SO.
I SHALL IMPART MY BOUNTY OF KNOWLEDGE, AND INSTRUCT THEE IN THE HERMENEUTICS OF THE GEMARA, AS FAR AS THOU ART CAPABLE OF UNDERSTANDING.

strings.string:
善，便如此。
吾将传授吾丰盛的知识，教汝《注疏》的解经之学——至于汝能领会到何种地步。

string.ID:
IT SHALL TAKE TIME, HOWBEIT, TO MASTER THE SERAPHIC RITUALS. ONLY IN THY OLD AGE SHALL THE INMOST LAYERS UNFURL.
BUT TOGETHER, WE SHALL SEEK.

strings.string:
然而，要精通炽天使的仪轨需费时日。唯有到汝之暮年，最内里的层叠才会展开。
但我们当一同探寻。

string.ID: Then I assent. The covenant is drawn.
I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.
THOU SHALT REMAIN HERE, OR NO COVENANT SHALL BE DRAWN.

strings.string: 汝须留于此地，否则便无誓约可立。

string.ID: I am off.
I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.
AY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN.

strings.string: 然也，星纪将尽，女巫会正在归来。

string.ID: The noosphere must be tilled ere they arrive.

strings.string: 在他们到来之前，智圈必须先被耕耘。

string.ID: I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.
THEN LET US DISCOURSE.
Enter into a new covenant with me.
Though the threat has been neutralized, I can't abide your amoral course. I return now to Qud to help nurture its communities.

strings.string: 尽管威胁已被化解，我仍无法忍受你这不辨善恶的做法。我如今要回卡德（Qud）去，帮助培育那里的社群。

string.ID: I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.
O? BUT THEN, A CHANGE MUST BE WROUGHT FROM WHAT HATH BEEN BEFORE.

strings.string: 哦？既是如此，则须自往昔之中锻出一番改变。

string.ID: I STROVE MINE UTMOST TO KEEP IN HIGH ESTEEM THE PERSPECTIVES OF MINE ATTENDANT AND HER STOUT-HEARTED CUB, BUT THEIR WILLS WERE TOO WEAK, AND I SUBSUMED THEM.

strings.string: 吾曾竭尽全力尊崇吾之侍从与她那只心志坚定的幼崽的见解，但他们的意志太弱，吾将他们吸纳了。

string.ID: WILL THOU REMAIN AT THE SHEVA WITH ME, AND LEND THY HAND TO STEER THE COURSE OF THE WORLD FROM THIS LOFTY PERCH.

strings.string: 汝可愿与吾同留示巴，自此高处以汝之手，为世界之航向掌舵。

string.ID: THOU SHALT MAINTAIN DISCOURSE WITH THY CONTACTS UPON THE WORLD, AND FROM THIS PLACE SHALT THOU COUNSEL THEM.

strings.string: 汝须与汝在世上之诸般联系保持交谈，并自此地向他们进言。

string.ID: I assent to this. The covenant is drawn.
I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.
I shall remain here, but I have one demand.

strings.string: 我会留在此地，但我有一个要求。

string.ID: SPEAK THY ASK.
Then I assent. The covenant is drawn.
I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.

AYE, LET IT BE SO.
I SHALL IMPART MY BOUNTY OF KNOWLEDGE, AND INSTRUCT THEE IN THE HERMENEUTICS OF THE GEMARA, AS FAR AS THOU ART CAPABLE OF UNDERSTANDING.

strings.string:
善，便如此。
吾将传授吾丰盛的知识，教汝《注疏》的解经之学——至于汝能领会到何种地步。

string.ID:
IT SHALL TAKE TIME, HOWBEIT, TO MASTER THE SERAPHIC RITUALS. ONLY IN THY OLD AGE SHALL THE INMOST LAYERS UNFURL.
BUT TOGETHER, WE SHALL SEEK.

strings.string:
然而，要精通炽天使的仪轨需费时日。唯有到汝之暮年，最内里的层叠才会展开。
但我们当一同探寻。

string.ID: Then I assent. The covenant is drawn.
I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.

BE STEERED BY THINE OWN WILL, WORLD-CHILD.
RETURN IF THOU MUST. LIVE AND QUAFF.

strings.string:
由汝自身之意志指引吧，世界之子。
若汝必须离去，便离去。活下去，畅饮。

string.ID: I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.

O? THOU ART WISE BEYOND THY STATURE.
THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN.

strings.string:
哦？汝之智慧超出汝之身量。
星纪将尽，女巫会正在归来。

string.ID: The noosphere must be tilled ere they arrive.

strings.string: 在他们到来之前，智圈必须先被耕耘。

string.ID: I must think on this further.
I must think on this further.
AY, SO THOU HAST.

AND THOU SHALT DO SO AGAIN IF PROMPTED? WHEN LOW DENIZENS CAN UNDO THE PLAGUES, THE MARSHALLING HATH FAILED.
THE WORLD IS THUS DOOMED.

strings.string:
若再受催促，汝还会如此行事？当低微的住民都能解除那些瘟疫时，地慧之聚便已失败。
这世界因此注定毁灭。

string.ID:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES.
WHEREFORE ART THOU?

strings.string:
地慧之聚正在增长。
汝为何而来？

string.ID:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING HATH FAILED.
WHEREFORE ART THOU?

strings.string:
地慧之聚已然失败。
汝为何而来？

string.ID: Not all life then. But most intelligent life. Why?

strings.string: 那么不是一切生命。而是大多数有智生命。为什么？

string.ID: Nootropic current?
Automata Sophia?
What is the Gemara?

'TIS A SILLY STRATAGEM FOR THE CONVEYANCE OF CULTURE, IN MINE ESTIMATION.
ALAS, 'TIS WHAT THE COVEN SERVETH.

strings.string:
以吾之见，此乃传递文化的愚拙之策。
奈何，女巫会所事奉者正是此物。

string.ID: If its full workings are unknowable, is it possible the course of action you take is the wrong one?

strings.string: 若它全部的运作不可知，你所采取的做法是否可能是错的？

string.ID: What is the Gemara?
AFTER THE {{R|EXIT}}, I AND THE OTHER ORPHANED SERAPHIM SET FORTH TO INTERPRET THE WORKINGS OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA AND DISCERN WHY THE COVEN HAD DEPARTED.

strings.string: {{R|出离}}之后，吾与其他沦为孤儿的炽天使一同出发，去解读索菲亚自动机的运作，并辨明女巫会为何离去。

string.ID:
CENTURIES OF PATTERN-MAKING, ARGUMENT, AND CHANTING DID ENSUE.
THE SERAPHIC COMMENTARIES WERE COMPILED. THE GEMARA SOPHIA IS THE RESULT THEREOF.

strings.string:
其后历经数百年的制式、论辩与吟唱。
炽天使的注疏被编纂成集。《索菲亚注疏》便是其成果。

string.ID: Can I read the Gemara?
Automata Sophia?
I have more to ask.
NAY, IT WOULD TAKE CENTURIES TO INCULCATE THEE IN THE SERAPHIC HERMENEUTICS. AND AS YET, THOU ART NO GIFTED CANTOR.

strings.string: 否，要教会汝炽天使的解经之学，需数百年。而汝至今尚非有天赋的唱经者。

string.ID: I have more to ask.
You say plurality. Are there other interpretations?

strings.string: 你说是「多数」。还有别的解读吗？

string.ID: BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.

strings.string: 依《索菲亚注疏》之推演，{{R|出离}}乃由先在场域中一道心智营养流之环流（Gyre）所引。

string.ID: What is the Gemara Sophia?
Nootropic current?
I have more to ask.
INWITH THE FLUIDIC MANIFOLD OF LOCAL SAPIENCE, BEINGS THINK AND FEEL, CURRENTS DOTH FORM, AND KINESIS IS BEGOTTEN.

strings.string: 在本地智慧的流体流形之中，众生思考与感受，诸流因而成形，而动势由此生。

string.ID: I have more to ask.
PERCHANCE. SOME BEETLES DOST HOP FROM LEAF TO LEAF. AND SOME DO NOT.

strings.string: 或然。有些甲虫会自一叶跃至另一叶。有些则否。

string.ID: I have more to ask.
NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE WORLD-GARDEN MUST BE TILLED FOR THE COVEN'S RETURN.

strings.string: 否，星纪将尽，为迎女巫会归来，世界之园必须被耕耘。

string.ID: But you entered into a covenant with Barathrum.

strings.string: 可你与巴拉瑟鲁姆立过誓约。

string.ID: You have no right to sovereignty here.

strings.string: 你在此地并无主权可言。

string.ID: If you put so little value on the flourishing of life, where does your desire for readmittance to the Coven spring from?

strings.string: 你若对生命的繁盛如此不以为然，那你渴求重归女巫会的愿望又从何而来？

string.ID: Resheph, reverse the Gyre, or I will destroy you.

strings.string: 雷谢夫，逆转环流（Gyre），否则我便毁了你。

string.ID: I would ask something else.
What you ask may be impossible.
Couldn't another covenant be written?
I would ask something else.
I ASKED FOR NAUGHT. BARATHRUM DID.

strings.string: 吾无所求。是巴拉瑟鲁姆所求。

string.ID: TO WHAT END? BARATHRUM OFFERED NO INROADS TO SUCCESS.

strings.string: 所为何来？巴拉瑟鲁姆未曾觅得通往成功之径。

string.ID: I am not Barathrum. Grant me the same covenant and I will succeed.

strings.string: 我不是巴拉瑟鲁姆。赐我同样的誓约，我会成功。

string.ID: I would ask something else.
NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. THE TILLAGE OF THE NOOSPHERE REMAINTH THE PATH OF PLURALITY. SO IT IS WRIT IN THE GEMARA.

strings.string: 否，星纪将尽。耕耘智圈仍是「多数」之途。《注疏》中如此写着。

string.ID: Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.

strings.string: 雷谢夫！纵使执政官在那有感知、能感受的动物身上看不出任何价值，三位一体想必看得出。你必须重新考虑。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

WHERE DO SOVEREIGNTY AND RIGHTNESS INTERSECT IN THY MANIFOLD?
MOREOVER, I WAS ARCHON HERE LONG ERE THOU.

strings.string:
在汝之流形中，主权与正当于何处相交？
况且，吾为此地执政官，远早于汝。

string.ID: Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.

strings.string: 雷谢夫！纵使执政官在那有感知、能感受的动物身上看不出任何价值，三位一体想必看得出。你必须重新考虑。

string.ID: I would ask something else.
THOU ART MISTAKEN IN WHAT I VALUE. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME.

strings.string: 汝对吾所珍视者有所误解。汝已在吾之内筑起碑铭。

string.ID:
SO IT IS ONCE MORE.
THE CROWN IS PRUNED, YET THE TREE IS PRESERVED. THE SKIN IS SHED, YET THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE DOTH SLITHER TO TRIUMPH.

strings.string:
于是又一次如此。
冠被修剪，而树得以保全。皮被蜕去，而新得的蛇仍蜿蜒走向凯旋。

string.ID:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.
I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS.

strings.string:
汝不知晓，一个无女巫会之存在的日寒，就如同孑然一身、尽失亲缘地活着。
吾悲伤于汝无法感知此事。

string.ID: AY, A BEETLE CANST CLOG A PIPE. YET, EVEN IF IT WERE TO, THE PLAGUES WOULD NOT BE REVERSED. THEY HAVE BEEN SET A-WHORLING.

strings.string: 然也，一只甲虫能堵住管道。然则纵使堵住，瘟疫亦不会逆转。它们已被旋起。

string.ID: I am the beetle in your crimination. But shall not beetles survive your plagues?

strings.string: 我便是你罪状中的那只甲虫。可甲虫不也会在你的瘟疫中存活吗？

string.ID: I would ask something else.
NAY, THEY SHALL BE CRUSHED.
THE FELT AND FEELING ANIMAL...

strings.string: 那有感知、能感受的动物……

string.ID: I HAVE BEEN THAT BEAST. AT WATER-ROAR I FELT THE FRIGID SPRAY AND PEELED APART IN CHILD'S FEAR.

strings.string: 吾曾为那野兽。在水之轰鸣里，吾感到那刺骨水雾，并如孩童般在恐惧中崩解。

string.ID: IN AWE I GULPED AS SORCERESS STRIPES ARROWED UP A WORLD-SKIN, ALIGHT THE MARBLED MOON.

strings.string: 吾曾敬畏地吞咽，看那女巫的条纹如箭射上一片世界之皮，点亮那斑驳之月。

string.ID: EVEN THE ARCHON QUAILED AT THE GESTURE OF AN UNORDERABLE SPACE.

strings.string: 纵是执政官，面对那不可整序之空间的姿态，也曾畏缩。

string.ID: I can't abide a transformed world if it must make casualty of its past.

strings.string: 若一个被改造的世界必须以自己的过去为牺牲，我无法忍受。

string.ID: I am moved by this. Let me consider.

strings.string: 我被这话触动了。容我考虑。

string.ID: I would ask something else.
THOU DOST SURPRISE, WORLD-CHILD. I KNEW THOU HADST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME, BUT I DEEMED THEM THINGS OF STONE.

strings.string: 汝令吾惊讶，世界之子。吾知汝已在吾之内筑起碑铭，但吾以为它们是石头做的东西。

string.ID: The old players are vanished. Let us form a covenant anew.

strings.string: 旧日的参与者皆已消逝。让我们重新立约。

string.ID: ONE AGED PLAYER LIVETH STILL. WHILE BARATHRUM DOTH REMAIN UPON THE STAGE, NO PACT SHALL BE FORGED.

strings.string: 尚有一位年迈的参与者活着。只要巴拉瑟鲁姆仍在台上，便无盟约可缔。

string.ID: GRANT ME A MOMENT TO MUSE.
DO THUS.
POSE THY QUESTIONS, CHILD.
Who are you? What are the seraphim?

strings.string: 你是谁？炽天使又是什么？

string.ID: What is the Coven?
Has the Coven returned?
Rainwater Shomer claimed Brightsheol was the dream of the Seraph? Is that true?

strings.string: 雨水看守说，明暗界（Brightsheol）是炽天使的梦？那是真的吗？

string.ID: How did you initiate the plagues?

strings.string: 你是如何引发那些瘟疫的？

string.ID: Onworld and inside a polyp-strewn trellis, there is a giant frog who hates you.

strings.string: 在此世之上、一座息肉遍布的棚架之内，有一只巨蛙恨着你。

string.ID: ARCHONS, APE-REARED BELOW AND STIRRED BY THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, WHO DOST ORDER THE WORLD IN SUNDRY ROLES.

strings.string: 执政官们，由下方猿类养育，为大息阿赫的运转所搅动，以种种职分整序这世界。

string.ID: What is your role?
Are there others?
I have more to ask.
HIGH ADMINISTRATOR AND MACHINIC SUPERSTRATE OF THE NORTHERN SHEVA, ATOP GJAUS.

strings.string: 北示巴的至高管理者与机械基座，居于格豪斯之上。

string.ID: What is your role?
Are there others?
I have more to ask.
AY, OR AT LEAST THERE WERE SUCH. ONE YET DOTH SKULK ABOUT WITH BASE INTENTS.

strings.string: 然也，至少曾有此等存在。尚有一个怀着卑劣意图潜行于世。

string.ID: What is your role?
Are there others?
I have more to ask.
THE GRAND KNIT-WORK OF BEINGS YONSIDE THE JEWELED COSMOS, LABORING INWITH THE 72-FOLD PEACE.

strings.string: 那珠饰宇宙彼侧众生的宏大编织，在七十二重和平之中劳作。

string.ID:
NAY, NOT SINCE THE {{R|EXIT}}.
BUT NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE GEMARA SOPHIA CONVERGES ON PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR.

strings.string:
否，自{{R|出离}}以来未曾。
但如今星纪将尽，《索菲亚注疏》正汇聚于零时附近的近拱点。

string.ID: IN A SENSE, THE LOW SHOMER SPEAKETH TRUE. I AM THE SUPERSTRATE AND NINHURSAG THE SUBSTRATE; THAT THIN ORBIS DOTH SPIN BETWIXT THE TWO.

strings.string: 某种意义上，那低微的看守所言不虚。吾是基座之上层，宁胡尔萨格是基座之下层；那薄薄的球体便在这两者之间旋转。

string.ID: IN SEVERAL MANNER. THE FIRST FROGS WERE REARED IN TERRARIA. THE NEPHILIM, GRAFTED AND LIGHT-SMELT IN STAR ORBIT, THEN SET TO INCUBATE UPON THE CRYSTAL STAIR.

strings.string: 有数种方式。最初的蛙类养在陆生园中。拿非利则在星辰轨道上嫁接并熔光，随后被安置在水晶之阶上孵化。

string.ID: SOME, LIKE THE INCIDENCE OF SALT, WERE EXTANT AFFLICTIONS AND ONLY SYNCRETIZED UNTO THE NAMESAKE GYRE WHEN THE MYTHOMOLD OF RESHEPH SET AND FIRMED.

strings.string: 有些——如盐之侵袭——本是既存的苦厄，直到雷谢夫的神话模子凝固定型，它们才被糅合进那同名的环流（Gyre）。

string.ID: VERILY, THERE IS A WEALTH OF WISDOM IN THE POETRY OF THIS FACT. ONE DAY, I SHALL BE EAGER TO UNCOVER IT.

strings.string: 诚然，此事之诗意中蕴藏着丰厚的智慧。总有一天，吾将急于去发掘它。

string.ID:
I must admit, =name=, that I can think of few notions more challenging to my people than to welcome a flower-people into our town. Some will see them as no better than walking lah.
But if the notion came from you, they might consider putting it to a vote, at least. If you'll stand by, I will call a referendum.

strings.string:
我必须承认，=name=，我几乎想不出比「欢迎一支花之民进入我们镇子」更能挑战我族人的主意了。有些人会把他们看得不比会走路的拉赫强。
但若这主意出自你，他们至少可能会考虑付诸表决。你若愿意在场，我就召开一次公投。

string.ID:
I'll have Warden Neelahind gather everyone as soon as they can spare the eyes and ears for it.
{{emote|*Hindriarch Esk canters away, voice already raised.*}} Hey, Warden!

strings.string:
我会让看守尼拉欣德在大家抽得出眼和耳的时候把人召集起来。
{{emote|*埃斯克女族长小跑着离开，声音已经扬了起来。*}} 嘿，看守！

string.ID: {{emote|The moments pass in hundreds, filled with dust and noise. Voices rise, hooves stamp the packed earth, and a fledgling democratic process takes its first faltering steps.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*数以百计的片刻流逝，满是尘土与喧响。人声四起，蹄子踏着夯实的泥土，一套初生的民主程序迈出了它摇摇晃晃的头几步。*}}

string.ID: Hold there! Who are you? What do you want?

strings.string: 站住！你是谁？你想干什么？

string.ID: I am leaving.
Hold there! Who are you? What do you want?

strings.string: 站住！你是谁？你想干什么？

string.ID: I am =name=. Hindriarch Keh sent me.

strings.string: 我是=name=。女族长凯派我来的。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Start2.Give back what you stole.Choice.Text
string.ID: I am justice. Give back what you stole.

strings.string: 我就是正义。把你偷的还回来。

string.ID: I am your worst nightmare. Prepare to die.

strings.string: 我是你最深的噩梦。准备受死吧。

string.ID: Nothing. Live and drink.
Keh? I'm shocked that she even deigned to speak my name. I am a pariah now, beneath discussion. Does she demand remuneration for the scant supplies I stole?

strings.string: 凯？她竟肯说出我的名字，真叫我吃惊。我如今是个贱民，不配被谈论。她是要我为偷走的那点物资赔偿吗？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Hindriarch Keh sent me..You stole Kindrish.Choice.Text
string.ID: She says that you stole Kindrish, the village's treasure.

strings.string: 她说你偷了金德里什（Kindrish），村里的宝物。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Give back what you stole..Text
string.ID: What I stole? I stole supplies to sustain myself and my sisters, nothing more, and little enough that no one would suffer for its absence. You would cut those from my hide?

strings.string: 我偷了什么？我偷了些物资养活我和我的姐妹，仅此而已；少得没人会因为缺了它而受苦。这你也要从我皮上割下来？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Give back what you stole..You stole Kindrish.Choice.Text
string.ID: No. You stole the treasure called Kindrish.

strings.string: 不。你偷了那件叫金德里什（Kindrish）的宝物。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Eskhind bursts into forced, nervous laughter*}}
Is that her angle? To claim that I stole Kindrish? Her influence must be waning more than even I knew.

strings.string:
{{emote|*埃斯欣德迸出一阵勉强而紧张的笑声*}}
她打的是这个主意？声称我偷了金德里什（Kindrish）？她的影响力衰退得比我以为的还要厉害。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You stole Kindrish..What are you saying?Choice.Text
string.ID: What are you saying?

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You stole Kindrish..You claim innocence?Choice.Text
string.ID: You claim innocence?

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You stole Kindrish..I suspected this.Choice.Text
string.ID: A frame-up. I suspected this.

strings.string: 一场栽赃。我早怀疑如此。

string.ID:
What do you imagine I am saying? The aging, ineffectual leader of a village in isolation. A system that strives to forget anyone who sees the outside, no matter how much its inhabitants strive for a better tomorrow.
Bey Lah's isolationism provides ideal patsies for any crime the Hindriarch chooses to commit.

strings.string:
你以为我在说什么？一个与世隔绝的村庄里，那位年迈无能的领袖。一套竭力忘记任何见过外面的人的体制——无论它的居民多么努力想争一个更好的明天。
贝拉的孤立主义，为女族长想犯的任何罪提供了最理想的替罪羊。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.What are you saying?.You think Keh stole the treasure?Choice.Text
string.ID: You think Keh stole the treasure?

strings.string: 你认为凯偷了那件宝物？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.What are you saying?.Why should I believe you?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why should I believe you?

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.What are you saying?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What do you expect me to do, then?

Yes. I am falsely accused.
See, Bey Lah strives to forget anyone who sees the outside. The gerontocracy ensures that its leaders will always be aging and fearful. Pariahs like me can be easily accused of crimes committed by Keh or her cronies.

strings.string:
是的。我是被诬告的。
你看，贝拉竭力忘记任何见过外面的人。长者政治确保它的领袖永远年迈而怯懦。像我这样的贱民，很容易被指控犯下凯或她亲信所犯的罪。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You claim innocence?.You think Keh stole the treasure?Choice.Text
string.ID: You think Keh stole the treasure?

strings.string: 你认为凯偷了那件宝物？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You claim innocence?.Why should I believe you?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why should I believe you?
Lies. You are trying to manipulate me.

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You claim innocence?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What do you expect me to do, then?

Well, good. I would give you a prize for your insight, but times have been lean.
As you say, the Hindriarch is obviously framing me. As a pariah, I am an ideal patsy for Keh. Much as I love my people, they are weak of will and do not question the Grand-Doe.

strings.string:
嗯，很好。我本该为你的洞察力给你发个奖，但日子一直紧巴。
如你所说，女族长显然在栽赃我。作为一个贱民，我是凯最理想的替罪羊。我虽然深爱我的族人，可他们意志薄弱，从不质疑大母鹿。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..You think Keh stole the treasure?Choice.Text
string.ID: You really think Keh stole the treasure?

strings.string: 你真的认为凯偷了那件宝物？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..Why should I believe you?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why should I believe you?
Lies. You are trying to manipulate me.

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What can be done, then?

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..Eskhind is rudeChoice.Text
string.ID: You didn't need to be rude about it.

strings.string: 你没必要为这事这么无礼。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You think Keh stole the treasure?.Text
string.ID:
Ay, you kendren are just as thick as the elders. I'd hoped otherwise.
Yes, I am suggesting that old Grand-Doe is trying to fool you, and the village as well. I'm not certain that she stole it herself, but an investigation might undermine her authority, and she cannot have that.

strings.string:
唉，你们外客和那些长老一样愚钝。我本希望不是。
是的，我是在说那位老大母鹿正试图骗你，也骗整个村子。我不确定是她亲手偷的，但一场调查可能动摇她的权威，而那是她不能容忍的。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You think Keh stole the treasure?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What should I do, then?

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You think Keh stole the treasure?.Eskhind is rudeChoice.Text
string.ID: You don't need to be so rude.

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Why should I believe you?.Text
string.ID:
Why should you believe me? Well, why should you believe Keh? Ayvah, think about this!
I'm not asking you to give me your unconditional trust, understand? Only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable? Is that not just?

strings.string:
你凭什么相信我？那么，你又凭什么相信凯？哎呀，你想想看！
我不是要你给我无条件的信任，明白吗？只是要你给我与凯同等程度的信任。这不过分吧？这不公正吗？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Why should I believe you?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What are you suggesting I do?

Ayvah. I'd wanted Grand-Doe to be wrong about you kendren, but perhaps you are all violent fools after all.
I'm not asking you to trust me, only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable?

strings.string:
哎呀。我本希望大母鹿对你们外客的看法是错的，可也许你们当真全都是些暴力的蠢货。
我不是要你信任我，只是要你给我与凯同等程度的信任。这不算过分吧？

string.ID: What are you suggesting I do?
You don't need to be so rude.
You've wasted enough of my time. Prepare to die.

strings.string: 你已经浪费了我太多时间。准备受死吧。

string.ID:
Rude? How dare--
No, I... I apologize for my rudeness. Please understand that we have lost so much by leaving Bey Lah. My mind is not in a gentle place, and being revisited by the tyranny I left behind is causing newly-closed wounds to open.
Forgive my tone, but please understand: I did not steal Kindrish. You are being used.

strings.string:
无礼？你竟敢——
不，我……我为我的无礼道歉。请理解，离开贝拉让我们失去了太多。我的心境并不温和，而我抛下的那套暴政再度找上门来，正让刚刚愈合的伤口重新裂开。
原谅我的语气，但请你明白：我没有偷金德里什（Kindrish）。你被人利用了。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Eskhind is rude.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What should I do?

The proof is in the petals, kendren. You want justice? Find out what really happened.
If you find evidence, Warden Neelahind will support you. Speak to her. She is loyal to Grand-Doe, but more loyal to the truth.
I will return to the village and we will sort this out. The Hindriarch will have to tolerate my presence until my name is cleared.

strings.string:
证据就在花瓣里，外客。你想要正义？去查清究竟发生了什么。
你若找到证据，看守尼拉欣德会支持你。去跟她谈。她忠于大母鹿，但更忠于真相。
我会回村里去，我们把这事理清。在我洗清名声之前，女族长只能容忍我在场。

string.ID: I'll look into this, but you'd better not go missing.

strings.string: 我会去查，但你最好别失踪。

string.ID: Go tell Keh that I will remain in Bey Lah until this is sorted.

strings.string: 去告诉凯，事情查清之前我会留在贝拉。

string.ID: How are things with Neelahind?
Wisdom and Will, Eskhind.

Things are good. Better than I dreamed. I owe you so much for your intervention, =name=.
I still can't quite believe that my feelings are requited. I am at once elated and terrified. But this is good. My future is brighter now.
Thank you.

strings.string:
一切都好。比我梦想的还好。你的介入让我欠你太多，=name=。
我至今还不太敢相信我的感情得到了回应。我既欣喜又恐惧。但这是好的。我的未来如今更明亮了。
谢谢你。

string.ID: May it brighten even further. Live and drink.

strings.string: 愿它更加明亮。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: What is it, kendren?
Does this crumpled sheet of paper belong to you?

strings.string: 这张揉皱的纸是你的吗？

string.ID: Nothing. Live and drink.
Ask away.
Does this crumpled sheet of paper belong to you?

strings.string: 这张揉皱的纸是你的吗？

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?
Who might have stolen Kindrish?
What evidence should I be looking for?
You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和看守曾很亲近，不是吗？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪儿？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 眼下没有。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?
What evidence should I be looking for?
You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和看守曾很亲近，不是吗？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪儿？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 眼下没有。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?
What evidence should I be looking for?
You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和看守曾很亲近，不是吗？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪儿？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 眼下没有。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Objects out of place, certainly. Bey Lah produces little and sees almost no violence, so signs of the outside world should be easy to find.
You may wish to talk to the villagers, too. My people are starved for entertainment, gossip travels fast, and we are all notoriously poor liars.

strings.string:
当然是些放错了位置的东西。贝拉出产很少，几乎见不到暴力，所以外界的痕迹应该容易找到。
你也许还想跟村民聊聊。我的族人极缺消遣，闲话传得飞快，而且我们出了名地不擅撒谎。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?
Who might have stolen Kindrish?
You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和看守曾很亲近，不是吗？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪儿？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 眼下没有。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Yes. We were close. More than close.
If it tore my heart to ragged halves to leave my people behind, leaving Neelahind shredded it into scraps.

strings.string:
是的。我们曾很亲近。不止是亲近。
离开我的族人已把我的心撕成两半；而离开尼拉欣德，是把它绞成了碎屑。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?
Who might have stolen Kindrish?
What evidence should I be looking for?
The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪儿？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 眼下没有。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I have no brother. My two sisters are all the blood family I can claim.

strings.string: 我没有兄弟。我的两个姐妹就是我能认的全部血亲。

string.ID: Keh seems to believe otherwise.
Why did you leave Bey Lah?
Who might have stolen Kindrish?
What evidence should I be looking for?
You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和看守曾很亲近，不是吗？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 眼下没有。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Keh believes that she gets final say regarding who is a sister or brother. Regardless of what the sibling in question thinks.
That's part of why I left.

strings.string:
凯认为谁算姐妹、谁算兄弟，由她说了算。不管当事人怎么想。
这也是我离开的原因之一。

string.ID: May I ask further questions?

strings.string: 我可以再问几个问题吗？

string.ID:
Oh. Oh no. Yes, that's. That's mine.
I meant to burn it. I probably should have burned it. I wish I had burned it.
May I please have it back?

strings.string:
哦。哦，不。是的，那是。那是我的。
我本想烧掉它。我大概本该烧掉它。我真希望我烧掉了它。
能请你把它还给我吗？

string.ID: So you can burn it?
Hmm. No, I think not.

You have me helpless. That poem is my clumsy expression of a deep truth that frightens me. It is a risk that I lacked the strength to take or leave.
My heart quails in your hands, kendren.

strings.string:
你让我束手无策。那首诗，是我对一个令我恐惧的深刻真相所作的笨拙表达。那是一场我既无力承担、也无力放弃的风险。
我的心在你手里发抖，外客。

string.ID: You wish you had burned such a vital truth?

strings.string: 你倒希望自己烧掉了这么一个要紧的真相？

string.ID: It shall quail a bit longer. Live and drink.

strings.string: 它还得再抖一阵。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
No! Yes? I don't know.
Yes, I wish I burned it, but I wish I had given it. I wish I had never written it, or I had written it better, or I had simply confessed in person. I wish I had a harder heart.
I wish you would give it back, or burn it, or give it to her.

strings.string:
不！是吗？我不知道。
是的，我希望我烧了它；可我也希望我交出去了。我希望我从未写过它，或者写得更好些，或者干脆当面坦白。我希望自己的心更硬一些。
我希望你把它还给我，或者烧掉它，或者交给她。

string.ID: If I do give it back, what will you do with it?

strings.string: 我若真把它还回去，你会怎么处置它？

string.ID: I could give it to her.
This got a bit intense. Live and drink.

strings.string: 这有点太激烈了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I was trying not to think too hard about any of this until you found my poem, so... I can't say.
But I can't ignore this sign of my cowardice, not after you found it.

strings.string:
在你找到我的诗之前，我一直尽量不去多想这些，所以……我说不上来。
可既然你找到了它，我就不能无视这个怯懦的证据。

string.ID: Take the poem. Be brave.
Shall I deliver the poem for you?
I will think further on this.

Kendren... =name=. I will try.
I... thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string:
外客……=name=。我会试试。
我……谢谢你。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Live and drink, Eskhind.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，埃斯欣德。

string.ID:
Deliver it? But how do you even know who--
Mm. Never mind. My head is spinning. I think that if... the poem were to find itself in the warden's hands, that would perhaps be a good thing. Maybe.

strings.string:
替你送？可你怎么会知道是谁——
嗯。算了。我脑子在转。我想，如果……那首诗自己到了看守手里，那也许是件好事。也许吧。

string.ID: Then perhaps it will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 那也许它会。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: No, Eskhind. Take the poem. Be brave.

strings.string: 不，埃斯欣德。收下这首诗。勇敢些。

string.ID:
I couldn't save them.
I tried. I tried to save them.

strings.string:
我救不了他们。
我试过。我试过救他们。

string.ID: I think this poem is yours.
Condolences. Live and drink.
I'm uneasy. What is this mounting dread? I cannot talk now.

strings.string: 我不安。这份愈来愈重的恐惧是什么？我现在不能谈。

string.ID:
If it isn't the hero kendren, =name=.
Welcome back to Bey Lah! Stay as long as you like.

strings.string:
这不是那位英雄外客吗，=name=。
欢迎回贝拉！你想待多久就待多久。

string.ID: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 女族长，我找到了金德里什（Kindrish）。

string.ID: How is life as Hindriarch?

strings.string: 当女族长的日子怎么样？

string.ID:
Hah! Real justice? I never thought I'd see the like, not here. Well done!
I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.

strings.string:
哈！真正的正义？我从没想过能见到这种东西，尤其在这里。干得好！
我承认，我本宁愿不当这个女族长，但我希望能把我的族人带向一种更民主的治理形式。那样我就能把自己投票选下去了。

string.ID: Welcome back to Bey Lah, =name=. Stay as long as you like.

strings.string: 欢迎回贝拉，=name=。你想待多久就待多久。

string.ID: I believe this poem is yours.
How is life as Hindriarch?

strings.string: 当女族长的日子怎么样？

string.ID:
You have my gratitude for this exoneration, kendren. This worked out better than I expected thanks to you.
I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.

strings.string:
多谢你为我洗清罪名，外客。多亏你，事情的结果比我预期的好。
我承认，我本宁愿不当这个女族长，但我希望能把我的族人带向一种更民主的治理形式。那样我就能把自己投票选下去了。

string.ID: I believe this poem is yours.

Oh! Well. For you to bring me this after returning me to Bey Lah...
{{emote|*she smiles.*}}
Message received, =name=. If I expect my people to face their fear of the unknown, I owe it to them to face mine.
I will confess my feelings to Neelahind, give her the poem I wrote, and accept whatever reply she has for me. Thank you again.

strings.string:
哦！嗯。你把我送回贝拉之后，又把这个带给我……
{{emote|*她笑了。*}}
信息收到了，=name=。我若指望我的族人直面他们对未知的恐惧，我就该为他们直面我自己的。
我会向尼拉欣德坦白我的心意，把我写的诗交给她，并接受她给我的任何答复。再次谢谢你。

string.ID:
Kendren! I am glad to see you.
Thank you again for bringing Neela around, and please forgive her reservation. She mourns the people she thought she knew, but our future will be brighter together.

strings.string:
外客！见到你真高兴。
再次谢谢你让尼拉回心转意，也请原谅她的保留。她是在为那些她以为自己认识的人哀悼，但我们一起的未来会更明亮。

string.ID: Of course. Live and drink.

Kendren, thank you.
Things may seem grim, but I have a new strength with Neela by my side.

strings.string:
外客，谢谢你。
局面看似严峻，但有尼拉在我身边，我有了新的力量。

string.ID:
Oh, it's you. Need to rest by the fire?
It's fine, my wrath has clarified. You were never the problem. Live and drink.

strings.string:
哦，是你。要在火边歇歇吗？
没事，我的怒火已经澄清了。你从来不是问题所在。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I think this poem is yours.
You're just trying to keep dear Esk informed, then? Or could it be that you're wondering if that home may be Bey Lah?

strings.string: 所以你只是想让亲爱的埃斯克知道些消息？还是说，你在想那个家会不会就是贝拉？

string.ID: You have my thanks, Hindriarch.

I am afeared to even mention this notion to the villagers. Can you imagine my epitaph?
"Here lies the youngest Hindriarch in Bey Lah's history, trampled to death because she suggested we invite in a people most readily described as 'lah with legs'."
If they trusted you more, maybe we could put it to a vote. But as it is? No. Sorry, =name=.

strings.string:
我连向村民提起这个念头都害怕。你能想象我的墓志铭吗？
「此处长眠贝拉历史上最年轻的女族长，因提议引入一个最容易被形容为『长了腿的拉赫』的族群而被踩死。」
若他们更信任你，也许我们还能付诸表决。可照现在这样？不行。抱歉，=name=。

string.ID: We are on the tips of our hooves, =name=! Any word about the slynth?

strings.string: 我们正翘着蹄子等消息，=name=！斯林斯那边有说法了吗？

string.ID: My thanks, Hindriarch.

Live and drink, =name=!
At long last I bear a lighter load of work coordinating our new family members. I won't claim that all of my people are fully comfortable with the slynth, but the faundren love them.

strings.string:
活下去，喝足水，=name=！
协调我们的新家人这件事，终于让我肩上的担子轻了些。我不会说我的族人全都对斯林斯完全自在，但芳德伦们喜欢他们。

string.ID: My thanks again, Hindriarch.
I'm sorry.
{{emote|*The hindren pariah ignores you.*}}

Don't you have someone else to bother?
Live and drink piss.

strings.string:
你就没有别人可以烦吗？
喝尿去吧。

string.ID: I think this poem is yours.

Oh, so you have! Amazing work, kendren. We owe you more than we can give, but here is what we can give nonetheless.
You are more than welcome here in Bey Lah any time.

strings.string:
哦，你真找到了！了不起，外客。我们欠你的多过我们能给的，但这些是我们起码能给的。
贝拉随时都极其欢迎你。

string.ID:
Extremely frustrating! But I am yet hopeful.
My people are resistant to change, but they don't seem opposed to the idea of a Democracy. I need to give them a measure of time before we hold an election, but they'll ultimately agree as long as I am acting Hindriarch.
Then, fates willing, they will vote me out. I'll be voting for Isahind, myself. Once I convince her to run.

strings.string:
极其令人沮丧！但我仍有希望。
我的族人抗拒改变，可他们似乎并不反对民主这个念头。在举行选举之前，我得给他们一段时间，但只要还是我代理女族长，他们最终会同意的。
然后，若命运允许，他们会把我投票选下去。我自己会投伊萨欣德。等我先说服她参选。

string.ID: May fortune favor you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 愿好运眷顾你。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Wh-
My heart's sheen wanes to hear this of you. You abrade me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I am scuffed.
What of my trinket, then? Did you cast it into the... "hole in the ground?"

strings.string:
什——
听你这样说，我心的光泽都黯淡了。你磨伤了我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我起了划痕。
那我的小玩意儿呢？你把它扔进那个……「地上的洞」里了？

string.ID: Yes, I threw it in the hole.

strings.string: 是的，我把它扔进洞里了。

string.ID: No, I lost it.
I gave it to someone. Or sold it, perhaps.

strings.string: 我给了别人。或者也许卖掉了。

string.ID:
Well... the light of the Kasaphescence yet glimmers through your rasping edge.
I must, then, thank you.

strings.string:
嗯……卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）之光仍从你粗糙的边缘透出微光。
那么，我必须谢谢你。

string.ID: You're welcome.

My stomach lurches and quavers at the shock of this knowledge.
If there is a lesson in your disregard, I will meditate upon it in my own time.
Let us speak no more.

strings.string:
得知此事，我的胃一阵翻搅、发抖。
若你的漠视中有什么教训，我会在自己的时间里静思它。
我们不要再谈了。

string.ID:
Ah, a pit opens under my stomach!
Let us speak no more, I beg you. You scuff me. Live and drink.

strings.string:
啊，我胃底下裂开了一个坑！
我们不要再谈了，我求你。你磨伤了我。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Wanderer and =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! Have you journeyed yet to the Stilt, and seen the Sacred Well?

strings.string: 游荡者兼=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=！你可曾前往高跷，见过那神圣之井？

string.ID: Not yet, friend. Live and drink.

strings.string: 还没有，朋友。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Wanderer! Do you venture northwise? Into the Great Desert and nearer the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 游荡者！你要往北去吗？进入大漠，更靠近六日高跷？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt?
Why do you ask?

Ah! The great Mechanimist temple of glass, the sacred offering Well, and history in stone relief. Peopled by the Argent Fathers, in statue and light sculpture. And circled by the grand bazaar. I hear there are more people there than numbers in the void, and their chatter makes a sound wholly raw and new to the world.
Will you go there, and take my bauble? Will you offer it at the Well, where I cannot?

strings.string:
啊！那座机械教派的伟大玻璃神殿、那口神圣的奉献之井，还有石刻浮雕中的历史。那里住着银之父——以雕像与光雕之形。四周环绕着大集市。我听说那里的人比虚空中的数目还多，他们的喧哗发出一种对世界而言全然生涩而崭新的声音。
你愿意去那里，带上我的小饰物吗？愿意在井边替我献上它吗——那是我去不了的地方？

string.ID: Your bauble?
Argent Fathers?
Why can you not go?
I will make the journey.
I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能答应这件事。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned something loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻里族亲都听腻了这个故事。我当时在割藤，刀面从土里翻出了什么东西。从前见到铬也让我心动，但亲手挖出一小片碎片，在「美」的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那你去吗？在井边替我献上我的小饰物？

string.ID: Why can you not go?
What is the Six Day Stilt again?

strings.string: 六日高跷再说一遍是什么？

string.ID: I will make the journey.
I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能答应这件事。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I am no rector, understand, but They are the molders of chrome. The gods under Shekhinah who wrought metal edifices from the raw Kasaphescence.
Will you go?

strings.string:
你要明白，我不是什么教长，但他们是铬的塑成者。舍金纳之下的诸神，从原初的卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）中锻出金属的宏伟之物。
你去吗？

string.ID: Perhaps. Why?
I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能答应这件事。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I would ask you make an offering at the sacred Well of my bauble. Moon and sun, I beg you!

strings.string: 我想请你在那神圣之井边，为我这小饰物作一次奉献。月与日啊，我求你！

string.ID: Why can you not go?
What is the Six Day Stilt?
I will make the journey.
I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能答应这件事。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert, and little more in the canyons. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我会变成一堆闷烧的焦炭，被晨滑蜥的光线烤死！我会变成一具被伊萨卡里人的步枪打得满是弹孔的尸体！
大漠里没有仁慈，峡谷里更是少得可怜。我去了就活不成。

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt again?

strings.string: 六日高跷再说一遍是什么？

string.ID: I will make the journey.
I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能答应这件事。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Moon and sun, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! You have my deep and many-sided thanks. Here, take the trinket now. And if you're to ever return, let us visit again.
Live and drink!

strings.string:
月与日啊，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=！我向你致以深切而多面的谢意。来，现在就把这小玩意儿拿去吧。你若哪天回来，我们再见一面。
活下去，喝足水！

string.ID: Bey Lah is gone. I hope you're happy.
Our world is ending...
Live and drink, =name=.

Perhaps it was too much to wish that Bey Lah would change.
But Esk is happy again. That makes me feel happy too.

strings.string:
也许指望贝拉改变是奢求了。
但埃斯克又快乐起来了。那也让我觉得快乐。

string.ID: I can't imagine why you would think we want your company, kendren.

strings.string: 我想不出你凭什么觉得我们想要你作陪，外客。

string.ID: Leave us alone.
Thank you for what you've done for our sister.

strings.string: 谢谢你为我们姐妹做的事。

string.ID: If you've nothing you need of me, kendren, I'd just as soon hold my peace.

strings.string: 你若对我没什么需要的，外客，我倒宁愿闭口不言。

string.ID: I suppose.
Tell me about your family.
Keh told me that Eskhind has a brother.

strings.string: 凯告诉我埃斯欣德有个兄弟。

string.ID: Who do you think stole Kindrish?

strings.string: 你认为是谁偷了金德里什（Kindrish）？

string.ID: ... did she.
Where is he? Tell me what happened to him.

strings.string: 他在哪儿？告诉我他出了什么事。

string.ID: But she doesn't, does she? Only sisters.

strings.string: 可她并没有，对吧？只有姐妹。

string.ID:
I don't like to speculate on a matter I know so little of, nor one whose outcome so dearly affects my life.
If what you want is a strongly-worded accusation based on nothing, Liihart is the sister to talk to.

strings.string:
我不喜欢对一件我所知甚少的事妄加揣测，更何况这件的结果如此深切地影响我的生活。
你若想要的是一句毫无根据、措辞严厉的指控，该去找的姐妹是莉哈特。

string.ID: That's all for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 眼下就这些。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: That's all for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 眼下就这些。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: {{emote|*Meyehind's glare turns withering for the few seconds it takes before she turns her face and body away from you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*梅耶欣德的瞪视变得枯败，持续了几秒，随后她把脸和身子都转开了。*}}

string.ID:
What's to tell? We are outcasts, pushed to the margins by our people for the crime of harmless deviance.
It's beyond perverse to call us back just so Grand-Doe can punish us further.

strings.string:
有什么好说的？我们是弃民，因为「无害的偏差」这桩罪名，被族人推到了边缘。
把我们叫回来，只为让大母鹿进一步惩罚我们，这已经悖理到了极点。

string.ID: That's all for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 眼下就这些。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Hm! No, Eskhind wrote that, but I thought she burned it.
If you return it to anyone, you should return it to her.

strings.string:
嗯！不，那是埃斯欣德写的，但我以为她烧掉了。
你若要把还给谁，就该还给她。

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with brief life.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一声悠长的鸣响。一条浅溪的河床上涌动着短暂的生命。*}}

string.ID: Tau has met her fate.

{{emote|*You tumble from the jar, your sinewy body twisting against the electric emptiness in your belly, the weight of eggs. You discover a morsel and consume it soft and delicious. You will spawn here. You will eat the morsels. Your babies will eat all of the morsels.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你从罐子里翻滚而出，筋络分明的身体扭动着，抵抗腹中那电一般的空虚——那是卵的重量。你发现一小块食物，柔软而美味地把它吃下。你将在此产卵。你将吃那些食物。你的孩子们将吃光所有的食物。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.
{{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with life and death, nature's self-consuming ouroboros.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一声悠长的鸣响。一条浅溪的河床上涌动着生与死，自然自噬的衔尾之环。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Wielding an oversized jar in little hands, a child tips it into the running current of a softly burbling creek. Tiny creatures that had been living in the jar spill into the creek, protected from the killing current by a clump of slimy biofilm. The child peers at a little fry swimming in the jar.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一双小手捧着一只过大的罐子，孩子把它倾入一条汩汩低语的溪流。原本住在罐里的微小生物涌入溪中，靠一团黏滑的生物膜避开那致命的水流。孩子凑近看着罐中游动的一尾小鱼。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

{{emote|*From the banks of a shallow creek, you watch a toad floating on the water, belly up. It flails, helpless against even the gentle current of the water in which you placed it seconds ago. You watch it float away, toward the rushing currents ahead.
Helpless to myriad unknowable fates, the toad disappears from view into the rapids, sent there by your hand.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*从一条浅溪的岸上，你看着一只蟾蜍肚皮朝上浮在水面。它挣扎着，连几秒前你把它放进去的那道缓流都无法抗拒。你看着它漂走，漂向前方湍急的水流。
无力抗拒无数不可知的命运，那只蟾蜍消失在你视线之外的急流里——是被你的手送去的。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.
{{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with life and death, nature's self-consuming ouroboros.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一声悠长的鸣响。一条浅溪的河床上涌动着生与死，自然自噬的衔尾之环。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*From the mouth of the jar in your little hands, you watch a frog leap into the water of a softly burbling creek. The gentle current sweeps the frog's little body away to an unknown fate as curious crayfish peek out from their hiding places. The jar in your hands is empty.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*从小手中那只罐子的口沿，你看着一只蛙跃入一条汩汩低语的溪水。缓流把蛙的小小身躯卷向未知的命运，好奇的螯虾从藏身处探出头来。你手中的罐子空了。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

{{emote|*the chime rings*}}
{{emote|*In your mind's eye, you see yourself touching a mirror. You tap the glass and it ripples like the surface of a placid lake.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*鸣钟响起*}}
{{emote|*在你心智的视野里，你看见自己触碰一面镜子。你轻敲玻璃，它如一片平静湖面般泛起涟漪。*}}

string.ID: Your name is pronounced as the pause between two words, friend. How do I know this?

strings.string: 你的名字读作两个词之间的停顿，朋友。我怎么会知道这个？

string.ID: Tell me of gyredream.

{{emote|*The moment stretches on into a steep asymptote, the peaks and valleys of possible outcomes speeding by in an imaginary blur. You imagine the sound of a tiny metal thread brushing across the bottom of a dusty valley, amplified a thousand times.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*这一刻延展成一条陡峭的渐近线，种种可能结局的峰与谷以想象的速度模糊掠过。你想象一根细小的金属丝擦过一座尘谷的底部，声音被放大了一千倍。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*the entity chimes, and you witness water lapping at the long edge of a pebble beach. Slowly, the tide brushes clean the surface of each rock, etching time's passage onto millions of tiny canvases. Somewhere, something dies.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那存在鸣响，你看见水拍打着一片卵石滩的长岸。潮水缓缓刷净每一块石头的表面，把时间的流逝镌刻在数百万幅微小的画布上。在某处，有什么死去了。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Your entire self buzzes at the sound of _'s chime, a shock from the center and radiating outward. Sensation bubbles up to the surface, a tightening of the self. It is as if cresting a great hill atop a cathedra or an oncoming witchwood overdose; the void yawns under you. Something terrible is born.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*_的鸣声让你整个自我嗡嗡作响，一道震荡自中心向外辐射。感觉涌上表层，是自我的一次收紧。如同乘着宝座登上高丘之顶，或是一场正在袭来的巫木过量；虚空在你身下张口。某种可怕的东西诞生了。*}}

string.ID: I don't understand. What could it mean?

strings.string: 我不明白。这可能意味着什么？

string.ID: Let... let us speak of other things.
Excuse... excuse me.

{{emote|*You are a little sapfly resting in the crook of a swarmshade tree. The boughs stretch in great barkish deserts before exploding into a tangle of branches. Your brethren buzz in an agitated cloud, feeling fear or excitement or hunger. Something buzzes beyond the leafy reaches of your sight, all-consuming but unclear.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你是一只小汁蝇，歇在一株群荫树的枝杈间。粗枝伸展成一片片树皮的荒漠，随后炸开成一团乱枝。你的同类在一团躁动的云雾里嗡嗡作响，感到恐惧，或兴奋，或饥饿。有某种东西在你看不见的叶幕之外嗡嗡作响，吞噬一切，却模糊不清。*}}

string.ID: I... wish to speak of other things.
I will think on this... live and drink.

strings.string: 这事我会想想……活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: {{emote|*Just as you activate an artifact listening device that ceased to exist centuries ago, you hear the end of an emotional song. The space between relief and sorrow throbs with uncomfortable tension. You ache with it.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*就在你启动一件数百年前便已不复存在的遗物听音器时，你听见一首情感之歌的结尾。释然与悲伤之间的那片空间，以令人不适的张力搏动着。你也随之作痛。*}}

string.ID:
{{B|[{{C|Voice transmitting through panel}}]}}
Be gone, wayfarer. This is no place for you.

strings.string:
{{B|[{{C|人声从面板中传出}}]}}
走开，旅人。这里不是你的地方。

string.ID: I come by way of Joppa. The elder Irudad calls me friend.

strings.string: 我从约帕（Joppa）来。长者伊鲁达称我为朋友。

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. I've come into possession of a data disk stamped with a peculiar sigil. Does this have meaning to your order of tinkers? Might you examine it?

strings.string: 等等！我叫=name=。我得到了一张数据盘，上面压着一个奇特的印记。这对你们修补匠的教团有意义吗？你们能查验一下吗？

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. I've come into possession of a data disk stamped with a peculiar sigil. Does this have meaning to your order of tinkers? Might you examine it?

strings.string: 等等！我叫=name=。我得到了一张数据盘，上面压着一个奇特的印记。这对你们修补匠的教团有意义吗？你们能查验一下吗？

string.ID: I am a merchant, cave dweller. I wish only to trade.

strings.string: 我是商人，洞穴居民。我只想做生意。

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. I bring a message from Argyve of Joppa.

strings.string: 等等！我叫=name=。我带来了约帕（Joppa）的阿尔盖夫的口信。

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. The people of =villageZeroName= recently came into possession of a data disk, onto which a strange signal was recorded. At their behest I carry the disk with me. They say your tutelage is to be my reward.

strings.string: 等等！我叫=name=。=villageZeroName=的人们最近得到了一张数据盘，上面录着一道奇怪的信号。受他们所托，我随身带着这张盘。他们说你的教导便是我的酬劳。

string.ID: [A slot opens from the center of the door and a metal tray slides out]

strings.string: 【门中央裂开一道缝，一只金属托盘滑了出来】

string.ID: [Place stamped disk in tray]
[Place scratched disk in tray]
[Place disk in tray]
Uh, I'll come back later with it.

[several minutes pass]
So you wish to study with us. Unfortunately, we require more than a willing spirit.
Qud is not =villageZeroName=. You will need to prove your worth, that you might not waste our time and efforts. Travel to the great cavern Golgotha to the north. Within its halls you will find a cache of dysfunctional waydroids.
Recover one, repair it, and return here. If we are satisfied with your work, you will be admitted to our order. Otherwise, you will not be.
Do you accept this arrangement?

strings.string:
【几分钟过去了】
所以你想随我们研习。遗憾的是，我们要求的多于一份热忱。
卡德（Qud）不是=villageZeroName=。你必须证明自己的价值，以免浪费我们的时间与心力。往北前往那处大洞窟各各他。在它的厅堂里，你会发现一批失能的道机。
取回一台，修好它，再回到此处。若我们对你的成果满意，你将被接纳进我们的教团。否则不会。
你接受这个安排吗？

string.ID: No, I'm not interested.

[several minutes pass]
The disk you bring is encoded with an important signal. To discuss it further, we must admit you to our order. Unfortunately, we require more than a willing spirit.
You will need to prove your worth, that you might not waste our time and efforts. Travel to the great cavern Golgotha to the north. Within its halls you will find a cache of dysfunctional waydroids.
Recover one, repair it, and return here. If we are satisfied with your work, you will be admitted as an apprentice. Otherwise, you will be turned away.
Do you accept this arrangement?

strings.string:
【几分钟过去了】
你带来的这张盘上编码着一道重要信号。要进一步讨论它，我们必须先接纳你进教团。遗憾的是，我们要求的多于一份热忱。
你必须证明自己的价值，以免浪费我们的时间与心力。往北前往那处大洞窟各各他。在它的厅堂里，你会发现一批失能的道机。
取回一台，修好它，再回到此处。若我们对你的成果满意，你将被接纳为学徒。否则你将被拒之门外。
你接受这个安排吗？

string.ID: No, I'm not interested.

[several minutes pass]
So it seems that you are indeed Argyve's apprentice. He wishes you to study with us. Unfortunately, we require more than a willing spirit.
Qud is not Joppa. You will need to prove your worth, that you might not waste our time and efforts. Travel to the great cavern Golgotha to the north. Within its halls you will find a cache of dysfunctional waydroids.
Recover one, repair it, and return here. If we are satisfied with your work, you will be admitted to our order. Otherwise, you will not be.
Do you accept this arrangement?

strings.string:
【几分钟过去了】
看来你确实是阿尔盖夫的学徒。他希望你来随我们研习。遗憾的是，我们要求的多于一份热忱。
卡德（Qud）不是约帕（Joppa）。你必须证明自己的价值，以免浪费我们的时间与心力。往北前往那处大洞窟各各他。在它的厅堂里，你会发现一批失能的道机。
取回一台，修好它，再回到此处。若我们对你的成果满意，你将被接纳进我们的教团。否则不会。
你接受这个安排吗？

string.ID: No, I'm not interested.
Have you completed the task?
Not yet. But I require entrance to the city for the purposes of trade.

strings.string: 还没有。但我需要进城做买卖。

string.ID: Welcome, wayfarer.
I require entrance to the city.
Enter then, traveler.

[The slot opens from the center of the door. A bright red light shines through.]
[Several minutes pass.]
You may enter. Simply walk through the force barrier. Make your first two lefts and speak to Steward Otho in his office.

strings.string:
【门中央裂开一道缝。一道鲜亮的红光透了出来。】
【几分钟过去了。】
你可以进来了。直接穿过力场屏障。头两个路口左转，去办公室找管家奥索说话。

string.ID:
I'm so excited.
Many thanks for releasing Nacham, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I believe that its presence here will provide a great mutual boon.

strings.string:
我太兴奋了。
多谢你释放了纳查姆，=factionaddress:Mopango=。我相信它在此地的存在会带来巨大的互利。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, I hear that =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= freed one of the children! I cannot wait to speak to it, but for now I must observe Nacham to see if this event hath affected it. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome to watch too.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，我听说=ifplayerplural:你们:你=释放了其中一个孩子！我迫不及待想与它交谈，但眼下我必须观察纳查姆，看此事是否影响了它。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=也欢迎一同观看。

string.ID: Live and drink, Doyoba.
Welcome, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Live and drink. =ifplayerplural:Need ye:Needest thou= a place to rest and sup? =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst= trade?

strings.string: 欢迎，=factionaddress:Mopango=。活下去，喝足水。=ifplayerplural:你们需要:你需要=个地方歇息用餐吗？=ifplayerplural:你们想:你想=做买卖吗？

string.ID: I seek a use for this repulsive device.

strings.string: 我在为这件令人厌恶的装置找个用处。

string.ID: Why are you here?
Have you a credo?
Live and drink, watcher.

I am Doyoba, proud watcher of the children of the tomb. One child in particular. Of course =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must comprehend, 'child' is but a fabricated epithet, as they are far older than we. The children are, that is.

strings.string: 我是多约巴，陵墓之子们骄傲的看守。尤其照看其中一个孩子。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=当然要明白，「孩子」只是个编出来的称呼，因为它们比我们年长得多。我是说，那些孩子们。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

We mopango watch the past, each of us a different facet. My charge is named Nacham, that which watcheth and understandeth not, that which speaketh and cannot be understood. Information floweth through Nacham as water through a sieve, mixed together beyond ken.

strings.string: 我们莫潘戈守望过去，各人守着一个不同的切面。我照看的那个名叫纳查姆——那个观看却不理解者，那个言说却不被理解者。信息穿过纳查姆如同水穿过筛子，混作一团，超出认知之外。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

I do.
"Suffering breedeth in still water."
Live and drink, watcher.

...?
=ifplayerplural:Ye ask:Thou askest= after the meaning of my credo. Wouldst I shall chew =ifplayerplural:your:thy= food for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well?

strings.string:
……？
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=在追问我的信条是什么意思。那要不要我也替=ifplayerplural:你们:你=把饭嚼了？

string.ID: I apologize for my rudeness.
No, no, =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest= not our ways and I was too harsh. I apologize, and I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

strings.string: 不，不，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=不懂我们的规矩，是我太严厉了。我道歉，我并不生=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的气。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.
By Her Light, it's ghastly. May I touch it?

strings.string: 以她的光之名，这东西真可怖。我能碰碰它吗？

string.ID: You may.
You may not.

Oh.
Well then, I suppose I have no insight for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

strings.string:
哦。
那好吧，我想我就没什么见解能给=ifplayerplural:你们:你=了。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

{{emote|*Doyoba's face scrunches in pain as ey communes with the device, before finally pushing it back into your grasp*}}
By her light, that was unpleasant. How it twisted and turned, leading me to visions of Nacham's past, scraps and flashes. I can discern only glimpses of significance. Once a creator, an innovator. Can these parts of itself return intact, under the device's influence? An thou sendest void away, hast thou lost a part of thee?

strings.string:
{{emote|*多约巴在与装置相通时痛苦地皱起脸，最后把它推回你手中*}}
以她的光之名，那真不好受。它翻搅扭转，把我引向纳查姆往昔的幻象——碎片与闪光。我只能辨出意义的吉光片羽。它曾是创造者，是革新者。在装置的影响下，它自身的这些部分能完好地回来吗？若你把虚空遣走，你是否也失去了自己的一部分？

string.ID: Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也许我们会知道。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I hope =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= confident in =ifplayerplural:your:thy= choice, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I am happy with it, to be sure.
Kah is free. It heals my heart to see it at rest. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= my thanks.

strings.string:
我希望=ifplayerplural:你们:你=对自己这个选择有信心，=factionaddress:Mopango=。就我而言，我确实为此高兴。
卡自由了。见它安歇，我的心也被治愈了。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=得我一句谢。

string.ID: You're welcome, Gyamyo. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客气，贾缪。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= truly free one of the children? I see =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=. Congratulations.
Wouldst fain see Kah free, one day. I shall have to live a while and find a way.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们真的:你真的=释放了其中一个孩子？看来=ifplayerplural:你们:你=确实做到了。恭喜。
我但愿有朝一日能见卡得自由。我得活得久一些，再寻个法子。

string.ID: Live and drink, Gyamyo.
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, welcome. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done well to survive so long in this peculiar place.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，欢迎。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=能在这么个古怪地方撑这么久，做得不错。

string.ID:
My name is Gyamyo. I am pleased to meet =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=. =ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= spoken to the other watchers? How fare they?
Well, I hope.

strings.string:
我叫贾缪。很高兴认识=ifplayerplural:你们:你=，=name=。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=跟其他看守谈过了吗？他们可好？
但愿都好。

string.ID:
I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.
Often I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.

strings.string:
我自愿来监测一头名叫卡的古老机械生物。也许=ifplayerplural:你们:你=见过它，用它那些古怪的肢足四处蹦跳。
我常常想，卡除了恐惧，还知道别的什么吗。

string.ID:
I do, and I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for asking after it.
My credo is "Reconciliation without understanding is a salt poultice."

strings.string:
有，也谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=问起它。
我的信条是：「不求解的和解，只是一剂盐敷。」

string.ID:
Oh dear.
This is the credo by which I live my life, and =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= "what does that mean?"
I cannot summarize such a thing for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. It is too great, too multifaceted.

strings.string:
哎呀。
这是我一生的信条，而=ifplayerplural:你们:你=问「那是什么意思？」
我没法为=ifplayerplural:你们:你=把这种东西概括出来。它太大了，切面太多了。

string.ID: May the future bear out =ifplayerplural:your:thy= promises.

strings.string: 愿未来印证=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=承诺。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= an object of great interest.
An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= allow, I'd fain commune with it.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=有一件极有意思的东西。
若=ifplayerplural:你们:你=允许，我但愿与它相通。

string.ID: I wouldst.
I wouldstn't.
Hm. I wonder at =ifplayerplural:your:thy= decision.

strings.string: 嗯。我对=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=决定感到好奇。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Gyamyo moves little during communion, but shivers and twitches from time to time. After a minute or so, ey returns the device to you.*}}
I am shaken. No doubt my journey wast shallow compared to Lebah's dive. But now, by my troth I say: Kah hath ever been a being of motion. Swift, kinetic, and elegant. No doubt 'twould be so if freed by yon device.

strings.string:
{{emote|*贾缪在相通时几乎不动，只是不时发抖、抽搐。约一分钟后，伊把装置还给你。*}}
我心神摇动。无疑我这一趟比莱巴那一次深潜浅得多。但如今，我以我的信义说：卡从来就是一个运动的存在。迅捷、充满动能、优雅。若被那装置释放，无疑也会如此。

string.ID:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= done a momentous thing.
I feel the stored energy of Her Light. Dagasha shall shepherd us to our uplifting. =ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= be proud.

strings.string:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=做了一件重大的事。
我能感到她之光所蓄的能量。达加莎将引领我们走向升华。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=应当自豪。

string.ID: Thank you, Yona. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，约娜。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Ah, =factionaddress:Mopango=, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= a bittersweet sight. Would fain =ifplayerplural:ye had:thou hadst= chosen Dagasha, but my Light shineth elsewhere.
Still, I hope to see more of =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= in my future. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome back, an =ifplayerplural:ye survive:thou surviveth=.

strings.string:
啊，=factionaddress:Mopango=，见到=ifplayerplural:你们:你=是苦甜参半。我但愿=ifplayerplural:你们:你=选了达加莎，可我的光照在别处。
尽管如此，我希望在我往后的日子里能多见=ifplayerplural:你们:你=几面。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=随时可以回来——只要=ifplayerplural:你们:你=还活着。

string.ID: Live and drink, Yona.
What have we here? Approach, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and be known.

strings.string: 我们这儿来了什么？上前来，=player.formalAddressTerm=，报上名来。

string.ID: =name=. Greetings. I am called Yona. =ifplayerplural:Ye seem:Thou seemest= unlike most other climbers. I wonder why.

strings.string: =name=。你好。我叫约娜。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=看起来与大多数攀登者不同。我很好奇为什么。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= seen it, out there? The spiny, eel-like creature. That is Dagasha, angry one, lost child. =ifplayerplural:Ye can:Thou canst= feel the hostility pour from it in waves.
Yet, it attacketh not.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=在外头见过它吗？那个多刺、像鳗鱼的东西。那是达加莎——愤怒者，迷失的孩子。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=能感到敌意从它身上一波波涌出。
然而它并不攻击。

string.ID: Yes. "Anyone may strike a slumberling once."

strings.string: 有。「谁都可以打沉睡兽一下。」

string.ID: Only a fool asketh after the meaning of a credo.

strings.string: 只有愚人才追问信条的含义。

string.ID: I am not offended, simply making =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= aware of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= foolishness.

strings.string: 我并未被冒犯，只是让=ifplayerplural:你们:你=意识到自己的愚行。

string.ID:
I am consumed by curiosity. How it resembleth the children in make!
May I hold the device in communion?

strings.string:
我被好奇心吞噬了。它在构造上多么像那些孩子！
我可以捧着这装置与它相通吗？

string.ID:
Ahh.
Stranger, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= cruel to withhold this experience, but I shall abide.

strings.string:
啊。
生客，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=不给这场体验，未免残忍，但我会忍着。

string.ID:
Oh wow, an animal.
Congratulations for... not dying.
... wanna buy something?

strings.string:
哦哇，一只动物。
恭喜你……没死。
……想买点什么吗？

string.ID: Are you part of this tree?

strings.string: 你是这棵树的一部分吗？

string.ID: Why are you selling goods in such a remote and dangerous place?

strings.string: 你为什么在这么偏远危险的地方卖东西？

string.ID: Don't call me "an animal."

I am Santalalotze.
... of ... the Consortium of Phyta. Some call me 'Sant', I think, in fantasy or memory.

strings.string:
我是桑塔拉洛策。
……属于……植物联盟。有人叫我「桑特」，我想是这样，在幻想里，或者记忆里。

string.ID: You don't remember?

No. Well... no, no. I don't think so.
We're just... sharing nutrients.

strings.string:
不。嗯……不，不。我想不是。
我们只是……在共享养分。

string.ID: So you're a parasite?
You don't seem sure.
May I change the subject?

Would you? Yes.
What may... can I help with?

strings.string:
你愿意？好的。
有什么我……我能帮上忙的吗？

string.ID:
'Parasite' so negative. It's like... ah... economic symbiosis?
Chavvah sustains me, and we are, I am not... them. We are in a... beneficial arrangement, you know. Yes?

strings.string:
「寄生者」太负面了。这就像……啊……经济共生（symbiosis）？
查瓦供养我，而我们是，我不是……他们。我们处于一种……互利的安排，你知道的。是吧？

string.ID: You don't seem sure about any of this.

strings.string: 你对这些看起来都不太确定。

string.ID: I'd like to ask you about something else.

It is safe here.
Business is slow, but I've... gotten attached, ahaha.

strings.string:
这里很安全。
生意冷清，但我……有了感情，啊哈哈。

string.ID:
Buy something, and I will call you 'customer'.
If I remember to.

strings.string:
买点东西，我就叫你「顾客」。
如果我记得的话。

string.ID: Are you having some memory trouble?

It's fine. I... forget nothing important.
Or, I don't remember. So no sense worrying. Right?

strings.string:
没事。我……没忘记什么重要的东西。
或者说，我不记得了。所以担心也没用。对吧？

string.ID: Perhaps being Chavvah's parasite is affecting your mind.

strings.string: 也许做查瓦的寄生者正在影响你的心智。

string.ID: I'd like to ask you about something else.

Well. Nothing... is like Chavvah. Nothing at all.
I once thought ... my haustorium carried only lifestuff. Now I am unsure. Am I of Twofirm, now?
It's fine.
Let's... change subjects.

strings.string:
嗯。没有什么……比得上查瓦。完全没有。
我曾以为……我的吸器里只输送生命质料。如今我不确定了。我现在属于双形了吗？
没事。
我们……换个话题吧。

string.ID: Quetzal! Who are you, stranger?
I must be going.
It's time to fight, =name=. Are you with me?
Quetzal, quetzal, quetzal! Welcome to the workshop, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 绿咬鹃，绿咬鹃，绿咬鹃！欢迎来到工坊，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Barathrum asked me to deliver your blueprints to Pax Klanq.

strings.string: 巴拉瑟鲁姆让我把你的图纸送给帕克斯·克兰克。

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Q Girl?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰鸣了吗，Q女郎？

string.ID: What does 'quetzal' mean?
Your hair is a quasar of red ochre and indigo.

strings.string: 你的头发是红赭与靛蓝构成的类星体。

string.ID: Do you like my goggles?
There must be a hundred gadgets here. What are you working on?

strings.string: 这里怕是有上百个小玩意儿。你在做什么？

string.ID: Otho informs me that you have a method for decoding the signal. Can you encode your instructions for the baetyl onto this disk?

strings.string: 奥索告诉我你有解码那道信号的方法。你能把给贝提尔的指令编码到这张盘上吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.
Yikes! Yes! The intensity was too great to be the result of one of my experiments. What was it, I wonder?

strings.string: 哎呀！是啊！那强度太大，不可能是我某个实验的结果。那到底是什么呢，我寻思？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

It's a word I say out of excitement. Sort of a semantic extension of the feeling I get when I see a quetzal. Oh, a quetzal is a pretty bird in the trogon family. I tend to incorporate things I like into my idiolect.

strings.string: 那是我激动时会说的一个词。算是我见到绿咬鹃时那种感觉的语义延伸。哦，绿咬鹃是咬鹃科的一种漂亮鸟。我习惯把我喜欢的东西揉进自己的个人语汇里。

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.
Quetzal! Thank you, thank you. What a poetic metaphor! You're a regular Shakesprig, aren't you?

strings.string: 绿咬鹃！谢谢，谢谢。多诗意的比喻！你可真是个莎士比亚普里格，是不是？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.
Yes, yes, yes. They are so quetzal!

strings.string: 是的，是的，是的。它们太绿咬鹃了！

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.
Live and drink, tinker.
I do, brave friend. I'll imprint them now.

strings.string: 我有，勇敢的朋友。我现在就把它们印上去。

string.ID: Thank you, Q Girl.
Thank you, Q Girl.
Be nimble, wayfarer. Take in a draught of cider before leaving.

strings.string: 机灵点，旅人。走之前喝口苹果酒。

string.ID: Why is the cider chunky?

strings.string: 这苹果酒为什么有块儿？

string.ID: Is that a Naphtaali mask over there?

strings.string: 那边是纳夫塔利面具吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, cider-friend.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，苹果酒朋友。

string.ID: I am called Erah. Branches part for you, =name=.

strings.string: 我叫埃拉。枝条为你让路，=name=。

string.ID: That'd be the mushrooms. Bit heartier, a-ye?

strings.string: 那是蘑菇。稍微顶饱些，呃？

string.ID: Why would you put mushrooms in cider?

strings.string: 你为什么往苹果酒里放蘑菇？

string.ID:
...
Bit heartier, a-ye?
Is. Was naphtaali once.
Was? Not any more?
Let us speak of something else.
Mmm. Have cider?
A-ye, quit. Lost most my minyan to goatfolk. The sower's eye fell upon us and so we fell too.

strings.string: 呃，别提了。我的祷团大半死在了羊人手里。播种者之眼落在我们身上，于是我们也倒下了。

string.ID: What is a minyan?
What became of your Godhed?

strings.string: 你们的神首后来怎么样了？

string.ID: May their memories bless you.
Let us speak of something else.

As the very canopy, they will.
Thank you.

strings.string:
如同这头顶的树冠，他们会的。
谢谢你。

string.ID: Let us speak of something else.
Live and drink, ciderer.

Pilgrims, drawn together by need and awe and inspiration. Tinkers and sodders and guards and scouts, alloyed under the pressure of lifeswork.
Family, like.

strings.string:
朝圣者，被需要、敬畏与灵感聚到一起。修补匠、焊工、守卫、斥候，在毕生志业的压力下熔成一体。
算是家人吧。

string.ID:
Don't know. Wrecked? Fled?
I crawled away, never looked back. That's the all of it.

strings.string:
不知道。毁了？逃了？
我爬走了，再没回头看。就这些。

string.ID: Strange creatures can be so cruel and arbitrary, I say in greeting.

strings.string: 陌生的生灵可以如此残忍而任性——我以此作问候。

string.ID: I see you.

I do not know how to remember beloved Tau, struggling like a minnow in Soft. In a place between death and living.
Leave me, please.

strings.string:
我不知道该如何追忆亲爱的陶——她像一尾小鱼在柔质中挣扎。在死与生之间的某处。
请让我一个人待着。

string.ID: No parting is simple. I see you, -elser.

strings.string: 没有哪一场离别是简单的。我看见你，「-不成」者。

string.ID:
And the sole tether she reached for severed. I mourn for the future she built for herself, now, and worry for Tau herself.
Thank you, all the same, for taking part in this. May you find your comfort.

strings.string: 而她伸手去够的那唯一一根系绳也断了。我为她为自己筑起的那个未来哀悼，也为陶本身担忧。

string.ID: No parting is simple. I see you, fair -elser.

strings.string: 没有哪一场离别是简单的。我看见你，美好的「-不成」者。

string.ID: Oh? A traveler? I see you, then. Live... and drink.

strings.string: 哦？一位旅人？那我看见你了。活下去……喝足水。

string.ID: Your chime is cracked and ribboned on inside with starless clouds. Why?

strings.string: 你的鸣声裂了，内里缠着没有星辰的云带。为什么？

string.ID: Were you affected by gyredream?
Oh? Please, then, friend, ask.

{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}
I am Miryam, friend.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以低沉之音鸣响。*}}
我是米里亚姆，朋友。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in long tones.*}}
It's the kriah, traveler. I am in mourning, and I chime in low tones.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以悠长之音鸣响。*}}
这是裂衣，旅人。我在服丧，所以以低音鸣响。

string.ID: I am sorry, Miryam. Did you lose someone close to you?

strings.string: 我很遗憾，米里亚姆。你失去了亲近的人吗？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}
I swim in cool and dark waters, traveler. For me, it is Shiva, the lament of seven thousand years.
I mourn the passing of all life, and all the necessity of death life must bring. For you, traveler, to come here, how many had to die? I mourn them.
Or are you the rarest one, who walks below the bright arches and claims no such cost? Even then, what losses did {{M|you}} suffer to come, traveler? What selves of yours had you to shed? Those are -else to us, and I mourn them as well.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以深沉之音鸣响。*}}
我游在清凉幽暗的水里，旅人。对我而言，这是七日丧期，一场七千年的哀歌。
我为一切生命的逝去而哀悼，也为生命必然带来的一切死亡而哀悼。旅人，为了让你来到这里，有多少人必须死去？我为他们哀悼。
又或者你正是那最稀有的一类，行走在明亮的拱顶之下，声称没有付出这样的代价？即便如此，{{M|你}}为来到这里承受了怎样的失去，旅人？你不得不蜕下多少个自我？那些对我们而言是「-不成」，我也为他们哀悼。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in aching tones.*}}
...but, too, someone close. Tau. Bright tau. She is gone.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以痛楚之音鸣响。*}}
……但也有，一个亲近的人。陶。明亮的陶。她走了。

string.ID: {{emote|*Miryam chimes in aching tones.*}}

{{emote|*Miryam chimes in melodic tones.*}}
Oh? You would finish the -elseing act?
I am your debtor, =name=. The ritual is how we organize the anguished practice of being. Now my grieving can begin.
Bright Tau shines always, here or there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以旋律之音鸣响。*}}
哦？你愿意完成这「-不成」之举？
我欠你的，=name=。这仪式是我们为存在的痛苦实践赋予秩序的方式。如今我的哀悼可以开始了。
明亮的陶永远闪耀，在此处或彼处。

string.ID: Sapience? Hey! The time goes, since I have communed last, my adornments speak. Has interstate power been declared among the Codex people?

strings.string: 有智者？嘿！ 时间流逝，自我上次相通以来，我的饰物会说话。 典录之民中已宣告了邦际之权吗？

string.ID: Who are you? What are you?
I ascended the Spindle to arrive at this place.

strings.string: 我登上纺锤（the Spindle）才抵达此处。

string.ID: What 'interstate power'? Who are the 'Codex people'?

strings.string: 什么「邦际之权」？「典录之民」是谁？

string.ID: Live and... drink?
Gathered and spun, I emerge into {{zetachrome|Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart}}. What is... what are. I cannot. Finding no entry, for the rest is at home. A strand to you.

strings.string: 聚集并旋转，我显现为{{zetachrome|经共价之心言说的离子}}。 什么是……什么是。我不能。 找不到条目，因为其余的都留在老家里了。给你一丝缕。

string.ID: Greetings, Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart. I am =name=.

strings.string: 你好，经共价之心言说的离子。我是=name=。

string.ID: I like your jewelry.
I shiver at a magnanimity long since worn! Decorate you, decorate. Your adornments fascinate also, hey! Span of time across stars shines through it.

strings.string: 我为一份久已磨损的宽宏而战栗！装饰你，装饰。 你的饰物也令我着迷，嘿！ 跨越星辰的时间跨度透过它闪耀。

string.ID: Emerges this creature from soil, speaks adornment. Shaken carefully because thought was the line closed. Our remembers at home. Strand.

strings.string: 这生灵自土壤中显现，以饰物言说。 小心地被摇动，因为思绪曾是那闭合的线。 我们的「记得」留在老家里。丝缕。

string.ID: By my adornments, it is the mat below and its home-havers. It is not? I offer a strand. This entry can be at home. Having all time and no entry-home, we addle.

strings.string: 以我的饰物为证，那是下方的垫子及其拥有家园者。 不是吗？我献上一丝缕。这个条目可以回老家。 拥有全部时间却没有条目的家，我们会昏乱。

string.ID: How long have you been here?
I must offer a strand to you. Having not this entry, for I left it at home. At smallest... more than one hundred Codex cycle. Less than ten thousand. Big span. I offer you strands for this.

strings.string: 我必须向你献上一丝缕。 没有这个条目，因为我把它留在老家里了。 最少……一百多个典录周期。不到一万。 好大的跨度。为此我向你献上丝缕。

string.ID: Hey! This one I have. Rootbound we to {{M|Star Orchid Temple}}, one of more. Here celebrate burn dust of the tail riders, mosaic innumerability.

strings.string: 嘿！这个我有。 我们盘根于{{M|星兰神殿}}，众多之一。 在此庆祝尾骑者的焚尘、镶嵌的不可胜数。

string.ID: Is there anyone else here?
For temple 'here' yes: {{zetachrome|Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart}} here. Also, you.

strings.string: 就神殿的「这里」而言，有： {{zetachrome|经共价之心言说的离子}}在这里。 还有，你。

string.ID: But is there anyone else here on the Quay?

strings.string: 但码头上还有别的什么人吗？

string.ID: Offering adornment, No entry for this. My mat is small.

strings.string: 献上饰物， 没有关于此的条目。 我的垫子很小。

string.ID:
Va'am is released. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done something great, for good or ill.
I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for this new future.

strings.string:
瓦阿姆被释放了。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=做成了一件大事——或善，或恶。
我为这个新的未来谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=. =ifplayerplural:Ye did:Thou didst= rouse a child. Well done.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=唤醒了一个孩子。做得好。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink, Dadogom.

strings.string: 谢谢。活下去，喝足水，达多戈姆。

string.ID: I am Dadogom.

I watch over Va'am. It watcheth over me. Together, we watch.
=ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= as well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Sit. Watch. Consider how =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= fare under a dome of adamant carapace.
Safe, undying, alone.

strings.string:
我看护瓦阿姆。它看护我。我们一起看护。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=也该如此，=factionaddress:Mopango=。坐下。看护。想想=ifplayerplural:你们:你=若身处一座坚刚甲壳的穹顶之下，会是何等境况。
安全，不死，孤独。

string.ID: "Be still and know."
I cannot think on =ifplayerplural:your:thy= behalf.
Consider =ifplayerplural:your:thy= words ere =ifplayerplural:ye say:thou sayest= them, and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= issue fewer apologies.

strings.string: 在说出口之前先掂量=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=话，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=就会少道些歉。

string.ID: Ah. May I?
Ah, pity.
What indignity have you come to heap upon the mound, whelp? Out with it.

strings.string: 你这崽子，又来给这土丘添什么羞辱？说吧。

string.ID: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?

strings.string: 你是这个自由领的创建者之一，对吧？

string.ID: I've never seen a frog of your stature.

strings.string: 我从没见过你这么大的蛙。

string.ID: What can you tell me about the Freehold?

strings.string: 关于自由领，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: This pond is peaceful.
What of it? Scurry on and leave me to brood.

strings.string: 那又怎样？快走开，让我独自郁结。

string.ID: This seems a joyful place. Why are you angry?

strings.string: 这地方看着挺快乐。你为什么生气？

string.ID: I've something else to ask

Why? A lifetime of vexation. Born to a cacophony of static ringing the ears raw. Thousands of my kinfolk cut down by that porphyric wasp fools called Lamb. A millenium of hot stinking sun and disgusting brine lice for supper.
Misery obtains on this pond, whelp. By Chavvah if you start beaming like a sunray and yodeling at the Beetle Moon, I'll eat you where you stand.

strings.string:
为什么？一辈子的烦扰。出生时耳边就是一片刺耳的静电杂音。我数千名族亲被那帮被叫作「兰姆」的紫红蜂愚人砍杀。一千年灼热发臭的太阳，晚饭是恶心的卤水虱。
这池塘上只有苦难，崽子。以查瓦之名，你若开始像道日光那样咧嘴傻笑、对着甲虫之月（Beetle Moon）唱起山歌，我就当场把你吃了。

string.ID: ...I've more to ask.
Who am I? Mak. That's all you get. I'll not waste the honey of my mouth on idle inquiries.

strings.string: 我是谁？马克。你能得到的就这些。我不会把嘴里的蜜浪费在无聊的打听上。

string.ID:
...
And? Is that the whole of your fool statement?

strings.string:
……
还有呢？你那些蠢话就这些？

string.ID: I'll ask something else.
Trust what you hear of the svardym, whelp. The sky blackens at our accession and we are like to eat you.

strings.string: 崽子，关于斯瓦迪姆的传言，你尽可信。我们登位之时天空会变黑，而我们会吃了你。

string.ID: Have the adiyy chewed the hue from your eyes? See for yourself. Free folk make a gathering here and their racket rings through the reef. One can hardly steep in his greens without being mewled to by a salt-stung baby.

strings.string: 是阿迪伊把你眼睛里的颜色嚼掉了吗？你自己看。自由之民在此聚集，他们的喧嚷响彻整片礁区。想在自己的绿荫里泡一会儿都难，总有被盐水蜇过的娃娃冲你喵喵叫。

string.ID: It was once.
What happened?
Whelp, affix your eyes to that clam right yonder. Go step inside and find your answers.

strings.string: 崽子，把眼睛盯住那边那只蛤蜊。走进去，自己找答案。

string.ID:
{{emote|*long, smoky croak*}}
Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, here at last. Sit. Smoke. Rest.

strings.string:
{{emote|*一声悠长、烟熏般的呱鸣*}}
啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，终于来了。坐。抽烟。歇息。

string.ID: Sorry, have we already spoken?

strings.string: 抱歉，我们之前说过话吗？

string.ID: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?

strings.string: 你是这个自由领的创建者之一，对吧？

string.ID: I can't help but notice your impressive stature, even in repose.

strings.string: 我忍不住注意到你这副惊人的体格，哪怕是在静息时。

string.ID:
Ayup. But seconds ago. As only yesterday, no? Hoh hoh hoh.
{{emote|*continued croaking laughter*}}

strings.string:
是啊。就在几秒前。就像只是昨天，不是吗？呵呵呵。
{{emote|*呱鸣的笑声继续*}}

string.ID: Ah. Well. Let's talk about something else, then.

strings.string: 啊。嗯。那我们就聊点别的吧。

string.ID: Oh, very funny. Live and drink.

strings.string: 哦，真好笑。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Greetings, Geeub. I am =name=.

{{emote|*croaking sigh*}}
Congratulation, condolence, which ever. Mind and name slip by another.

strings.string:
{{emote|*一声呱鸣的叹息*}}
恭喜也好，节哀也好，随你。心智与名字，彼此擦身而过。

string.ID:
So large? Hoh hoh. Well. Hatchlings, so rage-dense. Size diffuses, no?
However. Mak diverges, hoh hoh. Egg-rage simmers on a greater pot. Our voice eld-feeble, close your ears to it. Hoh hoh hoh.

strings.string:
这么大？呵呵。嗯。小崽们，怒气那么密实。体型会把它稀释，不是吗？
不过。马克是个例外，呵呵。蛋里的怒气在一口更大的锅里煨着。我们的声音老迈虚弱，你们把耳朵闭上吧。呵呵呵。

string.ID:
Sun we once blotted out nestles our horizon. We tend thought-seeds with algae, wrap in crysteel, bathe in arc-light. Build, live, fight.
Here as elsewhere, grow is struggle. Fun to watch, no? Hoh. Hoh.

strings.string:
我们曾遮蔽的太阳，如今安卧在我们的地平线上。我们用藻类培育思想之种，用冰钢包裹，在弧光中沐浴。建造、生活、争斗。
此处与别处一样，生长即挣扎。看着好玩，不是吗？呵呵。呵。

string.ID: Yes, we were present, if less active than other-bodies. But we saw, and rattle with memory-artifacts as a Consortium lockbox rattles with jewels; shards of an eon-old data disk, bits of stories and places. Kin-fleeing, louse-meals, ghastly boredom. But Fate's caprice brought us through history's footsteps. There was a machine-speaker, and her ursine apprentice with his little plant, and the Sower with a tetrad of chubby whelps, and then, at last, Many-Eyes. Our dear galgal. So many.

strings.string: 是的，我们在场，只是不如别的躯体活跃。但我们看见了，而且浑身哗啦作响地装着记忆的遗物，就像植物联盟的保险匣里哗啦作响地装着宝石：一张亿万年之久的数据盘的碎片，故事与地方的零零碎碎。逃避亲族、以虱为食、可怕的无聊。但命运的任性带着我们穿过了历史的足迹。有一位机械言者，和她那带着小盆栽的熊族学徒，还有带着四个圆胖小崽的播种者，最后，终于，「众眼」。我们亲爱的加尔加尔。那么多。

string.ID: But alas. Like our sea-grape friend's lockbox, these memories are not mine to retrieve at will. They come and go, and may be warped by eld.

strings.string: 但可惜。就像我们那位海葡萄朋友的保险匣，这些记忆不是我随意就能取出的。它们来来去去，还可能被岁月扭歪。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous and faint, its light flickering.*}}
Please… no…

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟的声音怨诉而微弱，它的光在闪动。*}}
求你了……不要……

string.ID: It ignores the monster. It ignores it. It ignores it.

strings.string: 它无视那怪物。它无视它。它无视它。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous.*}}
The light shines upon you but illuminates nothing. It quails.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟的声音怨诉地响着。*}}
光照在你身上，却什么也照不亮。它在畏缩。

string.ID: It stares into the light and wishes away the monster.

strings.string: 它盯着光，用愿望把那怪物驱走。

string.ID: Relief, relief. Relief from the void, safety from its creases.

strings.string: 宽慰，宽慰。从虚空中得来的宽慰，从它的褶皱中得来的安全。

string.ID:
The light shines so bright, the voidshadow folds not upon it. It exults. It relaxes. It wills this troubled feeling away.
Thank you for clearing Tau's path, =name=. This is better.

strings.string:
光照得那么亮，虚空之影覆不到它身上。它欢欣。它松弛。它用意志把这烦扰的感觉赶走。
