谢谢你为陶清出道路，=name=。这样更好。

string.ID: It is happy, it lies. It swells to witness Tau's choice, in pantomime of shared joy.

strings.string: 它很快乐，它在撒谎。它鼓胀起来见证陶的选择，以默剧演出一份共享的喜悦。

string.ID:
It wills this troubled feeling away. It looks to the light with something in its eyes. It tries to blink the something away, but it cannot. The light is dim through the something in its eyes.
But the light yet shines. It will blink and it will see the light in searing glory. I thank you, I thank you, I thank you.

strings.string:
它用意志把这烦扰的感觉赶走。它望向光，眼里有某种东西。它想眨掉那东西，却眨不掉。透过眼里的那东西，光变得黯淡。
但光仍在照。它会眨眼，然后它会看见那光灼人的荣耀。我谢你，我谢你，我谢你。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long, clarion tone.*}}
You are as beautiful as imagined. You ring with a shining purpose. This chime is awed to bask in your presence.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟发出一声悠长清亮的音。*}}
你与想象中一样美。你鸣响着一种闪亮的目的。这口鸣钟能在你面前沐浴，深感敬畏。

string.ID: Your chime shines with such painful light.

strings.string: 你的鸣钟照着如此痛楚的光。

string.ID: Yes. It looks into the light with you.

strings.string: 是的。它与你一同望向那光。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings again*}}
It is called Tikva, low and humble. The chime rests in a web of strong love, a little piece of something greater and so much more beautiful. As are you, but a gestalt unto yourself. A world to be orbited.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟再次响起*}}
它名叫提克瓦，卑微而低微。这口鸣钟安歇在一张强烈爱意的网里，是某种更宏大、也美得多的东西的一小块。你也一样，只是你自己就是一个完形。一个值得环绕的世界。

string.ID: It channels the breathtaking things seen and heard and known. Bathe your senses in it until they grow accustomed. You will see nothing else.

strings.string: 它导引着所见、所闻、所知中那些令人屏息之物。把你的感官浸在里面，直到它们习惯。你将看不见别的任何东西。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings, a querulous and tinny sound*}}
It... can scarce find the dream in this light. It thinks of Tzedech and weeps. It was not here, last time the static was in high pitch, but it remembers the pain and fear. It is not ready to feel these, it cannot. Gaze into its light and speak not of nightmares.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟响着，一种怨诉而尖薄的音*}}
它……在这光里几乎找不到那场梦。它想到特泽德赫，然后哭泣。上一次静电高鸣时它不在这里，但它记得那痛苦与恐惧。它还没准备好去感受这些，它做不到。望向它的光，不要谈论噩梦。

string.ID: 'Your' Tzedech?
Live and drink, =name=. Any news from Red Rock?

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，=name=。红岩那边有消息吗？

string.ID: Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me.

strings.string: 有。我找到了那害兽，还有些被啃过的水藤。我带着一具尸体回来。

string.ID: None yet.
Taste what on the wind today, =name=?
Moon and sun, =name=.
I can taste lime, =name=. And mayhaps gallium?

strings.string: 我尝到石灰味，=name=。也许还有镓？

string.ID: Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 哎，除害英雄！活下去，喝足水，=name=。

string.ID: A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.

strings.string: 水之手？哎。活下去，喝足水，旅人。

string.ID: I am called =name=.
Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?

strings.string: 能讲讲你们的村子约帕（Joppa）吗？

string.ID: Mehmet, the tongue says. Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 舌头说，叫穆罕默德。活下去，喝足水，=name=。

string.ID: Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here.

strings.string: 沼泽怀抱里的一片水藤田。你吸过藤饼里的水分吧，嗯？我们在这儿照看这植物。

string.ID:
Wind off the Great Desert cools a touch and gives up moisture. Just enough. A tongue can taste a hundred kinds of wind, y'know?
Anywhile, that's where my wandering mind goes. More's about Joppa I say speak to our Elderfriend. Irudad. Up northwise the path.

strings.string:
从大漠吹来的风凉上那么一点，就吐出水分。刚刚够。舌头能尝出一百种风，你知道吗？
反正，我胡思乱想就到这儿。约帕（Joppa）还有更多可说的，去问我们的长者朋友伊鲁达。沿路往北。

string.ID:
Aye? I have it, then.
Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.
I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock...

strings.string:
哎？那我有活给你。
甲虫之月（Beetle Moon）前后，有什么东西在吃我们的水藤。库-鲁恩说他见过一只蜘蛛样的生物，在盐水里潜行。可没有哪个洞穴蜘蛛敢靠看守的地盘那么近。
我在水洼里尝到一点红色碎屑。页岩，跟我们红岩边上土里的那种一样……

string.ID:
Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.
Kill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand.

strings.string:
去跑一趟，行吗？去红岩。就在约帕（Joppa）往北约两帕拉桑（parasang）。
把那害兽杀了，带一具尸体回来，好看看它是什么东西。之后长者会付你酬劳的，水之手。

string.ID:
Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses.*}}
Don't like the look o' that thing. Best bring it to Elder. Hut's northwise up the path.

strings.string:
哦？哦。{{emote|*穆罕默德停顿。*}}
我不喜欢那东西的样子。最好把它带给长者。他的棚屋沿路往北。

string.ID: Live and eat honey.
Oh, look. It is a not-bear. Greetings, not-bear.

strings.string: 哦，看。这是一只非熊。你好，非熊。

string.ID: Live and drink, little friend.
I would enjoy some honey.
{{emote|*heavy sigh*}}
Oh my, what a cute not-bear. Greetings, cute not-bear.

strings.string: 哎呀，多可爱的一只非熊。你好，可爱的非熊。

string.ID: Hmm. Oh! Greetings.
Excuse me.
Oh. Live and drink, not-bear.
I cannot decide which I like best: berries, meat, or honey? I simply cannot decide.

strings.string: 我决定不了自己最喜欢哪样：浆果、肉，还是蜂蜜？我就是决定不了。

string.ID: Glowfish are not the tastiest food, but they are the prettiest.

strings.string: 光鱼不是最好吃的食物，但它们是最漂亮的。

string.ID: I once traveled over a mountain, believing I would see something that I had not seen before once past the summit. I was disappointed to find that the other side of the mountain bore a striking resemblance to the one I'd just left. What is the purpose of mountains?

strings.string: 我曾翻过一座山，以为过了山顶就能看见我从未见过的东西。结果我很失望：山的另一面与我刚离开的那一面惊人地相似。山的意义是什么？

string.ID: Live and eat honey, bear friend.

Live and =player.formalAddressTerm=!
{{emote|*self-conscious rkkk*}}
Dr... drink and =player.formalAddressTerm=!
Krka, me. Krka.

strings.string:
活下去，还有=player.formalAddressTerm=！
{{emote|*自觉失言的呱咕*}}
喝……喝足水，还有=player.formalAddressTerm=！
克兰卡，我。克兰卡。

string.ID: Are you svardym?
Why are you dressed like an apothecary?

strings.string: 你为什么穿得像个药剂师？

string.ID: What do you think of the Freehold?
Live and drink, Krka.

{{emote|*gweep!*}}
Krka, me!

Vardy! Yes.
But. Gemtle? No kill.

strings.string:
瓦迪！是的。
但。温和？不杀。

string.ID: Why aren't you aggressive too?

Hatchling hungry. Angry. Angry-hungry.
Kill, eat, don't eaten. Calm down evengefully.

strings.string:
小崽饿。凶。凶饿。
杀，吃，别被吃。报完仇就冷静。

string.ID:
{{emote|*chirp!*}}
Poth carry!
Yes, apothecary. Do you know what those are?

strings.string: 对，药剂师。你知道那是什么吗？

string.ID:
{{emote|*several moments of softly creaking thought*}}
G-good!

strings.string:
{{emote|*片刻轻柔吱嘎的思考*}}
好、好！

string.ID: Just... good?
It's all right. You seem to like it here.

strings.string: 没关系。你看起来喜欢这里。

string.ID:
{{emote|*krka!*}}
Yes! To like! But... never home else. So {{emote|*reep?*}}.

strings.string:
{{emote|*呱咔！*}}
是！喜欢！但……从没别的家。所以{{emote|*咿？*}}。

string.ID: Care you to trade?
I aggress not.
You peaceful, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
Wish trade?
Good scavenge?
Ah! You seem wanderer. How fare?

strings.string: 啊！你像是游荡者。过得如何？

string.ID: Live and grow, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
=player.FormalAddressTerm=, I greet in peace.
Greet, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
I am of slynth, a people grown by hydropon.

strings.string: 我属斯林斯，由水培城培育出的族群。

string.ID: What are slynth?
What is a hydropon?

What see. Leg plant, glow crest.
Grow from sun-crungled hydropon and depart siblings.

strings.string:
你所见。腿是植物，冠会发光。
从日晒蜷缩的水培城里长出，然后离开同胞。

string.ID: What is a hydropon?

Cradle glaze in sun-melt. Plant stuff molded to man-shape.
Within grow slynth. Only slynth, now.

strings.string:
培育槽的釉在日光里熔了。植物材料被塑成人形。
里面长出斯林斯。如今只有斯林斯。

string.ID: Where is the hydropon?
What are slynth?

The cracked egg from we crawl yet rest, in the Reef.
Siblings there. One speak very well: Thah.

strings.string:
我们爬出来的那只裂壳仍在礁区安放着。
同胞在那里。有一个说得很好：塔赫。

string.ID: Perhaps I shall visit. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也许我会去看看。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: {{emote|*nods mutely*}}
Shh. Listen.
I am peaceful.
Any dangers?
{{emote|*ignores you*}}
Let's not linger together.
May the Eaters gift you.
Scrap for goods?
I might be willing to trade.
{{emote|*shakes =pronouns.possessive= head*}}
{{emote|*puts a finger to =pronouns.possessive= lips*}}
I'm armed. Don't try anything.
{{emote|*tenses as you approach*}}
Found anything good?
Finders keepers.
Lot of good stuff down here. Lots of bad stuff too.

strings.string: 下面好东西很多。坏东西也很多。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

Live and learn, wanderer. Have you come across any books or scrolls in your travels? Do you care to donate one to the cathedral library? Whenever you return, you may speak to me and read anything you've donated.

strings.string: 活下去，学下去，游荡者。你旅途中有没有遇到什么书籍或卷轴？可愿意捐一本给主教座堂的图书馆？你每次回来，都可以找我，阅读你捐赠过的任何东西。

string.ID: Where is the library?
What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?

strings.string: 在这盐窝里，图书馆有什么用？在这被野草勒死、被辉光毒害的沼泽里，又有什么用？囤一批割藤刀，岂不更实用？

string.ID: Not today. Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 今天不了。活下去，喝足水，编年史官。

string.ID: You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?

strings.string: 你觉得他们会在高跷场这儿的信众中间繁茂起来？

string.ID: This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular. But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them.

strings.string: 高跷场收容难民，这不是头一回了，=name=；而且说清楚：这是教会的重担，尤其是传道师与护教者。但你的话在我们心中回荡，如在我们廊道里回荡一样响。我们当中有些人会把斯林斯看作蒙选者中的蒙选者；只要我先去跟他们说，其余人就会把它当作舍金纳的旨意。这话说得也未必错。去告诉斯林斯：机械教派会接纳他们。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Sheba.

I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.

strings.string: 我无意轻慢这些斯林斯人，=name=；但高跷场从前收容过难民，那对我们的管事们是沉重的负担。我们的资源与空间都很有限，我只能请你为他们另寻一个家。愿卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）在此事上照彻他们，也照彻你。

string.ID: =name=, bless you. Have you brought tidings of the slynth?

strings.string: =name=，愿你得福。你带来斯林斯的消息了吗？

string.ID:
Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!
I can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?

strings.string: 赞美舍金纳，=name=，你那些斯林斯朋友勤快又学得快！

string.ID: My thanks, chronicler.

Live and learn, =name=.
The slynth are settling in as folk do. I see some flank the Priests and Catechists with empty eye, but some have proven hungry for knowledge. I have established a weekly Canticle study group, and its numbers grow each meeting.
Praise be to Shekhinah for this meeting, =name=.

strings.string:
活下去，学下去，=name=。
斯林斯正像常人那样安顿下来。我看到有些人对司祭与传道师投以空洞的目光，但也有些人对知识如饥似渴。我办了一个每周的《颂歌》研读小组，每次聚会人数都在增加。
为这次相聚赞美舍金纳，=name=。

string.ID: My thanks again, chronicler.

Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places.

strings.string: 哦，我们才刚建起它的第一阶段。这些年来教会积攒了一批极好的抄本。荣耀的舍金纳——愿赞美归于祂——赐给了我们好几处窖藏。隐修士们在缮写室里日夜誊抄，而我自己则担起了向旅人恳求的差事，因为最稀有的发现往往来自最不可能的地方。

string.ID: I will donate a book.
What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?

strings.string: 在这盐窝里，图书馆有什么用？在这被野草勒死、被辉光毒害的沼泽里，又有什么用？囤一批割藤刀，岂不更实用？

string.ID: Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，编年史官。

string.ID:
You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.
To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.
The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do.

strings.string:
你和我族亲、以及好几位司祭一样悲观。我的心听见你了，但请听我的话，也许你也会渐渐与我有同样的感受。
贬低智慧，就是贬低卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）。她在虚空中照耀，折射光芒，照亮她周遭的一切。我们长辈留下的文字智慧也是如此。
铬的机械在它的神性中是复杂的。我们对它一无所知、对过去一无所知、对未来一无所知，岂不是愧对我们的父辈？我们难道不配享有知晓的喜悦？愿埃舍尔施塔特二世——首位圣子——受福，因为他与我想的一样。

string.ID: I will donate a book.
Where is the library?
Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，编年史官。

string.ID: Friend! Guns? Knives? Hats? Cucumbers?
You're a member of the Consortium of Phyta, right? What do you know about the Earl of Omonporch?

strings.string: 你是植物联盟的成员，对吧？关于奥蒙波奇伯爵，你知道什么？

string.ID: What are you? What's your story?

strings.string: 你是什么？你有什么来历？

string.ID: I'm Yurl, chandler and Consortium notary. As for my story, I've been growing out of this pot for a while now. Before that, I was in another pot.

strings.string: 我是尤尔，杂货商兼植物联盟的公证人。至于我的来历，我在这只盆里长出来已经有一阵子了。在那之前，我在另一只盆里。

string.ID:
Yes, the Consortium of Phyta. We're a merchant fellowship of trees, vines, shrubs, weeds, flowers, herbs, cacti, algae -- most sorts of plants, really.
I can't say I trust any of them, but there is no doubting their usefulness. My shelves are full and the gossip flows.

strings.string:
是的，植物联盟。我们是一个商贾团体：树、藤、灌木、野草、花、香草、仙人掌、藻类——真的，差不多各类植物都有。
我不能说我信任他们中的任何一个，但他们的用处毋庸置疑。我的货架是满的，闲话是通的。

string.ID: What about fungi?

{{emote|*Yurl flicks a leaf in displeasure.*}}
What about fungi?

strings.string:
{{emote|*尤尔不快地弹了一下叶子。*}}
真菌怎么了？

string.ID: Are there any fungi in the Consortium?
Let's change the subject.

I am a gentleplant, -friend-. Uncross your roots and figure it out.
Live and DRINK.

strings.string:
我是株温和的植物，「朋友」。把你的根松开，自己想明白。
活下去，喝足水——足水！

string.ID:
Asphodel the socialite? Asphodel the scoundrel? You can hate xym -- and I do -- but you have to admire xym (I don't).
The truth of it is that Plysago had the idea first, to lay claim to the Spindle per some precedent of law established in Abram's time. Of course, Plysago isn't around to make their case, are they?

strings.string:
社交名流阿斯福德勒？无赖阿斯福德勒？你可以恨伊——我也恨——但你不得不佩服伊（我不佩服）。
实情是，最初是普利萨戈的主意：依亚伯兰时代立下的某条法律先例，对纺锤（the Spindle）提出所有权主张。当然，普利萨戈如今不在了，没法替自己申辩，对吧？

string.ID: How can I convince Asphodel to lease the Spindle to Barathrum?

strings.string: 我怎样才能说服阿斯福德勒把纺锤（the Spindle）租给巴拉瑟鲁姆？

string.ID:
Asphodel trades on reputation and favors. Xe is likely to want to leverage your connections, so be in good social standing with a few factions for xem to even consider it.
Now, alternatively, if you're loved by the Consortium, xe will feel the pressure to acquiesce. Xe has enough enemies among phyta.
Of course, where all else fails, you can always sharpen your shears, if you get my meaning.
{{emote|*Yurl winks with one of their leaves.*}}

strings.string:
阿斯福德勒靠名声与人情做生意。伊多半想利用你的人脉，所以你得在几个派系里都有好名声，伊才会考虑。
另一条路：你若受植物联盟爱戴，伊就会感到压力而让步。伊在植物中间树敌够多了。
当然，别的法子都不行时，你总可以把剪子磨快——你懂我的意思。
{{emote|*尤尔用一片叶子朝你眨眼。*}}

string.ID: I see. Live and drink, Yurl.

strings.string: 我明白了。活下去，喝足水，尤尔。

string.ID:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=! You have my deepest gratitude. Few =player.personTerm|pluralize= could have defended Grit Gate so deftly.
Now, give me time to assess our losses and consult with Barathrum. Return soon.

strings.string:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=！我向你致以最深切的谢意。少有=player.personTerm|pluralize=能如此干练地守住砂砾门。
现在，给我些时间评估损失、与巴拉瑟鲁姆商议。尽快回来。

string.ID: Live and drink, Otho.
Given the circumstances, this is a remarkable lack of destruction. Your defense of Grit Gate was first-class, =name=.

strings.string: 就当时的情形而言，破坏程度之低已属难得。你对砂砾门的防守是一流的，=name=。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.
Much was lost, but such is what I expected. Once again, thank you for efforts, =name=.

strings.string: 损失惨重，但这在预料之中。再次感谢你的努力，=name=。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.
Such tremendous loss. I wonder if more could have been done to prevent it.

strings.string: 损失如此之大。我在想，是否本可以做更多来防止它。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.
Yes, =name=?
Live and drink, steward.
Be straightforward, disciple. You mean to ask if we will house them.

strings.string: 直说吧，门徒。你想问的是我们会不会收容他们。

string.ID: I am uncertain that you know the enormity of what you ask me, =name=. Nonetheless, I cannot deny what you have done for our order. These slynth must be tested as you were, but should they show the mettle and drive set by your example, we will accept them as apprentices.

strings.string: 我不确定你是否明白你向我求的是何等大事，=name=。尽管如此，我不能否认你为本教团所做的一切。这些斯林斯必须像你一样接受考验；但若他们展现出由你树立的胆识与干劲，我们会接纳他们为学徒。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Otho.
You have grown bold beyond your station. What you have asked of us you have not earned. If you must ask again, become worthier first.

strings.string: 你的胆量已经超出了你的身份。你向我们求的东西，你还没挣到。若你非问不可，先让自己更配得上。

string.ID: Has this slynth situation been settled yet?

I did not expect to admit this, disciple, but the refugees have met my expectations. Like you, they have shown more than a willing spirit in work and curiosity both.
The slynth have promise, and you may have been right to bring them to us.

strings.string:
我没想到自己会承认这一点，门徒，但这些难民达到了我的期望。像你一样，他们在工作与好奇心两方面都表现出了远超一份热忱的东西。
斯林斯有前途，你把他们带来给我们，也许是对的。

string.ID: My thanks, Otho.

Live and drink, disciple.
You will be pleased to know that the slynth have proven themselves worthy of apprentice status. They will reside here for as long as they uphold and serve the tenets of our order.

strings.string:
活下去，喝足水，门徒。
你会高兴知道，斯林斯已证明自己配得学徒身份。只要他们维护并遵行本教团的信条，就可以在此居住。

string.ID: My thanks again, Otho.
Welcome to Omonporch, traveler. Enjoy your visit to my earldom. Feast your eyes upon my tall and glorious Spindle. Take in the scent of roasted musa.

strings.string: 欢迎来到奥蒙波奇，旅人。祝你在我的伯爵领过得愉快。尽情饱览我那高耸荣耀的纺锤（the Spindle）吧。也闻一闻烤芭蕉的香气。

string.ID: Are you truly the Earl of Omonporch?

strings.string: 你真是奥蒙波奇的伯爵？

string.ID: Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumites request your permission to lease control of the Spindle. Their inquiries into the past have led them here.

strings.string: 阿斯福德勒伯爵，巴拉瑟鲁姆派请求你许可他们租借纺锤（the Spindle）的控制权。他们对往昔的探究把他们引到了这里。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.
Indubitably, for I've proclaimed it so! There was no Earl to tell me otherwise.

strings.string: 毋庸置疑，因为是我亲自宣告的！当时并没有别的伯爵来反驳我。

string.ID: Lease control of my Spindle, you say? Well, well... That's a colossal request. There's no simple price I can assign to such a thing. Were I to grant such a request, you would owe me a great debt. You and several of your allies.

strings.string: 租借我纺锤（the Spindle）的控制权，你说？哎呀，哎呀……这可是个天大的请求。这种事我开不出简单的价码。我若准了这请求，你就欠我一笔重债。你，还有你的好几位盟友。

string.ID: So you say. How can I appease you?

strings.string: 既然你这么说。我怎样才能让你满意？

string.ID: I will convene a council. The First Council of Omonporch. Send word to four of your allied factions. Have them send delegates. Together, perhaps, you can appease me.

strings.string: 我会召开一次议事会。奥蒙波奇第一次议事会。给你的四个盟友派系送信，让他们派代表来。你们合起来，也许就能让我满意。

string.ID: Hear me, Asphodel. I am a dear friend to the Consortium. I ask that you reconsider.

strings.string: 听我说，阿斯福德勒。我是植物联盟的挚友。我请你重新考虑。

string.ID: Convene the council, then. I am willing.

strings.string: 那就召开议事会吧。我愿意。

string.ID: Not today, Asphodel. Live and drink.

strings.string: 今天不了，阿斯福德勒。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Oh... oh! It's you! You are a dear friend, indeed. Of course, of course! You and your bear friends are most welcome to my Spindle.

strings.string: 哦……哦！是你！你确实是位挚友。当然，当然！你和你的熊朋友们都极其欢迎使用我的纺锤（the Spindle）。

string.ID: You are kind, Earl Asphodel. You have my thanks.

strings.string: 你真好心，阿斯福德勒伯爵。多谢你。

string.ID: Greetings, my viceroy. Sit your rump on a cushion or lie your long back on a kline. Soak in the natural light.

strings.string: 问候你，我的总督。把你的屁股搁在垫子上，或者把你那长背躺到榻上去。尽情沐浴在自然光里吧。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

That's right. I've leased your friends the Spindlegrounds and appointed you viceroy to oversee their operation.
Welcome to court, asphodelyte. You serve at my pleasure.

strings.string:
没错。我把纺锤（the Spindle）场地租给了你的朋友们，并任命你为总督，监管他们的运作。
欢迎入朝，阿斯福德勒的信徒。你供职全凭我高兴。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.
Oh joy, another meat-being. Please tell me you're here to buy something.

strings.string: 哦，太好了，又一个血肉之躯。求求你告诉我，你是来买东西的。

string.ID: I am =name=. You are?
You're being a bit rude.
I suppose I'll be leaving, then.

I am Sixshrew, a merchant from the Consortium of Phyta disinclined to waste xyr time on talkative strangers.
I sell things, and you can buy them. I would in fact strongly encourage you to buy them, or be on your way.

strings.string:
我是六鼩，植物联盟的商人，不乐意把时间浪费在爱闲聊的生客身上。
我卖东西，你可以买。事实上我强烈建议你买，或者赶紧上路。

string.ID: Why are you called Sixshrew?
I'll be on my way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我这就走。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Why are you called pest?
I'm not...
Because I am a pest?

You are now.
Are you going to buy something, pest?

strings.string:
现在是了。
你要买东西吗，害虫？

string.ID: I'm all set. Live and drink, rude one.

strings.string: 我不需要了。活下去，喝足水，无礼的家伙。

string.ID:
Just so.
Would you like to buy something, pest?

strings.string:
正是如此。
你想买点什么吗，害虫？

string.ID: I'm all set. Live and drink, rude one.

strings.string: 我不需要了。活下去，喝足水，无礼的家伙。

string.ID:
You're being a bit annoying, so I suppose both of us have our burdens to bear.
Perhaps we should do some trading and move on with our lives, hmm?

strings.string:
你有点烦人，所以我想我们俩各有各的苦要吃。
也许我们该做点买卖，然后各自回去过日子，嗯？

string.ID: I'll skip to the last part. Live and drink, rude one.

strings.string: 我直接跳到最后一个环节。活下去，喝足水，无礼的家伙。

string.ID:
Oh, I'm fine, fine.
I simply adore being assigned this stinking backwater musa grove after decades of service, unceremoniously dumped in an office next to a fleshy tinker who works day and night, making all manner of racket through the thinnest, most conductive walls ever crafted.
What is it humans say? "Living the dreen?" Yes, I am living the dreen.

strings.string:
哦，我很好，很好。
我简直太喜欢在服务几十年之后被派到这个发臭的穷乡僻壤芭蕉林了，毫不客气地被丢进一间办公室，隔壁就是个日夜干活的血肉修补匠，隔着一堵史上最薄、最导音的墙，弄出各式各样的噪音。
人类怎么说来着？「过着德里恩的日子」？是的，我正过着德里恩的日子。

string.ID: I'll be on my way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我这就走。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Come. Browse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=!
I see my wares catch your eye, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They can be yours.

strings.string: 我看我的货抓住你的眼了，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们可以归你。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
I have what you need, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, thank the Eaters that you have found Qud's only honest shopkeep.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，感谢食者（the Eaters），你找到了卡德（Qud）唯一诚实的店主。

string.ID: On my honor, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my goods are of only the highest quality and I offer a fair trade.

strings.string: 以我的名誉起誓，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的货只有最高的品质，我做的买卖也公道。

string.ID: Welcome, traveler.
Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. How may I serve you today?

strings.string: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。今天我能为你效劳什么？

string.ID: Do your waterskins grow heavy, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
=player.FormalAddressTerm=, I beseech you. Enter.
Buy something, will you?
May you find shade and vittle, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Be quick about it.
By the Eaters, have you ever seen so much treasure?

strings.string: 以食者（the Eaters）之名，你见过这么多财宝吗？

string.ID: Greetings. I am =name=.
Rokhas. I ranch these here beauts.

strings.string: 罗哈斯。这些漂亮家伙是我牧的。

string.ID: This is your ranch?
Are those... giant slugs?
What do you think of the Yd Freehold?

strings.string: 你觉得伊德自由领怎么样？

string.ID: Live and drink, Rokhas.

I said I ranch these here beauts.
The Freeholders en't much for letting a body lay claim to land. En't what I'da wished for, but as the Issachari say: "Should your compass lead you to the Six Day Stilt, throw it in the well."

strings.string: 我说了，这些漂亮家伙是我牧的。

string.ID: Are you from the desert? How did you end up here?

strings.string: 你是沙漠来的？你怎么会到了这儿？

string.ID:
Lived most of m'life on a desert steppe twixt the flower fields of Qud and the M'ryee's salt pans.
I ended up here when m'snapbrain cousin played tinker with one of them coiler doodads. The less said about all that, the better.

strings.string:
我这辈子大半都住在卡德（Qud）花田与姆里伊盐田之间的荒漠草原上。
我会到这儿，是因为我那个脑子短路的表亲拿一台回弹器小玩意儿瞎鼓捣。那事说得越少越好。

string.ID: Kaleidoslugs! Beautiful slugs, they are, lovely crooners. Love em. Big ole slugs. Heh.

strings.string: 万花蛞蝓！漂亮家伙，可爱的哼唱手。我爱它们。老大的蛞蝓。嘿。

string.ID:
Is what it is. Fine enough place. I've a trade, critters, and nowheres else to go.
I en't much for grand experiments, I just got to live. Ken?

strings.string:
就是这样。地方还算不错。我有门手艺、有牲口，也没别处可去。
我不太搞什么大实验，我就是得活着。懂吗？

string.ID: Is okay?
Ahh... nervous ... excited.
Happy do not fight here.
Ah ha ha... nervous!
Stay here?
=player.FormalAddressTerm= stay also?
Strange new.
This is home.
Welcome here.
Good meeting.
Ah... good.
We chose our new home well.
Happy here.
Ha ha ha! Joyful!
Ah =player.formalAddressTerm= visit, good.
O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!

strings.string: 哦！哦！新的生命成立了吗？你不该对旧日的死亡发抖！

string.ID: When an eremite consults the teraphim and sees the eyes of Death, only the fools frets! There is Change but no Ending.

strings.string: 当隐修士请教家神像、看见死亡之眼时，只有愚人才焦躁！有变化，却没有终结。

string.ID: A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.

strings.string: 瘟疫就是烧空果核、好让浆果长出来的东西。

string.ID: O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??

strings.string: 哦，拿非利！是来赴我们的星浴吗？？

string.ID: I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.

strings.string: 我要嘴里有盐，要死眼映在辐射的黑暗里，要一只蛙做朋友。

string.ID: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...

strings.string: 哦，生命，哦，变化！拥抱我们，缠住我们……

string.ID: I can lick the flanges free of their pipe milk and hear my tongue fizzle in foam!

strings.string: 我能把那些凸缘上的管奶舔干净，听我的舌头在泡沫里嘶嘶作响！

string.ID: Girsh Agolgot! Red dusts in my nails and burning hot bubbles swell in my glands! Now I point to the future.

strings.string: 基什阿戈洛特！我的指甲缝里有红粉，我的腺体里胀起灼热的泡！现在我指向未来。

string.ID: The world stews and titrates
O, the thrill of coursing Change within. Each pump of the heart drives it deeper. Each breath a breath of new life.

strings.string: 哦，体内奔流着「变化」的那种颤栗。心脏每搏动一次，就把它推得更深。每一次呼吸都是新生命的呼吸。

string.ID: Roil with me, and bubble over. Let us exceed ourselves!

strings.string: 与我一同翻涌，沸溢而出。让我们超越自己！

string.ID: O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!

strings.string: 哦！哦！新的生命成立了吗？你不该对旧日的死亡发抖！

string.ID: When an eremite consults the teraphim and sees the eyes of Death, only the fools frets! There is Change but no Ending.

strings.string: 当隐修士请教家神像、看见死亡之眼时，只有愚人才焦躁！有变化，却没有终结。

string.ID: A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.

strings.string: 瘟疫就是烧空果核、好让浆果长出来的东西。

string.ID: O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??

strings.string: 哦，拿非利！是来赴我们的星浴吗？？

string.ID: I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.

strings.string: 我要嘴里有盐，要死眼映在辐射的黑暗里，要一只蛙做朋友。

string.ID: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...

strings.string: 哦，生命，哦，变化！拥抱我们，缠住我们……

string.ID: Do you wish for a gleaming bath, and fractal veins that pump the continuity of life?

strings.string: 你想要一场闪亮的沐浴，以及泵送生命之连续的分形血管吗？

string.ID: You've a twin across the boundary of the future, where new life blooms in rot. Are you with them?

strings.string: 在未来的边界之外，你有一个孪生者——那里新生命在腐朽中绽放。你站在他们那边吗？

string.ID: Would you kill your double? Would you let it kill you?

strings.string: 你会杀了你的复制体吗？你会让它杀了你吗？

string.ID: It is to witness the scalpel parting tissue. The beauty of division and resection.

strings.string: 那就是目睹手术刀剖开组织。分割与切除之美。

string.ID: O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!

strings.string: 哦！哦！新的生命成立了吗？你不该对旧日的死亡发抖！

string.ID: A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.

strings.string: 瘟疫就是烧空果核、好让浆果长出来的东西。

string.ID: O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??

strings.string: 哦，拿非利！是来赴我们的星浴吗？？

string.ID: I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.

strings.string: 我要嘴里有盐，要死眼映在辐射的黑暗里，要一只蛙做朋友。

string.ID: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...

strings.string: 哦，生命，哦，变化！拥抱我们，缠住我们……

string.ID: The Fishhead will catalyze the electric lake, and sure we as fossils will brick the ground but what a dais it will be!

strings.string: 鱼头会让那电湖发生触媒反应；我们这些化石固然会把地面砌住，但那将是一座何等的高台！

string.ID: The electric sizzle of life! Prickling and crisping skin, red and raw and beautiful beneath.

strings.string: 生命那电一般的嘶响！皮肤刺痒、焦脆，底下又红又生、美得惊人。

string.ID: Eaten by the air. Death by life. O Rermadon!

strings.string: 被空气吃掉。因生命而死。哦，雷尔马东！

string.ID: Live mites in the burning gas will appear green to the Future.

strings.string: 在燃烧的气体里活着的螨虫，在未来看来会是绿色的。

string.ID: O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!

strings.string: 哦！哦！新的生命成立了吗？你不该对旧日的死亡发抖！

string.ID: When an eremite consults the teraphim and sees the eyes of Death, only the fools frets! There is Change but no Ending.

strings.string: 当隐修士请教家神像、看见死亡之眼时，只有愚人才焦躁！有变化，却没有终结。

string.ID: A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.

strings.string: 瘟疫就是烧空果核、好让浆果长出来的东西。

string.ID: O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??

strings.string: 哦，拿非利！是来赴我们的星浴吗？？

string.ID: I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.

strings.string: 我要嘴里有盐，要死眼映在辐射的黑暗里，要一只蛙做朋友。

string.ID: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...

strings.string: 哦，生命，哦，变化！拥抱我们，缠住我们……

string.ID: The moon is their marriage light! And then a whole world for the Girsh daughters of nephilim!

strings.string: 月亮就是他们的婚灯！然后是一整个属于拿非利之基什女儿们的世界！

string.ID: Reach out and touch the heart. Our bonds transcend distance!

strings.string: 伸出手，触摸那颗心。我们的纽带超越距离！

string.ID: Push out the walls of the new world, Qas, to be its center!

strings.string: 把新世界的墙壁撑开吧，卡斯，好成为它的中心！

string.ID: O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!

strings.string: 哦！哦！新的生命成立了吗？你不该对旧日的死亡发抖！

string.ID: When an eremite consults the teraphim and sees the eyes of Death, only the fools frets! There is Change but no Ending.

strings.string: 当隐修士请教家神像、看见死亡之眼时，只有愚人才焦躁！有变化，却没有终结。

string.ID: A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.

strings.string: 瘟疫就是烧空果核、好让浆果长出来的东西。

string.ID: O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??

strings.string: 哦，拿非利！是来赴我们的星浴吗？？

string.ID: I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.

strings.string: 我要嘴里有盐，要死眼映在辐射的黑暗里，要一只蛙做朋友。

string.ID: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...

strings.string: 哦，生命，哦，变化！拥抱我们，缠住我们……

string.ID: Primrose and witchwood will boil the boundaries of sense into death-pleasure!

strings.string: 月见草与巫木会把感官的边界煮沸，化成死亡的欢愉！

string.ID: The Grounded Mind cannot soar. The Mind Aloft is limitless.

strings.string: 落地的头脑无法翱翔。高扬的头脑没有极限。

string.ID: Be open. Receive the Greatest Dreams. Hear the Girsh Sing.

strings.string: 敞开吧。领受那群最伟大的梦。听见基什的歌唱。

string.ID: You can be it. We can all be it! Behold Nephilim!

strings.string: 你可以成为它。我们都能成为它！看哪，拿非利！

string.ID: Learn well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I would fain see =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= succeed in =ifplayerplural:your:thine= task.

strings.string: 好好学，=factionaddress:Mopango=。我但愿见=ifplayerplural:你们:你=成就=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=任务。

string.ID: Live and learn, Nacham.

{{emote|*Every surface of the strange entity vibrates with the sound of a hundred dry lectures by long-dead scholars, teaching a volume of knowledge so dense and overlapping that the end result is incomprehensible.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那奇异存在的每一面都在振动，发出上百场早已死去的学者所讲的干枯讲座之声；所传授的知识卷帙如此密集交叠，以致最终结果完全不可理解。*}}

string.ID: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.

strings.string: 我把这件令人厌恶的装置献给你，独一无二者。

string.ID: Live and... do as you please.
{{emote|*Swimming in sound, Nacham stares at you and looks away simultaneously, giving no indication of understanding.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*纳查姆游在声音里，同时既盯着你、又移开目光，没有任何表示理解的迹象。*}}

string.ID: Here. Take it.
I am not yet ready. I may return.

strings.string: 我还没准备好。我也许会回来。

string.ID: Use your gadgets hard, don't you? I can fix them.

strings.string: 小玩意儿用得很狠，是吧？我能修。

string.ID: I can repair, recharge, and identify whatever you have! Within reason.

strings.string: 你身上有什么，我都能修、能充、能鉴定！在合理的范围内。

string.ID: If you've got anything you can't make heads or tails of it, give it here.

strings.string: 你有什么弄不明白的东西，拿来就是。

string.ID: You've got to respect a machine. Machines bite harder than any croc.

strings.string: 对机器得有敬畏。机器咬起人来比任何鳄鱼都狠。

string.ID: You a maker?
Take out what you've busted and I'll jury-rig it for a fair price.

strings.string: 把你弄坏的东西拿出来，我按公道价给你临时拼一台。

string.ID: Need scrap?
You get used to the nicks and burns, after years working with spark and solder.

strings.string: 跟火花和焊锡打上几年交道，那些划口和烫伤你就习惯了。

string.ID: They say some folks can talk to machines. I say we all can, if we listen right.

strings.string: 他们说有些人能跟机器说话。我说我们都能——只要听得对。

string.ID: My fees for battery charging depend how empty the battery is when you bring it to me.

strings.string: 充电池的价钱，看你拿来的时候电池有多空。

string.ID: Absolutely no refunds or returns on scrap.
I've the cure for what ails you.

strings.string: 你有什么毛病，我这儿都有药。

string.ID: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.

strings.string: 你气色不太好。你饮食里得加点辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）和蜂蜜。

string.ID: In the market for a tonic, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Spend water now or blood later, your choice.

strings.string: 想买补剂吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？现在花水，还是以后流血，你自己挑。

string.ID: Prickly-boons and yuckwheat for trade.
Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.

strings.string: 不舒服就用辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）做饭。病发现得够早，就能杀掉它。

string.ID: If you came for the humble pie, you had best not have led any mind-hunters here.

strings.string: 你若是来吃那盘「低头派」的，最好没把任何猎心者引到这儿来。

string.ID: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: 「止痛，也乱脑。」嚼巫木树皮要当心。

string.ID: Don't eat the hoarshrooms too fast, now.
Have you got enough tonics?
Got a fungal infection? You'll want one of my spray bottles to apply the cure.

strings.string: 染上真菌了？你需要我这儿的一只喷瓶来上药。

string.ID: Get your hands on the Corpus Choliys for disease and fungus cures.

strings.string: 想治疾病和真菌，就去弄一本科利伊斯医典（Corpus Choliys）。

string.ID: {{emote|*silent nod*}}
Careful. It's hot.
=player.FormalAddressTerm=. Need protection?
Be quick about it, eh?
I've got my eye on you.
Leather, ring, and plate, to keep you alive.

strings.string: 皮革、环甲、板甲，保你的命。

string.ID: Don't get near the hearth.
=player.FormalAddressTerm=. Live and drink.
You can't go wrong with my slugspitters, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Guns, guns, guns! Don't they just make you smile?

strings.string: 枪，枪，枪！它们不让你笑吗？

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I tell you: there is no defense like a good, and distant, offense.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我跟你说：最好的防守，就是一场出色的、远距离的进攻。

string.ID: Ahh, I love the smell of cordite. You know, that sulfury smell? Accelerants make a fine perfume, if you ask me.

strings.string: 啊，我爱线状火药的味道。你知道的，那股硫磺味？要我说，助燃剂就是上好的香水。

string.ID: Live, drink, and shoot, =player.formalAddressTerm=, in whichever order you like.

strings.string: 活下去、喝足水、开枪吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，顺序随你。

string.ID: Need something blown up, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
Grenades do no good sitting in a pack. Don't forget to use them.

strings.string: 手雷躺在背包里毫无用处。别忘了用。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, there is little you can't solve with a well-thrown grenade... as long as you don't stand too close.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，没有多少事是一枚投得好的手雷解决不了的……只要你别站太近。

string.ID: Defoliant and fungicide are perfectly safe, but you may wish to avoid breathing too deeply all the same.

strings.string: 落叶剂和杀真菌剂完全安全，不过你还是别深呼吸为好。

string.ID: Can I serve you something explosive, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 要来点爆炸性的东西吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: You'll be back, =player.formalAddressTerm=, provided you don't blow =player.reflexive= up.

strings.string: 你还会回来的，=player.formalAddressTerm=——只要你别把=player.reflexive=炸了。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Be careful with my wares as you peruse them.

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。翻看我的货时请当心。

string.ID: How is your throwing arm, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Barring that, do you feel lucky?

strings.string: 你的投掷臂力如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？若是不行，你觉得自己运气好吗？

string.ID: It's a dangerous job, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but well worth it.
The vintners say that 'one rose is fair, but five is death'. I can sell you blossoms that mean death no matter the number.

strings.string: 酒农们说「一朵玫瑰是美，五朵就是死」。我这儿的花，不论几朵都意味着死。

string.ID: I would prefer not to interrupt this task long.

strings.string: 我希望不要中断这项工作太久。

string.ID: How my joints ache! Buy something to justify my pain.

strings.string: 我的关节多疼啊！买点什么吧，好让我这疼有个说法。

string.ID: Unfinished schematics are obviously not for sale. Everything else is.

strings.string: 未完成的图纸显然不卖。别的都卖。

string.ID: Disturb the trash if you must, but do not touch any of my papers.

strings.string: 垃圾你要翻就翻，但绝对不许碰我的纸。

string.ID: Are you a tinker? Surely I have something you wish to build.

strings.string: 你是修补匠吗？我一定有你想造的东西。

string.ID: If you've the wits to build, I've got something you want.

strings.string: 你若有动手的头脑，我就有你想要的东西。

string.ID: I have lost much to my dedication. Help me gain anew, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 我为了这份投入失去了很多。帮我重新挣回来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: So help me, Argent Fathers, if someone has changed the order of my papers...

strings.string: 银之父作证，要是有人动过我纸张的顺序……

string.ID: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, buy a schematic. I'm sure it will be of use to you.

strings.string: 求你了，=player.formalAddressTerm=，买一张图纸吧。我相信它会对你有用。

string.ID: Even if you can't make a thing now, you could gain the insight later.

strings.string: 即便你现在造不出某样东西，日后也可能用得着那份见识。

string.ID: Come here. No, closer. Don't mind the bees, they rarely sting.

strings.string: 过来。不，再近点。别管那些蜂，它们很少蜇人。

string.ID: Don't be afraid to approach. The bees rarely sting.
Care for some beejuice?
Drink a dram of honey every morning, Slog itself couldn't make you sick.

strings.string: 每天早上喝一德拉姆（dram）蜂蜜，连斯洛格本人也弄不病你。

string.ID: You know, bees communicate by dancing. Got a whole language.

strings.string: 你知道吗，蜂靠跳舞交流。那是一整套语言。

string.ID: Without bees, all life in Qud would eventually die.

strings.string: 没有蜂，卡德（Qud）的一切生命终将死去。

string.ID: Bees are smarter than you think. They got that hive mind, see.

strings.string: 蜂比你以为的聪明。它们有那种群体心智，你懂吧。

string.ID: I eat honey matz every morning and I ain't been sick in decades.

strings.string: 我每天早上吃蜂蜜无酵饼，几十年没病过。

string.ID: We'd all be dead without bees, you know.

strings.string: 没有蜂，我们早就全死了，你知道的。

string.ID: Smell a bit strong? That's how you know it's good.

strings.string: 味儿有点冲？那正说明它是好东西。

string.ID: You can preserve almost anything. Al... most.

strings.string: 几乎什么都能腌存。几……几乎。

string.ID: Preserved ingredients cook better, safer.

strings.string: 腌过的食材做出来更好、更安全。

string.ID: Everything I sell is safe to eat as it is.

strings.string: 我卖的每一样，开袋即食都安全。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Need vittle?
Crave a bit of salt, =player.formalAddressTerm=, or a load of salt?

strings.string: 想要一点盐，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还是要一整批盐？

string.ID: Nothing sadder than a cookfire and nothing to cook over it.

strings.string: 没有什么比一堆篝火、火上却无物可炊更令人难过了。

string.ID: Are you a chef, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My vittles are of the highest quality.

strings.string: 你是厨子吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的干粮品质最高。

string.ID: Nourishment for the road, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
There's a shape in every stone waiting to be brought out.

strings.string: 每一块石头里都藏着一个形状，等着被取出来。

string.ID: If you bend the light just so, it frays into brilliance.

strings.string: 把光折到那个角度，它就散成一片璀璨。

string.ID: I can wait years for the inspiration to craft another figurine. I have before.

strings.string: 为了雕出下一尊小像的灵感，我可以等上几年。我以前就等过。

string.ID: What manner of jewel are our eyes, to skew light into thought?

strings.string: 我们的眼睛是怎样一种宝石，竟能把光扭成思想？

string.ID: Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and behold my jewels and figurines.

strings.string: 进来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，欣赏我的宝石与小像。

string.ID: Uncrafted jewels and metals buy and sell for the same cost, but my art's price tag is up to me.

strings.string: 未加工的宝石与金属买卖同价，但我这件艺术品的价签由我定。

string.ID: Every statuette is a tribute, of a kind, but not every tribute is received well.

strings.string: 每一尊小雕像都算是一种献礼，但并非每一份献礼都被欣然接受。

string.ID: Wouldn't these make a fine conversation piece for a water ritual?

strings.string: 这些拿来作水仪式上的谈资，岂不正好？

string.ID: Beautiful baubles and gleaming gemstones over here!

strings.string: 漂亮的小饰物和闪亮的宝石，这边看！

string.ID: Aren't they beautiful, =player.formalAddressTerm=? The bottles, the phials, the light shining through them.

strings.string: 它们不美吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？那些瓶子、那些小药管，光穿过它们的样子。

string.ID: Live and drink, but not everything. Some things you don't drink.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水——但不是什么都喝。有些东西是不能喝的。

string.ID: Is there any state of form so fine as a liquid?

strings.string: 还有哪种形态比液体更精妙？

string.ID: Pouring, decanting, collecting, mixing. I adore my calling.

strings.string: 倾倒、滗出、收集、混合。我热爱我的志业。

string.ID: If it flows, I desire it. You should too, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 只要它会流，我就想要它。你也该如此，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Do you ever stop and think about fluids? Are they not divine?

strings.string: 你有没有停下来想过流体？它们难道不是神圣的吗？

string.ID: Someday I will plumb the depths of Bethesda Susa, that I may meet the Alchemist.

strings.string: 总有一天我要探到贝塞斯达·苏萨的深处，好去见那位炼金术士。

string.ID: Live and drink, and collect, and combine...

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，然后收集，然后调配……

string.ID: Need something?
Sorry bout the smell.
Watch for blood puddles.
No lie, I love my job.
Leeches. Blood. If that's what you want, I got what you want.

strings.string: 水蛭。血。你要的是这个，我就有你要的。

string.ID: I feed these critters what blood the ranchers have to spare.

strings.string: 我拿牧场主们多余的血喂这些小家伙。

string.ID: Takes a simple person to tend a simple creature. I don't mind it.

strings.string: 简单的人养简单的生物。我不介意。

string.ID: Bless this mess and bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 祝福这一团糟，也祝福你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: What can I do for you? Need slime?

strings.string: 我能为你做什么？要黏液吗？

string.ID: Have you ever taken a swig of slime? It's not half bad!

strings.string: 你灌过一口黏液吗？味道还真不赖！

string.ID: I keep my amoebas happy! Or, you know, whatever they got in place of happy.

strings.string: 我让我的变形虫过得开心！或者说，它们拿什么替代开心的那个东西。

string.ID: See how their skin glisters in the salt sun? Lovely.

strings.string: 看它们的皮在盐日下怎么发亮？真好看。

string.ID: Now don't you dare pop my amoeba.

strings.string: 你可别把我的变形虫戳破。

string.ID: I think I got all the puddles, but watch for slime all the same.

strings.string: 我想我把水洼都收拾干净了，但还是留神黏液。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Are you hungry?

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，旅人。你饿吗？

string.ID: Git ta pig mud. Mud?
Mind the pig leavins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Now don't you go breaking my fence.

strings.string: 你可别去弄坏我的篱笆。

string.ID: You best not hurt my critters.
I en't filthy. I'm muddy. Big difference.

strings.string: 我不是脏。我是沾了泥。差别大着呢。

string.ID: It's get meat here or risk a slugsnout ball in the gut. Your choice, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 要么在这儿买肉，要么冒着肚子挨一记弹鼻的风险。你自己挑，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Good clean meat! Well. Clean as it gets.

strings.string: 上好的干净肉！嗯。也就干净到这份上。

string.ID: Moon and sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Take care, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Let not complacency end =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, and I shall anticipate further news of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= exploits.

strings.string: 保重，=factionaddress:Mopango=。莫让自满终结了=ifplayerplural:你们:你=；我会期待=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=事迹传来新的消息。

string.ID: Live and lead, Dagasha.

strings.string: 活下去，引领众人，达加莎。

string.ID: {{emote|*The jagged, serpentine entity stares you down, twitching with feigned half-strikes in your direction as if goading an aggressive response from you. Though it has no mouth, it is not silent: piercing the air is a strange, external tinnitus, the whine of an ancient viewscreen.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那锯齿状、蛇形的存在瞪着你，朝你的方向抽搐着做出假意的半击，仿佛在激你作出攻击性的回应。它没有嘴，却并不沉默：刺穿空气的是一种奇异的、外在的耳鸣，像一面古老显示屏的嗡鸣。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Dagasha tilts its head, staring you down. It twitches, but makes no move to strike as you approach.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*达加莎歪了歪头，瞪着你。它抽搐着，但在你靠近时并未出手。*}}

string.ID: Are you all right?

Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.
I recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.

strings.string:
虽然我如今只是昔日自我的一抹苍白影子，是的。我的处境与心境都已大为改善。
从前的生活我记不清细节。我曾有影响力，是那种言语能激励人心付诸行动的角色。那么久以来我都无从开口，被困在自己的情绪里。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=把我从一场可怕的命运中解救了出来。

string.ID: What will you do now?

I know not. Perhaps I can lead again. These creatures that looked after me, named me, kept me safe. The mopango.
They are kind, but weak. Perhaps I can teach them. Spur them to be greater.
But for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, I must even our score. Take this piece of my chassis. Wear it with confidence. Command in my name.

strings.string:
我不知道。也许我能再度引领。这些照看我、为我命名、护我周全的生灵。莫潘戈。
他们善良，却软弱。也许我能教导他们。鞭策他们变得更强。
但对=ifplayerplural:你们:你=，我必须结清这笔账。收下我底盘上的这一块。带着它自信地穿戴。以我的名义号令。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Dagasha.

strings.string: 活下去，永保自由，达加莎。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Dagasha.

strings.string: 活下去，永保自由，达加莎。

string.ID: Stay safe.
Live and remain stalwart, Va'am.

strings.string: 活下去，永保坚毅，瓦阿姆。

string.ID: {{emote|*The hardened shell-thing traces a path around you slowly, its strange brush-feet scrabbling at the floor, a pace unaffected by your presence and movement. Behind the hissing of those feet on the ground is the strains of a faint voice, someone speaking from inside a distant cave. Audible, but not understandable.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那硬壳之物缓缓绕着你画出一道路径，它那些奇特的刷状足在地面上抓挠；那步伐不受你在场与移动的影响。在那些足摩擦地面的嘶声之后，是一缕微弱嗓音的余韵——有人在遥远的洞穴里说话。听得见，却听不懂。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Vaam seems oblivious to your words, but does slow its patrol as it nears you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*瓦阿姆似乎对你的话毫无察觉，但靠近你时确实放慢了巡行。*}}

string.ID: Are you all right?

Yes. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a deep stupor. Once I was a protector, before being sentenced to protect nothing and no one.
I remember little of that time.

strings.string:
是的。我谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=把我从一场深沉的昏寐中解救了出来。我曾是个守护者，后来却被判去守护无物、无人。
那段时日我记得的很少。

string.ID: What will you do now?

I have yet to find my purpose. I can think and speak, and so this shell is nearly comfortable.
One piece, however, doth yet chafe me. =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= take it? Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye can:thou canst= grant it some use.

strings.string:
我还没找到我的目的。我能思考、能说话，所以这具外壳还算舒适。
不过有一块仍磨着我。=ifplayerplural:你们愿:你愿=收下它吗？也许=ifplayerplural:你们:你=能给它派上些用场。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= loose the bonds that keep =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= from =ifplayerplural:your:thy= goals, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Be free.

strings.string: 愿=ifplayerplural:你们:你=解开那些阻碍=ifplayerplural:你们:你=达成目标的束缚，=factionaddress:Mopango=。自由吧。

string.ID: Live and be free, Kah.

{{emote|*The creature-silhouette lacks any means to make sound, save for the pointed tips of its six flexible legs. These tap against the ground like a sparse but heavy rainfall on a scrap metal roof as the strange pseudo-beast skitters away from predicted or perceived threats.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那生物的剪影没有任何发声的手段，唯有它六条柔韧长腿的尖端。当这奇特的伪兽从预判或感知到的威胁旁疾窜而走时，那些腿尖敲击地面，如同稀疏而沉重的雨点打在废铁皮屋顶上。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Kah skitters away, but soon returns, and skitters away a shorter distance. Whether because of your words or because you are still, its desire for flight ebbs over the course of a minute until its escape attempts halt.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*卡疾窜而去，但很快又回来，再窜开的距离更短些。不知是因为你的话，还是因为你静止不动，它逃走的欲望在一分钟里渐渐退去，直到逃脱的尝试完全停止。*}}

string.ID: Are you all right?

I am weary to my core, but at last this once-hateful body obeyeth me. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for restoring my autonomy.
Memory of my once-self doth elude me, but I recognize the irony of my punishment. Once a strider, then sentenced to stride without restraint, forever. I knew only fear and flight. No more.

strings.string:
我疲惫入骨，但这具曾令我憎恨的身体终于听命于我了。我谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=恢复了我的自主。
我昔日自我的记忆已不可追，但我认得出这惩罚的讽刺：曾是奔行者，随后被判永远无拘无束地奔行。我只知恐惧与逃亡。不会再有。

string.ID: What will you do now?

I shall enjoy my free mobility freely, for a time. After that, I know not. I may speak to these mopango creatures that named me, and find a purpose with them. I cannot ever repay their care, but perhaps I may repay =ifplayerplural:yours:thine=.
I wouldst fain offer =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= a fragment of this form come loose. =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= ever run free.

strings.string:
我要自在地享受一阵子这自由的行动力。之后，我不知道。我也许会去跟那些为我命名的莫潘戈谈谈，与他们一同找个目的。他们的照料我永远报不完，但也许我能报=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=。
我但愿把从这形态上脱落的一块献给=ifplayerplural:你们:你=。愿=ifplayerplural:你们:你=永远奔行自由。

string.ID: NON MOLOCH? NON MOLOCH RETURNEN FROM BRIGHTSHEOL.

strings.string: 非摩洛克？非摩洛克自明暗界（Brightsheol）归返者。

string.ID: Non Moloch?
Yes, I've returned from Brightsheol.

strings.string: 是的，我从明暗界（Brightsheol）回来了。

string.ID: NON MOLOCH HER AT HOM. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.

strings.string: 非摩洛克在此为家者。非摩洛克在玛孔·伊德之中。

string.ID: Maqqom Yd? The Place outside Itself?

strings.string: 玛孔·伊德？「自身之外的地方」？

string.ID: MAQQOM YD. SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN FROM SALUM.

strings.string: 玛孔·伊德。南土之自萨鲁姆得自由者。

string.ID: Many Eyes, can you tell me of Maqqom Yd?

strings.string: 众眼，你能跟我讲讲玛孔·伊德吗？

string.ID:
SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN FROM SALUM. BY TRETE WITH SAAD CALLEN MOLOCH, AND MONEIEN BI ALDERSESSE.
BY TRETE GALGALLIM BILDEN PIPE TO DRINKEN THANE SLIPSTREAM, AND FORGE TO BURNEN STEL-CRISTAL, AND CASKE TO HOLDEN GLOUINGE O FISH.

strings.string: 南土之自萨鲁姆得自由者。依与名为摩洛克者可缔之约，与经由阿尔德塞斯之数。

string.ID: And what of the Freehold? What do you do now?

strings.string: 那自由领呢？你现在做什么？

string.ID: Who is Non Moloch, from before?
BY TRETE GALGALLIM SERVEN, BUT NON NOU.

strings.string: 依约，加尔加尔服役之——然今已不然。

string.ID: I want to ask something else.
YOU. YOU REGNEN NON HER. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.

strings.string: 汝。汝统治非此处者。非摩洛克在玛孔·伊德之中。

string.ID: Be nimble.
Be sodder-handed.
Where is your minyan?
Bow to the Godhed.
No goatfolk?
Sower's eye pass over you.
Find Chrome, lonelyfolk.
Ah, lonelyfolk.
Blessed be the Godhed, Whom we planish and uplift.

strings.string: 愿神首受福——我们压光祂、高举祂。

string.ID: Trees shield you.
By the sun, you're ugly.
Pick a direction and walk in it.

strings.string: 挑个方向，然后往那儿走。

string.ID: What do you want, lack-salt?
Got nothing to say to a lack-salt.

strings.string: 跟缺盐的没什么好说的。

string.ID: Keep your eyes moving, lack-salt.
Hey lack-salt. How much water you got? No, don't ever answer that question.

strings.string: 嘿，缺盐的。你有多少水？不，这问题永远别答。

string.ID: Be respectful of the red-and-white and we will get along.

strings.string: 对红白旗放尊重点，我们就能相处。

string.ID: Keep your mouth covered, or the brine air will cure your lungs to jerky.

strings.string: 把嘴捂上，不然卤气会把你的肺腌成肉干。

string.ID: Stay warm, lack-salt.
Stay dry, lack-salt.
Oh. Hm?
An =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= ready.
An =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.
Peace, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
By Her Light.
Her Light shine on you.
=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= business with me?
Humble before Her we walk.

strings.string: 我们在她面前谦卑而行。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:Will ye:Wilt thou=, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
May Her Light guide =ifplayerplural:your:thy= steps, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿她的光指引=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=脚步，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink by Her Light.

strings.string: 在她的光中活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I've a bad feeling about all this.

strings.string: 我对这一切有不好的预感。

string.ID: The threat is not over. Mark my words.

strings.string: 威胁还没过去。记住我的话。

string.ID: We're not safe yet. I can feel it.

strings.string: 我们还不安全。我能感觉到。

string.ID: This resolution is not to my liking...

strings.string: 这个结局不合我的心意……

string.ID: I remain wary, but there is no question that Bey Lah thrives, even with open borders.

strings.string: 我仍存戒心，但毫无疑问，即便开放了边界，贝拉也兴旺了。

string.ID: Oh, it is you. Stay safe.
I am uncomfortable with change, but it is a skill to train like any other.

strings.string: 改变让我不适，但它和别的技能一样，是可以练的。

string.ID: I hope Hindriarch Esk can keep us safe.

strings.string: 我希望埃斯克女族长能保我们平安。

string.ID: I will do my best to be civil with you, kendren, but we hindren are bred into wariness.

strings.string: 我会尽量对你客气，外客，但我们欣德伦是天生育成戒心的。

string.ID: Cause no trouble here, kendren.

Shivering stillness, coldbark pricking with each thump.
It comes.

strings.string:
颤栗的静止，每一次重击都刺痛冷皮。
它来了。

string.ID:
Can you feel the stillness? The drycrackle of space between as you thump my crystal arms.
Life flees you. Motion flees you.

strings.string:
你能感到那份静止吗？你重击我的水晶臂时，其间空间的干裂声。
生命逃离你。运动逃离你。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long and pensive tone.*}}
How something stirs, deep in Soft.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟发出一声悠长而沉思的音。*}}
有什么东西在柔质深处搅动着。

string.ID: Soft churns Tau in beingstuff. She will -then, but perhaps not Taulike.

strings.string: 柔质在存在质料中搅动陶。她会「-将成」，但也许不再是陶的样子。

string.ID:
{{emote|*through the chime you hear an echoing cacophony, muted by distance and matter.*}}
How we ring with it. Your kicksoft drowns under the beat of our selfcries.

strings.string:
{{emote|*透过那鸣钟，你听见一片回荡的嘈杂，被距离与物质压得低沉。*}}
我们与它一同鸣响。你的踢柔淹没在我们自哭的节拍之下。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime is hard to distinguish from the rising cacophony.*}}
Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Arid tearsalt dries between the Lovers.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟已难与渐起的嘈杂分辨开来。*}}
尽途蜷缩。柔质穿透万形的界限，以无火的热皮折磨我们。它回荡在陶那洞穴般的空缺之中。干涸的泪盐在两位爱人之间干去。

string.ID:
{{emote|*through the chime you hear an echoing cacophony, muted by distance and matter.*}}
How we ring with it. Your kicksoft drowns under the beat of our selfcries.

strings.string:
{{emote|*透过那鸣钟，你听见一片回荡的嘈杂，被距离与物质压得低沉。*}}
我们与它一同鸣响。你的踢柔淹没在我们自哭的节拍之下。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime is hard to distinguish from the rising cacophony.*}}
Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Touchloss blooms, each facet trembling for shearpull.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣钟已难与渐起的嘈杂分辨开来。*}}
尽途蜷缩。柔质穿透万形的界限，以无火的热皮折磨我们。它回荡在陶那洞穴般的空缺之中。触失绽放，每一面都因剪拉而颤抖。

string.ID: Who thumps my crystal arms, and kicksofts me at windfall? I feel you here, friend.

strings.string: 是谁重击我的水晶臂，在风落处踢柔我？我在此处感到你，朋友。

string.ID: You... feel me?

{{emote|*there is an agitation in Thicksalt's accepting chime.*}}
Pluck the air, then, with your mouth sounds.

strings.string:
{{emote|*厚盐那接纳的鸣声里有一丝躁动。*}}
那就用你的口音拨动空气吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes a single, outstretched tone.*}}
The naming act is imponderable. So Tau called me Thicksalt, one brickword in a towerful poem whose everyshape I forget, but whose flushing of Soft in afterfeel I am in allway.

strings.string:
{{emote|*厚盐鸣出一记单一的、伸展的音。*}}
命名之举不可思议。陶便这样叫我厚盐——一首塔般高耸的诗里的一个砖词，它的万形我已忘却，但它在后感中柔质的涌动，我尽途都在其中。

string.ID:
...
{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes in gentle tones.*}}
Begone from me, stardimmer. Your own hand has vaporized your purpose.

strings.string: 从我面前消失，黯星者。你自己的手已把你的目的蒸发掉了。

string.ID:
You thrived at the performance of a pruning motion, utensil. Now store yourself until Fate reshapes you.
The end.

strings.string:
你在演示一次修剪动作时颇为得意，器具。现在把自己收起来，等命运重塑你。
结束了。

string.ID: The utensil arrives. You, to prune the fate-rhizome and free our girl. Go now and perform the motion.

strings.string: 器具到了。你，去修剪命运之根茎，解放我们的女孩。现在就去，执行那个动作。

string.ID: You're a seeker of the Sightless Way?

strings.string: 你是「无眼之道」的求道者？

string.ID: Where are you taking Tau?
Give her your parting words, utensil. Our hearts are in elsewhere.

strings.string: 把你的临别之言给她，器具。我们的心在别处。

string.ID: Begone. Fate has not yet shaped you, utensil.

strings.string: 走开。命运还没把你塑成，器具。

string.ID: Utensil? That is my avocation, yes. A million sun-dead homes I've roved, a trillion more await. I'm a worm in the loam of a cosmic wood, perched on a cosmic gulf, swathed in the god-manifold.

strings.string: 器具？那正是我的志业，没错。我漫游过百万个太阳已死的家园，还有万亿个在等着。我是宇宙之林的壤土里的一条虫，栖息在宇宙的深渊之上，裹在神之流形之中。

string.ID:
Prune! The utensil prunes! -but no, the utensil quivers in uncertainty and vibrates out a question?
The self is riddled with category errors. The thinking brain mistakes formation for meaning.

strings.string:
修剪！器具在修剪！——可不对，器具在不确定中发抖，还振出一个问题？
这个自我满是范畴错误。会思考的头脑把成形误认作意义。

string.ID: Tell me. I wish to understand.
Maggot! What do you think words are? Arrows of inquiry? Words are bricks. Each spoken is laid in bond and builds your prison. There is no understanding.

strings.string: 蛆虫！你以为言语是什么？探问的箭矢？言语是砖。每一句被说出的都按砌法垒起，筑成你的牢。没有理解这回事。

string.ID: Bricks can be thrown, too.
You tarry on the future's boundary with abandon, utensil. Throw your brick if you dare.

strings.string: 你恣意盘桓在未来的边界上，器具。有胆就把你的砖扔出来。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Welcome to the Stilt.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，旅人。欢迎来到高跷。

string.ID: Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!

strings.string: 赞美舍金纳！哦，至高的父辈们……我终于到了！

string.ID: This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here.

strings.string: 这就是六日高跷，嗯。它……庞大、美丽。我明白铬色管事们为什么聚集在此了。

string.ID: So... many... folks....
Is it true what they say? That it's a petrified kraken?

strings.string: 他们说的是真的吗？这是一只石化的海怪？

string.ID: What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?

strings.string: 多宏大的集市！这些帐篷里各是什么？

string.ID: Live and drink, wardens.
You are among friends here, pilgrim. Stay peaceful.

strings.string: 你在这里是在朋友中间，朝圣者。保持平和。

string.ID:
Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.
Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.

strings.string:
那=player.reflexive=就不是信教的，嗯？我也不是。不过还是进去看看吧。她是个美人。她的椽木高处镶着染色的玻璃。两翼上还有两幅绝妙的雕刻。另外还有一尊神的光雕。想听就听听布道。大祭司很有说服力，但不及大教堂她本人的一半。你知道，美之中自有力量。
无论如何，你在教堂里或高跷场上，都要保持平和。

string.ID:
Aye, aye. The clamor of it all can overwhelm.
The glowcrows say 'twas a bird-god who taught folks to gather like this, in large flocks. So blame birds.

strings.string:
哎，哎。这一切的喧嚷确实能把人压垮。
辉鸦们说，是一位鸟神教会了人们这样聚集，成群成片。所以要怪就怪鸟。

string.ID:
Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.
Whatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her.

strings.string:
谁知道呢？我自己也想过。有时在月光银亮的时候，她会入我的眼，就在那里俯压着滩地。
不管她是什么，她巨大。而且古老。真的很老。比机械教派在她体内建起的那座教堂老得多。

string.ID:
Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.
Have a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round.

strings.string:
你疯了吗？你以为我会给每个踏进高跷场的店主做记录？他们来去自如。这里各种商人都有。卖酒的、吆喝蜂蜜的、装订书的、做鞋的。
=player.reflexive=自己转转吧。顺着绕高跷的路走。一路都是帐篷。

string.ID: You wandering? Be nimble.
Branches part for you.
Be nimble, broadfinger.
Need aught?
Hm hm hm.
Forage fruitfully.
Danger, a-ye?
Traveler. Put down your mangled trinkets and I'll repair them.

strings.string: 旅人。把你那些扭坏的小玩意儿放下，我来修。

string.ID: Tell me about this ancient village.

strings.string: 跟我讲讲这座古老的村庄。

string.ID: Who is the man camped near the graveyard?

strings.string: 在墓地边扎营的那个人是谁？

string.ID: What do you think of the plant you share this building with?

strings.string: 跟你共用这栋建筑的那株植物，你怎么看？

string.ID:
{{emote|*She gives you a hard stare.*}}
I am a Daughter of Exile, but you should call me Yla Haj.

strings.string:
{{emote|*她狠狠瞪了你一眼。*}}
我是流放之女，但你该叫我伊拉·哈吉。

string.ID: Daughter of Exile?

Tinker-nuns. The world sees fit to call us that, my sisters and me.
Do you know the story told of Rebekah the Exile? She was a teacher to Resheph, but he excommunicated her from the sultanate and banished her from the realm.
To know her, I've chosen a life of unbelonging. And among my sisters, I have the honor of permanent residence by her gravesite.
I'll tell you this, traveler: the shape of a society is visible only from the outside, and there is peace beyond a boundary.

strings.string:
修补修女。这世界乐意这么叫我们——我和我的姐妹们。
你知道那个关于流放者蕾贝卡的故事吗？她曾是雷谢夫的老师，但他把她逐出苏丹国的教门，并把她驱逐出疆域。
为了认识她，我选择了一种无所归属的生活。而在姐妹们中间，我享有长居她墓旁的殊荣。
我告诉你这一点，旅人：一个社会的形状，只有从外面才看得见；而边界之外，自有一份安宁。

string.ID: Wasn't Rebekah a healer? Why are you an order of tinkers?

strings.string: 蕾贝卡不是医者吗？你们为什么是修补匠的教团？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Yla Haj pauses.*}}
You presume too narrow a meaning of "health".

strings.string:
{{emote|*伊拉·哈吉停顿。*}}
你对「健全」的理解太狭窄了。

string.ID:
Ezra sits in the shadow of history, where small things grow. It's the moss beneath the statue, quite literally. For centuries monarchs concerned themselves with felling trees, and now of the Covenate only Ezra remains.
It's home to Rebekah's gravesite, so for the Daughters, it is a sacred place. You may notice more of us on pilgrimage.

strings.string:
埃兹拉坐在历史的阴影里，那里生长着细小的东西。它字面意义上就是雕像脚下的苔藓。几个世纪里，君主们只关心伐树；如今女巫会治世的遗存，只剩下埃兹拉。
这里是蕾贝卡墓地的所在，所以对流放之女而言，这是圣地。你也许会注意到我们中有更多人来此朝圣。

string.ID:
Zothom. I don't see utility in unkindness, but he's a fool. Were it that proximity to meekness made one meek...
I have no use for a man who seeks salvation in the body of a dead woman.

strings.string:
佐索姆。我看不出刻薄有什么用处，但他是个愚人。若接近温顺就能让人温顺，那倒好了……
我看不上一个在一具女尸身上寻求救赎的男人。

string.ID: I don't.
Moon and sun.
How a'yeh.
All well?
Marshes be generous.
Live and drink, waterhand.
Don't want trouble.
Watervine coming in good, see? Fat wafers.

strings.string: 水藤长势不错，看见没？肥厚的藤饼。

string.ID: Need watervine?
You harvest it, you keep it.
Good crop this year.
Goin' out? Mind the crocs.
You quit.

Leaving the village will end the game.
Type =prompt= to confirm.

strings.string:
离开村庄将结束游戏。
输入「END GAME」（英文）以确认。

string.ID: Hmm, what of your artifacts? Make an offering of them to Shekhinah at the Sacred Well.

string.ID:
On the =day= of =month=, you arrive at the oasis-hamlet of {{green|Joppa}}, along the far rim of {{Y|Moghra'yi, the Great Salt Desert}}.
All around you, moisture farmers tend to groves of viridian watervine. There are huts wrought from rock salt and brinestalk.
On the horizon, {{r|Qud's}} jungles strangle chrome steeples and rusted archways to the earth. Further and beyond, the fabled {{C|Spindle}} rises above the fray and pierces the cloud-ribboned sky.

strings.string:
在=month=的=day=，你抵达了绿洲小村{{green|约帕（Joppa）}}，它坐落在{{Y|莫格拉伊，大盐漠}}的远缘。
你四周，水农们照看着一片片翠绿的水藤林。还有用岩盐与卤秆搭成的棚屋。
地平线上，{{r|卡德（Qud）}}的丛林把铬色尖塔与锈蚀的拱道勒向地面。更远处，传说中的{{C|纺锤（the Spindle）}}自这片纷乱中升起，刺穿那缠着云带的天空。

string.ID: At =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random= under =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random|article= and =color= sky, the people of =villageName= saw an image on the horizon that looked like =elementNoun|article= bathed in =color=. strings.string: 在=spice:time.partsOfDay.!random=，在=spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random|article=而=color|title=的天空下，=villageName=的人们看见地平线上有一个影像，看上去像沐浴在=color=之中的=elementNoun|article=。那是=player.name=。=player.subjective=来去之后，=villageName=的人们为=name=立了一座纪念碑，此后便称=player.objective=为=elementNoun|title=-in-=color|title=。
