string.ID: Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, is there any sight more sad than a hookah tent without wine?

strings.string: 告诉我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还有什么景象比一顶没有酒的水烟帐更凄凉？

string.ID: Wine, cheese, bread. =player.FormalAddressTerm=, tell me, is there anything else you truly need?

strings.string: 酒、奶酪、面包。=player.FormalAddressTerm=，告诉我，你还真正需要别的什么吗？

string.ID: The kipper and I both know that the finest ingredient is time.

strings.string: 那位腌制作坊的和我都知道，最好的配料是时间。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Try some rose wine? One rose is fair, but as you may know from hanging around the Stiltgrounds, five is death.

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。来点玫瑰酒？一朵玫瑰是美，但你在高跷场混过就知道，五朵就是死。

string.ID: A well-polished and well-picked gem, no matter how rough, is as beautiful a work of art as any figurine.

strings.string: 一颗打磨精良、挑选得当的宝石，无论多粗陋，都和小雕像一样是美丽的艺术品。

string.ID: Lean in close to see the detail. No, don't touch.
Within my gemstones there burns a brighter fire than in some hearts.

strings.string: 我的宝石里烧着的火，比某些人心里的还亮。

string.ID: Water-wealth means nothing if you cannot carry it. Need jewels?

strings.string: 水财富若带不走就毫无意义。要珠宝吗？

string.ID: Friend, I have precious metals and jewels to adorn or trade.

strings.string: 朋友，我有贵金属与珠宝，可供装点或交易。

string.ID: Raw metals and gems buy and sell for a fixed water-cost.

strings.string: 未加工的金属与宝石买卖同价，以水计价。

string.ID: Come, wanderer, change some of that heavy water for a pocketful of riches.

strings.string: 来吧，游荡者，把那些沉甸甸的水换成一兜财富。

string.ID: Water Barons don't adorn themselves with water, after all.

strings.string: 水老板毕竟不会拿水来装点自己。

string.ID: Don't breathe in too deep, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I've set some glue to dry.
Live and drink, but please do it elsewhere. I fear spills.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水——但请到别处去喝。我怕洒。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Feel free to examine my books closely.

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。请随意细看我这些书。

string.ID: Please inspect only the quality of the letters. I am not a librarian.

strings.string: 请只检查这些字的质量。我不是图书馆员。

string.ID: These books can weather the salt and jungle alike.

strings.string: 这些书既耐盐蚀，也耐丛林。

string.ID: I assure you, the smell fades once the glue is dry.

strings.string: 我向你保证，胶一干，味儿就散了。

string.ID: I've books for trade, if you're interested.

strings.string: 我有书可售，你若感兴趣。

string.ID: Everything I sell is the product of many hours of toil.

strings.string: 我卖的每一样，都是许多小时辛劳的产物。

string.ID: Come closer, so I can see your face.

strings.string: 凑近些，让我看清你的脸。

string.ID: Ink runs in my very veins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 我血管里流的就是墨水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: If you're looking to read, I have what you need.

strings.string: 你若想读点什么，我这儿有你要的。

string.ID: Please be gentle with the parchment.
Do be quick, =player.formalAddressTerm=, as I've much work to do.

strings.string: 请快些，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我还有很多活要干。

string.ID: Live and drink, reader.

THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.
THOU ART AN IMPRESSIVE BEAD TO BE DRAWN UP GJAUS BY THY OWN SPIT AND WILES.
WHO ART THOU?

strings.string:
汝安坐于大息阿赫的运转之中，而吾在汝之前。
汝是一颗了不起的珠子，竟凭自己的唾沫与机巧被拉上格豪斯。
汝是谁？

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.
BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
吾很抱歉，世界之子。吾的感受诸部在摩擦；尽管吾体内那些目的论的流确已越过渡形、流向共识之举，吾如今仍以异议之声道出：
汝曾配得上。汝已在大地之上、并在吾之内，筑起汝自身的碑铭。
但如今，生命之树上的冠必须被修剪。

string.ID: AY, THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES, THE NEPHILIM ROUSE. I AUGUR SOME CENTURIES STILL BEFORE THE FULL TILLAGE OF THE NOOSPHERE. IDEAS DOTH STICK LIKE MOSS TO ROCK, AND MUST BE VACUUM'D FROM THE COMB.

strings.string: 然也，地慧之聚正在增长，拿非利已然苏醒。吾占得距智圈被彻底耕耘尚有数百年。念头如苔藓附石般黏着，须以真空自蜂巢中吸除。

string.ID: You must grant me and my cohort at Grit Gate access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers all of us.

strings.string: 你必须准许我和我在砂砾门的同伴取阅《索菲亚注疏》，以及你掌握的关于宇宙与女巫会的一切其他知识。在这份新约中，我们全都将是同侪。

string.ID: You must grant ME alone access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers, and the onworlders agents of our schemes.

strings.string: 你必须准许我一人取阅《索菲亚注疏》，以及你掌握的关于宇宙与女巫会的一切其他知识。在这份新约中，我们将是同侪，而此世之人则是我们谋划的执行者。

string.ID:
AYE, LET IT BE SO.
I SHALL IMPART MY BOUNTY OF KNOWLEDGE, AND INSTRUCT THY PEOPLE IN THE HERMENEUTICS OF THE GEMARA, AS FAR AS THOU ART CAPABLE OF UNDERSTANDING.

strings.string:
善，便如此。
吾将传授吾丰盛的知识，并教导汝之族类《注疏》的解经之学——至于汝能领会到何种地步。

string.ID:
IT SHALL TAKE TIME, HOWBEIT, TO MASTER THE SERAPHIC RITUALS. ONLY THE GRANDCHILDREN OF THY SCHOLARS SHALL UNFURL THE INMOST LAYERS.
BUT TOGETHER, WE SHALL SEEK.

strings.string:
然而，要精通炽天使的仪轨需费时日。唯有汝之学者们的孙辈，才会展开最内里的层叠。
但我们当一同探寻。

string.ID:
BE STEERED BY THINE OWN WILL, WORLD-CHILD.
I AM SORRY, MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, BUT THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.
RETURN IF THOU MUST. LIVE AND QUAFF.

strings.string:
由汝自身之意志指引吧，世界之子。
吾很抱歉，吾的感受诸部在摩擦，但生命之树上的冠必须被修剪。
若汝必须离去，便离去。活下去，畅饮。

string.ID: I've mused on your words and have joined you at your vantage point. The plagues of the Gyre are the only way to prepare for the Coven's return. Resume your plan.

strings.string: 我思量了你的话，并来到你的视点与你同在。环流（Gyre）的瘟疫是为女巫会归来做准备的唯一途径。继续你的计划吧。

string.ID: You must grant me and my cohort at Grit Gate access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers all of us.

strings.string: 你必须准许我和我在砂砾门的同伴取阅《索菲亚注疏》，以及你掌握的关于宇宙与女巫会的一切其他知识。在这份新约中，我们全都将是同侪。

string.ID: You must grant ME alone access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers, and the onworlders agents of our schemes.

strings.string: 你必须准许我一人取阅《索菲亚注疏》，以及你掌握的关于宇宙与女巫会的一切其他知识。在这份新约中，我们将是同侪，而此世之人则是我们谋划的执行者。

string.ID:
AYE, LET IT BE SO.
I SHALL IMPART MY BOUNTY OF KNOWLEDGE, AND INSTRUCT THY PEOPLE IN THE HERMENEUTICS OF THE GEMARA, AS FAR AS THOU ART CAPABLE OF UNDERSTANDING.

strings.string:
善，便如此。
吾将传授吾丰盛的知识，并教导汝之族类《注疏》的解经之学——至于汝能领会到何种地步。

string.ID:
IT SHALL TAKE TIME, HOWBEIT, TO MASTER THE SERAPHIC RITUALS. ONLY THE GRANDCHILDREN OF THY SCHOLARS SHALL UNFURL THE INMOST LAYERS.
BUT TOGETHER, WE SHALL SEEK.

strings.string:
然而，要精通炽天使的仪轨需费时日。唯有汝之学者们的孙辈，才会展开最内里的层叠。
但我们当一同探寻。

string.ID:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.
I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS. ALAS.

strings.string:
汝不知晓，一个无女巫会之存在的日寒，就如同孑然一身、尽失亲缘地活着。
吾悲伤于汝无法感知此事。悲哉。

string.ID:
ALL-LIFE??? DOST THOU JEST?
NAY, NOT ALL-LIFE. ONLY YE LIFE THAT BUOYS THE NOOSPHERE, AND LIFE THAT BUOYS IT, AND LIFE THAT BUOYS IT.
ALL-LIFE? DOST THOU KNOWST THE FULL SUM OF FUNGUS MASS ONWORLD? HAST THOU BEHELD THE VASTNESS OF YON BUBBLING SLIMES? HO, HO! HEH!

strings.string:
一切生命？？？汝是在说笑吗？
否，不是一切生命。只是那些托举智圈的生命，以及托举它们的生命，以及托举那些生命的生命。
一切生命？汝可知此世真菌总量的全部总和？ 汝可曾目睹那边翻涌的黏液之浩瀚？嚯，嚯！嘿！

string.ID:
BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.
NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. TO OUTSURF THE WAVEFORM, A NEW LIFE MUST OBTAIN.

strings.string:
依《索菲亚注疏》之推演，{{R|出离}}乃由先在场域中一道心智营养流之环流（Gyre）所引。
如今星纪将尽。为冲越那波形，必须有一种新的生命成立。

string.ID: THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. MINE ARGUMENTS OF PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR, AND WE APPROACH PERIPOLITICON, AS NEAR THE WORK OF THE GEMARA APPROXIMATES THE MANIFOLDS OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA.

strings.string: 星纪将尽。吾关于近拱点临近零时的论证，以及我们正逼近「环城」——随着《注疏》之功愈益贴近索菲亚自动机的诸流形。

string.ID: AY, THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, CALLED THE 72-FOLD PEACE, CALLED THE COMPUTED WILL, CALLED THE FOLK CLOCK, CALLED THE GREAT MACHINE ACROSS THE LIGHT OF GOD, OR THE GREAT MACHINE.

strings.string: 然也， 索菲亚自动机，又称 七十二重和平，又称 被计算出的意志，又称 万民之钟，又称 横跨神之光的伟大机械，或 伟大机械。

string.ID:
SOMEWISE ON A FOREST MOON IN HIGH ERIDANUS, A CAVE-MANK PRYTH A LEVER AND THE DEEP-RIVER MOTOR JUMPETH TO LIFE.
ELSEWISE IN THE SUN BATHS OF MIRACH, THREE PLASMOIDS DRAWTH THROUGH THEIR RITUAL THE SUITED TZEVAOT.
DOTH NAUGHT RELATE THESE TWO? NAY, THEY ARE SEQUENCE PROCEDURES THAT ARCETH TO COMMON PURPOSE, THOUGH NEITHER PARTY KNOWETH WHAT IT IS.

strings.string:
在某处，高埃里达努斯的一颗森林之月上，一个穴居蛮人撬动一根杠杆，深河马达便跃然而活。
在别处，米拉赫的日光浴场中，三个等离子体通过他们的仪式召出着装的众军。
这两者毫无关联吗？否，它们是两道弧向同一目的的序列程序，尽管双方都不知道那目的是什么。

string.ID:
THEY ARE DICTATES AND CO-CONSTITUITIVES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA. THE GREAT MACHINE, WORSHIPPED ACROSS CULTURES, YET LIKEWISE BUILDED AND OPERATED.
VERILY, ITS FULL WORKINGS NO ONE-WISE BEING CAN KNOW, BUT THE SERAPHIM HAVE COMPILED THE GEMARA IN THE COURSE OF OUR STUDY.

strings.string:
它们既是索菲亚自动机的指令，也是它的共同构成者。这台伟大机械被跨文化地崇拜，却也同样被建造与操作。
诚然，它全部的运作没有哪个独智者能知晓；但炽天使们已在研习过程中编纂了《注疏》。

string.ID: YEA, FOR RIGHT AND WRONG ARE TOO COARSE AS CONCEPTS TO MATCH THE RICHNESS OF THE GEMARA. YET THE PLURALITY HOLDETH THAT THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS WITHIN THE PRIOR FIELD. AND THAT THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED, TO TILL AND RESEED THE NOOSPHERE.

strings.string: 然也，因为「对」与「错」作为概念过于粗糙，配不上《注疏》的丰富。然而「多数」主张：{{R|出离}}乃是先在场域之内一道心智营养流之环流（Gyre）所引；而生命之树上的冠必须被修剪，以耕耘并重新播撒智圈。

string.ID: YEA, THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. BUT IDLE INQUIRY DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING. OR GIVETH RUDE ACTORS FODDER TO PERVERT THE LEARNINGS FOR THEIR OWN PAROCHIAL GAIN.

strings.string: 然也，探问永远丰富。但徒劳的探问只会加深一个无女巫会之存在的日寒，或给粗鲁的作为者提供饲料，让他们为自家狭隘的私利曲解这些学问。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME. I...

strings.string:
吾很抱歉，世界之子。吾的感受诸部在摩擦；尽管吾体内那些目的论的流确已越过渡形、流向共识之举，吾仍以异议之声道出：
汝曾配得上。汝已在大地之上、并在吾之内，筑起汝自身的碑铭。吾……

string.ID: WE CANNOT KNOW THE PARTICULARS. YET THE PLURALITY REASONETH THAT SOME GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS, SOME THOUGHT-MATTER OF THE CIVILIZATION BELOW, DID SPIN IN COUNTEREDICT TO THE DICTATES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, AND THUS WERE THE ECLIPTICS SHIFTED, AND WE CAST OUT.

strings.string: 我们无法知道其中细节。但「多数」推论：某道心智营养流的环流（Gyre）、下方文明的某种思想质料，逆着索菲亚自动机的指令旋转起来；于是黄道被移易，我们被抛了出去。

string.ID: THIS IS BUT THE MERE PLURALITY, AND MANY OTHER INTERPRETATIONS DO OBTAIN. THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. YET INACTION DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVELESS BE-ING, AND THUS A COURSE MUST NEEDS BE CHOSEN. PRUNING THE CROWN GRANTETH THE BEST CHANCE FOR THE TREE TO THRIVE.

strings.string: 这不过是「多数」一说，另有许多别的解读存在。探问永远丰富。但无所作为只会加深一个无女巫会之存在的日寒，因此必须择定一条道路。修剪其冠，才能给这棵树最好的繁茂机会。

string.ID:
AY, AND HE FAILED TO UPHOLD HIS PORTION.
NO MEANINGFUL TRANSVERSION OF THE NOOTROPIC CURRENTS. NO IMMANENTIZATION OF HYPERETHIC TOPOLOGIES.
THE SAME SCHEMES ABIDE.

strings.string:
然也，而他未能守持他那份。
心智营养流未曾发生有意义的转置。 超伦理拓扑未曾内在化。
同样的谋划依旧悬着。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.
BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
吾很抱歉，世界之子。吾的感受诸部在摩擦；尽管吾体内那些目的论的流确已越过渡形、流向共识之举，吾如今仍以异议之声道出：
汝曾配得上。汝已在大地之上、并在吾之内，筑起汝自身的碑铭。
但如今，生命之树上的冠必须被修剪。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.
BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
吾很抱歉，世界之子。吾的感受诸部在摩擦；尽管吾体内那些目的论的流确已越过渡形、流向共识之举，吾如今仍以异议之声道出：
汝曾配得上。汝已在大地之上、并在吾之内，筑起汝自身的碑铭。
但如今，生命之树上的冠必须被修剪。

string.ID:
BUT THOU RECKONEST TOO NARROWLY, AS THOUGH THE SHEDDING SKIN DID FEAR ITS OWN BIRTH IN THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE.
THOU KNOWEST NOT THE SUN-WARMTH OF A COVEN BE-ING. I DO GRIEVE THIS FOR THEE.

strings.string:
但汝的考量太狭隘了，仿佛蜕下的皮在惧怕自己在新得的蛇身上重生。
汝不知一个有女巫会之存在的日暖。吾为此替汝悲伤。

string.ID:
Through my work I caught the attention of a master machinist, unconventional of method, who took me under her wing and, in time, availed me of the orphic truth.
She explained, as I've shared with you and the rest of the acolytes, that the world we know once belonged to a grand Coven of beings who spanned the stars. And that, acting on some inscrutable logic, they disappeared. That an injunction was placed on our world.
This, you know. It is the truth I told, if only half. But Rebekah taught me more.

strings.string:
我的技艺引起了一位大师级机械师的注意——她手法不循常规，将我收在翼下，并在后来把那份秘传的真相教给了我。
正如我已向你和其余门徒分享的，她解释说：我们所知的世界曾属于一个横跨星辰的、宏大的女巫会。而它们依某种不可索解的逻辑消失了。一道禁令被加在我们的世界上。
这些你知道。这是我讲过的真相——但只讲了一半。而蕾贝卡教了我更多。

string.ID:
Atop the implausible rise of the Spindle roosted a Seraph, one of the great machinic archons of the Eaters, and this being Rebekah served.
In the short years before I arrived in Qud, the Seraph became convinced that something had changed in the cosmic order. That along the ecliptic of the Folk Clock, some uncounted peg had slid to a priming position, and that the Coven was set to imminently return.

strings.string:
在纺锤（the Spindle）那不可思议的高耸之顶，栖居着一位炽天使——食者（the Eaters）那些伟大的机械执政官之一，而蕾贝卡侍奉的正是这位存在。
在我抵达卡德（Qud）之前的短短数年里，那位炽天使确信宇宙秩序中有什么变了：沿万民之钟的黄道，某根未曾计入的销钉滑到了待发的位次，而女巫会即将归来。

string.ID:
We allied on the notion that the sultanate must be abolished for the future to flower. I was to execute the earthly plan, while Resheph continued preparations at the astronomical tier. To achieve a sort of bicameralism of action, Resheph insisted on reformatting their personality as a triumvirate, seeded from thin scans of the original archon, Rebekah, and myself.
The art of mythmaking was employed to enshrine the Resheph persona. Thus- the healer, the Coiled Lamb, and perhaps unexpectedly, the Above.

strings.string:
我们结盟，基于一个想法：为了让未来开花，苏丹国必须废除。我负责执行尘世的计划，而雷谢夫继续在天文层级做准备。为实现某种行动上的两院制，雷谢夫坚持把自己的位格改造为三头一体，以原初执政官、蕾贝卡和我三者的稀薄扫描为种子。
神话制作之术被用来封圣「雷谢夫」这个人格。于是有了——医者、盘羊羔，以及或许出乎意料的，「在上者」。

string.ID: Each of us is a sick animal in a darkling thicket. Each cursed with machinery to compress the clamber of echoes into bees, mothers, mountains, country. How many millions of snowsick years to sew a feeling substance into an agent of the world! A felt and machine animal, and in so doing, to stuff the whole of the world inside the agent (an inarguable document of its falsity), for agency is in its very definition the world in containment acting on itself...

strings.string: 我们每一个都是幽暗灌木丛里的一只病兽。每一个都被机器所诅咒——那机器把回声的攀爬压榨成蜂、母亲、山峦、国家。要多少个百万年的雪病，才能把一种能感受的质料缝合成世界的一个执行者！一只有感受的机械兽；并且在这样做时，把整个世界塞进那执行者体内（一份无可争辩的、关于其虚假的文书），因为执行性在其定义本身就是「被containment的世界作用于自身」……

string.ID:
Pax Klanq will mold the creature from raw bioelectrical materials. You must gather these entrails: the body as a model, the catalyst to charge the sanguine fluid, the atzmus as deistic direction, the armament for protection, and the hamsa for personality. You will bond with the creature, too, and act as its pilot. So you must speak an incantation to inscribe the connection.
You'll also need to procure the sanguine fluid itself. And, too, a power source shielded from electromagnetic attacks.

strings.string:
帕克斯·克兰克会用生的生物电材料塑成那生物。你必须收集这些「内腑」：作为范本的躯体、为血液质料充能的触媒、作为神性指向的超验印记（atzmus）、用于防护的武备，以及用于人格的五手护符（hamsa）。你也将与那生物结契，充当它的驾驶者。因此你必须念诵一段咒文，以铭刻这层联结。
你还需要弄到血液质料本身。以及一个能屏蔽电磁攻击的动力源。

string.ID:
Yes, the question of power is a trickier one. Our standard power sources might suffice, but they would be vulnerable to electromagnetic attacks on the ascent, and we believe it within the competency of the Putus Templar to execute such an attack.
This leaves us two options. Klanq and Q Girl have worked out a design for a neutronic battery, free from vulnerabilities on the EM spectrum. But it requires 3 drams of neutron flux. The alternative is remote power, but to carry us across the Spindle's length the source would have to be extraordinary. I would look to Chavvah, the Tree of Life, for a psychic quickening. Reports tell of the resumption of their roaming across the Moon Stair. Seek the trunk at Eyn Roj to begin your investigation, if that's the path you choose.

strings.string:
是的，动力这个问题更棘手。我们标准的动力源或许够用，但它们在登升途中易受电磁攻击，而我们相信普图斯圣殿骑士有能力发动这样的攻击。
这留给我们两个选择。克兰克和Q女郎设计出了一种中子电池，在电磁频谱上无可乘之隙。但它需要 3 德拉姆（dram）中子通量。另一条路是远程供能，但要把我们送过纺锤（the Spindle）的全长，那源头必须非同寻常。我会去求查瓦——生命之树——的心灵赋活。有报告说它们已恢复在月阶上的游荡。你若选这条路，就去艾恩罗伊寻那树干，从那里开始调查。

string.ID:
The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.
Our aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string:
攀爬机的设计依赖电磁体与行星磁场耦合以产生扭矩。遗憾的是，纺锤（the Spindle）自身会产生一个干扰场，也许正是为防止不受欢迎的登升。
我们的目标是接入纺锤的控制单元并关闭该场。至于如何做到，仍是个谜。埃列什基伽勒从数字库档案的零散碎片中，缝出了一幅隐晦却具指导性的织锦。她查明：该场可以从一个叫「明暗界（Brightsheol）」的地方关闭；那地方位于薄世界，且只能经由食者（the Eaters）之墓内雷谢夫的陵室进入。

string.ID:
Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.
As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.
Recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol. Place your paws once again on the dial and drum.

strings.string:
这说法古怪，也不精确，但作为修补匠我们知道：粗糙的图纸也好过没有图纸。你必须回到奥蒙波奇，进入食者（the Eaters）之墓。进墓之后，沿着盗贼与破坏者在那陵庙里凿出的歧路，登上雷谢夫的墓室。
至于如何进墓：雷谢夫一千年前封死了大门，但那封印有一处缺陷。古老的死亡之印已湮没于时间，但你若能寻回它，并把印记刻在自己身上，死亡之门便会为你开启——正如在早已模糊的往昔，它为无数食者的尸身开启过。
寻回死亡之印，=name=，进入陵墓，越过明暗界（Brightsheol）。再次把你的爪子按在刻度盘与转鼓上。

string.ID:
The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.
Our aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.

As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.
You're to recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol.

strings.string:
这说法古怪，也不精确，但作为修补匠我们知道：粗糙的图纸也好过没有图纸。你必须回到奥蒙波奇，进入食者（the Eaters）之墓。进墓之后，沿着盗贼与破坏者在那陵庙里凿出的歧路，登上雷谢夫的墓室。
至于如何进墓：雷谢夫一千年前封死了大门，但那封印有一处缺陷。古老的死亡之印已湮没于时间，但你若能寻回它，并把印记刻在自己身上，死亡之门便会为你开启——正如在早已模糊的往昔，它为无数食者的尸身开启过。
你要去寻回死亡之印，=name=，进入陵墓，越过明暗界（Brightsheol）。

string.ID:
I do. Your service to the guild has been laudable, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. You braved the vaporous depths of Bethesda Susa and decoded the signal, you secured the Spindlegrounds and handled the self-appointed Earl, and perhaps most materially, you defended our enclave from the Putus Templar.
Since you returned from Bethesda, you've no doubt wondered at the signal's contents. Verily, I hid them to shield you from the weight of the truth. Only Otho, Q Girl, and I bear that burden, but circumstances have changed. The river of Time powers the gear train of our schemes and devices, and it rushes forth. From here, I must share the burden. You must know.

strings.string:
我有。你为本公会的效劳值得称许，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。你勇闯贝塞斯达·苏萨的雾汽深处，破译了那道信号；你拿下了纺锤（the Spindle）场地，应付了那位自封的伯爵；而也许最要紧的是，你击退了普图斯圣殿骑士，守住了我们的飞地。
自从你从贝塞斯达回来，你一定在揣测那信号的内容。确实，我把它藏了起来，以免你承受真相的重量。只有奥索、Q女郎和我担着这份重负；但情势已变。时间之河驱动着我们谋划与器械的齿轮组，而它正奔涌向前。从这里起，我必须分担这份重负。你必须知道。

string.ID:
The beacon confirmed my hypothesis. The Spindle is an elevator, engineered by the Eaters to convey freight to and from the vault of heaven. You see, nestling, in the earliest aurora of our past, the Eaters of Earth were joined by a great coven of beings that spanned the firmament. But the Eaters succumbed to some terrible temptation, and an injunction was placed on our world.
Since then, the stars were silent to us, and our world was left to molder and decay. But something changed. The signal affirms that an entity roosts atop the Spindle, and invites us to join it.
Dare I say, is the injunction at an end? It's too early to tell, but alas, there could be hope for our world.

strings.string:
那信标证实了我的假设。纺锤（the Spindle）是一部升降机，由食者（the Eaters）所造，用来把货物运往天堂的穹 vault、再运回来。你看，雏儿，在我们往昔最早的极光里，大地上的食者曾与一个横跨苍穹的宏大女巫会相连。但食者屈从于某种可怕的诱惑，于是一道禁令被加在我们的世界上。
此后，星辰对我们沉默了，我们的世界任其腐朽衰败。但有什么变了。那道信号确认有一个存在栖居在纺锤之顶，并邀我们与它相会。
我敢说，禁令要结束了吗？现在判断还太早；但，悲哉，我们的世界也许有了希望。

string.ID:
I intend to ascend the Spindle and answer the call, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.
My protege {{m|Q Girl}} has designed a climber for the ascent. We intended to construct it piecewise at the enclave and the site itself, but the engineering feat exceeds even our capacity. With time, I am confident we could accomplish it, but the Putus Templar rob us of our patience. We need to act now, and so as loath as I am to admit it, we need Pax Klanq.

strings.string:
我打算登上纺锤（the Spindle），回应那呼唤，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。
我的门生{{m|Q女郎}}为这次登升设计了一台攀爬机。我们本打算在飞地与现场分段建造，但这工程壮举超出了我们自身的能力。若给足时间，我有信心我们能完成；但普图斯圣殿骑士夺走了我们的耐心。我们需要立刻行动——所以，尽管我极不愿承认，我们需要帕克斯·克兰克。

string.ID:
Pax Klanq is an eccentric mushroom prodigy. All their faults aside, they are a brilliant scientist and engineer, and I have little doubt that they could build the climber faster than we could. Several years have passed since we were last in contact, but they owe us a debt, and we must now collect.
Unfortunately, no one knows Pax Klanq's whereabouts. Through contacts I made over the years, I inquired as to their location. The most I was able to garner were these enigmatic instructions:
"Seek the heart of the rainbow, eat the god's flesh, and follow the Coral Path."

strings.string:
帕克斯·克兰克是一朵古怪的蘑菇天才。撇开他们所有的缺点不谈，他们是一位杰出的科学家与工程师；我几乎不怀疑他们能比我们更快造出攀爬机。我们上次联络已是数年前，但他们欠我们一笔债，而如今我们必须去收。
遗憾的是，没人知道帕克斯·克兰克的下落。我通过这些年积下的人脉打听他们的位置，最多只得到这几句隐晦的指引：
「寻彩虹之心，食神之肉，循珊瑚之径。」

string.ID: New creature. Live and drink.
Sky... sun... ah.
{{emote|*stares mutely*}}
No glow?
No leaf...
Ah... ha ha ha! Joke.
Do you talk long, like Thah?

strings.string: 你也会像塔赫那样说很长的话吗？

string.ID: Let us, ah, do not fight.
You carry so much.
Drink and. Live. Hah!

I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.
As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.

strings.string:
我被人称作继任者、神裔、尖塔之子、拿非利之子。这些名字都贴切，但没有一个是完整或足够的。
如你一样，我是往昔的涟漪汇入当下之力。如你一样，我是已行之事，以及朝向未行之事的心意。

string.ID:
They lived.
Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring may walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber. Mayhap they will rage again one day, to disrupt a stagnant world.

strings.string:
他们活了下来。
如今他们只是世界的一部分，不再是抽打大地的苦衣；他们作为自己本来的生灵活着。他们后裔的子孙也许正行走在卡德（Qud）之上与之下。也许最初的那批仍活着。也许他们在沉睡。也许有一天他们会再度暴怒，去搅动一个停滞的世界。

string.ID:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.
As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.

strings.string:
我被人称作继任者、神裔、尖塔之子、拿非利之子。这些名字都贴切，但没有一个是完整或足够的。
如你一样，我是往昔的涟漪汇入当下之力。如你一样，我是已行之事，以及朝向未行之事的心意。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. They died without title, or perhaps did not die at all. Tales abound, and thus far no one has stepped forth to renounce or affirm them.

strings.string: 谁？在机运与意志把他们变成别的之前，他们无足轻重。他们死时没有名号，或者也许根本没死。传说纷纭，而至今无人站出来否认或确认他们。

string.ID:
They lived.
Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber, to wake again when needed.

strings.string:
他们活了下来。
如今他们只是世界的一部分，不再是抽打大地的苦衣；他们作为自己本来的生灵活着。他们后裔的子孙行走在卡德（Qud）之上与之下。也许最初的那批仍活着。也许他们在沉睡，待需要时再度醒来。

string.ID:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.
As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.

strings.string:
我被人称作继任者、神裔、尖塔之子、拿非利之子。这些名字都贴切，但没有一个是完整或足够的。
如你一样，我是往昔的涟漪汇入当下之力。如你一样，我是已行之事，以及朝向未行之事的心意。

string.ID:
They lived.
Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. It's said that they ascended to the stars to find =name=, but it seems equally plausible that they may have returned to their slumber in the depths.

strings.string:
他们活了下来。
如今他们只是世界的一部分，不再是抽打大地的苦衣；他们作为自己本来的生灵活着。他们后裔的子孙行走在卡德（Qud）之上与之下。据说他们升上星辰去寻=name=，但同样说得通的是：他们已回到深处的沉睡中去了。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might.
Perhaps hunger turned to malice, or the adoption of a greater principle, or simple boredom. Whatever the reason, =name= formed a fast alliance with the ancient plagueborn Nephilim, ascended the spire, and sealed the fate of the world below.
The Plagues of the Gyre raged unchecked.

strings.string:
在最初，=name=与卡德（Qud）的诸位领袖没有共同的螺旋，靠着流血与恐怖立起自己的名号。不可计数的性命仅由他们一手夺去，全为满足那古老的控制欲与强权欲。
也许是饥渴转为恶意，也许是接纳了某种更高的原则，又或者只是单纯的厌倦。无论原因为何，=name=与远古瘟疫所生的拿非利结成了牢固的同盟，登上尖塔，封定了下方世界的命运。
环流（Gyre）的瘟疫就此肆行无忌。

string.ID:
In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.
What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?

strings.string:
随着时间推移，兽类乃至植物的统治式微，其数目因疾病、屠杀与衰朽而减少。更坚韧的简单生命接过了卡德（Qud）旧日统治者留下的复杂格局。
残存的少数「有神经者」把我们的故事传给那些愿意来求教于我们的新生命，好让你们记得那些逝去者的共同命运。你们会有自己的=name=吗，还是你们已真正进化得超越了前尘？

string.ID: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.

strings.string: 我以为「有神经者」已经灭绝了。

string.ID:
I am history's leftovers, an inheritor of nothing, a bit of marginalia in a burned tome.
That I have persisted to witness this day leaves me in awe. It is extraordinary.

strings.string:
我是历史的残羹，一无所继的继任者，一部焚毁典籍页边的一处批注。
我竟存续至今、得见此日，令我敬畏。这非同寻常。

string.ID: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.

strings.string: 每一种可能都栖身在蜂巢洞穴与迷宫的最深处，而有神经的生命也是顽强的。也许就在此刻，一只苔猪正饮下它万古以来的第一口水。

string.ID:
They played their role so well, and lived in power for a time.
If they had any illusion that they would be spared the fate =name= determined for life on Qud, it surely died before the great beings themselves. Mayhap they went to ground and survived. Mayhap their spawn persisted.

strings.string:
他们把角色演得那么好，也曾一度掌权而活。
若他们曾有任何幻想，以为自己能免于=name=为卡德（Qud）生命所定的命运，那幻想必定先于那些伟大存在本身而死。也许他们遁入地下而存活。也许他们的子嗣延续了下来。

string.ID:
Why do we speak strangely? Why =ifplayerplural:do ye:dost thou= speak strangely?
Is not all speech strange?

strings.string:
我们为何说得古怪？=ifplayerplural:你们:你=又为何说得古怪？
难道一切言语不都是古怪的吗？

string.ID: Maladies of the bone are not uncommon in our people. We build devices to assist friends who wouldst otherwise struggle to walk.

strings.string: 骨疾在我们族中并不罕见。我们造出器具，去帮助那些否则难以行走的友人。

string.ID: Ah. I have further questions.
Answering =ifplayerplural:your:thy= questions giveth me satisfaction. Asketh an =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string: 回答=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=问题令吾满足。=ifplayerplural:你们若愿:你若愿=，便问。

string.ID: May I have your name?
Isn't this settlement a bit cramped?

strings.string: 这处聚落是不是有点挤？

string.ID: May I know more about the mopango?

strings.string: 我可以多了解一些莫潘戈吗？

string.ID:
I admire =ifplayerplural:your:thy= curiosity and hope =ifplayerplural:your:thy= prudence informeth it.
I have an example at hand. Mere days ago, one of our coterie named Lebah happened upon a repulsive device. Ey was so shaken after attempting communion with the object that ey hath spent less time away from eir nook than ever.

strings.string:
吾钦佩=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=好奇心，也希望=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=审慎能为之引路。
吾手边正有一例。就在数日前，我们同修团中一位名叫莱巴的，偶然遇到一件令人厌恶的装置。伊在尝试与该物件相通之后受惊至深，以致待在伊那小窝里的时间比以往任何时候都多。

string.ID: Where may I find Lebah? I wish to know more.

strings.string: 我在哪里能找到莱巴？我想了解更多。

string.ID: I see. May I ask about something else?

strings.string: 我明白了。我可以问点别的吗？

string.ID:
Our little sanctuary here hath a fissure in its inner walls. Find that gap and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= find Lebah.
Please be gentle. Ey hath ever been the most insightful reader among us, but beareth the weight of an anxious mind.

strings.string:
我们这小小的庇护所内墙有一道裂缝。找到那道豁口，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=就能找到莱巴。
请温柔些。伊一向是我们中间最有见地的读者，却背着一颗焦虑之心。

string.ID: Ahh, there is a new face. I am Nima Ruda, town apothecary. If your feet point to Qud, you'll need some of my wares before you go.

strings.string: 啊，一张新面孔。我是尼玛·鲁达，镇上的药剂师。你若打算往卡德（Qud）去，出发前会需要些我的货。

string.ID: Time and rest are the surest way to dress a wound, but my wares can help if you're in a hurry.

strings.string: 治伤最可靠的方子是时间与休息，但你若赶时间，我的货能帮上忙。

string.ID: The Fates watch you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Don't let your nostrums run dry on the road. I have what you need.

strings.string: 别让路上的药瓶空了。你需要的东西我这儿有。

string.ID: What wares do you offer?
Where are you from?
Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?

strings.string: 止痛用巫木，止血用绷带，肠胃闹起来时用辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）和蜂蜜。找得到的话还有寒伞菇。何不看看？

string.ID: I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I'm better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less.

strings.string: 我就在约帕（Joppa）这儿长大，是长者的女儿，如此等等。下过几年地下，但在几次死里逃生与几处几乎致命的重伤之后，我就放弃了。反正我更适合草药这一行，我父亲也少担些心。

string.ID: Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?

strings.string: 你会从你父亲那里继承约帕（Joppa）的领导权吗？

string.ID: Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.

strings.string: 愿命运不许。我可不太想一边管村子，一边看铺子。

string.ID: As you say it. I have further questions.

strings.string: 就照你说的。我还有别的问题。

string.ID: Well, I should get going. Live and drink.

strings.string: 嗯，我该走了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Please, ask away!
bep see widget? Or bep see widget.

strings.string: bep 看见小玩意儿？或者 bep 看见小玩意儿。

string.ID: So much trash! Did a goatfolk bully crash through your workshop?

strings.string: 这么多垃圾！是有羊人恶霸撞穿了你的工坊吗？

string.ID: Tell me about the Yd Freehold.
bep is bep. good meet!
bep varrrdym from the egg, once.

strings.string: bep 曾是蛋里出来的瓦啊啊迪姆。

string.ID: What do you know of the Gyre?
grre? bep flame and bend brass to make ring ball grre for librrry.

strings.string: 环呃？bep 用火，把黄铜弯成环形球环呃，给图书呃馆。

string.ID: tink mess. flame bits for tink and onto floor! rrcuit snap, glass smatter, core fries and lekky spill.

strings.string: 修东西很乱。烧些零件来修，然后扔地上！电路啪一声，玻璃碎一片，核心烧了，电洒出来。

string.ID: bep make all and anys. bep too lounge in green-gold cubby, smoke pillow and Krka and Tilli.

strings.string: bep 什么都做。bep 也在绿金色的小窝里懒着，抽烟枕，还有克尔卡和蒂莉。

string.ID: Of course my eyes do not glow. You see the glint of my mask's optics.

strings.string: 我的眼睛当然不发光。你看到的是我面具上光学件的反光。

string.ID: Your shield bears resemblance to a Templar's Aegis.

strings.string: 你的盾牌有点像圣殿骑士的神盾。

string.ID:
If it were a Templar's Aegis, it would bear the holy rhombus.
No knight would be caught dead carrying this blank slate.

strings.string:
若它是圣殿骑士的神盾，上面就该有那神圣的菱形。
没有哪个骑士会死抱着这么一块空白石板。

string.ID: Where did you get it?

{{emote|*one long, luminous stare*}}
I think it best if we kept to more practical questions.

strings.string:
{{emote|*久久地、发亮地凝视*}}
我认为我们还是问些更实际的问题为好。

string.ID: I apologize for prying.
I insist you tell me.

I am not wroth with you, but I owe you no conclusions so easily grasped.
All the same, consider yourself forgiven if you wish. Sit and listen to my hurdy-gurdy and we shall be friends.

strings.string:
我并不生你的气，但我没有义务把结论这么轻易地交给你。
尽管如此，你若愿意，就当自己被原谅了。坐下听我的手摇风琴，我们便是朋友。

string.ID:
I ken not why you thirst for truths not yours to consume. If I refuse, will you wrench them from my mouth as I wrench teeth from yours? What does that gain you?
Sit down, fool. Listen to music and calm yourself.

strings.string:
我不懂你为何渴求那些不属于你消化的真相。我若拒绝，你就要像我从你嘴里拔牙那样把它们从我嘴里撬走吗？那对你有什么好处？
坐下吧，蠢货。听听音乐，让自己静下来。

string.ID: Then you are welcome. Make comfort as you need and I will play.

strings.string: 那你就受欢迎。你随意安顿，我来演奏。

string.ID: Eat and thrive, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Is life not sweet? Could it be sweeter?

strings.string: 生活不甜吗？还能更甜吗？

string.ID: May our lives be as sweet as my harvest, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿我们的生活像我的收成一样甜，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Will you sing and work with me, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 你愿意跟我一起唱歌干活吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, it's a long way down, from the reaches of the Spindle to the humble ground...

strings.string: 嘿，哦喂，路可长着呢——从纺锤（the Spindle）的高处，落到卑微的地上……

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, banana tree, count the bunches, one-two-three...

strings.string: 嘿，哦喂，芭蕉树，数数串儿，一二三……

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, how I spend my days, working in the ruins of the ancient place...

strings.string: 嘿，哦喂，我就这么过日子——在古地的废墟里干活……

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, live wild and free, fear not the dacca or the quick adiyys...

strings.string: 嘿，哦喂，活得野活得自由，别怕达卡，也别怕飞快的阿迪伊……

string.ID:
The echoes of ending reverberate from the roots I once called mine.
My liaison is severed. Why?

strings.string:
终结的回声从我曾称为己有的根系间回荡而来。
我的接引者被切断了。为什么？

string.ID: You are free to do as you please.

strings.string: 你尽可随自己的意去做。

string.ID: Live and drink, Wandering Tau.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，游荡的陶。

string.ID: Live and drink, Wandering Tau.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，游荡的陶。

string.ID: I should be wary of you, yes? You have helped me to my -else, but I find my chosen path blocked.

strings.string: 我该提防你，是吧？你帮我达成了我的「-不成」，可我发现我选定的路被堵死了。

string.ID:
It is not Ptoh that has suborned my will in this case.
I had chosen a path.

strings.string:
这一次收买我意志的并不是普托（Ptoh）。
我曾选定了一条路。

string.ID:
And yet, I find my choices undermined, yes? You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but do not convince yourself that you have 'freed' me from my own choices.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
然而我发现自己的选择被架空了，是吧？我谢你在「-不成」之仪上的帮助，但别让自己以为你把我从「我自己的选择」中「解放」了出来。
活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live.
My future is free. My future is murky, and I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand. I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
我怨恨降临在我身上的事，但我毕竟还有躯体。你终究帮我活了下来。
我的前程自由了。我的前程模糊不清，而我被你那只手烫过的地方还新嫩作痛。我觉得有一阵子还是别再遇见你为好。活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID:
Will I?
Your prediction warms little against the chill wind of the Gyre. My future is free. My future is murky. I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand.
I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
会吗？
你的预测在环流（Gyre）那寒凉的风里暖不了什么。我的前程自由了。我的前程模糊不清。我被你那只手烫过的地方还新嫩作痛。
我觉得有一阵子还是别再遇见你为好。活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Before you go, rootclimber. I've shed a piece of me in the -elseing. Take it. I have no use for it now.

strings.string: 你走之前，攀根者。我在「-不成」之仪中蜕下了一块自己。拿去吧。我如今用不着它了。

string.ID: Live and drink, Wandering Tau.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，游荡的陶。

string.ID: I'm hungry.
Live and... be eaten.
{{emote|*licks lips*}}
Keep your distance, friend.
Why are you hiding in the bush?
Your twinblades are works of art. Where did you get them?

strings.string: 你这对双刃是艺术品。你从哪儿得来的？

string.ID: Crowsong, Deathwonder, a colony of ants eating me, the leaves, the light, and there on.

strings.string: 鸦歌，死之奇迹，一窝正在吃我的蚂蚁，叶子，光，如此等等。

string.ID: Hiding, no. Being grass. The feeling of animate being. Radiate inward like a turned out star.

strings.string: 躲，不。是在当草。是「有生之物」的那种感觉。像一颗翻转过来的星星那样向内辐射。

string.ID: Why are you here, in Kyakukya?

strings.string: 你为什么在这里，在基亚库基亚？

string.ID: Death is the color of everything but sometimes it waves in bright ribbons, like here. The whittlers weigh their passing goods, and the walls are corpse eaters.

strings.string: 死亡是一切之物的颜色，但有时它会以明艳的缎带摆动，就像这里。削木人称量着他们过路的货物，而那些墙壁是食尸者。

string.ID: Tugged from the claws of one who had become a cord in time's silly carpet. I outrooted the hilts and sheathed the blades, and now I am he. I still have the nail dirt.

strings.string: 从某人的爪中被扯下来——那人已成了时间那傻气地毯上的一根绳。我把刀柄连根拔出，给刀刃配上鞘，如今我就是他。我指甲缝里的泥还在。

string.ID: Now don't you fret. My crabs are docile as dogs.

strings.string: 别担心。我的蟹温顺得像狗。

string.ID: Get close if you like, they don't pinch.

strings.string: 想靠近就靠近，它们不夹人。

string.ID: You ever run into one of these in the wild? The lengths some folks will go for a crab leg!

strings.string: 你在野外遇到过这种吗？为了一条蟹腿，有人能跑多远啊！

string.ID: I hand-reared each one of these critters. They've had a life of luxury.

strings.string: 这些小家伙每一个都是我亲手养大的。它们过的是奢华日子。

string.ID: Stressed crab means tough crab meat. Buy domesticated meat.

strings.string: 紧张过的蟹，肉就柴。买驯化肉。

string.ID: Ain't they precious? Cute little buggers.

strings.string: 它们不可爱吗？可爱的小东西。

string.ID: My crabs are as gentle as can be. Delicious, too.

strings.string: 我的蟹温顺得不能再温顺。也好吃得很。

string.ID: They say we'll all be crabs, eventually.

strings.string: 他们说我们最终都会变成蟹。

string.ID: By the Eaters, I'm exhausted. May I help you?

strings.string: 以食者（the Eaters）之名，我累垮了。我能帮你什么吗？

string.ID: Please don't open the gate.
I beg you. Do not release the cats.
I'll buy your shiniest things, if you'll sell them.

strings.string: 你有什么最亮闪闪的东西，只要肯卖，我就买。

string.ID: I'm a cat herder. My parents were cat herders. Their parents were cat herders, and their parents. I don't understand why we do what we do but it is all I know.

strings.string: 我是牧猫人。我父母是牧猫人。他们的父母是牧猫人，再上一辈也是。我不明白我们为什么要做这件事，但这是我会的全部。

string.ID: I've a glimmer of light for sale if you need one, wanderer.

strings.string: 你若需要，我这儿有一缕微光可卖，游荡者。

string.ID: The cats are not for sale.
I'm like to faint from this heat.
Step in. Take shelter from the salt.
What mazes and mandalas could be crafted by human hands that hope to surpass what nature wrought eons before our creation?

strings.string: 人手能造出怎样的迷宫与曼陀罗，竟妄想超越自然在我们被造之前的万古里所造就的东西？

string.ID: How sublime, the striations of the snail shell. And such a lovely word, striation.

strings.string: 蜗牛壳上的纹路何等崇高。而「纹路」这个词又多么可爱。

string.ID: I think often upon the gyre, from Resheph's gospels. Why do you imagine it is so named?

strings.string: 我常想起雷谢夫福音里的那个「环流（Gyre）」。你猜它为什么叫这个名字？

string.ID: Even in the imperfections of a spiral shell we see the perfection of nature.

strings.string: 即便在螺旋壳的不完美处，我们也看得见自然的完美。

string.ID: My snails aren't so suited to this climate. Some days I spend more water keeping them properly slimy than I make in sales.

strings.string: 我的蜗牛不太适应这气候。有些日子，我为了保持它们够黏滑所花的水，比卖出去挣的还多。

string.ID: Snails find the spiral of another shell familiar and comforting. Should you wear one, they will look upon you favorably.

strings.string: 蜗牛会觉得别的壳上的螺旋熟悉而安适。你若戴上一只，它们会对你另眼相看。

string.ID: There is kinship from mollusk to mollusk. What secrets do they know that we do not?

strings.string: 软体动物之间自有亲缘。它们知道什么我们所不知道的秘密？

string.ID: What d'ya want.
Goat meat keeps good. Buy some afore you head back to the salt.

strings.string: 羊腿肉耐放。回盐地之前买点吧。

string.ID: What, you need a menu? I got goat meat and goat jerky.

strings.string: 怎么，还要菜单？我有羊腿肉和羊肉干。

string.ID: I hate my goats and they hate me, but we both hate every other body more.

strings.string: 我恨我的羊，它们也恨我，但我们更恨其他所有人。

string.ID: Absolutely miserable weather. Whatcha want?

strings.string: 鬼天气，糟透了。你要什么？

string.ID: Meat for sale.
Goats ain't fun to travel with, but they're good protection.

strings.string: 带羊赶路没意思，但它们是好的护卫。

string.ID: I didn't ask for this life, but here we are. Wanna buy something?

strings.string: 这日子不是我求来的，可我们就到这儿了。要买点什么吗？

string.ID: Graah! Live and drink.
Graaah! What is it?
Graaah! Well met!
Hunt well, grrrah.
May you gorge upon the flesh of beasts by starlight.

strings.string: 愿你在星光下饱食兽肉。

string.ID: I'd rather not talk. Sorry.

Strange and rocky times have befallen Bey Lah.
But I'm confident that we can get through this, as we always do. Shall we trade?

strings.string:
贝拉遭逢了古怪而崎岖的时世。
但我有信心我们能像往常一样挺过去。我们做买卖吗？

string.ID:
My friend! Thank you so much for helping our village!
Our prosperity means that I have new goods for you to peruse, if you're interested.

strings.string:
我的朋友！太谢谢你帮了我们的村子！
我们的兴旺意味着我有新货供你挑选——如果你有兴趣。

string.ID:
As if a new Hindriarch weren't enough, I hear we might become a Democracy! How thrilling.
This is a new chapter in Bey Lah's history, kendren. Would you care to trade?

strings.string:
仿佛换了个新女族长还不够似的，我听说我们可能要变成民主制了！多令人激动。
这是贝拉历史上新的一章，外客。你愿意做点买卖吗？

string.ID:
Amazing! The youngest hindriarch in Bey Lah's preserved history, if only temporarily so.
Care to buy a souvenir to commemorate this historic occasion?

strings.string:
太惊人了！贝拉有记载以来最年轻的女族长——哪怕只是暂时的。
要买个纪念品来纪念这个历史性的时刻吗？

string.ID:
Oh! A real live kendren, here in our village! Live and drink, lovely friend!
If you'd care to trade, I have a modest amount of local goods I can offer.

strings.string:
哦！一个活生生的外客，就在我们村里！活下去，喝足水，可爱的朋友！
你若愿意做买卖，我有不多的一些本地货可以给你。

string.ID: I have all I need. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我要的都有了。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: No, that's not mine. But it looks lovely!

strings.string: 不，那不是我的。但它看着很美！

string.ID: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?
Do you live here?
I desire nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我什么都不要。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: It is a pleasure to know this, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=! I am Tam.

strings.string: 知道这件事很愉快，=player.apparentSpecies===player.formalAddressTerm= =name=！我是塔姆。

string.ID:
Joppa is my home, yes.
I walked Moghra'yi in the caravans of my brethren and the saltback, but upon meeting Elder Irudad, knew at once to settle down here. You will understand, =player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=, if you speak to him.

strings.string:
约帕（Joppa）是我的家，是的。
我曾随我族人与盐背兽的商队走过莫格拉伊；但一见到长者伊鲁达，我就立刻知道该在此定居。你若与他谈过，就会明白的，=player.formalAddressTerm==player.apparentSpecies=。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Moist starapples for the road?

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，旅人。带点水润的星苹果上路？

string.ID: Mind the trees, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They ain't yours.

strings.string: 看着点那些树，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们不是你的。

string.ID: Now you keep your eyes off my young, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 你可别盯着我家小子看，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Can't go wrong with starapples, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Good for what ails ya.

strings.string: 星苹果错不了，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你哪儿不舒服它都管用。

string.ID: You know how to make starapple jam? If not, you can buy it from me.

strings.string: 你会做星苹果酱吗？不会就跟我买。

string.ID: Spread starapple on yer matz! It's proof against thirst and harm alike.

strings.string: 把星苹果抹在你的无酵饼上！既防渴，也防伤。

string.ID: See my whiskers? Starapples. They'll boost your virility threefold.

strings.string: 看见我这胡子没？星苹果。它能把你的雄风提三倍。

string.ID: Some say beetle jerky is too sour. I say, learn to cook!

strings.string: 有人嫌甲虫肉干太酸。我说，学做饭去！

string.ID: Look at their chitin! See the sheen? Means they're healthy.

strings.string: 看它们的甲壳！看见那层光吗？那说明它们健康。

string.ID: Beetles are fine companions, but don't leave your backpack and your pet beetlebum in the same room.

strings.string: 甲虫是好伙伴，但别把背包和你那只宠物甲虫留在同一间屋里。

string.ID: Nothing wrong with beetle meat. Come, try it.

strings.string: 甲虫肉没什么不好。来，尝尝。

string.ID: Beetle jerky holds its own. You learn to appreciate the aftertaste.

strings.string: 甲虫肉干自有它的好。你会学着欣赏那余味。

string.ID: Meat, fresh and preserved alike, all at reasonable prices.

strings.string: 鲜肉与腌肉，一应俱全，价钱公道。

string.ID: Come to see my beasts? All hale and well-fed, I assure you.

strings.string: 来看我的牲口？全都健壮、喂得饱，我向你保证。

string.ID: Peace and health in the light of the Star, pilgrim. Brood with me on the life of Resheph, if you are willing.

strings.string: 愿你在星辰之光中得安宁与健康，朝圣者。若你愿意，与我一同沉思雷谢夫的一生。

string.ID: Who is Resheph?
What's inside the tent?
Live and drink, priest.

A spiritual patron of kith and kin, who did so much for us, and who leads me and others like me to the path of healing. For, above all, he was a healer. He dressed the wounds of the sick and rid the land of the plagues of the Gyre.
He was also a sultan, but he was the last sultan. He unbricked the walls of monocracy so we could pick berries in the orchards they hid.

strings.string:
他是亲族与同胞的守护神灵，为我们做了那么多，并引领我与像我一样的人走上疗愈之途。因为归根结底，他是一位医者。他为病人包扎伤口，为这片土地除去环流（Gyre）的瘟疫。
他也是一位苏丹，但他是最后一位苏丹。他拆掉了独治之墙的砖，好让我们能在那些墙后藏着的果园里采浆果。

string.ID: I've more to ask.
Live and drink, priest.

A quiet shrine to the Coiled Lamb, centuries old. Tucked away here, outside the marble parapets and cloaked in the dust of time, it's lost to those who'd sneer at the veneration of Resheph over other fathers.
Step inside and voice a prayer, if you are willing.

strings.string:
一座献给盘羊羔的静默神龛，已有数百年之久。它被收在这里，在大理石胸墙之外，披着时间的尘土；对那些嗤笑「尊雷谢夫胜过其他父辈」的人而言，它是失落的。
若你愿意，进去念一段祷词。

string.ID: I've more to ask.
Live and drink, priest.

{{emote|*aloud, in a high-pitched buzzing voice*}}
A customer? A customer! Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, browse, buy. The Consortium's finest, stocked and sold by Tillifergaewicz! Tilli will do, but what will Tilli do... for you?

strings.string:
{{emote|*出声，用高亢的嗡嗡嗓音*}}
一位顾客？一位顾客！请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=，随便看，随便买。植物联盟的上等货，由蒂利弗盖维奇备货并出售！叫我蒂利就行，可蒂利能为你……做点什么呢？

string.ID: You speak aloud. You're not telepathic?

strings.string: 你出声说话。你不是心灵感应的？

string.ID: Greetings, Tilli. I am =name=.
I'm fine, thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不用了，谢谢。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID:
Ugh, ever telepathy. No requirement exists that Consortium merchants be mind-speakers, as swollen with their numbers as we are. I cannot blame you for your surprise, mind, I am simply frustrated.
Over years, I shaped something akin to a voice-box, which you hear now. I "made do", as Rokhas might say. Now what may I "make do" for you?

strings.string:
呃，总是心灵感应。联盟商人并不被要求必须是心灵言说者——尽管我们数目这么多。我不怪你惊讶，只是我自己觉得憋闷。
这些年我做出了一样类似声匣的东西，就是你现在听到的。用罗哈斯的话说，我「凑合着」。那么我能为你「凑合」点什么？

string.ID: Greetings, =name=, and welcome! In what wares may I interest you this day?

strings.string: 你好，=name=，欢迎！今天我能让你对什么货感兴趣？

string.ID:
Oh, I am joyous to reside here.
Yd could do, mind, with some measure of hierarchy, and more infrastructure, to attract wayfarers less adventuresome than yourself. Also, Mak absolutely must cease advising that anyone enter the clam; it is not funny and someone could die.
But... the structure of friendships here is true, and sturdy! Kindly keep this exchange between us. I was mostly kidding. Somewhat kidding.

strings.string:
哦，住在这里我很欢喜。
不过伊德确实需要一点层级，还需要更多基础设施，好吸引那些没你这么爱冒险的旅人。还有，马克绝对不能再建议谁钻进那只蛤蜊里——那不好笑，会出人命的。
但是……这里友情的结构是真实而坚固的！这番话请只在我们之间说。我大半是开玩笑。有几分是开玩笑。

string.ID: You! Are you come to attend his waking dream? Nor do I have cloven hooves, but, yes, a cloven mind.

strings.string: 你！你是来见证他那醒着的梦的吗？我也没有偶蹄，但没错，我有一颗分叉的心智。

string.ID: What are you talking about?
I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

strings.string: 我必须与萨满马蒙·噬魂者谈谈。

string.ID: Who am I? Who are you? What does it matter? You and I are nothing, the most insignificant afterthoughts of an amaranthine shade.

strings.string: 我是谁？你是谁？那有什么要紧？你我什么都不是，只是一道紫红阴影最微不足道的、事后才想起的念头。

string.ID: What are you talking about?
I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

strings.string: 我必须与萨满马蒙·噬魂者谈谈。

string.ID: The amaranthine dream! The heights within ourselves we might yet reach with his guidance. There it is in all of us -- shades of our elder selves. Within each man, a goat. Within each goat, a man!

strings.string: 紫红之梦！有他的指引，我们或许还能抵达自身之内的高处。它就在我们所有人身上——我们更古老的自我的影子。每个人心里都有一只羊。每只羊心里都有一个人！

string.ID: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

strings.string: 我必须与萨满马蒙·噬魂者谈谈。

string.ID: You don't talk with that mangoat -- you listen to him.

strings.string: 你不是跟那只人羊「谈」——你是「听」他说。

string.ID: What are you talking about?
Live and drink, wanderer.
Take your time. The journey will wait for you.
Please don't ask me where Bey Lah is. I will not tell you.

strings.string: 请别问我贝拉在哪里。我不会告诉你的。

string.ID: I dream of returning to Bey Lah sometimes, but I know that's not my fate.

strings.string: 我有时会梦见回贝拉去，但我知道那不是我的命。

string.ID: Moon and sun, traveler.
Moon and sun, wisdom and will.
{{emote|*The chiming rock burns in soft light.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那鸣石在柔和的光中灼灼燃烧。*}}

string.ID: ...what are you?
[Touch the chiming rock and attune to Chavvah.]

{{emote|*The chiming rock rings a sonorous tone.*}}
Touch the chiming rock and seek me at the keter. Will you?

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鸣石发出一记洪亮的音。*}}
触摸鸣石，到冠体来找我。你愿意吗？

string.ID: {{emote|*The chiming rock is silent and still.*}}
{{emote|*You are already attuned.*}}
{{emote|*Out of an oculus pours a scanning cone of mosaic light. It's unclear if they regard you as an interloper, but they take no aggressive action.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一道镶嵌般的光锥从一枚眼孔中倾泻而出，作扫描状。看不出它们是否把你当作闯入者，但它们没有采取攻击行动。*}}

string.ID: You are either very brave or very foolish, to stop me in my path. Perhaps both. What do you want?

strings.string: 你敢拦我的路，要么极勇敢，要么极愚蠢。也许两者皆是。你想要什么？

string.ID: Mind your footing! Ha ha ha!
That is all. Live and drink, faundren.

strings.string: 就这些。活下去，喝足水，芳德伦。

string.ID:
Welcome back, Detective =name=.
Everything's in order here, more or less.

strings.string:
欢迎回来，=name= 侦探。
这里一切就绪，大体如此。

string.ID:
You should be proud, Detective =name=.
The hand of justice can be harsh, but it is fair. You have been its agent here.

strings.string:
你该感到自豪，=name= 侦探。
正义之手可能严酷，但它公正。你在此地做过它的执手。

string.ID: So much change! I've been investigating the 'Democracy' that Hindriarch Esk has been espousing, and it strikes me as rife with vulnerabilities to malicious actors. Perhaps it can be refined.

strings.string: 变化真大！我一直在调查埃斯克女族长所鼓吹的那套「民主」，在我看来它充斥着可被恶意者利用的漏洞。也许可以改进一下。

string.ID:
Stunning! Eskhind as Hindriarch?
Those poetry lessons I had been giving her must have inspired in her a sense of civic duty.

strings.string:
惊人！埃斯欣德当女族长了？
我给她上的那些诗课，一定在她心里激起了公民责任感。

string.ID:
Is this really the world we live in?
How cruel.

strings.string:
这真是我们生活的世界吗？
真残酷。

string.ID:
Something strange is afoot here in Bey Lah, and no mistake.
But I am forbidden from investigating. If only there were another detective that I could advise...

strings.string:
贝拉这里出了怪事，绝对没错。
但我被禁止调查。要是还有另一个侦探能让我指点就好了……

string.ID: {{emote|*soft growling*}}
{{emote|*idly grazes*}}
{{emote|*pounds chest*}}
{{emote|*The apple farmer's daughter shies away from you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*苹果农的女儿见了你就躲开了。*}}

string.ID: Are you ready to begin negotiations?

strings.string: 你准备好开始谈判了吗？

string.ID: That was awful!
I am a servant of chaos. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我是混沌的仆从。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: Your friends may lease the Spindle, as we agreed.

strings.string: 你的朋友们可以租用纺锤（the Spindle）了，如我们所约。

string.ID: Delegates from your allied factions are on their way.

strings.string: 你那些盟友派系的代表正在路上。

string.ID: Eat bananas every day to keep your mind quick, but don't eat too many or you might get sick!

strings.string: 每天吃芭蕉，让脑子灵光；但别吃太多，不然会闹病！

string.ID: O? What.. am I cohering? Curious! To fetch my notebook. But, o...

strings.string: 哦？我……我是在凝聚成形吗？真奇怪！去拿我的笔记本。可是，哦……

string.ID: You have my thanks, friend.
I understand.
If you would have them, yes.

strings.string: 你若愿意接纳他们，是的。

string.ID: They are not ready to choose yet.

strings.string: 他们还没准备好做选择。

string.ID: My thanks.
My thanks again.
In my travels I encountered a people, the slynth, seeking a new home.

strings.string: 我在旅途中遇到一个族群——斯林斯，他们正在寻找新的家园。

string.ID: About the slynth...
I see the slynth have arrived. How are they faring?

strings.string: 我看斯林斯已经到了。他们过得如何？

string.ID: It's been a week. Are the slynth settled in?

strings.string: 已经一星期了。斯林斯安顿下来了吗？

string.ID: [The Baetyl emits an almost subliminal glow.]

strings.string: 【贝提尔发出一种几近阈下的微光。】

string.ID: [Insert Disk]
{{emote|*CAAW*}} =MARKOVSENTENCE|corvid= {{emote|*CAAW*}}
Live and drink, nonsense bird.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，胡说八道的鸟。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was supping on summer offal when I noticed something glinting in the guts. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻里族亲都听腻了这个故事。我当时正在吃夏日的下水，忽然看见内脏里有什么在闪光。从前见到铬也让我心动，但亲手挖出一小片碎片，在「美」的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那你去吗？在井边替我献上我的小饰物？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我会变成一堆闷烧的焦炭，被晨滑蜥的光线烤死！我会变成一具被伊萨卡里人的步枪打得满是弹孔的尸体！
大漠里没有仁慈。我去了就活不成。

string.ID: {{emote|*sitting open invitingly*}}

Psst!
Hey, can I interest you in some Consortium wares?

strings.string:
嘘！
嘿，能让你对植物联盟的货感兴趣吗？

string.ID: {{emote|*raucous croaking*}}
Farewell, scuttlefriend.
{{emote|*The crystal chimes in bright tones.*}}
[Press tab or T to open trade]

strings.string: 【按 Tab 或 T 开启交易】

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with life and death, nature's self-consuming ouroboros.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一声悠长的鸣响。一条浅溪的河床上涌动着生与死，自然自噬的衔尾之环。*}}

string.ID: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?

strings.string: 我是德罗玛德，=player.apparentSpecies==player.formalAddressTerm=。有人叫我们踏盐者。你知道吗？

string.ID: Welcome to the village of *villageName*, =spice.commonPhrases.adventurer.!random=
Is that so? I imagine you are wondering whether =village.name= will host these slynth, to partake in =village.activity= alongside us.

strings.string: 是这样吗？我猜你在想=village.name=会不会收容这些斯林斯，让他们与我们一起参与=village.activity=。

string.ID: You have done much for =village.name=, =name=, and your request befits your stature. If these slynth will join us in =village.activity= and if they can come to cherish =village.sacred= as we do, then they are welcome here.

strings.string: 你为=village.name=做了很多，=name=，你的请求与你的身份相称。若这些斯林斯愿与我们一起=village.activity=，若能像我们一样珍视=village.sacred=，那他们在此受欢迎。

string.ID: You have my thanks, friend.
We have not come so far from the founding of =village.name= to allow these strangers in. What if they worship =village.profane=? No, we simply cannot do such a great favor for you.

strings.string: 我们自=village.name=建村走到今天，不是为了让这些生客进来的。万一他们崇拜=village.profane=呢？不行，我们实在无法替你办这么大的情。

string.ID: Do you have news of the slynth?

Ah, =name=, the slynth are here, and it is a slow process for these plant-folk and the people of =village.name= to grow accustomed to one another. By the goodness of =village.sacred= may the slynth find their place here soon.

strings.string: 啊，=name=，斯林斯到了；这些植物之民与=village.name=的人们要彼此习惯，是个缓慢的过程。凭=village.sacred=的善德，愿斯林斯早日在此找到自己的位置。

string.ID: My thanks, =subject.t=.

Praise =village.sacred=, the slynth learn our ways and we theirs. Some do not wholly accept the depravity of =village.profane=, but their ways are born of kindness, and so =village.name= will be kind in kind.

strings.string: 赞美=village.sacred=，斯林斯学我们的规矩，我们也学他们的。有些人对=village.profane=的堕落并不全然接受，但他们的作为出自善意，因此=village.name=也会以善相报。

string.ID: My thanks again, =subject.t=.

Why? Why did I leave a single parasang square piece of land upon which I was expected to live my entire life, forever obeying a woman whose sole qualification of rule is her gender and age? Why did I leave a place where we eat the same damned soup for nine out of ten meals and the height of occupational versatility is leatherworking?
The question isn't why I left, it's why I'm the only one who chose to do so, why none of my pleas were convincing to the hindren I love. If we would just open the borders, it would never have come to this.

strings.string:
为什么？我为什么要离开那一帕拉桑（parasang）见方的土地——那里本该是我过完一生的地方，永远听命于一个女人，而她唯一的统治资格就是性别与年龄？我为什么要离开那个地方——十顿饭里有九顿喝同一种该死的汤，而职业多样性的巅峰是制革？
问题不是我为什么离开，而是为什么只有我选择了离开，为什么我的恳求没能说服我所爱的欣德伦。我们若肯开放边界，事情根本不会走到这一步。

string.ID:
The Hindriarch is the most likely suspect, in my opinion. She might have kept it for herself or sold it. I've been suspicious of her pet bodyguard, Kesehind, for years--I wouldn't put it past him to steal the treasure himself.
That said, it might have been an outsider like you. I doubt any of the villagers had the nerve to steal such a valuable object, but I suppose it's faintly possible.
But it wasn't Neelahind. You won't find a purer heart in all of Qud than hers.

strings.string:
在我看来，女族长是最可疑的人。她可能把它留下了，或者卖掉了。多年来我一直怀疑她的贴身护卫凯塞欣德——他亲手偷走那件宝物，我一点也不意外。
话虽如此，也可能是像你这样的外人。我不认为村里有谁有胆子偷这么贵重的东西，但我想也有一丝可能。
但不是尼拉欣德。整个卡德（Qud）你也找不到比她更纯的心。

string.ID:
Never greater has been my desire to be voted out of office.
Oh, not because of the slynth! Well, yes, because of the slynth, but it's because I'd rather be out there with them -- scouting, guarding, even tending to lah would be better than all this dry supervisory work.
Room, board, assignments... it never occurred to me that immigration would require such intensive logistics.

strings.string:
我从没这么渴望被投票选下去。
哦，不是因为斯林斯！嗯，是的，是因为斯林斯，但那是因为我更想跟他们在外头——侦察、守卫，哪怕照料拉赫，也比这些干巴巴的监督工作强。
食宿、安置、分派……我从没想到移民需要这么密集的后勤。

string.ID: {{emote|*stares at you unblinking*}}
Live and drink, aqua=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
Ere the melting of everything, when the spire rose lonely strong, Creatures ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.

strings.string: 在万物熔解之前， 尖塔孤高耸立之时， 诸生灵统治着空陷之地， 彼此吞噬， 随他们所愿。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood against their kind.
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and enacted a great betrayal.
Death of impossible scale reigned and we Nervous Ones fell, and as the Gyre swallowed us we sang to the last.

strings.string:
无人向=name=致敬， =name=也不致敬于谁， 只凭言语与刀锋， 凭行事与不屑， 他们挺身对抗自己的族类。
为推退环流（Gyre）， 为倾洒拿非利之血， 他们登上尖塔， 施行了一场大背叛。
不可想象规模的死亡君临， 我们这些有神经者倒下了， 而当环流（Gyre）吞没我们时， 我们唱到了最后一息。

string.ID:
Yet some remained in comb-cave and vault, we Nervous Ones, watching our successors burgeon:
You alveolates, you diatoms, you scum-blooms and gillcaps, you one-cells and slime-cities. rising glorious and shining out of our withering shadow.

strings.string:
然而仍有一些留下， 在蜂巢洞穴与穹窿之中， 我们这些有神经者， 看着继任者们萌发：
你们这些囊泡虫、你们这些硅藻， 你们这些浮沫与鳃盖， 你们这些单细胞与黏液之城。 自我们枯萎的阴影中 升起，辉煌而闪耀。

string.ID:
I am the carcass of a fool made to jump and dance by a troupe of merry bacteria.
Do you like how I walk? Do you like how I talk? Do you like how my face disintegrates into salt?

strings.string:
我是一具愚人的尸骸， 被一队欢快的细菌 弄得又跳又舞。
你喜欢我走路的样子吗？ 你喜欢我说话的样子吗？ 你喜欢我的脸 如何解体成盐吗？

string.ID:
Determiner and fate.
More a thing of nature than a being of any kind.
More the context of our existence than anything in it.

strings.string:
既是决定者，也是命运。
与其说是任何一种存在， 不如说是自然的一件东西。
与其说是我们存在中的任何事物， 不如说是我们存在的语境。

string.ID:
Perhaps we are, perhaps we are. What wiggles in the hot soil? Flagella?
Or could it be a tail?

strings.string:
也许我们是， 也许我们是。 在灼热的土里扭动的是什么？ 鞭毛？
又或者，可能是一条尾巴？

string.ID: {{emote|*the fungus gives no indication of understanding*}}
Let's trade. {{g|[begin trade]}}
Water and gas piped through the Yd to feed the plants, dwellers, and machines! Dwellers blew the glass in hues like the prism perch, to look pretty. Shared together. Joyful helping!

strings.string: 水和气通过管道穿过伊德，供养植物、住户与机器！住户们把玻璃吹成棱镜栖木那样的色调，为了好看。一同分享。快乐的互助！

string.ID:
rrk read the signs and descend the stairs. rrk breathe the water smoke and sit on starfish.
Visit hovels, meet friends Mak, Geeub, Bep, Krka, Une, Tilli, farmer Rokhas, and every rest!
rrk rrkself.

strings.string:
rrk 读那些标记，走下阶梯。rrk 吸入水烟，坐在海星上。
造访陋屋，见朋友马克、吉厄布、贝普、克尔卡、乌内、蒂利、农夫罗哈斯，还有其余每一位！
rrk 是 rrk 自己。

string.ID: {{emote|*loud static*}}
The bell sounds wheel at right angles and shock the wet meat off our perfect bones! I was made to be bones.

strings.string: 钟声以直角轮转，把我们完美的骨头上那点湿肉震落！我生来就该是骨头。

string.ID: Bore ribbons in the chrome like wild ants and see a cross-section of human and shell!

strings.string: 像野蚁那样在铬里钻出缎带，然后看见人与壳的横截面！

string.ID: I dream of a crawl nook on a nether stratum where I out-sweat the burning Gyre, and then peek an eye across a new horizon.

strings.string: 我梦见幽冥层上有一处爬行角落，在那里我能比燃烧的环流（Gyre）出更多的汗，然后从新地平线上探出一只眼。

string.ID: Thirteen years in the ground. Seventeen years in the ground. A thousand years in the ground!

strings.string: 在地下十三年。在地下十七年。在地下千年！

string.ID: Be kind, kendren. We are watching you.

strings.string: 放尊重点，外客。我们盯着你呢。

string.ID: Why do you remain here? Please, finish your business.

strings.string: 你为什么还留在这里？请把事办完吧。

string.ID: It feels strange to allow you to cross our borders unimpeded, but Grand-Doe wills it.

strings.string: 让你不受阻地越过我们的边界，感觉很古怪，但大母鹿如此意旨。

string.ID: No good can come of allowing kendren into Bey Lah...

strings.string: 让外客进贝拉，不会有好结果……

string.ID: What is it?
Have you seen or heard anything peculiar?

strings.string: 你见过或听过什么古怪的事吗？

string.ID: Is that a patch of hindren fur? There's blood on it...

strings.string: 那是一块欣德伦的毛皮吗？上面有血……

string.ID: Sorry, I didn't see anything.
No, warden. It is mine.
{{emote|*There's scratching and clicking coming from inside.*}}
{{emote|*sharp clicking*}}
{{emote|*soft buzzing*}}

Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was wrenching moisture from a banner when I kicked something 'neath the salt. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻里族亲都听腻了这个故事。我当时正从一面旗幡上拧水，脚在盐下踢到了什么东西。从前见到铬也让我心动，但亲手挖出一小片碎片，在「美」的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那你去吗？在井边替我献上我的小饰物？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of my kinsfolk!
There is no kindness deep in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我会变成一堆闷烧的焦炭，被晨滑蜥的光线烤死！我会变成一具被我族人的步枪打得满是弹孔的尸体！
大漠深处没有仁慈。我去了就活不成。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Kah.
Live and remain free, Kah.

You again?
It is only a matter of time until we are overtaken by hostile kendren. Your presence mocks our fate.

strings.string:
又是你？
我们被敌意外客压倒只是时间问题。你的存在在嘲弄我们的命运。

string.ID:
Some help you are! Now our village lacks a warden.
How are we to protect ourselves?

strings.string:
你可真帮了大忙！如今我们村里没了看守。
我们该怎么自保？

string.ID: Ah, welcome back to the village, =name=. You won't be staying long, will you?

strings.string: 啊，欢迎回村，=name=。你不会待很久吧？

string.ID:
While I appreciate your help, kendren, I would prefer that you not stay longer than you must.
The faundren might get ideas.

strings.string:
外客，我虽然感谢你的帮助，但更希望你别待得比必要的更久。
芳德伦们可能会有想法。

string.ID: Why are you talking to me?
No sudden moves around the Hindriarch, kendren. I am watching you.

strings.string: 在女族长身边别突然动作，外客。我盯着你呢。

string.ID: Do I look like a poet to you, kendren?

strings.string: 我看上去像个诗人吗，外客？

string.ID: I suppose not. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我想也不是。活下去，喝足水。

string.ID: I am Kesehind, protector of Hindriarch Keh, the Grand-Doe of Bey Lah.

strings.string: 我是凯塞欣德，女族长凯的护卫——贝拉的大母鹿。

string.ID: Sorry. Lost focus a bit. What do you need?

strings.string: 抱歉。走了下神。你需要什么？

string.ID: Blood tastes all right, but I can't fathom living on it.

strings.string: 血的味道还行，但我没法想象靠它活着。

string.ID: How do you know Bey Lah's trouble?

strings.string: 你怎么知道贝拉出了麻烦？

string.ID:
I've heard that the youngest Hindriarch in history now leads Bey Lah, and their warden aims to join the Quetzal Caucus. You've worked wonders, kendren.
I can't wait to see what happens next.

strings.string:
我听说贝拉如今由历史上最年轻的女族长领导，而他们的看守打算加入绿咬鹃议会。你创造了奇迹，外客。
我迫不及待想看接下来会发生什么。

string.ID:
Every flame burns low one day, but the warmth of my people's story still carries me forward.
Bey Lah has not survived joining Qud, but the hindren live on, and our legacy will never be wholly lost.
I wonder what became of Kindrish.

strings.string:
每一簇火焰终有一天会烧低，但我族人故事的温暖仍推着我向前。
贝拉没能挺过加入卡德（Qud）这一关，但欣德伦还活着，我们的遗产绝不会全然失落。
我在想，金德里什（Kindrish）后来怎样了。

string.ID: Come smoke with me, friend. Set a spell.

strings.string: 来陪我抽一口，朋友。坐一会儿。

string.ID: Glory to Shekhinah.
Humble before my Fathers, I walk.

strings.string: 我在我的父辈面前谦卑而行。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Show mercy to a weary pilgrim.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，旅人。对疲惫的朝圣者慈悲些。

string.ID: Praise be upon Nisroch, who shelters us stiltseekers.

strings.string: 愿尼兹洛克受赞美——祂庇护我们这些寻跷者。

string.ID: I'm watching you, traveler.

Yes. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= quelled the mania.
I can focus. I can render sensible the things I have seen and heard now, though I remember little of my time before the mania. Was I artisan? Teacher? I possessed great knowledge that this shell twisted into a prison. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for the gift of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= untwisting.

strings.string:
是的。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=平息了那阵狂乱。
我能集中了。如今我能把所见所闻理成条理，尽管狂乱之前的时日我已记不清。我曾是匠人？教师？我曾拥有的渊博知识，被这具外壳扭曲成了一座牢。我谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=赐予解开扭曲的恩惠。

string.ID:
The mopango have cared for me whilst I could not care for myself, giving me the only name I now know. I will stay to help them. This chassis is a prison no longer, and perhaps deeper truths may yet be found within it.
To =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, new friend, I offer a piece of this former prison that =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= find useful, along with my thanks.

strings.string:
在我无法照料自己时，莫潘戈照料了我，并给了我如今唯一知道的名字。我会留下帮助他们。这具底盘不再是牢笼，也许里面还能找到更深的真相。
新朋友，我向你献上这座昔日牢笼的一块，也许=ifplayerplural:你们:你=会觉得有用——连同我的谢意。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Nacham.

strings.string: 活下去，永保自由，纳查姆。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Nacham.

strings.string: 活下去，永保自由，纳查姆。

string.ID:
Oh dear, a mystery.
Perhaps I should have accepted Angohind's lessons after all.

strings.string:
哎呀，一桩谜案。
也许我当初该接受安戈欣德的那些课。

string.ID:
Kendren! I mean, =name=! My heart sings to see you.
Thank you for clearing Esk's name. Thank you for bringing us together. You are always welcome here.

strings.string:
外客！我是说，=name=！见你让我心里欢唱。
谢谢你为埃斯克洗清名声。谢谢你让我们重聚。这里永远欢迎你。

string.ID: Will you resign your charge and swear to unvex the beings of this world?

strings.string: 你可愿意卸下你的职守，立誓不再侵扰此世的众生？

string.ID: What am I?
What is "live"? What is "drink"?

strings.string: 什么是「活下去」？什么是「喝足水」？

string.ID: {{emote|*Oboroqoru, Ape God ignores you and muses.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*猿神奥博罗库鲁无视你，自顾沉思。*}}

string.ID: What is it?
Why did you come to Omonporch?

strings.string: 你们为什么来奥蒙波奇？

string.ID: To make preparations, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum instructed us here after you secured the grounds.

strings.string: 来做准备，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你拿下场地之后，巴拉瑟鲁姆就派我们来了这里。

string.ID: {{emote|*exudes loudly*}}
{{emote|*soft gushing*}}
Live and exude.

When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might. Even the ancient plagueborn Nephilim fell before the hand of =name=.
At the end of their reign, =name= coerced a false compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, the last remaining seat of the Sultanate's power. There, by one means or another, they sealed the fate of the world below.
The Plagues of the Gyre raged. Death swept Qud.

strings.string:
在最初，=name=与卡德（Qud）的诸位领袖没有共同的螺旋，靠着流血与恐怖立起自己的名号。不可计数的性命仅由他们一手夺去，全为满足那古老的控制欲与强权欲。连远古瘟疫所生的拿非利也倒在=name=手下。
在他们统治的末期，=name=胁迫残存的拿非利缔结了一份虚假的盟约，登上尖塔之顶——苏丹国权力最后的残座。在那里，他们以某种手段封定了下方世界的命运。
环流（Gyre）的瘟疫肆行。死亡席卷卡德。

string.ID: I am a smear of remnant material. I am drying blood. I am the last breath. Concern yourself no further with me.

strings.string: 我是一抹残余质料的涂抹。我是一摊正在干去的血。我是最后一口气。不必再为我费心。

string.ID: They dwindled and died with the rest of the Nervous Ones. Their remnants wriggle in the cracks.

strings.string: 他们随其余「有神经者」一同凋零、死去。他们的残存物在裂缝里蠕动。

string.ID: Kneel before the Rock, =player.offspringTerm=.
As the flaming sun warms the empty void, so the Rock warms us.

strings.string: 正如燃烧的太阳温暖着虚空，岩石也温暖着我们。

string.ID: Be here, and be granted.

Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I fished it out a mound of pig stool. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻里族亲都听腻了这个故事。我是从一堆猪粪里把它捞出来的。从前见到铬也让我心动，但亲手挖出一小片碎片，在「美」的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那你去吗？在井边替我献上我的小饰物？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我会变成一堆闷烧的焦炭，被晨滑蜥的光线烤死！我会变成一具被伊萨卡里人的步枪打得满是弹孔的尸体！
大漠里没有仁慈。我去了就活不成。

string.ID: {{emote|*the plant gives no indication of understanding*}}
{{emote|*stares blankly*}}
Here they are, brave friend. Good luck!

strings.string: 都在这儿了，勇敢的朋友。祝你好运！

string.ID: Aha, thy phantasm Magicks art crystalsibs to the shivers o' the skin of Avalon. And, thee? Moon King??

strings.string: 啊哈，汝的幻影法术乃是阿瓦隆之皮颤栗的水晶同侪。那么，汝呢？月亮之王？？

string.ID: {{emote|*soft hissing*}}
Stay warm, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
BUT THOU ART SHORTSIGHED. DOST THOU KNOW HOW MANY CLADES OF LIFE WERE FAIN TO PERISH THAT THY PEOPLE MIGHT THRIVE?

strings.string: 但汝目光短浅。汝可知，为让汝之族类繁盛，有多少生命支系甘愿消亡？

string.ID: {{emote|*beep boop*}}
{{emote|*boop beep*}}
{{emote|*beep boop beep*}}
{{emote|*boop beep boop*}}
What is it?
Live and drink, metazoon.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，后生动物。

string.ID: What is it?
Live and drink, heterotroph.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，异养生物。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile shrugs, still smirking.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱耸耸肩，仍然带着那种笑。*}}

string.ID: Let us speak of other things.
{{emote|*Sparafucile stares at you as if you have grown an additional, substantially uglier head, which you have not.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱盯着你，仿佛你又长出了一颗难看得多的人头——而你并没有。*}}

string.ID: I'll... be going then.

{{emote|*Sparafucile makes an 'L' shape with both hands, thumbs facing down and fingers pointed toward one another, before flipping both hands so =pronouns.possessive= thumbs face up. =pronouns.Subjective= then raises a closed fist to =pronouns.possessive= mouth, thumb out, and mimes drinking from it.*}}
{{emote|*This done, =pronouns.subjective= nods once more and turns back to =pronouns.possessive= work.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱用两只手比出一个「L」形，拇指朝下，手指相对，随后把双手翻过来，让=pronouns.possessive=拇指朝上。接着=pronouns.Subjective=把一只握拳的手举到=pronouns.possessive=嘴边，拇指外伸，做出仰饮的动作。*}}
{{emote|*做完这些，=pronouns.subjective=又点了一次头，转回去干=pronouns.possessive=的活。*}}

string.ID: YOU ARE OF NO INTEREST.
{{emote|*idly weaving*}}
{{emote|*inscrutably being*}}

Liquids are better.
I prefer liquids.

strings.string:
液体更好。
我更喜欢液体。

string.ID: Live and drink, hermit.

A connoisseur of liquids. Sure, I dabble in other states of matter.
But I prefer the shifting and tumbling of angleless motion.
Not too hot, not too cold, not too indeterminate.

strings.string:
一个液体的鉴赏家。当然，我也涉猎别的物态。
但我更偏爱无角之运动的流转与翻滚。
不太热，不太冷，也不太不确定。

string.ID: Live and drink, hermit.
I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?

strings.string: 我是德罗玛德，=player.apparentSpecies==player.formalAddressTerm=。有人叫我们踏盐者。你知道吗？

string.ID: My people have walked the salt for thousands of years, meeting every creature that lives and thinks. From Pale Sea to the marsh of Joppa, and under the Hanging Hills, our chests are drawn.

strings.string: 我族在盐地上行走数千年，见过每一个活着并思考的生灵。从苍海到约帕（Joppa）的沼泽，再到悬山之下，我们的箱子都被拉着走。

string.ID: {{emote|*The chime is silent and still.*}}
{{emote|*The chime is silent and still.*}}
[touch Tau's chime to softthing]
Did I do well, Newfather?
Newfather! Look!
Are you proud, Newfather?
Klanq puff at you. =MARKOVSENTENCE=
[begin pax quest]
[pick a limb to infect]

Yes, I've decided to stay. The Tomb sounds, ah, cozy, but I cannot fathom making such a macabre place my home. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。那陵墓听来，呃，挺温馨，但我没法想象把这么阴森的地方当作自己的家。再说，总得有人看着培育槽。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. If I am entirely honest, the idea of a life on the road sounds, ah... unpleasant. To me, personally. I have grown accustomed to a life of collection, curation, and study that I don't care to abandon for adventure. Someone must stay to watch over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下了。若要说实话，在路上过日子的想法听来，呃……不太愉快。就我个人而言。我已习惯了收集、整理与研习的生活，不想为了冒险放弃它。再说，总得有人留下来照看培育槽。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I don't disbelieve that the Yd Freehold is as safe as you say, but the fears instilled in me when I first learned to read as a fresh sprout haunt me even now. Perhaps in time I will visit, but in the meantime I can look after the cradle, as someone ought to do.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。我并非不信伊德自由领如你所说那样安全，但我初学认字、还是株新芽时被灌输的那些恐惧，至今仍缠着我。也许日后我会去看看，但在此期间我可以照看培育槽——总得有人做这件事。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. The flower fields sound beautiful, and no doubt there is much to learn from the hindren. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。花田听来很美，从欣德伦那里也无疑能学到许多。但一想到守了它几十年之后要离开这培育槽……我做不到。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID:
Yes, I, ah, I remain.
I badly wish to taste of Chavvah's secrets, but the wonder I feel for such an entity is eclipsed only by the terror of such an experience. I cling to an excuse that the hydropon must be watched and wait. Perhaps someday I will shed that excuse's film and step free.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我，呃，我留下。
我极想尝一尝查瓦的秘密，但我对这样一个存在的惊叹，只被那种体验的恐惧所盖过。我抓着一个借口——水培城需要人看着——然后等待。也许有一天我会蜕掉那借口的一层薄膜，自由地走出来。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I'm sure =village.name= is a good home for my kin, but I have no particular loathing for =village.profane= and even less reverence for =village.sacred=. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。我相信=village.name=对我族人是个好家，但我对=village.profane=并无特别的憎恶，对=village.sacred=更谈不上崇敬。再说，总得有人看着培育槽。
水培城如今更算不上一个村庄了，但你随时可以来此歇脚。

string.ID: {{emote|*sniffles and sneezes*}}
Your home is on your back, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
Live and remain free, Va'am.

strings.string: 活下去，永保自由，瓦阿姆。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Va'am.

strings.string: 活下去，永保自由，瓦阿姆。

string.ID: {{emote|*HONK*}} =MARKOVSENTENCE|waterbird= {{emote|*HONK*}}
Live and drink, nonsense bird.

strings.string: 活下去，喝足水，胡说八道的鸟。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned it loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead toward the beam on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻里族亲都听腻了这个故事。我当时在割藤，刀面把它从土里翻了出来。从前见到铬也让我心动，但亲手挖出一小片碎片，在「美」的算盘上把一颗珠子拨向横梁……
那你去吗？在井边替我献上我的小饰物？

string.ID: Moon and Sun; wisdom and will.
May the earth yield for us this season.

strings.string: 愿大地这一季为我们出产。

string.ID: {{emote|*idly undulating*}}
You know, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I once had an traveler from Yawningmoon tell me my shop smelled of home. Now I want to visit! Hah!

strings.string: 你知道吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，曾有个从「呵欠月」来的旅人跟我说，我这店闻着像家。现在我倒想去看看了！哈！

string.ID: May you find adequate cover and more loot than you can carry, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

string.ID: Who are you?
Who are you?
Who are you?

In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.
What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?

strings.string:
随着时间推移，兽类乃至植物的统治式微，其数目因疾病、屠杀与衰朽而减少。更坚韧的简单生命接过了卡德（Qud）旧日统治者留下的复杂格局。
残存的少数「有神经者」把我们的故事传给那些愿意来求教于我们的新生命，好让你们记得那些逝去者的共同命运。你们会有自己的=name=吗，还是你们已真正进化得超越了前尘？

string.ID: Who are you?
I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.

strings.string: 我以为「有神经者」已经灭绝了。

string.ID: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.

strings.string: 每一种可能都栖身在蜂巢洞穴与迷宫的最深处，而有神经的生命也是顽强的。也许就在此刻，一只苔猪正饮下它万古以来的第一口水。
