strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆停顿。*}}
哦，=name=，我们的游标在命运那具现象界的计算尺上相遇了！你因揣测而灼烧，而我——我在知晓的凉意中腐朽。我正进入矮星期。

string.ID:
O, deceit! The grueling gate I crossed on every tilt of glittering dusk. I slept in my crimeclothes and wept, did you hear?
Or could you hear only the damnable static, like me, and speak naught to the machine that belches it out. Heal none of the wounds of its grievous heart, or mine own...
O, oh... So much to bear.

strings.string:
哦，欺妄！每当闪耀的黄昏倾侧，我都要跨过那道磨人的门。我穿着罪衣入睡、哭泣，你听见了吗？
还是说，你也同我一样只听得见那该诅咒的静电，对那台喷吐静电的机器说不出一句话。既治不好它那颗悲苦之心的伤，也治不好我自己的……
哦，哦……要承受的太多了。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum exhales with effort.*}}
Let us sort our faculties before we reach the rim of our ascent. There is the edge of our journey still to lathe.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆费力地呼气。*}}
在抵达上升的边缘之前，让我们先理清各自的心智。此行的刃口尚待车削。

string.ID: I cannot say, =name=. But I know it's facile to believe a living heritage can be evanesced in one stroke. We are always downstream of a past violence.

strings.string: 我说不好，=name=。但我知道，以为一份活着的传承能被一击抹去，是轻率的想法。我们永远处在往昔暴力的下游。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum shifts his weight, pauses, and flexes an arthritic paw.*}}
I am sorry. Tis the acceleration, =name=. I am whirling and empty of breath. Steel yourself, and so shall I.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆挪了挪身子，顿了顿，活动了一下患关节炎的爪子。*}}
对不起。是加速的缘故，=name=。我天旋地转，喘不上气。你且稳住，我也会稳住。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}
Child. There is much more I would have liked to share. But... I am a puppet of my shame.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆的神情骤然凝重。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}

With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

strings.string:
用我给你的铬制钥匙卡，你现在可以使用我们的电网。聚落各处都布有链式激光炮位与力场投射器。借埃列什基伽勒的侦察来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过与埃列什基伽勒对接来广播超频指令，或启动罗达尼斯·Y。

string.ID: Ah, =name=. The sight of you is yet a bitter leaf, but you are welcome here.

strings.string: 啊，=name=。见到你仍像一片苦叶，但你在这里是受欢迎的。

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.
Live and drink, wayfarer.
Live and drink, friend.
Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Live and... remain ever rustless.
Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
I must go.
Who are you?
I do.
I do not.
What kind of creature are you?
I am =name=. Who are you?
What can you tell me about the Freehold?

strings.string: 关于自由领，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: I am.
Very well.
You will be happier this way.
How are you feeling?
I am sorry.
Your will would have been suborned to Ptoh.

strings.string: 你的意志本会被普托（Ptoh）收买。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.
Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
I must go.
Who are you?
I must go.
Who are you?
I must go.
Who are you?
I must go.
I tell you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my recipes come from years of experience. There's none the like.

strings.string: 我跟你说，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的配方是多年经验换来的。没有比得上的。

string.ID: Finest food for parasangs! Finest food in Qud! Recipes and samples!

strings.string: 方圆数帕拉桑（parasang）最好的吃食！卡德（Qud）最好的吃食！配方与样品！

string.ID: I will share my food-secrets with you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, if you're willing to make it worth my while.

strings.string: 我愿意把我的食物秘诀分享给你，=player.formalAddressTerm=，只要你愿意让我觉得值当。

string.ID: Do you cook, =player.formalAddressTerm=? So long as you aren't the type to throw whatever local debris you find in the pot, I have wares for you.

strings.string: 你做饭吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？只要你不是那种往锅里乱扔本地捡来的破烂的人，我就有货给你。

string.ID: Not a word of lie, I studied under a chef who studied under Agate Severance Star herself. That's why my recipes are the best.

strings.string: 一句假话都没有：我师从一位厨师，而那位厨师师从玛瑙·断离之星本人。所以我的配方是最好的。

string.ID: Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself.

strings.string: 试试我的配方。你会觉得=player.reflexive=正在厨房七边形里评判那些碳化物厨师。

string.ID: Live and eat, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Hand-coats for sale! Spare your digits the indignity of early removal!

strings.string: 手衣出售！免让你的指头蒙受提早离体的屈辱！

string.ID: Best protect your hands, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You don't know how much you need them until a madpole takes one.

strings.string: 最好护住你的手，=player.formalAddressTerm=。直到被疯梭鱼咬掉一只，你才知道自己多需要它们。

string.ID: Light gloves, heavy gloves, gauntlets. Don't let your hands go bare, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 轻手套、重手套、铁手甲。别让你的手光着，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: One size fits all, =player.formalAddressTerm=. If I sell it to you, it fits.

strings.string: 一个尺码全都能穿，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我卖给你，那就是合你的。

string.ID: How do I get my gloves so supple? I'll never tell.

strings.string: 我的手怎么做得这么柔软？我永远不说。

string.ID: Moving on soon, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My gloves and gauntlets need no maintenance, so finely are they crafted.

strings.string: 快走了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的手套和手甲无需保养，做工就是这么精。

string.ID: Live and eat, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, do come in. Take your time browsing my wares.
Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=, to the sole bastion of class in this wretched place.

strings.string: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来到这破地方唯一的一处品味堡垒。

string.ID: Please knock the sand from your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=. It gets everywhere.

strings.string: 请把脚上的沙跺掉，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它到处钻。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I can certainly help you.
How may I clothe you, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
Now, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I know you must have an eye for fashion, if you're here.

strings.string: 那么，=player.formalAddressTerm=，既然你来了这儿，我敢说你是有时尚眼光的。

string.ID: Oh dear. Who dressed you, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Let me help you, please.

strings.string: 哎呀。是谁给你穿的衣裳，=player.formalAddressTerm=？让我来帮帮你吧，求你了。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Need something to complete your ensemble, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 需要点什么来配齐你这一身吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: With a good hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=, you'll last longer in the salt sun.

strings.string: 有一顶好帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你在盐日下能撑得更久。

string.ID: Peruse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Adorn your head or heads.

strings.string: 随便看看我的货，=player.formalAddressTerm=。装点你的头——或者是几个头。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care for a new topper?
You need a new hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Or a helmet, if that's the life you lead.

strings.string: 你需要一顶新帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=。或者一顶头盔——如果你过的是那种日子。

string.ID: If you're passing through baboon country, you'll want to protect your head, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 你若要从狒狒的地盘过，就该护住脑袋，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
I've the cure for what ails you.

strings.string: 你有什么毛病，我这儿都有药。

string.ID: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.

strings.string: 你气色不太好。你饮食里得加点辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）和蜂蜜。

string.ID: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.

strings.string: 不舒服就用辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）做饭。病发现得够早，就能杀掉它。

string.ID: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: 「止痛，也乱脑。」嚼巫木树皮要当心。

string.ID: Hello, hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=, let's get your weary feet covered.

strings.string: 你好，你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来给你的倦脚裹上点东西吧。

string.ID: Come in, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and let me 'shoe' you around, ha ha!

strings.string: 进来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让我带你「鞋」一圈，哈哈！

string.ID: Boots! Shoes! Slippers! Sabatons! How would you prefer to cover your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 靴子！皮鞋！拖鞋！铁鞋！你想怎么裹你的脚，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Even as high-quality as my products are, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I don't suggest you go walking in the fracti to test them out.

strings.string: 虽说我的产品品质这么高，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我也不建议你去裂隙里走走试试它们。

string.ID: Anything you need to ask 'a boot', =player.FormalAddressTerm=? Just a little cobbler's joke, there.

strings.string: 有什么要问「一靴」的吗，=player.FormalAddressTerm=？就是个鞋匠的小笑话。

string.ID: Hot sands out there, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Is your footwear protecting you?

strings.string: 外头沙子烫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你的鞋护住你了吗？

string.ID: Hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Care to be shod?
Walk a few parasangs in my shoes, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and you'll wonder how you ever did otherwise.

strings.string: 穿着我的鞋走上几帕拉桑（parasang），=player.formalAddressTerm=，你就会纳闷从前是怎么过的。
